dharmāntarā dharmameghā dharmapūrvā dhanāvahā / dharmopadeṣṭrī dharmatmā dharmagamyā dharādharā
kāpālī śākalā mūrtiḥ kalā kalitavigrahā / sarvaśaktivinirmuktā sarvaśaktyāśrayāśrayā
sarvā sarveśvarī sūkṣmā susūkṣmā jñānarūpiṇī / pradhānapuruṣeśeśā mahādevaikasākṣiṇī / sadāśivā viyanmūrtirviśvamūrtiramūrtikā
evaṃ nāmnāṃ sahastreṇa stutvāsau himavān giriḥ / bhūyaḥ praṇamya bhītātmā provācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ
yadetadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ ghoraṃ te parameśvari / bhīto 'smi sāmprataṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamanyat pradarśaya
evamuktātha sā devī tena śailena pārvatī / saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa svarūpamaparaṃ punaḥ
nīlotpaladalaprakhyaṃ nīlotpalasugandhikam / dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ saumyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam
raktapādāmbujatalaṃ suraktakarapallavam / śrīmad viśālasaṃvṛttalalāṭatilakojjvalam
bhūṣitaṃ cārusarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇairatikomalam / dadhānamurasā mālāṃ viśālāṃ hemanirmitām
īṣatsmitaṃ suvimboṣṭhaṃ nūpurārāvasaṃyutam / prasannavadanaṃ divyamanantamahimāspadam
tadīdṛśaṃ samālokya svarūpaṃ śailasattamaḥ / bhītiṃ saṃtyajya hṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm
himavānuvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ / yanme sākṣāt tvamavyaktāprasannā dṛṣṭigocarā
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ pradhānādyantvayi sthitam / tvayyeva līyate devi tvameva ca parā gatiḥ
vadanti kecit tvāmeva prakṛtiṃ prakṛteḥ parām / apare paramārthajñāḥ śiveti śivasaṃśraye
tvayi pradhānaṃ puruṣo mahān brahmā tatheśvaraḥ / avidyā niyatirmāyā kalādyāḥ śataśo 'bhavan
tvaṃ hi sā paramā śaktiranantā parameṣṭhinī / sarvabhedavinirmuktā sarvebhedāśrayā nijā
tvāmadhiṣṭhāya yogeśi mahādevo maheśvaraḥ / pradhānādyaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ karoti vikaroti ca
tvayaiva saṃgato devaḥ svamānandaṃ samaśnute / tvameva paramānandastvamevānandadāyinī
tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ vyoma mahajjyotirnirañjanam / śivaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ brahmā sanātanam
tvaṃ śakraḥ sarvadevānāṃ brahmā brahmavidāmasi / vāyurbalavatāṃ devi yogināṃ tvaṃ kumārakaḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ vyāso vedavidāmasi / sāṃkhyānāṃ kapilo devo rudrāṇāmasi śaṅkaraḥ
ādityānāmupendrastvaṃ vasūnāṃ caiva pāvakaḥ / vedānāṃ sāmavedastvaṃ gāyatrī chandasāmasi
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ gatīnāṃ param gatiḥ / māyā tvaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmasi
oṅkāraḥ sarvaguhyānāṃ varṇānāṃ ca dvijāttamaḥ / āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthyamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ
puṃsāṃ tvamekaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvabhūtahṛdi sthitaḥ / sarvopaniṣadāṃ devi guhyopaniṣaducyate
īśānaścāsi kalpānāṃ yugānāṃ kṛtameva ca / ādityaḥ sarvamārgāṇāṃ vācāṃ devi sarasvatī
tvaṃ lakṣmīścārurūpāṇāṃ viṣṇurmāyāvināmasi / arundhatī satīnāṃ tvaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāmasi
sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu / sāvitrī cāsi japyānāṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam
parvatānāṃ mahāmerurananto bhogināmasi / sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ paraṃ brahma tvanmayaṃ sarvameva hi
rūpaṃ tavośeṣakalāvihīna- magocaraṃ nirmalamekarūpam / anādimadhyāntamanantāmādyaṃ namāmi satyaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
yadeva paśyanti jagatprasūtiṃ vedāntavijñānaviniścitārthāḥ / ānandamātraṃ praṇavābhidhānaṃ tadeva rūpaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
aśeṣabhūtāntarasanniviṣṭaṃ pradhānapuṃyogaviyogahetum / tejomayaṃ janmavināśahīnaṃ prāṇābhidhānaṃ praṇato 'smi rūpam
ādyantahīnaṃ jagadātmabhūtaṃ vibhinnasaṃsthaṃ prakṛteḥ parastāt / kūṭasthamavyaktavapustavaiva namāmi rūpaṃ puruṣābhidhānam
sarvāśrayaṃ sarvajagadvidhānaṃ sarvatragaṃ janmavināśahīnam / sūkṣmaṃ vicitraṃ triguṇaṃ pradhānaṃ nato 'smi te rūpamaluptabhedam
ādyaṃ mahat te puruṣātmarūpaṃ prakṛtyavasthaṃ triguṇātmabījam / aiśvaryavijñānavirāgadharmaiḥ samanvitaṃ devi nato 'smi rūpam
dvisaptalokātmakamambusaṃsthaṃ vicitrabhedaṃ puruṣaikanātham / anantabhūtairadhivāsitaṃ te nato 'smi rūpaṃ jagadaṇḍasaṃjñam
aśeṣavedātmakamekamādyaṃ svatejasā pūritalokabhedam / trikālahetuṃ rapameṣṭhisaṃjñaṃ namāmi rūpaṃ ravimaṇḍalastham
sahastramūrdhānamanantaśaktiṃ sahastrabāhuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam / śayānamantaḥ salile tathaiva nārāyaṇākhyaṃ praṇato 'smi rūpam
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ tridaśābhivandyaṃ yugāntakālānalakalparūpam / aśeṣabhūtāṇḍavināśahetuṃ namāmi rūpaṃ tava kālasaṃjñam
phaṇāsahastreṇa virājamānaṃ bhogīndramukhyairabhipūjyamānam / janārdanārūḍhatanuṃ prasuptaṃ nato 'smi rūpaṃ tava śeṣasaṃjñam
avyāhataiśvaryamayugmanetraṃ brahmāmṛtānandarasajñamekam / yugāntaśeṣaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ nato 'smi rūpaṃ tava rudrasaṃjñam
prahīṇaśokaṃ vimalaṃ pavitraṃ surāsurairarcitāpādapadmam / sukomalaṃ devi viśālaśumraṃ namāmi te rūpamidaṃ namāsi
oṃ namaste mahādevi namaste parameśvari / namo bhagavatīśāni śivāyai te namo namaḥ
tvanmayo 'haṃ tvadādhārastvameva ca gatirmama / tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ yāsye prasīda parameśvari
mayā nāsti samo loke devo vādānavo 'pi vā / jaganmātaiva matputrī saṃbhūtā tapasā yataḥ
eṣā tavāmbikā devi kilābhūta pitṛkanyakā / menāśeṣajaganmāturaho vuṇyasya gauravam
pāhi māmamareśāni menayā saha sarvadā / namāmi tava pādābjaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivām
aho me sumahad bhāgyaṃ mahādevīsamāgamāt / ājñāpaya mahādevi kiṃ kariṣyāmi śaṅkari
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tadā himagirīśvaraḥ / saṃprekṣaṇamāṇo girijāṃ prāñjaliḥ pārśvato 'bhavat
atha sā tasya vacanaṃ niśamya jagato 'raṇiḥ / sasmitaṃ prāha pitaraṃ smṛtvā paśupatiṃ patim
devyuvāca śṛṇuṣva caitat paramaṃ guhyamīśvaragocaram / upadeśaṃ giriśreṣṭha sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ
yanme sākṣāt paraṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ dṛṣṭamadbhutam / sarvaśaktisamāyuktamanantaṃ prerakaṃ param
śāntaḥ samāhitamanā dambhāhaṅkāravarjitaḥ / tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadeva śaraṇaṃ vraja
bhaktyā tvananyayā tāta padbhāvaṃ paramāśritaḥ / sarvayajñatapodānaistadevārcaya sarvadā
tadeva manasā paśya tad dhyāyasva japasva ca / mamopadeśāt saṃsāraṃ nāśayāmi tavānagha
ahaṃ vai matparān bhaktānaiśvaraṃ yogamāsthitān / saṃsārasāgarādasmāduddharāmyacireṇa tu
dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva hi / prāpyāhaṃ te giriśreṣṭha nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyak karma varṇāśramātmakam / adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye satataṃ kuru
dharmāt saṃjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā saṃprāpyate param / śrutismṛtibhyāmudito dharmo yajñādiko mataḥ
nānyato jāyate dharmo vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau / tasmānmumukṣurdharmārtho madrūpaṃ vedamāśrayet
mamaivaiṣā parā śaktirvedasaṃjñā purātanī / ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpeṇa sargādau saṃpravartate
teṣāmeva ca guptyarthaṃ vedānāṃ bhagavānajaḥ / brāhmaṇādīn sasarjātha sve sve karmaṇyayojayat
ye na kurvanti tad dharmaṃ tadarthaṃ brahmanirmitam / teṣāmadhastād narakāṃstāmistrādīnakalpayat
na ca vedād ṛte kiñcicchāstradharmābhidhāyakam / yo 'nyatraramateso 'saunasaṃbhāṣyo dvijātibhiḥ
yāni śāstrāṇi dṛśyante loke 'smin vividhānitu / śrutismṛtiviruddhāni niṣṭhā teṣāṃ hi tāmasī
kāpālaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca yāmalaṃ vāmamārhatam / evaṃvidhāni cānyāni mohanārthāni tāni tu
ye kuśāstrābhiyogena mohayantīha mānavān / mayā sṛṣṭāni śāstrāṇi mohāyaiṣāṃ bhavāntare
vedārthavittamaiḥ kāryaṃ yat smṛtaṃ karma vaidikam / tat prayatnena kurvanti matpriyāste hi ye narāḥ
varṇānāmanukampārthaṃ manniyogād virāṭ svayam / svāyaṃbhuvo manurdhārmān munīnāṃ pūrvamuktavānā
śrutvā cānye 'pi munayastanmukhād dharmamuttamam / cakrurdharmapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi
teṣu cāntarhiteṣvevaṃ yugānteṣu maharṣayaḥ / brahmaṇo vacanāt tāni kariṣyanti yuge yuge
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni vyāsena kathitāni tu / niyogād brahmaṇo rājaṃsteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
anyānyupapurāṇāni tacchiṣyaiḥ kathitāni tu / yuge yuge 'tra sarveṣāṃ kartā vai dharmaśāstravit
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca / jyotiḥ śāstraṃ nyāyavidyā mīmāṃsā copabṛṃhaṇam
evaṃ caturdaśaitāni vidyāsthānāni sattama / caturvedaiḥ sahoktāni dharmo nānyatra vidyate
evaṃ paitāmahaṃ dharmaṃ manuvyāsādayaḥ param / sthāpayanti mamādeśād yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam
brahmaṇā saha te sarve saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare / parasyānte kṛtātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dharmārthaṃ vedamāśrayet / dharmeṇa sahitaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ brahma prakāśayet
ye tu saṅgān parityajya māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / upāsate sadā bhaktyā yogamaiśvaramāsthitāḥ
sarvabhūtadayāvantaḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ / amānino buddhimantastāpasāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
maccittā madgataprāṇā majjñānakathane ratāḥ / saṃnyāsino gṛhasthāśca vanasthā brahmacāriṇaḥ
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ māyātattvasamutthitam / nāśayāmi tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jñānadīpane mā cirāt
te sunirdhūtatamaso jñānenaikena manmayāḥ / sadānandāstu saṃsāre na jāyante punaḥ punaḥ
tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ / māmevārcaya sarvatra menayā saha saṃgataḥ
aśakto yadi me dhyātumaiśvaraṃ rūpamavyayam / tato me sakalaṃ rūpaṃ kālādyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
yad yat svarūpaṃ me tāta manaso gocaraṃ bhavet / tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadarcanaparo bhava
yattu me niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ cinmātraṃ kevalaṃ śivam / sarvopādhivinirmuktamanantamamṛtaṃ param
jñānenaikena tallabhyaṃ kleśena paramaṃ padam / jñānameva prapaśyanto māmeva praviśanti te
tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ / gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
māmanāśritya paramaṃ nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam / prāpyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
ekatvena pṛthaktvena tathā cobhayato 'pi vā / māmupāsya mahārāja tato yāsyāsi tatpadam
māmanāśritya tat tattvaṃ svabhāvavimalaṃ śivam / jñāyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
tasmāt tvamakṣaraṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ cārūpamaiśvaram / ārādhaya prayatnena tato bandhaṃ prahāsyasi
karmaṇā manasā vācā śivaṃ sarvatra sarvadā / samārādhaya bhāvena tato yāsyasi tatpadam
na vai paśyanti tat tattvaṃ mohitā mama māyayā / anādyanantaṃ paramaṃ maheśvaramajaṃ śivam
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ sarvādhāraṃ nirañjanam / nityānandaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ tamasaḥ param
advaitamacalaṃ brahma niṣkalaṃ niṣprapañcakam / svasaṃvedyamavedyaṃ tat pare vyomni vyavasthitam
sūkṣmeṇa tamasā nityaṃ veṣṭitā mama māyayā / saṃsārasāgare ghore jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
bhaktyā tvananyayā rājan samyag jñānena caiva hi / anveṣṭavyaṃ hi tad brahma janmabandhanivṛttaye
ahaṅkāraṃ ca mātsaryaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham / adharmābhiniveśaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitaḥ
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani / anvīkṣya cātmanātmānaṃ brahmabhūyāya kalpate
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ / aiśvarīṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vindetānanyagāminīm
vīkṣate tat paraṃ tattvamaiśvaraṃ brahmaniṣkalam / sarvasaṃsāranirmukto brahmaṇeyavāvatiṣṭhate
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāyaṃ parasya paramaḥ śivaḥ / anantasyāvyayasyaikaḥ svātmādhāro maheśvaraḥ
jñānena karmayogena bhaktiyogena vā nṛpa / sarvasaṃsāramuktyarthamīśvaraṃ satataṃ śraya
eṣa guhyopadeśaste mayā datto girīśvara / anvīkṣya caitadakhilaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kartumarhasi
ahaṃ vai yācitā devaiḥ saṃjātā parameśvarāt / vinindya dakṣaṃ pitaraṃ maheśvaravinindakam
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya tavārādhanakāraṇāt / menādehasamutpannā tvāmeva pitaraṃ śritā
sa tvaṃ niyogād devasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ / pridāsyase māṃ rudrāya svayaṃvarasamāgame
tatsaṃbandhācca te rājan sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / tvāṃ namasyanti vai tāta prasīdati ca śaṅkaraḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena māṃ viddhīśvaragocarām / saṃpūjya devamīśānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
sa evamukto bhagavān devadevyā girīśvaraḥ / praṇamya śirasā devīṃ prāñjaliḥ punarabravīt
vistareṇa maheśāni yogaṃ māheśvaraṃ param / jñānaṃ caivātmano yogaṃ sādhanāni pracakṣva me
tasyaitat paramaṃ jñānamātmayogamanuttamam / yathāvad vyājahāreśāsādhanānica vistarāt
niśamya vadanāmbhojād girīndro lokapūjitaḥ / lokamātuḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ yogāsakto 'bhavatpunaḥ
pradadau ca maheśāya pārvatīṃ bhāgyagauravāt / niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sādhvīṃ devānāṃ caiva saṃnidhau
ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ devyā māhātmyakīrtanam / śivasya saṃnidhau bhaktyā sucistadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
sarvapāpavinirmukto divyayogasamanvitaḥ / ullaṅghya brahmaṇo lokandevyāḥ sthānamavāpnuyāt
yaścaitat paṭhate stotraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ / devyāḥ samāhitamanāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
nāmnāmaṣṭasahastraṃ tu devyā yat samudīritam / jñātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ saṃbhāvya parameśvarīm
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairbhaktiyogasamanvitaḥ / saṃsmaran paramaṃ bhāvaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param
ananyamānaso nityaṃ japedāmaraṇād dvijaḥ / so 'ntakāle smṛtiṃ labdhvāparaṃ brahmādhigacchati
athavā jāyate vipro brāhmaṇānāṃ kule śucau / pūrvasaṃskāramāhātmyād brahmavidyāmavāpya saḥ
saṃprāpya yogaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram / śāntaḥ sarvagāto bhūtvā śivasāyujyamānapnuyāt
pratyekaṃ cātha nāmāni juhuyāt savanatrayam / pūtanādikṛtairdeṣairgrahadoṣaiśca mucyate
japed vāharaharnityaṃ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ / śrīkāmaḥ pārvatīṃ devīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ
saṃpūjya pārśvataḥ śaṃbhuṃ trinetraṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ / labhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena japtavyaṃ hi dvijātibhiḥ / sarvapāpānodārthaṃ devyā nāma sahastrakam
prasaṅgāt kathitaṃ viprā devyā māhātmyamuttamam / ataḥ paraṃ prajāsargaṃ bhṛgvādīnāṃ nibodhata
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇapriyā / devau dhātāvidhātārau merorjāmātarau tathā
āyatirniyatirmeroḥ kanye caiva mahātmanaḥ / dhātāvidhātroste bhārye tayorjātau sutāvubhau
prāṇaścaiva mṛkaṇḍuśca mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍutaḥ / tathā vedaśirā nāma prāṇasya dyutimān sutaḥ
marīcerapi saṃbhūtiḥ paurṇamāsamasūyata / kanyācatuṣṭayaṃ caiva sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
tuṣṭirjyeṣṭhā tathā vṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṭiścāpacitistathā / virajāḥ parvaścaiva paurṇamāsasya tau sutau
kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ / kardamaṃ ca varīyāṃsaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ munisattamam
tathaiva ca kanīyāsaṃ taponirdhūtakalpaṣam / anasūyā tathaivātrerjajñe putrānakalpaṣān
somaṃ durvāsasaṃ caiva dattātreyaṃ ca yoginam / smṛtiścāṅgirasaḥ putrīrjajñe lakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ caiva rākāmanumatiṃ tathā / prītyāṃ pulastyo bhagavān dattātrimasṛjat prabhuḥ
pūrvajanmani so 'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / vedabāhuṃ tathā kanyāṃ sannatiṃ nāma nāmataḥ
putrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhastraṃ saṃtatiḥ suṣuve kratoḥ / te cordhvaretasaḥ sarve bālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ
vasiṣṭhaśca tathorjāyāṃ saptaputrānajījanat / kanyāṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣāṃ sarveśobhāsamanvitām
rajohaścordhvabāhuśca savanaścānaghastathā / sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta putrā mahaujasaḥ
yo 'sau rudrātmako vahnirbrahmaṇastanayo dvijāḥ / svāhā tasmāt sutān lebhe trīnudārān mahaujasaḥ
pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śuciragniśca te trayaḥ / nirmathyaḥ pavamānaḥ syād vaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ
yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ śuciragnistvasau smṛtaḥ / teṣāṃ tu saṃtatāvanye catvāriṃśca pañca ca
pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śucisteṣāṃ pitā ca yaḥ / ete caikonapañcāśad vahnayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
sarve tapasvinaḥ proktāḥ sarve yajñeṣu bhāginaḥ / rudrātmakāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve tripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ
ayajvānaśca yajvānaḥ pitaro brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ / agniṣvāttā barhiṣado dvidhā teṣāṃ vyavasthitiḥ
tebhyaḥ svadhā sutāṃ jajñe menāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ tathā / te ubhe brahmavādinyau yoginyau munisattamāḥ
asūta menā mainākaṃ krauñcaṃ tasyānujaṃ tathā / gaṅgā himavato jajñe sarvalokaikapāvanī
svayogāgnibalād devīṃ lebhe putrīṃ maheśvarīṃ / yathāvat kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam
eṣā dakṣasya kanyānāṃ mayāpatyānusaṃtatiḥ / vyākhyātā bhavatāmadya manoḥ sṛṣṭiṃ nibodhata
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca priyavratottānapādau manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / dharmajñau sumahāvīryau śatarūpā vyajījanat
tatastūttānapādasya dhruvo nāma suto 'bhavat / bhakto nārāyaṇe deve prāptavān sthānamuttamam
dhruvāt śliṣṭiñca bhavyaṃ ca bhāryā śambhurvyajāyata / śliṣṭerādhatta succhāyā pañca putrānakalpaṣān
vasiṣṭhavacanād devī tapastaptvā suduścaram / ārādhya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śālagrāme janārdanam
ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ vipraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛṣatejasam / nārāyaṇaparān śuddhān svadharmaparipālakān
riporādhatta bṛhatī cakṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam / so 'jījanat puṣkariṇyāṃ vairaṇyāṃ cākṣuṣaṃ manum / prajāpaterātmajāyāṃ vīraṇasya mahātmanaḥ
manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ / kanyāyāṃ sumahāvīryā vairājasya prajāpateḥ
ūruḥ pūruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavāk śuciḥ / agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaścābhimanyukaḥ
ūrorajanayat putrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahābalān / aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ svātiṃ kratumaṅgirasaṃ śivam
aṅgād veno 'bhavat paścād bainyo venādajāyata / yo 'sau pṛthuriti khyātaḥ prajāpālo mahābalaḥ
yena dugdhā mahī pūrvaṃ prājānāṃ hitakāraṇāt / niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sārdhaṃ devendreṇa mahaujasā
venaputrasya vitate purā paitāmahe makhe / sūtaḥ paurāṇiko jajñe māyārūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ
pravaktā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ dharmajño guṇavatsalaḥ / taṃ māṃ nitta muniśreṣṭhāḥ pūrvodbhūtaṃ sanātanam
asmin manvantare vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / śrāvayāmāsa māṃ prītyā purāṇaṃ puruṣo hariḥ
madanvaye tu ye sūtāḥ saṃbhūtā vedavarjitāḥ / teṣāṃ purāṇavaktṛtvaṃ vṛttirāsīdajājñayā
sa tu vainyaḥ pṛthurdhomān satyasaṃdho jitendriyaḥ / sārvabhaumo mahātejāḥ svadharmaparipālakaḥ
tasya bālyāt prabhṛtyeva bhaktirnārāyaṇe 'bhavat / govardhanagiriṃ prāpya tapastepe jitendriyaḥ
tapasā bhagavān prītaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āgatya devo rājānaṃ prāha dāmodaraḥ svayam
dhramikau rūpasaṃpannau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau / matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ putrau tava bhaviṣyataḥ / ekamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ svakīyāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
vainyo 'pi vedavidhinā niścalāṃ bhaktimudvahan / apālayat svakaṃ rājyaṃ nyāyena madhusūdane
acirādeva tanvaṅgo bhāryā tasya sucismitā / khikhaṇḍanaṃ havirdhānamantardhānā vyajāyata
śikhaṇḍano 'bhavat putraḥ suśīla iti viśrutaḥ / dhārmiko rūpasaṃpanno vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
so 'dhītya vidhivad vedān dharmeṇa tapasi sthitaḥ / matiṃ cakre bhāgyayogāt saṃnyāṃ prati dharmavit
sa kṛtvā tīrthasaṃsevāṃ svādhyāye tapasi sthitaḥ / jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ kadācit siddhasevitam
tatra dharmapadaṃ nāma dharmasiddhipradaṃ vanam / apaśyad yogināṃ gamyamagamyaṃ brahmavidviṣām
tatra mandākinī nāma supuṇyā vimalā nadī / padmotpalavanopetā siddhāśramavibhūṣitā
sa tasyā dakṣiṇe tīre munīndrairyogibhirvṛtam / supuṇyamāśramaṃ ramyamapaśyat prītisaṃyutaḥ
mandākinījale strātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / arcayitvā mahādevaṃ puṣpaiḥ padmotpalādibhiḥ
dhyātvārkaṃsaṃsthamīśānaṃ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim / saṃprekṣamāṇo bhāsvantaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
rudrādhyāyena giriśaṃ rudrasya caritena ca / anyaiśca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śāṃbhavairvedasaṃbhavaiḥ
athāsminnantare 'paśyat tamāyāntaṃ mahāmunim / śvetāśvataranāmānaṃ mahāpāśupatottamam
bhasmasaṃdigdhasavāṅgaṃ kaupīnācchādanānvitam / tapasā karṣitātmānaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam
samāpya saṃstavaṃ śaṃbhorānandāstrāvilekṣaṇaḥ / vavande śirasā pādau prāñjalirvākyamabravīt
dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi yanme sākṣānmunīśvaraḥ / yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān dṛṣṭo yogavidāṃ varaḥ
aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ tapāṃsi saphalāni me / kiṃ kariṣyāmi śiṣyo 'haṃ tava māṃ pālayānagha
so 'nugṛhyātha rājānaṃ suśīlaṃ śīlasaṃyutam / śiṣyatve parijagrāha tapasā kṣīṇakalpaṣam
sāṃnyāsikaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ / dadau tadaiśvaraṃ jñānaṃ svaśākhāvihitaṃ vratam
aśeṣavedasāraṃ tat paśupāśavimocanam / antyāśramamiti khyātaṃ brahmādibhiranuṣṭhitam
uvāca śiṣyān saṃprekṣya ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ / brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān brahmacaryaparāyaṇān
mayā pravartitāṃ śākhāmadhītyaiveha yoginaḥ / samāsate mahādevaṃ dhyāyanto niṣkalaṃ śivam
iha devo mahādevo ramamāṇaḥ sahomayā / adhyāste bhagavānīśo bhaktānāmanukampayā
ihāśeṣajagaddhātā purā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam / ārādhayanmahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
ihaiva devamīśānaṃ devānāmapi daivatam / ārādhya mahatīṃ siddhiṃ lebhire devadānavāḥ
ihaiva munayaḥ pūrvaṃ marīcyādyā maheśvaram / dṛṣṭvā tapobalājjñānaṃ lebhire sārvakālikam
tasmāt tvamapi rājendra tapoyogasamanvitaḥ / tiṣṭha nityaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi
evamābhāṣya viprendro devaṃ dhyātvā pinākinam / ācacakṣe mahāmantraṃ yathāvat svārthasiddhaye
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ vedasāraṃ vimuktidam / agnirityādikaṃ puṇyamṛṣibhiḥ saṃpravartitam
so 'pi tadvacanād rājā suśīlaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ / sākṣāt pāśupato bhūtvā vedābhyāsarato 'bhavat
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaḥ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / śānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ saṃnyāsavidhimāśritaḥ
havirdhānastathāgneyyāṃ janayāmāsa satsutam / prācīnabarhiṣaṃ nāmnā dhanurvedasya pāragam
prācīnabarhirbhāgavān sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samudratanayāyāṃ vai daśa putrānajījanat
pracetasaste vikhyātā rājānaḥ prathitaijasaḥ / adhītavantaḥ svaṃ vedaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣo jajñe mahābhāgo yaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
sa tu dakṣo maheśena rudreṇa saha dhīmatā / kṛtvā vivādaṃ rudreṇa śaptaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat
samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ devyā gṛhaṃ haraḥ / dṛṣṭvā yathocitāṃ pūjāṃ dakṣāya pradadau svayam
tadā vai tamasāviṣṭaḥ so 'dikāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / pūjāmanarhāmanvicchan jagāma kupito gṛham
kadācit svagṛhaṃ prāptāṃ satīṃ dakṣaḥ sudurmanāḥ / bhartrā saha vinindyaināṃ bhartsayāmasā vai ruṣā
anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ / tvamapyasatsutāsmākaṃ gṛhād gaccha yathāgatam
tasya tadvākyamākarṇya sā devī śaṅkarapriyā / vinindya pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ dadāhātmānamātmanā
praṇamya paśubhartāraṃ bhartāraṃ kṛttivāsasam / himavadduhitā sābhūt tapasā tasya toṣitā
jñātvā tadbhāgavān rudraḥ prapannārtiharo haraḥ / śaśāpa dakṣaṃ kupitaḥ samāgatyātha tadgṛham
tyaktvā dehamimaṃ brahman kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavaḥ / svasyāṃ sutāyāṃ mūḍhātmā putramutpādayiṣyasi
evamuktvā mahādevo yayau kālāsaparvatam / svāyaṃbhuvo 'pi kālena dakṣaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / visargaṃ dakṣaparyantaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭmāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ naimiṣīyā ūcuḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām / utpattiṃ vistarāt sūta brūhi vaivasvate 'ntare
sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ / kimakārṣonmahābuddhe śrotumicchāma sāṃpratam
sūta uvāca vakṣye nārāyaṇenoktaṃ pūrvakalpānuṣaṅgikam / trikālabaddhaṃ pāpaghnaṃ prajāsargasya vistaram
sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ / vinindya pūrvavaireṇa gaṅgādvare 'yajad bhavam
devāśca sarve bhāgārthamāhūtā viṣṇunā saha / sahaiva munibhiḥ sarvairāgatā munipuṅgavāḥ
dṛṣṭvā devakulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śaṅkareṇa vināgatam / dadhīco nāma viprarṣiḥ prācetasamathābravīt
dadhīca uvāca brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasyājñānuvidhāyinaḥ / sa devaḥ sāṃprataṃ rudro vidhinā kiṃ na pūjyate
dakṣa uvāca sarveṣveva hi yajñeṣu na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ / na mantrā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasyeti nejyate
vihasya dakṣaṃ kupito vacaḥ prāha mahāmuniḥ / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvajñānamayaḥ svayam
dadhīca uvāca yataḥ pravṛttirviśveṣāṃ yaścāsya parameśvaraḥ / saṃpūjyate sarvayajñairviditvā kila śaṅkaraḥ
na hyaṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ saṃhartā tāmaso haraḥ / nagnaḥ kapālī vikṛto viśvātmā nopapadyate
īśvaro hi jagatstraṣṭā prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ svarāṭ / sattvātmako 'sau bhagavānijyate sarvakarmasu
dadhīca uvāca kiṃ tvayā bhagavāneṣa sahastrāṃśurna dṛśyate / sarvalokaikasaṃhartā kālātmā parameśvaraḥ
yaṃ gṛṇantīha vidvāṃso dhārmikā brahmavādinaḥ / so 'yaṃ sākṣī tīvrarociḥ kālātmā śāṅkarītanuḥ
eṣa rudro mahādevaḥ kaparde ca ghṛṇī haraḥ / ādityo bhagavān sūryo nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ
saṃstūyate sahastrāṃśuḥ sāmagādhvaryuhotṛbhiḥ / paśyainaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ rudramūrti trayīmayam
dakṣa uvāca ya ete dvādaśādityā āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ / sarve sūryā iti jñeyā na hyānyo vidyate raviḥ
evamukte tu munayaḥ samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ / bāḍhamityabruvan vākyaṃ tasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
tamasāviṣṭamanaso na paśyanti vṛṣadhvajam / sahastraśo 'tha śataśo bhūya eva vinindyate
nindanto vaidikān mantrān sarvabhūtapatiṃ haram / apūjayan dakṣavākyaṃ mohitā viṣṇumāyayā
devāśca sarve bhāgārthamāgatā vāsavādayaḥ / nāpaśyan devamīśānamṛte nārāyaṇaṃ harim
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ / paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
antarhite bhagavati dakṣo nārāyaṇaṃ harim / rakṣakaṃ jagatāṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ svayam
pravartayāmāsa ca taṃ yajñaṃ dakṣo 'tha nirbhayaḥ / rakṣate bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ
punaḥ prāha ca taṃ dakṣaṃ dadhīco bhagavānṛṣiḥ / saṃprekṣyarṣigaṇān devān sarvān vai brahmavidviṣaḥ
apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpyapūjane / naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānanā / daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ
evamuktvā tu viprarṣiḥ śaśāpeśvaravidviṣaḥ / samāgatān brāhmaṇāṃstān dakṣasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
yasmād bahiṣkṛtā vedā bhavadbhiḥ parameśvaraḥ / vinindito mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro lokavanditaḥ
bhaviṣyadhvaṃ trayībāhyāḥ sarve 'pīśvaravidviṣaḥ / nindanto hyaiśvaraṃ mārgaṃ kuśāstrāsaktamānasāḥ
mithyādhītasamācārā mithyājñānapralāpinaḥ / prāpya ghoraṃ kaliyugaṃ kalijaiḥ kila pīḍitāḥ
tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gacchadhvaṃ narakān punaḥ / bhaviṣyati hṛṣīkeśaḥ svāśrito 'pi parāṅmukhaḥ
evamuktvā tu viprarṣirvirarāma taponidhiḥ / jagāma manasā rudramaśeṣāghavināśanam
etasminnantare devī mahādevaṃ maheśvaram / patiṃ paśupatiṃ devaṃ jñātvaitat prāha sarvadṛk
devyuvāca dakṣo yajñena yajate pitā me pūrvajanmani / vinindya bhavato bhāvamātmānaṃ cāpi śaṅkara
devāḥ saharṣibhiścāsaṃstatra sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ / vināśayāśu taṃ yajñaṃ varamekaṃ vṛṇomyaham
evaṃ vijñāpito devyā devo devavaraḥ prabhuḥ / sasarja sahasā rudraṃ dakṣayajñajighāṃsayā
sahastraśīrṣapādaṃ ca sahastrākṣaṃ mahābhujam / sahastrapāṇiṃ durdharṣaṃ yugāntānalasannibham
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / daṇḍahastaṃ mahānādaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ devadevasamanvitam / sa jātamātro deveśamupatasthe kṛtāñjaliḥ
tamāha dakṣasya makhaṃ vināśaya śivostviti / vinindya māṃ sa yajate gaṅgādvāre gaṇeśvara
tato bandhuprayuktena siṃhenaikena līlayā / vīrabhadreṇa dakṣasya vināśamagamat kratuḥ
manyunā comayā sṛṣṭā bhadrakālī maheśvarī / tayā ca sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ samāruhya yayau gaṇaḥ
anye sahastraśo rudrā nisṛṣṭāstena dhīmatā / romajā iti vikhyātāstasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
śūlaśaktigadāhastāṣṭaṅkopalakarāstathā / kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśā nādayanto diśo daśa
sarve vṛṣāsanārūḍhāḥ sabhāryāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ / samāvṛtya gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ yayurdakṣamakhaṃ prati
sarve śaṃprāpya taṃ deśaṃ gaṅgādvāramiti śrutam / dadṛśuryajñadeśaṃ taṃ dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
devāṅganāsahastrāḍhyamapsarogītanāditam / vīṇāveṇuninādāḍhyaṃ vedavādābhināditam
dṛṣṭvā saharṣibhirdevaiḥ samāsīnaṃ prajāpatim / uvāca bhadrayā rudrairvorabhadraḥ smayanniva
vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ / bhāgābhilapsayā prāptā bhāgān yacchadhvamīpsitān
atha cet kasyacidiyamājñā munisurottamāḥ / bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām / taṃ brūtājñāpayati yo vetsyāmo hi vayaṃ tataḥ
evamuktā gaṇeśena prajāpatipuraḥ sarāḥ / devā ūcuryajñabhāge na ca mantrā iti prabhum
mantrā ūcuḥ surān yūyaṃ tamopahatacetasaḥ / ye nādhvarasya rājānaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ maheśvaram
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtatanurharaḥ / pūjyate sarvayajñeṣu sarvābhyudasiddhidaḥ
evamuktā apīśānaṃ māyayā naṣṭacetasaḥ / na menire yayurmantrā devān muktvā svamālayam
tataḥ sa rudro bhagavān sabhāryaḥ sagaṇeśvaraḥ / spṛśan karābhyāṃ brahmarṣi dadhīcaṃ prāha devatāḥ
mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ / yasmāt prasahya tasmād vo nāśayāmyadya garvitam
ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ dadāha gaṇapuṅgavaḥ / gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ
prastotrā saha hotrā ca aśvaṃ caiva gaṇeśvarāḥ / gṛhītvā bhīṣaṇāḥ sarve gaṅgāstrotasi cikṣipuḥ
vīrabhadro 'pi dīptātmā śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam / vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām
bhagasya netre cotpāṭya karajāgreṇa līlayā / nihatya muṣṭinā dantān pūṣṇaścaivamapātayat
tathā candramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā / dharṣayāmāsa balavān smayamāno gaṇeśvaraḥ
vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā / jaghāna mūrdhni pādena munīnapi munīśvarāḥ
tathā viṣṇuṃ saharuḍaṃ samāyāntaṃ mahābalaḥ / vivyādha niśetairbāṇaiḥ stambhayitvā sudarśanam
samālokya mahābāhurāgatya garuḍo gaṇam / jaghāna pakṣaiḥ sahasā nanādāmbunidhiryathā
tataḥ sahastraśo bhadraḥ sasarja garuḍān svayam / vainateyādabhyadhikān garuḍaṃ te pradudruvuḥ
tān dṛṣṭvā garuḍo dhīmān palāyata mahājavaḥ / visṛjya mādhavaṃ vegāt tadadbhutamivābhavat
antarhite vainateye bhagavān padmasaṃbhavaḥ / āgatya vārayāmāsa vīrabhadraṃ ca keśavam
prasādayāmāsa ca taṃ gauravāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / saṃstūya bhagavānīśaḥ sāmbastatrāgamat svayam
vīkṣya devādhidevaṃ taṃ sāmbaṃ sarvagaṇairvṛtam / tuṣṭāva bhagavān brahmā dakṣaḥ sarve divaukasaḥ
viśeṣāt pārvatīṃ devīmīśvarārdhaśarīriṇīm / stotrairnānāvidhairdakṣaḥ praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ
tato bhagavatī devī prahasantī maheśvaram / prasannamānasā rudraṃ vacaḥ prāha ghṛṇānidhiḥ
tvameva jagataḥ straṣṭā śāsitā caiva rakṣakaḥ / anugrāhyo bhagavatā dakṣaścāpi divaukasaḥ
tataḥ prahasya bhagavān kaparde nīlalohitaḥ / uvāca praṇatān devān prācetasamatho haraḥ
gacchadhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ prasanno bhavatāmaham / saṃpūjyaḥ sarvayajñeṣu na nindyo 'haṃ viśeṣataḥ
tvaṃ cāpi śṛṇu me dakṣa vacanaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam / tyaktvā lokaiṣaṇāmetāṃ madbhakto bhava yatnataḥ
bhaviṣyasi gaṇeśānaḥ kalpānte 'nugrahānmama / tāvat tiṣṭha mamādeśāt svādhikāreṣu nirvṛtaḥ
evamuktvā sa bhagavān sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ / adarśanamanuprāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
antarhite mahādeve śaṅkare padmasaṃbhavaḥ / vyājahāra svayaṃ dakṣamaśeṣajagato hitam
brahmovāca kiṃ tavāpagato mohaḥ prasanne vṛṣabhadhvaje / yadācaṣṭa svayaṃ devaḥ pālayaitadatandritaḥ
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ hṛdyeṣa vasatīśvaraḥ / paśyantyenaṃ brahmabhūtā vidvāṃso vedavādinaḥ
sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bījaṃ paramā gatiḥ / stūyate vaidikairmantrairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ
tamarcayati yo rudraṃ svātmanyekaṃ sanātanam / cetasā bhāvayuktena sa yāti paramaṃ padam
tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vijñāya parameśvaram / karmaṇā manasā vācā samārādhaya yatnataḥ
yatnāt parihareśasya nindāmātmavināśanīm / bhavanti sarvadoṣāya nindakasya kriyā yataḥ
yastavaiṣa mahāyogī rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ / sa devadevo bhagavān mahādevo na saṃśayaḥ
manyante ye jagadyoniṃ vibhinnaṃ viṣṇumīśvarāt / mohādavedaniṣṭhatvāt te yānti narakaṃ narāḥ
vedānuvartino rudraṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tathā / ekībhāvena paśyanti muktibhājo bhavanti te
yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ rudro yo rudraḥ sa janārdanaḥ / iti matvā yajed devaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
sṛjatyetajjagat sarvaṃ viṣṇustat paśyatīśvaraḥ / itthaṃ jagat sarvamidaṃ rudranārāyaṇodbhavam
tasmāt tyaktvā harernindāṃ viṣṇāvapi samāhitaḥ / samāśrayenmahādevaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmavādinām
upaśrutyātha vacanaṃ viriñcasya prajāpatiḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ gopatiṃ kṛttivāsasam
ye 'nye śāpāgninirdagdhā dadhīcasya maharṣayaḥ / dviṣanto mohitā devaṃ saṃbabhūvuḥ kaliṣvatha
tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viprāṇāṃ kulasaṃbhavāḥ / pūrvasaṃskāramahātmyād brahmaṇo vacanādiha
muktaśāpāstataḥ sarve kalpānte rauravādiṣu / nipātyamānāḥ kālena saṃprāpyādityavarcasam / brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmīśamanujñātāḥ svayaṃbhuvā
samārādhya tapoyogādīśānaṃ tridaśādhipam / bhaviṣyanti yathā pūrvaṃ śaṅkarasya prasādataḥ
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣayajñaniṣūdanam / śṛṇudhvaṃ dakṣaputrīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ caiva saṃtatim
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayaṃbhuvā / sasarja devān gandharvān ṛṣīṃścaivāsuroragān
yadāsya sṛjamānasya na vyavardhanta tāḥ prajāḥ / tadā sasarja bhūtāni maithunenaiva dharmataḥ
asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ / sutāyāṃ dharmayuktāyāṃ putrāṇāṃ tu sahastrakam
teṣu putreṣu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya saḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ dakṣo 'sṛjat kanyā vairaṇyāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa / viṃśat sapta ca somāya catastro 'riṣṭanemine
dve caiva bahuputrāya dve kṛśāśvāya dhīmate / dve caivāṅgirase tadvat tāsāṃ vakṣye 'tha nistaram
arundhatī vasurjāmī lambā bhānurmarutvatī / saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhāminī
dharmapatnyo daśa tvetāstāsāṃ putrān nibodhata / viśvāyā viśvadevāstu sādhyā sādhyānajījanat
marutvanto marutvatyāṃ vasavo 'ṣṭau vasoḥ sutāḥ / bhānostu bhānavaścaiva muhūrtā vai muhūrtajāḥ
lambāyāścātha ghoṣo vai nāgavīthī tu jāmijā / pṛthivīviṣayaṃ sarvamarundatyāmajāyata / saṃkalpāyāstu saṃkalpo dharmaputrā daśa smṛtāḥ
āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ / pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ
āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śrānto dhunistathā / dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokaprakālanaḥ
somasya bhagavān varcā dharasya draviṇaḥ sutaḥ / purojavo 'nilasya syādavijñātagatistathā
kumāro hyanalasyāsīt senāpatiriti smṛtaḥ / devalo bhagavān yogī pratyūṣasyābhavat sutaḥ / viśvakarmā prabhāsasya śilpakartā prajāpatiḥ
aditirditirdanustadvadariṣṭā surasā tathā / surabhirvinatā caiva tāmra krodhavaśā irā / kadrurmuniśca dharmajñā tatputrān vai nibodhata
aṃśo dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro 'tha varuṇor'yamā / vivasvān savitā pūṣā hyaṃśumān viṣṇureva ca
tuṣitā nāma te pūrvaṃ cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ / vaivasvate 'ntare proktā ādityāścāditeḥ sutāḥ
ditiḥ putradvayaṃ lebhe kaśyapād balasaṃyutam / hiraṇyakaśipuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathāparam
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo mahābalaparākramaḥ / ārādhya tapasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / dṛṣṭvālebhevarān divyān stutvāsau vividhaiḥ stavai
atha tasya balād devāḥ sarva eva surarṣayaḥ / bādhitāstāḍitā jagmurdevadevaṃ pitāmaham
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvajaganmayam / brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāraṃ trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ param / kūṭasthaṃ jagatāmekaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam
sa yācito devavarairmunibhiśca munīśvarāḥ / sarvadevahitārthāya jagāma kamalāsanaḥ
saṃstūyamānaḥ praṇatairmunīndrairamarairapi / kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ yatrāste harirīśvaraḥ
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ jagadyoniṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaguruṃ śivam / vavande caraṇau mūrdhnā kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
brahmovāca tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmananto 'syakhilātmakaḥ / vyāpī sarvāmaravapurmahāyogī sanātanaḥ
tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ parā / vairāgyaiśvaryanirato rāgātīto nirañjanaḥ
tvaṃ kartā caiva bhartā ca nihantā suravidviṣām / trātumarhasyananteśa trātā hi parameśvaraḥ
itthaṃ sa viṣṇurbhagavān brahmaṇā saṃprabodhitaḥ / provāconnidrapadmākṣaḥ pītavāsāsuradviṣaḥ
kimarthaṃ sumahāvīryāḥ saprajāpatikāḥ surāḥ / imaṃ deśamanuprāptāḥ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ karomi vaḥ
devā ūcuḥ hiraṇyakaśipurnāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ / bādhate bhagavan daityo devān sarvān saharṣibhiḥ
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāmṛte puruṣottama / hantumarhasi sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ trātāsi jaganmaya
śrutvā taddaivatairuktaṃ sa viṣṇurlokabhāvanaḥ / vadhāya daityamukhyasya so 'sṛjat puruṣaṃ svayam
meruparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ taṃ prāha garuḍadhvajaḥ
hatvā taṃ daityarājaṃ tvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ punaḥ / imaṃ deśaṃ samāgantuṃ kṣipramarhasi pauruṣāt
niśamya vaiṣṇavaṃ vākyaṃ praṇamya puruṣottamam / mahāpuruṣamavyaktaṃ yayau daityamahāpuram
vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āruhya garuḍaṃ devo mahāmerurivāparaḥ
ākarṇya daityapravarā mahāmegharavopamam / samācacakṣire nādaṃ tadā daityapaterbhayāt
asurā ūcuḥ kaścidāgacchati mahān puruṣo devacoditaḥ / vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ taṃ jānīmo 'marārdana
tataḥ sahāsuravarairhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / saṃnaddhaiḥ sāyudhaiḥ putraiḥ prahrādādyaistadā yayau
dṛṣṭvā taṃ garuḍāsīnaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham / puruṣaṃ parvatākāraṃ nārāyaṇamivāparam
dudruvuḥ kecidanyonmamūcuḥ saṃbhrāntalocanāḥ / ayaṃ sa devo devānāṃ goptā nārāyaṇo ripuḥ
asmākamavyayo nūnaṃ tatsuto vā samāgataḥ / ityuktvā śastravarṣāṇi sasṛjuḥ puruṣāya te / tāni cāśeṣato devo nāśayāmāsa līlayā
tadā hiraṇyakaśipoścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ / putrā nārāyaṇodbhūtaṃ yuyudhurmeghaniḥ svanāḥ / prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādo hrāda eva ca
prahrādaḥ prāhiṇod brāhmamanuhrādo 'tha vaiṣṇavam / saṃhrādaścāpi kaumāramāgneyaṃ hrāda eva ca
tāni taṃ puruṣaṃ prāpya catvāryastrāṇi vaiṣṇavam / na śekurbādhituṃ viṣṇuṃ vāsudevaṃ yathā tathā
athāsau caturaḥ putrān mahābāhurmahābalaḥ / pragṛhya pādeṣu karaiḥ saṃcikṣepa nanāda ca
vimukteṣvatha putreṣu hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / pādena tāḍayāmāsa vegenorasi taṃ balī
sa tena pīḍito 'tyarthaṃ garuḍena tathā'śugaḥ / adṛśyaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ yatra nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa pravṛttamakhilaṃ tathā
saṃcintya manasā devaḥ sarvajñānamayo 'malaḥ / narasyārdhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ tathā
nṛsiṃhavapuravyakto hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pure / āvirbabhūva sahasā mohayan daityapuṅgavān
daṃṣṭrākarālo yogātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ / samāruhyātmanaḥ śaktiṃ sarvasaṃhārakārikām / bhāti nārāyaṇo 'nanto yathā madhyandine raviḥ
dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ prahrādaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrakam / vadhāya prerayāmāsa narasihasya so 'suraḥ
imaṃ nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ pūrvasmād bahuśaktikam / sahaiva tvanujaiḥ sarvairnāśayāśu mayeritaḥ
tatsaṃniyogādasuraḥ prahrādo viṣṇumavyayam / yuyudhe sarvayatnena narasiṃhena nirjitaḥ
tataḥ saṃcodito daityo hiraṇyākṣastadānujaḥ / dhyātvā paśupaterastraṃ sasarja ca nanāda ca
tasya devādidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / na hānimakarodastraṃ yathā devasya śūlinaḥ
dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ tvastraṃ prahrādo bhāgyagauravāt / mene sarvātmakaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
saṃtyajya sarvaśastrāṇi sattvayuktena cetasā / nanāma śirasā devaṃ yogināṃ hṛdayeśayam
stutvā nārāyaṇaiḥ stotraiḥ ṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ / nivārya pitaraṃ bhrātṛn hiraṇyākṣaṃ tadābravīt
ayaṃ nārāyaṇo 'nantaḥ śāśvato bhagavānajaḥ / purāṇapuruṣo devo mahāyogī jaganmayaḥ
ayaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayañjyotirnirañjanaḥ / pradhānapuruṣastattvaṃ mūlaprakṛtiravyayaḥ
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmī guṇātigaḥ / gacchadhvamenaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumavyaktamavyayam
evamukte sudurbuddhirhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / provāca putramatyarthaṃ mohito viṣṇumāyayā
ayaṃ sarvātmanā vadhyo nṛsiṃho 'lpaparākramaḥ / samāgato 'smadbhavanamidānīṃ kālacoditaḥ
vihasya pitaraṃ putro vacaḥ prāha mahāmatiḥ / mā nindasvainamīśānaṃ bhūtānāmekamavyayam
kathaṃ devo mahādevaḥ śāśvataḥ kālavarjitaḥ / kālena hanyate viṣṇuḥ kālātmā kālarūpadhṛk
tataḥ suvarṇakaśipurdurātmā vidhicoditaḥ / nivārito 'pi putreṇa yuyodha harimavyayam
saṃraktanayano 'nto hiraṇyanayanāgrajam / nakhairvidārayāmāsa prahrādasyaiva paśyataḥ
hate hiraṇyakaśipau hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ / visṛjya putraṃ prahrādaṃ dudruve bhayavihvalaḥ
anuhrādādayaḥ putrā anye ca śataśo 'surāḥ / nṛsiṃhadehasaṃbhūtaiḥ siṃhairnotā yamālayam
tataḥ saṃhṛtya tadrūpaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / svameva paramaṃ rūpaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāhvayam
gate nārāyaṇe daityaḥ prahrādo 'surasattamaḥ / abhiṣekeṇa yuktena hiraṇyākṣamayojayat
sa bādhayāmāsa surān raṇe jitvā munīnapi / labdhvāndhakaṃ mahāputraṃ tapasārādhya śaṅkaram
devāñjitvā sadevendrān badhvāca dharaṇīmimām / nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīmindīvaraprabhām
tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ / gatvā vijñāpayāmāsurviṣṇave harimandiram
sa cintayitvā viśvātmā tadvadhopāyamavyayaḥ / sarvedevamayaṃ śubhraṃ vārāhaṃ vapurādadhe
gatvā hiraṇyanayanaṃ hatvā taṃ puruṣottamaḥ / daṃṣṭrayoddhārayāmāsa kalpādau dharaṇīmimām
tyaktvā varāhasaṃsthānaṃ saṃsthāpya ca suradvijān svāmeva prakṛtiṃ divyāṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ paraṃ padam
tasmin hate 'mararipau prahrādau viṣṇutatparaḥ / apālayat svakaṃrājyaṃ bhāvaṃ tyaktvā tadā'suram
iyāja vidhivad devān viṣṇorārādhane rataḥ / niḥ sapatnaṃ tadā rājyaṃ tasyāsīd viṣṇuvaibhavāt
tataḥ kadācidasuro brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam / tāpasaṃ nārcayāmāsa devānāṃ caiva māyayā
sa tena tāpaso 'tyarthaṃ mohitenāvamānitaḥ / śaśāpāsurarājānaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
yattadvalaṃ samāśritya brāhmaṇānavamanyase / sā bhaktirvaiṣṇavī divyā vināśaṃ te gamiṣyati
ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ prahrādasya gṛhād dvijaḥ / mumoha rājyasaṃsaktaḥ so 'pi śāpabalāt tataḥ
bādhayāmāsa viprendrān na viveda janārdanam / piturvadhamanusmṛtya krodhaṃ cakre hariṃ prati
tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam / nārāyaṇasya devasya prahrādasyāmaradviṣaḥ
kṛtvā tu sumahad yuddhaṃ viṣṇunā tena nirjitaḥ / purvasaṃskāramāhātmyāt parasmin puruṣe harau / saṃjātaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau
tataḥ prabhṛti daityendro hyananyāṃ bhaktimudvahan / nārāyaṇe mahāyogamavāpa puruṣottame
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putre yogasaṃsaktacetasi / avāpa tanmahad rājyamandhako 'surapuṅgavaḥ
hiraṇyanetratanayaḥ śaṃbhordehasamudbhavaḥ / mandarasthāmumāṃ devīṃ cakame parvatātmajām
purā dāruvane puṇye munayo gṛhamedhinaḥ / īśvarārādhanārthāya tapaśceruḥ sahastraśaḥ
tataḥ kadācinmahati kālayogena dustarā / anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā hyāsīd bhūtavināśinī
sametya sarve munayo gautamaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim / ayācanta kṣudhāviṣṭā āhāraṃ prāṇadhāraṇam
sa tebhyaḥ pradadāvannaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bahutaraṃ budhaḥ / sarve bubujire viprā nirviśaṅkena cetasā
gate tu dvādaśe varṣe kalpānta iva śaṅkarī / babhūva vṛṣṭirmahatī yathāpūrvamabhūjjagat
tataḥ sarve munivarāḥ samāmantrya parasparam / maharṣi gautamaṃ procurgacchāma iti vegataḥ
nivārayāmāsa ca tān kañcit kālaṃ yathāsukham / uṣitvā madgṛhe 'vaśyaṃ gacchadhvamiti paṇḍitāḥ
tato māyāmayīṃ sṛṣṭvā kṛśāṃ gāṃ sarva eva te / samīpaṃ prāpayāmāsugautamasya mahātmanaḥ
so 'nuvīkṣya kṛpāviṣṭastasyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇotsukaḥ / goṣṭhe tāṃ bandhayāmāsa spṛṣṭamātrā mamāra sā
sa śokenābhisaṃtaptaḥ kāryākāryaṃ mahāmuniḥ / na paśyati sma sahasā tādṛśaṃ munayo 'bruvan
govadhyeyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yāvat tava śarīragā / tāvat te 'nnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ gacchāmo vayameva hi
tena te muditāḥ santo devadāruvanaṃ śubham / jagmuḥ pāpavaśaṃ nītāstapaścartuṃ yathā purā
sa teṣāṃ māyayā jātāṃ govadhyāṃ gautamo muniḥ / kenāpi hetunā jñātvā śaśāpātīvakopanaḥ
bhaviṣyanti trayībāhyā mahāpātakibhiḥ samāḥ / babhūvuste tathā śāpājjāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
sarve saṃprāpya deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumavyayam / astuvan laukikaiḥ stotrairucchiṣṭā iva sarvagau
devadevau mahādevau bhaktānāmārtināśanau / kāmavṛttyā mahāyogau pāpānnastrātumarhathaḥ
tadā pārśvasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃprekṣya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ / kimeteṣāṃ bhavet kāryaṃ prāha puṇyaiṣiṇāmiti
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ / gopatiṃ prāha viprendrānālokya praṇatān hariḥ
na vedabāhye puruṣe puṇyaleśo 'pi śaṅkara / saṃgacchate mahādeva dharmo vedād vinirbabhau
tathāpi bhaktavātsalyād rakṣitavyā maheśvara / asmābhiḥ sarva eveme gantāro narakānapi
tasmād vai vedabāhyānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya pāpinām / vimohanāya śāstrāṇi kariṣyāmo vṛṣadhvaja
evaṃ saṃbodhito rudro mādhavena murāriṇā / cakāra mohaśāstrāṇi keśavo 'pi śiveritaḥ
kāpālaṃ nākulaṃ vāmaṃ bhairavaṃ pūrvapaścimam / pañcarātraṃ pāśupataṃ tathānyāni sahastraśaḥ
sṛṣṭvā tānūcaturdevau kurvāṇāḥ śāstracoditam / patanto niraye ghore bahūn kalpān punaḥ punaḥ
jāyanto mānuṣe loke kṣīṇapāpacayāstataḥ / īśvarārādhanabalād gacchadhvaṃ sukṛtāṃ gatim / vartadhvaṃ matprasādena nānyathā niṣkṛtirhi vaḥ
evamīśvaraviṣṇubhyāṃ coditāste maharṣayaḥ / ādeśaṃ pratyapadyanta śirasāsuravidviṣoḥ
cakruste 'nyāni śāstrāṇi tatra tatra ratāḥ punaḥ / śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsurdarśayitvā phalāni tu
mohayanta imaṃ lokamavatīrya mahītale / cakāra śaṅkaro bhikṣāṃ hitāyaiṣāṃ dvijaiḥ saha
kapālamālābharaṇaḥ pretabhasmāvaguṇṭhitaḥ / vimohayaṃllokamimaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ
nikṣipya pārvatīṃ devīṃ viṣṇāvamitatejasi / niyojyāṅgabhavaṃ rudraṃ bhairavaṃ duṣṭanigrahe
dattvā nārāyaṇe devīṃ nandinaṃ kulanandinam / saṃsthāpya tatra gaṇapān devānindrapurogamān
prasthite 'tha mahādeve viṣṇurviśvatanuḥ svayam / strīrūpadhārī niyataṃ sevate sma maheśvarīm
brahmā hutāśanaḥ śakro yamo 'nye surapuṅgavāḥ / siṣevire mahādevīṃ strīveśaṃ śobhanaṃ gatāḥ
nandīśvaraśca bhagavān śaṃbhoratyantavallabhaḥ / dvāradeśe gaṇādhyakṣo yathāpūrvamatiṣṭhata
etasminnantare daityo hyandhako nāma durmatiḥ / āhartukāmo girijāmājagāmātha mandaram
saṃprāptamandhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraḥ kālabhairavaḥ / nyaṣedhayadameyātmā kālarūpadharo haraḥ
tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam / śūlenorasi taṃ daityamājaghāna vṛṣadhvajaḥ
tataḥ sahastraśo daityaḥ sasarjāndhakasaṃjñitān / nandiṣeṇādayo daityairandhakairabhinirjitāḥ
ghaṇṭākarṇo meghanādaścaṇḍeśaścaṇḍatāpanaḥ / vināyako meghavāhaḥ somanandī ca vaidyutaḥ
sarve 'ndhakaṃ daityavaraṃ saṃprāpyātibalānvitāḥ / yuyudhuḥ śūlaśaktyṛṣṭigirikūṭaparaśvadhaiḥ
bhrāmayitvātha hastābhyāṃ gṛhītacaraṇadvayāḥ / daityendreṇātibalinā kṣiptāste śatayojanam
tato 'ndhakanisṛṣṭāste śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ / kālasūryapratīkāśā bhairavaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ
hā heti śabdaḥ sumahān babhūvātibhayaṅkaraḥ / yuyodha bhairavo rudraḥ śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam
dṛṣṭvāndhakānāṃ subalaṃ durjayaṃ tarjito haraḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum
so 'sṛjad bhagavān viṣṇurdevīnāṃ śatamuttamam / devīpārśvasthito devo vināśāyāmaradviṣām
tathāndhakasahastraṃ tu devībhiryamasādanam / nītaṃ keśavamāhātmyāllīlayaiva raṇājire
dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ sainyamandhako 'pi mahāsuraḥ / parāṅmukhoraṇāt tasmāt palāyata mahājavaḥ
tataḥ krīḍāṃ mahādevaḥ kṛtvā dvādaśavārṣikīm / hitāya loke bhaktānāmājagāmātha mandaram
saṃprāptamīśvaraṃ jñātvā sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ / samāgamyopatasthustaṃ bhānumantamiva dvijāḥ
praviśya bhavanaṃ puṇyamayuktānāṃ durāsadam / dadarśa nandinaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ keśavaṃ śivaḥ
praṇāmapravaṇaṃ devaṃ so 'nugṛhyātha nandinam / āghrāya mūrdhanīśānaḥ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje
dṛṣṭvā devī mahādevaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā / nanāma śirasā tasya pādayorīśvarasya sā
nivedya vijayaṃ tasmai śaṅkarāyātha śaṅkarī / bhairavo viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ praṇataḥ pārśvago 'vadat
śrutvā tadvijayaṃ śaṃbhurvikramaṃ keśavasya ca / samāste bhagavānīśo devyā saha varāsane
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ / ājagmurmandaraṃ druṣṭaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam
yena tad vijitaṃ pūrvaṃ devīnāṃ śatamuttamam / samāgataṃ daityasainyamīśdarśanavāñchayā
dṛṣṭvā varāsanāsīnaṃ devyā candravibhūṣaṇam / praṇemurādarād devyo gāyanti smātilālasāḥ
praṇemurgirijāṃ devīṃ vāmapārśve pinākinaḥ / devāsanagataṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
dṛṣṭvā siṃhāsanāsīnaṃ devyā nārāyaṇena ca / praṇamya devamīśānaṃ pṛṣṭavatyo varāṅganāḥ
kanyā ūcuḥ kastvaṃ vibhrājase kāntyā keyaṃ bālaraviprabhā / ko 'nvayaṃ bhti vapuṣā paṅkajāyatalocanaḥ
niśamya tāsāṃ vacanaṃ vṛṣendravaravāhanaḥ / vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtādhipatiravyayaḥ
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo gaurī jaganmātā sanātanī / vibhajya saṃsthito devaḥ svātmānaṃ bahudheśvaraḥ
na me viduḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ devādyā na maharṣayaḥ / eko 'yaṃ veda viśvātmā bhavānī viṣṇureva ca
ahaṃ hi niṣkriyaḥ śāntaḥ kevalo niṣparigrahaḥ / māmeva keśavaṃ devamāhurdevīmathāmbikām
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryameva ca / kartā kārayitā viṣṇurbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ
bhoktā pumānaprameyaḥ saṃhartā kālarūpadhṛk / straṣṭā pātā vāsudevo viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ
kṛṭastho hyakṣaro vyāpī yogī nārāyaṇaḥ svayam / tārakaḥ puruṣo hyātmā kevalaṃ paramaṃ padam
saiṣā māheśvarī gaurī mama śaktirnirañjanā / sāntā satyā sadānandā paraṃ padamiti śrutiḥ
asyāḥ sarvamidaṃ jātamatraiva layameṣyati / eṣaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gatīnāmuttamā gatiḥ
tayāhaṃ saṃgato devyā kevalo niṣkalaḥ paraḥ / paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ yastad veda sa mucyate
tasmādanādimadvaitaṃ viṣṇumātmānamīśvaram / ekameva vijānīdhvaṃ tato yāsyatha nirvṛtim
manyante viṣṇumavyaktamātmānaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ / ye bhinnadṛṣṭyāpīśānaṃ pūjayanto na me priyāḥ
dviṣanti ye jagatsūtiṃ mohitā rauravādiṣu / pacyamānā na mucyante kalpakoṭiśatairapi
tasamādaśeṣabhūtānāṃ rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ / yathāvadiha vijñāya dhyeyaḥ sarvāpadi prabhuḥ
śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ devyaḥ sarvagaṇeśvarāḥ / nemurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām
prārthayāmāsurīśāne bhaktiṃ bhaktajanapriye / bhavānīpādayugale nārāyaṇapadāmbuje
tato nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ gaṇeśā mātaro 'pi ca / na paśyanti jagatsūtiṃ tadbhutamivābhavat
tadantare mahādaityo hyandhako manmathārditaḥ / mohito girijāṃ devīmāhartuṃ girimāyayau
athānantavapuḥ śrīmān yogī nārāyaṇo 'malaḥ / tatraivāvirabhūd daityairyuddhāya puruṣottamaḥ
kṛtvātha pārśve bhagavantamīśo yuddhāya viṣṇuṃ gaṇadevamukhyaiḥ / śilādaputreṇa ca mātṛkābhiḥ sa kālarudro 'bhijagāma devaḥ
triśūlamādāya kṛśānukalpaṃ sa devadevaḥ prayayau purastāt / tamanvayuste gaṇarājavaryā jagāma devo 'pi sahastrabāhuḥ
rarāja madhye bhagavān surāṇāṃ vivāhano vāridavarṇavarṇaḥ / tadā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍha- strilokadṛṣṭirbhagavānivārkaḥ
jagatyanādirbhagavānameyo haraḥ sahastrākṛtirāvirāsīt / triśūlapāṇirgagane sughoṣaḥ papāta devopari puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ
samāgataṃ vīkṣya gaṇeśarājaṃ samāvṛtaṃ devaripurgaṇeśaiḥ / yuyodha śakreṇa samātṛkābhi- r gaṇairaśeṣairamapapradhānaiḥ
vijitya sarvānapi bāhuvīryāt sa saṃyuge śaṃbhumanantadhāma / samāyayau yatra sa kālarudro vimānamāruhya vihīnasattvaḥ
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ samayāntaṃ bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ / vyājahāra mahādevaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
hantumarhasi daityeśamandhakaṃ lokakaṇṭakam / tvāmṛte bhagavān śakto hantā nānyo 'sya vidyate
tvaṃ hartā sarvalokānāṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ / stūyate vividhairmantrarvedavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ
sa vāsudevasya vaco niśamya bhagavān haraḥ / nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ hanane daityandrasya matiṃ dadhau
jagāma devatānīkaṃ gaṇānāṃ harṣamuttamam / stuvanti bhairavaṃ devamantarikṣacarā janāḥ
jayānanta mahādeva kālamūrte sanātana / tvamagniḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi nityaśaḥ
tvaṃ yatrajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ dhātā hariravyayaḥ / tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ dhāma paramaṃ padam
oṅkāramūrtiryogātmā trayīnetrastrilocanaḥ / mahāvibhūtirdeveśo jayāśeṣajagatpate
tataḥ kālāgnirudro 'sau gṛhītvāndhakamīśvaraḥ / triśūlāgreṣu vinyasya prananarta satāṃ gatiḥ
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ devagaṇāḥ śūlaprotaṃ pitāmahaḥ / praṇemurīśvaraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ bhavamocakam
astuvan munayaḥ siddhā jagurgandharvikiṃnarāḥ / antarikṣe 'psaraḥ saṅghā nṛtyantisma manoramāḥ
saṃsthāpito 'thaśūlāgre so 'ndhako dagdhakilbiṣaḥ / utpannākhilavijñānastuṣṭāva parameśvaram
andhaka uvāca namāmi mūrdhnā bhagavantamekaṃ samāhitā yaṃ vidurīśatattvam / purātanaṃ puṇyamanantarūpaṃ kālaṃ kaviṃ yogaviyogahetum
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ hutāśavaktraṃ jvalanārkarūpam / sahastrapādākṣiśirobhiyuktaṃ bhavantamekaṃ praṇamāmi rudram
jayādidevāmarapūjitāṅghre vibhāgahīnāmalatattvarūpa / tvamagnireko bahudhābhipūjyase vāyvādibhedairakhilātmarūpa
tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇam ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt / tvaṃ paśyasīdaṃ paripāsyajastraṃ tvamantako yogigaṇābhijuṣṭaḥ
eko 'ntarātmā bahudhā niviṣṭo deheṣu dehādiviśeṣahīnaḥ / tvamātmaśabdaṃ paramātmatattvaṃ bhavantamāhuḥ śivameva kecit
tvamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pavitra- mānandarūpaṃ praṇavābhidhānam / tvamīśvaro vedapadeṣu siddhaḥ svayaṃ prabho 'śeṣaviśeṣahīnaḥ
tvamindrarūpo varuṇāgnirūpo haṃsaḥ prāṇo mṛtyurantāsi yajñaḥ / prajāpatirbhagavānekarudro nīlagrīvaḥ stūyase vedavidbhiḥ
nārāyaṇastvaṃ jagatāmathādiḥ pitāmahastvaṃ prapitāmahaśca / vedāntaguhyopaniṣatsu gītaḥ sadāśivastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si
namaḥ parastāt tamasaḥ parasmai parātmane pañcapadāntarāya / triśaktyatītāya nirañjanāya sahastraśaktyāsanasaṃsthitāya
trimūrtaye 'nandapadātmamūrte jagannivāsāya jaganmayāya / namo lalāṭārpitalocanāya namo janānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitāya
phaṇīndrahārāya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ munīndrasiddhārcitapādayugma / aiśvaryadharmāsanasaṃsthitāya namaḥ parāntāya bhavodbhavāya
sahastracandrārkavilocanāya namo 'stu te soma sumadhyamāya / namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyabāho namo 'mbikāyāḥ pataye mṛḍāya
namo 'tiguhyāya guhāntarāya vedāntavijñānasuniścitāya / trikālahīnāmaladhāmadhāmne namo maheśāya namaḥ śivāya
evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavān śūlāgrādavaropya tam / tuṣṭaḥ provāca hastābhyāṃ spṛṣṭvātha parameśvaraḥ
prīto 'haṃ sarvathā daitya stavenānena sāṃpratam / saṃprāpya gāṇapatyaṃ me sannidhāne vasāmaraḥ
arogaśchinnasaṃdeho devairapi supūjitaḥ / nandīśvarasyānucaraḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitaḥ
evaṃ vyāhṛtamātre tu devadevena devatāḥ / gaṇeśvarā mahādevamandhakaṃ devasannidhau
sahastrasūryasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candracihnitam / nīlakaṇṭhaṃ jaṭāmauliṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tuṣṭuvurdaityamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ / uvāca bhagavān viṣṇurdevadevaṃ smayanniva
sthāne tava mahādeva prabhāvaḥ puruṣo mahān / nekṣate 'jñānajān doṣān gṛhṇāti ca guṇānapi
itīrito 'tha bhairavo gaṇeśadevapuṅgavaiḥ / sakeśavaḥ sahāndhako jagāma śaṅkarāntikam
nirīkṣya devamāgataṃ saśaṅkaraḥ sahāndhakam / samādhavaṃ samātṛkaṃ jagāma nirvṛtiṃ haraḥ
pragṛhya pāṇineśvaro hiraṇyalocanātmajam / jagāma yatra śailajā vimānamīśavallabhā
vilokya sā samāgataṃ bhavaṃ bhavārtihāriṇam / avāpa sāndhakaṃ sukhaṃ prasādamandhakaṃ prati
athāndhako maheśvarīṃ dadarśa devapārśvagām / papāta daṇḍavatkṣitau nanāma pādapadmayoḥ
namāmi devavallabhāmanādimadrijāmimām / yataḥ pradhānapūruṣau nihanti yākhilaṃ jagat
vibhāti yā śivāsane śivena sākamavyayā / hiraṇmaye 'tinirmale namāmi tāmimāmajām
yadantarākhilaṃ jagajjaganti yānti saṃkṣayam / namāmi yatra tāmumāmaśeṣabedavarjitām
na jāyate nahīyate na vardhate ca tāmumām / namāmi yā guṇātigā girīśaputrikāmimām
kṣamasva devi śailaje kṛtaṃ mayā vimāhataḥ / surāsurairyadarcitaṃ namāmi te padāmbujam
itthaṃ bhagavatī gaurī bhaktinamreṇa pārvatī / saṃstutā daityapatinā putratve jagṛhe 'ndhakam
tataḥ sa mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhairavo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ / jagāmānujñayā śaṃbhoḥ pātālaṃ parameśvaraḥ
yatra sā tāmasī viṣṇormūrtiḥ saṃhārakārikā / samāste hariravyakto nṛsiṃhākṛtirīśvaraḥ
tato 'nantākṛtiḥ śaṃbhuḥ śeṣeṇāpi supūjitaḥ / kālāgnirudro bhagavān yuyojātmānamātmani
yuñjatastasya devasya sarvā evātha mātaraḥ / bubhukṣitā mahādevaṃ praṇamyāhustriśūlinam
mātara ūcuḥ bubhukṣitā mahādeva anujñā dīyatāṃ tvayā / trailokyaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmo nānyathā tṛptirastinaḥ
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ mātaro viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥ / bhakṣayāñcakrire sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
tataḥ sa bhairavo devo nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ harim / dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṣaṇātprādurabhūddhariḥ
vijñāpayāmāsa ca taṃ bhakṣayantīha mātaraḥ / nivārayāśu trailokyaṃ tvadīyā bhagavanniti
saṃsmṛtā viṣṇunā devyo nṛsiṃhavapuṣā punaḥ / upatasthurmahādevaṃ narasiṃhākṛtiṃ ca tam
saṃprāpya sannidhiṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvāḥ saṃhārakārikāḥ / pradaduḥ śaṃbhave śaktiṃ bhairavāyātitejase
apaśyaṃstā jagatsūtiṃ nṛsiṃhamatha bhairavam / kṣaṇādekatvamāpannaṃ śeṣāhiṃ cāpi mātaraḥ
vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśo ye bhaktāḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ / ye ca māṃ saṃsmarantīha pālanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
mamaiva mūrtiratulā sarvasaṃhārakārikā / maheśvarāṃśasaṃbhūtā bhuktimuktipradā tviyam
ananto bhagavān kālo dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu / tāmasī rājasī mūrtirdevadevaścaturmukhaḥ
so 'yaṃ devo durādharṣaḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / bhakṣayiṣyati kalpānte rudrātmā nikhilaṃ jagat
yā sā vimohikā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā / sattvodriktājagat kṛtsnaṃ saṃsthāpayati nityadā
sa hi viṣṇuḥ paraṃ brahma paramātmā parā gatiḥ / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sadānandeti kathyate
ityevaṃ bodhitā devyo viṣṇunā viśvamātaraḥ / prapedire mahādevaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ harim
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayāndhakanibarhaṇam / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya bhairavasyāmitaujasaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca andake nigṛhīte vai prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ / virocano nāma suto babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā
devāñjitvā sadevendrāna bahūn varṣān mahāsuraḥ / pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadācid viṣṇucoditaḥ / sanatkumāro bhagavān puraṃ prāpa mahāmuniḥ
dṛṣṭvā sihāsanagato brahmaputraṃ mahāsuraḥ / nanāmotthāya śirasā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt
dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi saṃprāpto me purātanaḥ / yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān yato 'sau brahmavit svayam
kimarthamāgato brahman svayaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ / brūhi me brahmaṇaḥ putra kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyaham
so 'bravīd bhagavān devo dharmayuktaṃ mahāsuram / draṣṭumabhyāgato 'haṃ vai bhavantaṃ bhāgyavānasi
sudurlabhā nītireṣā daityānāṃ daityasattama / triloke dhārmiko nūnaṃ tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate
ityukto 'surarājastaṃ punaḥ prāha mahāmunim / dharmāṇāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ brūhi me brahmavittama
so 'bravīd bhagavān yogī daityendrāya mahātmane / sarvaguhyatamaṃ dharmamātmajñānamanuttamam
sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānaṃ dattvā ca gurudakṣiṇām / nidhāya putre tadrājyaṃ yogābhyāsarato 'bhavat
sa tasya putro matimān balirnāma mahāsuraḥ / brahmaṇyo dhārmiko 'tyarthaṃ vijigye 'tha purandaram
kṛtvā tena mahad yuddhaṃ śakraḥ sarvāmarairvṛtaḥ / jagāma nirjito viṣṇuṃ devaṃ śaraṇamacyutam
tadantare 'ditirdevī devamātā suduḥ khitā / daityendrāṇāṃ vadhārthāya putro me syāditi svayam
tatāpa sumahad ghoraṃ taporāśistapaḥ param / prapannā viṣṇumavyaktaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ harim
kṛtvā hṛtpadmakiñjalke niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam / vāsudevamanādyantamānandaṃ vyoma kevalam
prasanno bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āvirbabhūva yogātmā devamātuḥ puro hariḥ
dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ viṣṇumaditirbhaktisaṃyutā / mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ toṣayāmāsa keśavam
aditiruvāca jayāśeṣaduḥ khaughanāśaikaheto jayānantamāhātmyayogābhiyukta / jayānādimadhyāntavijñānamūrte jayāśeṣakalpāmalānandarūpa
namo viṣṇave kālarūpāya tubhyaṃ namo nārasiṃhāya śeṣāya tubhyam / namaḥ kālarudrāya saṃhārakartre namo vāsudevāya tubhyaṃ namaste
namo viśvamāyāvidhānāya tubhyaṃ namo yogagamyāya satyāya tubhyam / namo dharmavijñānaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ namaste varāhāya bhūyo namaste
namaste sahastrārkacandrābhamūrte namo vedavijñānadharmābhigamya / namo devadevādidevādideva prabho viśvayone 'tha bhūyo namaste
namaḥ śaṃbhave satyaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ namo hetave viśvarūpāya tubhyam / namo yogapīṭhāntarasthāya tubhyaṃ śivāyaikarūpāya bhūyo namaste
evaṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo devamātrā jaganmayaḥ / toṣitaśchandayāmāsa vareṇa prahasanniva
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau sā vabre varamuttamam / tvāmeva putraṃ devānāṃ hitāya varaye varam
tathāstvityāha bhagavān prapannajanavatsalaḥ / dattvā varānaprameyastatraivāntaradhīyata
tato bahutithe kāle bhagavantaṃ janārdanam / dadhāra garbhaṃ devānāṃ mātā nārāyaṇaṃ svayam
samāviṣṭe hṛṣīkeśe devamāturathodaram / utpātā jajñire ghorā balervairocaneḥ pure
nirīkṣya sarvānutpātān daityendro bhayavihvalaḥ / prahlādamasuraṃ vṛddhaṃ praṇamyāha pitāmaham
baliruvāca pitāmaha mahāprājña jāyante 'smatpure 'dhunā / kimutpātā bhavet kāryamasmākaṃ kiṃnimittakāḥ
niśamya tasya vacanaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāsuraḥ / namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
prahlāda uvāca yo yajñairijyate viṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṃ jagat / dadhārāsuranāśārthaṃ mātā taṃ tridivaukasām
yasmādabhinnaṃ sakalaṃ bhidyate yo 'khilādapi / sa vāsudevo devānāṃ māturdehaṃ samāviśat
na yasya devā jānanti svarūpaṃ paramārthataḥ / sa viṣṇuraditerdehaṃ svecchayādya samāviśat
yasmād bhavanti bhūtāni yatra saṃyānti saṃkṣayam / so 'vatīrṇo mahāyogī purāṇapuruṣo hariḥ
na yatra vidyate nāmajātyādiparikalpanā / sattāmātrātmarūpo 'sau viṣṇuraṃśena jāyate
yasya sā jagatāṃ mātā śaktistaddharmadhāriṇī / māyā bhagavatī lakṣmīḥ so 'vatīrṇo janārdanaḥ
yasya sā tāmasī mūrtiḥ śaṅkaro rājasī tanuḥ / brahmā saṃjāyate viṣṇuraṃśenaikena sattvabhṛt
itthaṃ vicintya govindaṃ bhaktinamreṇa cetasā / tameva gaccha śaraṇaṃ tato yāsyasi nirvṛtim
tataḥ prahlādavacanād balirvairocanirharim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ viśvaṃ pālayāmāsa dharmataḥ
kāle prāpte mahāviṣṇuṃ devānāṃ harṣavardhanam / asūta kaśyapāccainaṃ devamātāditiḥ svayam
caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam / nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam
upatasthuḥ surāḥ sarve siddhāḥ sādhyāśca cāraṇāḥ / upendramindrapramukhā brahmā carṣigamairvṛtaḥ
kṛtopanayano vedānadhyaiṣṭa bhagavān hariḥ / samācāraṃ bharadvājāt trilokāya pradarśayan
evaṃ hi laukikaṃ mārgaṃ pradarśayati sa prabhuḥ / sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate
tataḥ kālena matimān balirvairocaniḥ svayam / yajñairyajñeśvaraṃ viṣṇumarcayāmāsa sarvagam
brāhmaṇān pūjayāmāsa dattvā bahutaraṃ dhanam / brahmarṣayaḥ samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ
vijñāya viṣṇurbhagavān bharadvājapracoditaḥ / āsthāya vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ yajñadeśamathāgamat
kṛṣṇājinopavītāṅga āṣāḍhena virājitaḥ / brāhmaṇo jaṭilo vedānudgiran bhasmamaṇḍitaḥ
saṃprāpyāsurarājasya samīpaṃ bhikṣuko hariḥ / svapādairvimitaṃ deśamayācata baliṃ tribhiḥ
prakṣālya caraṇau viṣṇorbalirbhāsamanvitaḥ / ācāmayitvā bhṛṅgāramādāya svarṇanirmitam
dāsye tavedaṃ bhavate padatrayaṃ prīṇātu devo hariravyayākṛtiḥ / vicintya devasya karāgrapallave nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ suśītalam
vicakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etā- mathāntarikṣaṃ divamādidevaḥ / vyapetarāgaṃ ditijeśvaraṃ taṃ prakartukāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prapannam
ākramya lokatrayamīśapādaḥ prājāpatyād brahmalokaṃ jagāma / praṇemurādityasahastrakalpaṃ ye tatra loke nivasanti siddhāḥ
athopatasthe bhagavānanādiḥ pitāmahāstoṣayāmāsa viṣṇum / bhittvā tadaṇḍasya kapālamūrdhvaṃ jagāma divyāvaraṇāni bhūyaḥ
athāṇḍabhedānnipapāta śītalaṃ mahājalaṃ tat puṇyakṛdbhiścajuṣṭam / pravartate cāpi saridvarā tadā gaṅgetyuktā brahmaṇā vyomasaṃsthā
gatvā mahāntaṃ prakṛtiṃ pradhānaṃ brahmāṇamekaṃ puruṣaṃ svabījam / atiṣṭhadīśasya padaṃ tadavyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāstatra tatra stuvanti
ālokya taṃ puruṣaṃ viśvakāyaṃ mahān balirbhaktiyogena viṣṇum / nanāma nārāyaṇamekamavyayaṃ svacetasā yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ
tamabravīd bhagavānādikartā bhūtvā punarvāmano vāsudevaḥ / mamaiva daityādhipate 'dhunedaṃ lokatrayaṃ bhavatā bhāvadattam
praṇamya mūrdhnā punareva daityo nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ karāgre / dāsye tavātmānamanantadhāmne trivikramāyāmitavikramāya
pragṛhya sūnorapi saṃpradattaṃ prahlādasūnoratha śaṅkhapāṇiḥ / jagāda daityaṃ jagadantarātmā pātālamūlaṃ praviśeti bhūyaḥ
samāsyatāṃ bhavatā tatra nityaṃ bhuktvā bhogān devatānāmalabhyān / dhyāyasva māṃ satataṃ bhaktiyogāt pravekṣyase kalpadāhe punarmām
uktvaivaṃ daityasiṃhaṃ taṃ viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ / purandarāya trailokyaṃ dadau viṣṇururukramaḥ
saṃstuvanti mahāyogaṃ siddhā devarṣikinnarāḥ / brahmā śakro 'tha bhagavān rudrādityamarudgaṇāḥ
kṛtvaitadadbhutaṃ karma viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk / paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
so 'pi daityavaraḥ śrīmān pātālaṃ prāpa coditaḥ / prahlādenāsuravarairviṣṇunā viṣṇutatparaḥ
apṛcchad viṣṇumāhātmayaṃ bhaktiyogamanuttamam / pūjāvidhānaṃ prahlādaṃ tadāhāsau cakāra saḥ
atha rathacaraṇāsiśaṅkhapāṇiṃ sarasijolacanamīśamaprameyam / śaraṇamupapayau sa bhāvayogāt praṇatagatiṃ praṇidhāya karmayogam
eṣa vaḥ kathito viprā vāmanasya parākramaḥ / sa devakāryāṇi sadā karoti puruṣottamaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāya baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīnmahābalaparākramam / teṣāṃ pradhāno dyutimān bāṇo nāma mahābalaḥ
so 'tīva śaṅkare bhakto rājā rājyamapālayat / trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya bādhayāmāsa vāsavam
tataḥ śakrādayo devā gatvocuḥ kṛttivāsasam / tvadīyo bādhate hyasmān bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ
vyāhṛto daivadaiḥ sarvairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ / dadāha bāṇasya puraṃ śareṇaikena līlayā
dahyamāne pure tasmin bāṇo rudraṃ triśūlinam / yayau śaraṇamīśānaṃ gopatiṃ nīlalohitam
mūrdhanyādhāya talliṅgaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ bhītavarjitaḥ / nirgatya tu purāt tasmāt tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
saṃstuto bhagavānīśaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ / gāṇapatyena bāṇaṃ taṃ yojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ
athābhavan danoḥ putrāstārādyā hyatibhīṣaṇāḥ / tārastathā śambaraśca kapilaḥ śaṅkarastathā / svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ
surasāyāḥ sahastraṃ tu sarpāṇāmabhavad dvijāḥ / anekaśirasāṃ tadvat khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām
ariṣṭā janayāmāsa gandharvāṇāṃ sahastrakam / anantādyā mahānāgāḥ kādraveyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
tāmrā ca janayāmāsa ṣaṭ kanyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ / śukīṃ śyenīṃ ca bhāsīṃ ca sugrīvāṅgṛdhrikāṃ śucim
gāstathā janayāmāsa surabhirmahiṣīstathā / irā vṛkṣalatāvallīstṛṇajātīśca sarvaśaḥ
khasā vai yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā / rakṣogaṇaṃ krodhavaśā janayāmāsa sattamāḥ
vinatāyāśca putrau dvau prakhyātau garuḍāruṇau / tayośca garuḍo dhīmān tapastaptvā suduścaram / prasādācchūnilaḥ prāpto vāhanatvaṃ hareḥ svayam
ārādhya tapasā rudraṃ mahdevaṃ tathāruṇaḥ / sārathye kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ prītenārkasya śaṃbhunā
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāḥ sthāṇujaṅgamāḥ / vaivasvate 'nte hyasmiñchṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ
saptaviṃśat sutāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyaśca suvratāḥ / ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa
bahuputrasya viduṣaścatastro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ / tadvadaṅgirasaḥ putrā ṛṣayo brahmasatkṛtāḥ
kuśāśvasya tu devarṣerdevapraharaṇāḥ sutāḥ / ete yugasahastrānte jāyante punareva hi / manvantareṣu niyataṃ tulyaiḥ kāryaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etānutpādya putrāṃstu prajāsaṃtānakāraṇāt / kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra sumahat tapaḥ
tasya vai tapato 'tyarthaṃ prādurbhūtau sutāvimau / vatsaraścāsitaścaiva tāvubhau brahmavādinau
vatsarānnaidhruvo jajñe raibhyaśca sumahāyaśāḥ / raibhyasya jajñire raibhyāḥ putrā dyutimatāṃ varāḥ
cyavanasya sutā patnī naidhruvasya mahātmanaḥ / sumedhā janayāmāsa putrān vai kuṇḍapāyinaḥ
asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samapadyata / nāmnā vai devalaḥ putro yogācāryo mahātapāḥ
śāṇḍilyānāṃ paraḥ śrīmān sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ / prasādāt pārvatīśasya yogamuttamamāptavān
śāṇḍilyā naidhru vāraibhyāstrayaḥ pakṣāstu kāśyapāḥ / naraprakṛtayo viprāḥ pulastyasya vadāmi vaḥ
tṛṇabindoḥ sutā viprā nāmnā tvilavilā smṛtā / pulastyāya sa rājarṣistāṃ kanyāṃ pratyapādayat
ṛṣistvailavilistasyāṃ viśravāḥ samapadyata / tasya patnyaścatastrastu paulastyakulavardhikāḥ
puṣpotkaṭā ca rākā ca kaikasī devavarṇinī / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāstāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ
jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasya suṣuve devarūpiṇī / kaikasī janayat putraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam
kumbhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam / puṣpotkaṭā vyajanayat putrān viśravasaḥ śubhān
mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā / kumbhīnasīṃ tathā kanyāṃ rākāyāṃ śṛṇuta prajāḥ
triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvo mahābalaḥ / ityete krūrakarmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā daśa / sarve tapobalotkṛṣṭā rudrabhaktāḥ subhīṣaṇāḥ
pulahasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyālāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ / bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ sarpāśca śūkarā hastinastathā
anapatyaḥ kratustasmin smṛto vaivasvate 'ntare / marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ svayameva prajāpatiḥ
bhṛgorapyabhavacchukro daityācāryo mahātapāḥ / svādhyāyayoganirato harabhakto mahādyutiḥ
atreḥ patnyo 'bhavan bahvyaḥ sodaryāstāḥ pativratāḥ / kṛśāśvasya tu viprendrā ghṛtācyāmiti me śrutam
sa tāsu janayāmāsa svastyātreyān mahaujasaḥ / vedavedāṅganiratāṃstapasā hatakilbiṣān
nāradastu vasiṣṭhāya dadau devīmarundhatīm / ūrdhvaretāstatra muniḥ śāpād dakṣasya nāradaḥ
haryaśveṣu tu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya tu / śaśāpa nāradaṃ dakṣaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
yasmānmama sutāḥ sarve bhavato māyayā dvija / kṣayaṃ nītāstvaśeṣeṇa nirapatyo bhaviṣyati
arundhatyāṃ vasiṣṭhastu śaktimutpādayat sutam / śakteḥ parāśaraḥ śrīmān sarvajñastapatāṃ varaḥ
ārādhya devadeveśamīśānaṃ tripurāntakam / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ kṛṣṇādvaipāyanaṃ prabhum
dvaipāyanācchrako jajñe bhagavāneva śaṅkaraḥ / aṃśāṃśenāvatīryorvyāṃ svaṃ prāpa paramaṃ padam
śukasyāpyabhavan putrāḥ pañcātyantatapasvinaḥ / bhūriśravāḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇo gauraśca pañcamaḥ / kanyā kīrtimatī caiva yogamātā dhṛtavratā
ete 'tra vaṃśyāḥ kathitā brāhmaṇā brahmavādinām / ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhadhvaṃ kaśyapādrājasaṃtatim

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca aditiḥ suṣuve putramādityaṃ kaśyapāt prabhum / tasyādityasya caivasīd bhāryāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam / saṃjñā rājñī prabhā chāyā putrāṃstāsāṃ nibodhata
saṃjñā tvāṣṭrī ca suṣuve sūryānmanumanuttamam / yamaṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva rājñī raivatameva ca
prabhā prabhātamādityācchāyā sāvarṇamātmajam / śaniṃ ca tapatīṃ caiva viṣṭiṃ caiva yathākramam
manostu prathamasyāsan nava putrāstu saṃyamāḥ / ikṣvākurnabhagaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca
nariṣyantaśca nābhāgo hyariṣṭaḥ kāruṣakastathā / pṛṣadhraśca mahātejā navaite śakrasannibhāḥ
ilā jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca somavaṃśavivṛddhaye / budhasya gatvā bhavanaṃ somaputreṇa saṃgatā
asūta saumyajaṃ devī purūravasamuttamam / pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikartāraṃ budhāditi hi naḥ śrutam
saṃprāpya puṃstvamamalaṃ sudyumna iti viśrutaḥ / ilā putratrayaṃ lebhe punaḥ strītvamavindata
utkalaśca gayaścaiva vinatāśvastathaiva ca / sarve te 'pratimaprakhyāḥ prapannāḥ kamalodbhavam
ikṣvākoścābhavad vīro vikukṣirnāma pārthivaḥ / jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāpi daśa pañca ca tatsutāḥ
teṣāñjyeṣṭhaḥ kakutstho 'bhūt kākutstho hi suyodhanaḥ / suyodhanāt pṛthuḥ śrīmān viśvakaśca pṛthoḥ sutaḥ
viśvakādārdrako dhīmān yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ / sa gokarṇamanuprāpya yuvanāśvaḥ pratāpavān
dṛṣṭvā tu gautamaṃ vipraṃ tapantamanalaprabham / praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau putrakāmo mahīpatiḥ / apṛcchat karmaṇā kena dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam
gautama uvāca ārādhya pūrvapuruṣaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam
yasya putraḥ svayaṃ brahmā pautraḥ syānnīlalohitaḥ / tamādikṛṣṇamīśānamārādhyāpnoti satsutam
na yasya bhagavān brahmā prabhāvaṃ vetti tattvataḥ / tamārādhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ prāpnuyāddhārmikaṃ sutam
sa gautamavacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ / ārādhayanmahāyogaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
tasya putro 'bhavad vīraḥ śrāvastiriti viśrutaḥ / nirmitā yena śrāvastirgauḍadeśe mahāpurī
tasmācca bṛhadaśvo 'bhūt tasmāt kuvalayāśvakaḥ / dhundhumāratvamagamad dhundhuṃ hatvā mahāsuram
dhundhumārasya tanayāstrayaḥ proktā dvijottamāḥ / dṛḍhāśvaścaiva daṇḍāśvaḥ kapilāśvastathaiva ca
dṛḍhāśvasya pramodastu haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ / haryaśvasya nikumbhastu nikumbhāt saṃhatāśvakaḥ
kṛśāśvaśca raṇāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasya vai sutau / yuvanāśvo raṇāśvasya śakratulyabalo yudhi
kṛtvā tu vāruṇīmiṣṭimṛṣīṇāṃ vai prasādataḥ / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ viṣṇubhaktamanuttamam / māndhātāraṃ mahāprājñaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
māndhātuḥ purukutso 'bhūdambarīṣaśca vīryavān / mucukundaśca puṇyātmā sarve śakrasamā yudhi
ambarīṣasya dāyādo yuvanāśvo 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ / harito yuvanāśvasya hāritastatsuto 'bhavat
purukutsasya dāyādastrasadasyurmahāyaśāḥ / narmadāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃbhūtistatsuto 'bhavat
viṣṇuvṛddhaḥ sutastasya tvanaraṇyo 'bhavat paraḥ / bṛhadaśavo 'naraṇyasya haryaśvastatsuto 'bhavat
so 'tīva dhārmiko rājā kardamasya prajāpateḥ / prasādāddhārmikaṃ putraṃ lebhe sūryaparāyaṇam
sa tu sūryaṃ samabhyarcya rājā vasumanāḥ śubham / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ tridhanvānamarindamam
ayajaccāśvamedhena śatrūn jitvā dvijottamāḥ / svādhyāyavān dānaśīlastitikṣurdharmatatparaḥ
ṛṣayastu samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ / vasiṣṭhakaśyapamukhā devāścendrapurogamāḥ
tān praṇamya mahārājaḥ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ / samāpya vidhivad yajñaṃ vasiṣṭhādīn dvijottamān
vasumanā uvāca kiṃsviccheyaskarataraṃ loke 'smin brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ / yajñastapo vā saṃnyāso brūta me sarvavedinaḥ
vasiṣṭha uvāca adhītya vedān vidhivat putrānutpādya dharmataḥ / iṣṭvā yajñeśvaraṃ yajñair gaccheda vanamathātmavān
pulastya uvāca ārādhya tapasā devaṃ yoginaṃ parameṣṭhinam / pravrajed vidhivad yajñairiṣṭvā pūrvaṃ surottamān
pulaha uvāca yamāhurekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ parameśvaram / tamārādhya sahastrāṃśuṃ tapasā mokṣamāpnuyāt
jamadagniruvāca ajasya nābhāvadhyekamīśvareṇa samarpitam / bījaṃ bhagavatā yena sa devastapasejyate
viśvāmitra uvāca yo 'gniḥ sarvātmako 'nantaḥ svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ / sa rudrastapasogreṇa pūjyate netarairmakhaiḥ
bharadvāja uvāca yo yajñairijyate devo jātavedāḥ sanātanaḥ / sa sarvadaivatatanuḥ pūjyate tapaseśvaraḥ
atriruvāca yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ yasyāpatyaṃ prajāpatiḥ / tapaḥ sumahadāsthāya pūjyate sa maheśvaraḥ
gautama uvāca yataḥ pradhānapuruṣau yasya śaktimayaṃ jagat / sa devadevastapasā pūjanīyaḥ sanātanaḥ
kaśyapa uvāca sahastranayano devaḥ sākṣī sa tu prajāpatiḥ / prasīdati mahāyogī pūjitastapasā paraḥ
kraturuvāca prāptādhyayanayajñas labdhaputrasya caiva hi / nāntareṇa tapaḥ kaściddharmaḥ śāstreṣu dṛśyate
ityākarṇya sa rājarṣistān praṇamyātihṛṣṭadhīḥ / visarjayitvā saṃpūjya tridhanvānamathābravīt
ārādhayiṣye tapasā devamekākṣarāhvayam / prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ puruṣamādityāntarasaṃsthitam
tvaṃ tu dharmarato nityaṃ pālayaitadatandritaḥ / cāturvarṇyasamāyuktamaśeṣaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam
evamuktvā sa tadrājyaṃ nidhāyātmabhave nṛpaḥ / jagāmāraṇyamanaghastapaścartumanuttamam
himavacchikhare ramye devadāruvane śubhe / kandamūlaphalāhāro munyannairayajat surān
saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ taponirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ / jajāpa manasā devīṃ sāvitrariṃ vedamātaram
tasyaivaṃ japato devaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ parameśvaraḥ / hiraṇyagarbho viśvātmā taṃ deśamagamat svayam
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ samāyāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvatomukham / nanāma śirasā tasya pādayornāma kīrtayan
namo devādhidevāya brahmaṇe paramātmane / hirṇyamūrtaye tubhyaṃ sahastrākṣāya vedhase
namo dhātre vidhātre ca namo vedātmamūrtaye / sāṃkhyayogādhigamyāya namaste jñānamūrtaye
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ straṣṭre sarvārthavedine / puruṣāya purāṇāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān viriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ / varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado 'smītyabhāṣata
rājovāca japeyaṃ devadeveśa gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / bhūyo varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tāvadāyurbhavenmama
bāḍhamityāha viśvātmā samālokya narādhipam / spṛṣṭvā karābhyāṃ suprītastatraivāntaradhīyata
so 'pi labdhavaraḥ śrīmān jajāpātiprasannadhīḥ / śāntastriṣavaṇasnāyī kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ
tasya pūrṇe varṣaśate bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ / prādurāsīnmahāyogī bhānormaṇḍalamadhyataḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vedaviduṣaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ sanātanam / svayaṃbhuvamanādyantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ
tuṣṭāva vaidikairmantraiḥ sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ / kṣaṇādapaśyat puruṣaṃ tameva parameśvaram
caturmukhaṃ jaṭāmaulimaṣṭahastaṃ trilocanam / candrāvayavalakṣamāṇaṃ naranārītanuṃ haram
bhāsayantaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ svaraśmibhiḥ / raktāmbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyānulepanam
tadbhāvabhāvito dṛṣṭvā sadbhāvena pareṇa hi / nanāma śirasā rudraṃ sāvitryānena caiva hi
namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine / trayīmayāya rudrāya kālarūpāya hetave
tadā prāha mahādevo rājānaṃ prītamānasaḥ / imāni me rahasyāni nāmāni śṛṇu cānagha
sarvavedeṣu gītāni saṃsāraśamanāni tu / namaskuruṣva nṛpate ebhirmāṃ satataṃ śuciḥ
adhyāyaṃ śatarudrīyaṃ yajuṣāṃ sāramuddhṛtam / japasvānanyacetasko mayyāsaktamanā nṛpa
brahmacārī mitāhāro bhasmaniṣṭhaḥ samāhitaḥ / japedāmaraṇād rudraṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam
ityuktvā bhagavān rudro bhaktānugrahakāmyayā / punaḥ saṃvatsaraśataṃ rājñe hyāyurakalpayat
dattvāsmai tat paraṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ parameśvaraḥ / kṣaṇādantardadhe rudrastadadbhutamivābhavat
rājāpi tapasā rudraṃ jajāpānanyamānasaḥ / bhasmacchannastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā śāntaḥ samāhitaḥ
japatastasya nṛpateḥ pūrṇe varṣaśate punaḥ / yogapravṛttirabhavat kālāt kālātmakaṃ param
viveśa tad vedasāraṃ sthānaṃ vai parameṣṭhinaḥ / bhānoḥ sa maṇḍalaṃ śubhraṃ tato yāto maheśvaram
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi rājñaścaritamuttamam / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekonaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tridhanvā rājaputrastu dharmeṇāpālayanmahīm / tasya putro 'bhavad vidvāṃstrayyāruṇa iti smṛtaḥ
tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro 'bhūnmahābalaḥ / bhāryā satyadhanā nāma hariścandramajījanat
hariścandrasya putro 'bhūd rohito nāma vīryavān / harito rohitasyātha dhundhustasya suto 'bhavat
vijayaśca sudevaśca dhundhuputrau babhūvatuḥ / vijayasyābhavat putraḥ kāruko nāma vīryavān
kārukasya vṛkaḥ putrastasmād bāhurajāyata / sagarastasya putrau'bhūd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
dve bhārye sagarasyāpi prabhā bhānumatī tathā / tābhyāmārādhitaḥ prādādaurvāgnirvaramuttamam
ekaṃ bhānumatī putramagṛhṇādasamañjasam / prabhā ṣaṣṭisahastraṃ tu putrāṇāṃ jagṛhe śubhā
asamañsasya tanayo hyaṃśumān nāma pārthivaḥ / tasya putro dilīpastu dilīpāt tu bhagīrathaḥ
yena bhāgīrathī gaṅgā tapaḥ kṛtvāvatāritā / prasādād devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
bhagīrathasya tapasā devaḥ prītamanā haraḥ / babhāra śirasā gaṅgāṃ somānte somabhūṣaṇaḥ
bhagīrathasutaścāpi śruto nāma babhūva ha / nābhāgastasya dāyādaḥ sindhudvīpastato 'bhavat
ayutāyuḥ sutastasya ṛtuparṇastu tatsutaḥ / ṛtuparṇasya putro 'bhūt sudāso nāma dhārmikāḥ / saudāsastasya tanayaḥ khyātaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ
vasiṣṭhastu mahātejāḥ kṣetre kalmāṣapādake / aśmakaṃ janayāmasā tamikṣvākukuladhvajam
aśmakasyotkalāyāṃ tu nakulo nāma pārthivaḥ / sa hi rāmabhayād rājā vanaṃ prāpa suduḥ khitaḥ
vibhrat sa nārīkavacaṃ tasmācchataratho 'bhavat / tasmād bilibiliḥ śrīmānvṛddhaśarmācatatsutaḥ
tasmād viśvasahastasmāt khaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ / dīrghabāhuḥ sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata
raghorajaḥ samutpanno rājā daśarathastataḥ / rāmo dāśarathirvoro dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ
bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalaḥ / sarve śakrasamā yuddhe viṣṇuśaktisamanvitāḥ / jajñe rāvaṇanāśārthaṃ viṣṇuraṃśena viśvakṛt
rāmasya subhagā bhāryā janakasyātmajā śubhā / sītā trilokavikhyātā śīlaudāryaguṇānvitā
tapasā toṣitā devī janakena girīndrajā / prāyacchajjānakīṃ sītāṃ rāmamevāśritā patim
prītaśca bhagavānīśastriśūlī nīlalohitaḥ / pradadau śatrunāśārthaṃ janakāyādbhutaṃ dhanuḥ
sa rājā janako vidvān dātukāmaḥ sutāmimām / aghoṣayadamitraghno loke 'smin dvijapuṅgavāḥ
idaṃ dhanuḥ samādātuṃ yaḥ śaknoti jagattraye / devo vā dānavo vāpi sa sītāṃ labdhumarhati
vijñāya rāmo balavān janakasya gṛhaṃ prabhuḥ / bhañjayāmāsa cādāya gatvāsau līlayaiva hi
udvavāha ca tāṃ kanyāṃ pārvatīmiva śaṅkaraḥ / rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā senāmiva ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ
tato bahutithe kāle rājā daśarathaḥ svayam / rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumārabhat
tasyātha patnī subhagā kaikeyī cārubhāṣiṇī / nivārayāmāsa patiṃ prāha saṃbhrāntamānasā
matsutaṃ bharataṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumarhasi / pūrvameva varo yasmād datto me bhavatā yataḥ
sa tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā duḥ khitamānasaḥ / bāḍhamityabravīd vākyaṃ tathā rāmo 'pi dharmavit
praṇamyātha pituḥ pādau lakṣmaṇena sahācyutaḥ / yayau vanaṃ sapatnīkaḥ kṛtvā samayamātmavān
saṃvatsarāṇāṃ catvāri daśa caiva mahābalaḥ / uvāsa tatra matimān lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ
kadācid vasato 'raṇye rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ / parivrājakaveṣeṇa sītāṃ hṛtvā yayau purīm
adṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇo rāmaḥ sītāmākulitendriyau / duḥ khaśokābhisaṃtaptau babhūvaturarindamau
tataḥ kadācit kapinā sugrīveṇa dvijottamāḥ / vānarāṇāmabhūt sakhyaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
sugrīvasyānugo vīro hanumān nma vānaraḥ / vāyuputrau mahātejā rāmasyāsīt priyaḥ sadā
sa kṛtvā paramaṃ dhairyaṃ rāmāya kṛtaniścayaḥ / ānayiṣyāmi tāṃ sītāmityuktvā vicacāra ha
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ sītādarśanatatparaḥ / jagāma rāvaṇapurīṃ laṅkāṃ sāgarasaṃsthitām
tatrātha nirjane deśe vṛkṣmūle śucismitām / apaśyadamalāṃ sītāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇāṃ hṛdyāṃ saṃsmarantīmaninditām / rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ cātmasaṃsthitam
nivedayitvā cātmānaṃ sītāyai rahasi svayam / asaṃśayāya pradadāvasyai rāmāṅgulīyakam
dṛṣṭvāṅgulīyakaṃ sītā patyuḥ paramaśobhanam / mene samāgataṃ rāmaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā
samāśvāsya tadā sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya cāntikam / nayiṣye tvāṃ mahābāhuruktvā rāmaṃ yayau punaḥ
nivedayitvā rāmāya sītādarśanamātmavān / tasthau rāmeṇa purato lakṣmaṇena ca pūjitaḥ
tataḥ sa rāmo balavān sārdhaṃ hanumatā svayam / lakṣmaṇena ca yuddhāya buddhiṃ cakre hi rakṣasām
kṛtvātha vānaraśatairlaṅkāmārgaṃ mahodadheḥ / setuṃ paramadharmātmā rāvaṇaṃ hatavān prabhuḥ
sapatnīkaṃ ca sasutaṃ sabhrātṛkamaridamaḥ / ānayāmāsa tāṃ sītāṃ vāyuputrasahāyavān
setumadhye mahādevamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam / sthāpayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
tasya devo mahādevaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ / pratyakṣameva bhagavān dattavān varamuttamam
yat tvayā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ drakṣyantīha dvijātayaḥ / mahāpātakasaṃyuktāsteṣāṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyatu
anyāni caiva pāpāni snātasyātra mahodadhau / darśanādeva liṅgasalya nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ
yāvat sthāsyanti girayo yāvadeṣā ca medinī / yāvat setuśca tāvacca sthāsyāmyatra tirohitaḥ
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyatyakṣyaṃ kṛtam / smaraṇādeva liṅgasya dinapāpaṃ praṇaśyati
ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ pariṣvajya tu rāghavam / sanandī sagaṇo rudrastatraivāntaradhīyata
rāmo 'pi pālayāmāsa rājyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / abhiṣikto mahātejā bharatena mahābalaḥ
viśeṣāḍh brāhmaṇān sarvān pūjayāmasaceśvaram / yajñena yajñahantāramaśvamedhena śaṅkaram
rāmasya tanayo jajñe kuśa ityabhiviśrutaḥ / lavaśca sumahābhāgaḥ sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ
atithistu kuśājjajñe niṣadhastatsuto 'bhavat / nalastu niṣadhasyābhūnnabhastamādajāyata
nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīkākhyaḥ kṣemadhanvā ca tatsutaḥ / tasya putro 'bhavad vīro devānīkaḥ pratāpavān
ahīnagustasya suto sahasvāṃstatsuto 'bhavat / tasmāccandrāvalokastu tārāpīḍastu tatsutaḥ
tārāpīḍāccandragirirbhānuvittastato 'bhavat / śrutāyurabhavat tasmādete ikṣvākuvaṃśajāḥ / sarve prādhānyataḥ proktāḥ samāsena dvijottamāḥ
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityamikṣvākorvaṃśamuttamam / sarvapāpavinirmukto svargaloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ romaharṣaṇa uvāca ailaḥ purūravāścātha rājā rājyamapālayat / tasya putrā babhūvurhi ṣaḍindrasamatejasaḥ
āyurmāyuramāvāyurviśvāyuścaiva vīryavān / śatāyuśca śrutāyuśca divyāścaivorvaśīsutāḥ
āyuṣastanayā vīrāḥ pañcaivāsan mahaujasaḥ / svarbhānutanayāyāṃ vai prabhāyāmiti naḥ śrutam
nahuṣaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ / nahuṣasya tu dāyādāḥ ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ
utpannāḥ pitṛkanyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ mahābalāḥ / yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyātiḥ pañcako 'śvakaḥ
teṣāṃ yayātiḥ pañcānāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ / devayānīmukhanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa saḥ / śarmiṣṭhāmāsurīṃ caiva tanayāṃ vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata / druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā cāpyajījanat
so 'bhyaṣiñcadatikramya jyeṣṭhaṃ yadumaninditam / purumeva kanīyāsaṃ piturvacanapālakam
diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ putramādiśat / dakṣiṇāparayo rājā yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat / pratīcyāmuttārāyāṃ ca druhyuṃ cānumakalpayat
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dharmataḥ paripālitā / rājāpi dārasahito navaṃ prāpa mahāyaśāḥ
yadorapyabhavan putrāḥ pañca devasutopamāḥ / sahastrajit tathājyeṣṭhaḥ kroṣaṭurnālo 'jitoraghuḥ
sahastrajitsutastadvacchatajinnāma pārthivaḥ / sutāḥ śatajito 'pyāsaṃstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
haihayaśca hayaścaiva rājā veṇuhayaḥ paraḥ / haihayasyābhavat putro dharma ityabhiviśrutaḥ
tasya putro 'bhavad viprā dharmanetraḥ pratāpavān / dharmanetrasya kīrtistu saṃjitastatsuto 'bhavat
mahiṣmān saṃjitasyābhūd bhadraśreṇyastadanvayaḥ / bhadraśreṇyasya dāyādo durdamo nāma pārthivaḥ
durdamasya suto dhīmān dhanako nāma vīryavān / dhanakasya tu dāyādāścatvāro lokasammatāḥ
kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtāgniśca kṛtavarmā tathaiva ca / kṛtaujāśca caturtho 'bhūt kārtavīryor'juno 'bhavat
sahastrabāhurdyutimān dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ / tasya rāmo 'bhavanmṛtyurjāmadagnyo janārdanaḥ
tasya putraśatānyāsan pañca tatra mahārathāḥ / kṛtāstrā balinaḥ śūrā dharmātmāno namasvinaḥ
śūraśca śūrasenaśca dhṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca / jayadhvajaśca balavān nārāyaṇaparo nṛpaḥ
śūrasenādayaḥ sarve catvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ / rudrabhaktā mahātmānaḥ pūjayanti sma śaṅkaram
jayadhvajastu matimān devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ daivataṃ dharmatatparaḥ
tamūcuritare putrā nāyaṃ dharmastavānagha / īśvarārādhanarataḥ pitāsmākamabhūditi
tānabravīnmahātejā eṣa dharmaḥ paro mama / viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtā rājāno yanmahītale
rājyaṃ pālayatāvaśyaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ / pūjanīyo yato viṣṇuḥ pālako jagato hariḥ
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ca svayaṃbhuvaḥ / tistrastu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ
sattvātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ saṃsthāpayati sarvadā / sṛjed brahmā rajomūrtiḥ saṃharet tāmaso haraḥ
tasmānmahīpatīnāṃ tu rājyaṃ pālayatāmayam / ārādhyo bhagavān viṣṇuḥ keśavaḥ keśimardanaḥ
niśamya tasya vacanaṃ bhrātaro 'nye manasvinaḥ / procuḥ saṃhārakṛd rudraḥ pūjanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ
ayaṃ hi bhagavān rudraḥ sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ śivaḥ / tamoguṇaṃ samāśritya kalpānte saṃharet prabhuḥ
yā sā ghoratarā mūrtirasya tejāmayī parā / saṃhared vidyayā sarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ śūlabhṛt tayā
tatastānabravīd rājā vicintyāsau jayadhvajaḥ / sattvena mucyate jantuḥ sattvātmā bhagavān hariḥ
tamūcurbhrātaro rudraḥ sevitaḥ sāttvikairjanaiḥ / mocayet sattvasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayeśaṃ tato haram
