athābravīd rājaputraḥ prahasan vai jayadhvajaḥ / svadharmo muktaye panthā nānyo munibhiraṣyate
tathā ca vaiṣṇavī śaktirnṛpāṇāṃ devatā sadā / ārādhanaṃ paro dharmo purāreramitaujasaḥ
tamabravīd rājaputraḥ kṛṣṇo matimatāṃ varaḥ / yadarjuno 'smajjanakaḥ svadharmaṃ kṛtavāniti
evaṃ vivāde vitate śūraseno 'bravīd vacaḥ / pramāṇamṛṣayo hyatra brūyuste yat tathaiva tat
tataste rājaśārdūlāḥ papracchurbrahmavādinaḥ / gatvā sarve susaṃrabdhāḥ saptarṣoṇāṃ tadāśramam
tānabruvaṃste munayo vasiṣṭhādyā yathārthataḥ / yā yasyābhimatā puṃsaḥ sā hi tasyaiva devatā
kintu kāryaviśeṣeṇa pūjitāśceṣṭadā nṛṇām / viśeṣāt sarvadā nāyaṃ niyamo hyanyathā nṛpāḥ
nṛpāṇāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca purandaraḥ / viprāṇāmagnirādityo brahmā caiva pinākadhṛk
devānāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇurdānavānāṃ triśūlabhṛt / gandharvāṇāṃ tathā somo yakṣāṇāmapi kathyate
vidyādharāṇāṃ vāgdevī sādhyānāṃ bhagavānraviḥ / rakṣasāṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ kiṃnarāṇāṃ ca pārvatī
ṛṣīṇāṃ daivataṃ brahmā mahādevaśca śūlabhṛt / manūnāṃ syādumā devī tathā viṣṇuḥ sabhāskaraḥ
gṛhasthānāṃ ca sarve syurbrahmā vai brahmacāriṇām / vaikhānasānāmarkaḥ syād yatīnāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ
bhūtānāṃ bhagavān rudraḥ kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ vināyakaḥ / sarveṣāṃ bhagavān brahmā devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
ityevaṃ bhagavān brahmā svayaṃ devo 'bhyabhāṣata / tasmājjayadhvajo nūnaṃ viṣṇvārādhanamarhati
tān praṇamyātha te jagmuḥ purīṃ paramaśobhanām / pālayāñcakrire pṛthvīṃ jitvā sarvaripūn raṇe
tataḥ kadācid viprendrā videho nāma dānavaḥ / bhīṣaṇaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ purīṃ teṣāṃ samāyayau
daṃṣṭrākarālo dīptātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ / śūlamādāya sūryābhaṃ nādayan vai diśo daśa
tannādaśravaṇānmartyāstatra ye nivasanti te / tatyajurjovitaṃ tvanye dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ
tataḥ sarve susaṃyattāḥ kārtavīryātmajāstadā / yuyudhurdānavaṃ śaktigirikūṭāsimudgaraiḥ
tān sarvān dānavo viprāḥ śūlena prahasanniva / vārayāmāsa ghorātmā kalpānte bhairavo yathā
śūrasenādayaḥ pañca rājānastu mahābalāḥ / yuddhāya kṛtasaṃrambhā videhaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ
śūro 'straṃ prāhiṇod raudraṃ śūrasenastu vāruṇam / prājāpatyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇo vāyavyaṃ dhṛṣṇa eva ca
jayadhvajaśca kauberamaindramāgneyameva ca / bhañjayāmāsa śūlena tānyastrāṇi sa dānavaḥ
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahāvīryo gadāmādāya bhīṣaṇām / spṛṣṭvā mantreṇa tarasā cikṣepa na nanāda ca
saṃprāpya sā gādāsyoro videhasya śilopamam / na dānavaṃ cālayituṃ śaśākāntakasaṃnibham
dudruvuste bhayagrastā dṛṣṭvā tasyātipauruṣam / jayadhvajastu matimān sasmāra jagataḥ patim
viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇuṃ lokādimaprameyamanāmayam / trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ pūrvaṃ śrīpatiṃ pītavāsasam
tataḥ prādurabhūccakraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham / ādeśād vāsudevasya bhaktānugrahakāraṇāt
jagrāha jagatāṃ yoniṃ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ / prāhiṇod vai videhāya dānavebhyo yathā hariḥ
saṃprāpya tasya ghorasya skandhadeśaṃ sudarśanam / pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa śiro 'driśikharākṛti
tasmin hate devaripau śīrādyā bhrātaro nṛpāḥ / samāyayuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhrātaraṃ cāpyapūjayan
śrutvājagāma bhagavān jayadhvajaparākramam / kārtavīryasutaṃ draṣṭuṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā rājā saṃbhrāntamānasaḥ / samāveśyāsane ramye pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ
uvāca bhagavān ghoraḥ prasādād bhavato 'suraḥ / nipātito mayā saṃkhye videho dānaveśvaraḥ
tvadvākyācchinnasaṃdeho viṣṇuṃ satyaparākramam / prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ tena prasādo me kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ
yakṣyāmi parameśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ padmadalekṣaṇam / kathaṃ kena vidhānena saṃpūjyo harirīśvaraḥ
ko 'yaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ kiṃprabhāvaśca suvrata / sarvametanmamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
viśvāmitra uvāca yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yasmin sarvamidaṃ jagat / sa viṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtātmā tamāśritya vimucyate
svavarṇāśramadharmeṇa pūjyo 'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ / akāmahatabhāvena samārādhyo na cānyathā
etāvaduktvā bhagavāna viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ / śūrādyaiḥ pūjito viprā jagāmātha svamālayam
atha śūrādayo devamayajanta maheśvaram / yajñena yajñagamyaṃ taṃ niṣkāmā rudramavyayam
tān vasiṣṭhastu bhagavān yājayāmāsa sarvavit / gautamo 'triragastyaśca sarve rudraparāyaṇāḥ
viśvāmitrastu bhagavān jayadhvajamarindamam / yājayāmāsa bhūtādimādidevaṃ janārdanam
tasya yajñe mahāyogī sākṣād devaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / āvirāsīt sa bhagavān tadadbhutamivābhavat
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ jayadhvajaparākramam / sarvapāpavimuktātmā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca jayadhvajasya putro 'bhūt tālājaṅgha iti smṛtaḥ / śataputrāstu tasyāsan tālajaṅghāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho mahāvīryo vītihotro 'bhavannṛpaḥ / vṛṣaprabhṛtayaścānye yādavāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ
vṛṣo vaṃśakarasteṣāṃ tasya putro 'bhavanmadhuḥ / madhoḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīd vṛṣaṇastasya vaṃśabhāk
vītihotrasutaścāpi viśruto 'nanta ityuta / durjayastasya putro 'būt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
tasya bhāryā rūpavatī guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṅkṛtā / pativratāsīt patinā svadharmaparipālikā
sa kadācinmahābhāgaḥ kālindītīrasaṃsthitām / apaśyadurvaśīṃ devīṃ gāyantīṃ madhurasvanām
tataḥ kāmāhatamanāstatsamīpamupetya vai / provāca suciraṃ kālaṃ devi rantuṃ mayār'hasi
sā devī nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutam / reme tena ciraṃ kālaṃ kāmadevamivāparam
kālāt prabuddho rājā tāmurvaśīṃ prāha śobhanām / gamiṣyāmi purīṃ ramyāṃ hasantī sābravīd vacaḥ
na hyanenopabhogena bhavatā rājasundara / prītiḥ saṃjāyate mahyaṃ sthātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ punaḥ
tāmabravīt sa matimān gatvā śīghrataraṃ purīm / āgamiṣyāmi bhūyo 'tra tanme 'nujñātumarhasi
tamabravīt sā subhagā tathā kuru viśāṃpate / nānyayāpsarasā tāvad rantavyaṃ bhavat punaḥ
omityuktvā yayau tūrṇaṃ purīṃ paramaśobhanām / gatvā pativratāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvā bīto 'bhavannṛpaḥ
saṃprekṣya sā guṇavatī bhāryā tasya pativratā / bhītaṃ prasannayā prāha vācā pīnapayodharā
svāmin kimatra bhavato bhītiradya pravartate / tad brūhi me yathā tattvaṃ na rājñāṃ kīrtaye tvidam
sa tasyā vākyamākarṇya lajjāvanatacetanaḥ / novāca kiñcinnṛpatirjñānadṛṣṭyā viveda sā
na bhetavyaṃ tvayā svāmin kāryaṃ pāpaviśodhanam / bhīte tvayi mahārāja rāṣṭraṃ te nāśameṣyati
tadā sa rājā dyutimān nirgatya tu purāt tataḥ / gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāmunim
niśamya kaṇvavadanāt prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham / jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ samuddiśya mahābalaḥ
so 'paśyat pathi rājendro gandharvavaramuttamam / bhrājamānaṃ śriyā vyomni bhūṣitaṃ divyamālayā
vīkṣya mālāmamitraghnaḥ sasmārāpsarasāṃ varām / urvaśīṃ tāṃ manaścakre tasyā eveyamarhati
so 'tīva kāmuko rājā gandharveṇātha tena hi / cakāra sumahad yuddhaṃ mālāmādātumudyataḥ
vijitya samare mālāṃ gṛhītvā durjayo dvijāḥ / jagāma tāmapsarasaṃ kālindīṃ draṣṭumādarāt
adṛṣṭvāpsarasaṃ tatra kāmabāṇābhipīḍitaḥ / babhrāma sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpasamanvitām
ākramya himavatpārśvamurvaśīdarśanotsukaḥ / jagāma śailapravaraṃ hemakūṭamiti śrutam
tatra tatrāpsarovaryā dṛṣṭvā taṃ siṃhavikramam / kāmaṃ saṃdadhire ghoraṃ bhūṣitaṃ citramālayā
saṃsmarannurvaśīvākyaṃ tasyāṃ saṃsaktamānasaḥ / na paśyati smatāḥ sarvāgiriśṛṅgāṇijagmivān
tatrāpyapsarasaṃ divyāmadṛṣṭvā kāmapīḍitaḥ / devalokaṃ mahāmeruṃ yayau devaparākramaḥ
sa tatra mānasaṃ nāma sarastrailokyaviśrutam / bheje śṛṅgāṇyatikramya svabāhubalabhāvitaḥ
sa tasya tīre subhagāṃ carantīmatilālasām / dṛṣṭavānanavadyāṅgīṃ tasyai mālāṃ dadau punaḥ
sa mālayā tadā devīṃ bhūṣitāṃ prekṣya mohitaḥ / reme kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jānānaḥ suciraṃ tayā
athorvaśī rājavaryaṃ ratānte vākyamabravīt / kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ purīṃ gatvā vṛthā nṛpa
sa tasyai sarvamācaṣṭa patnyā yat samudīritam / kaṇvasya darśanaṃ caiva mālāpaharaṇaṃ tathā
śrutvaitad vyāhṛtaṃ tena gacchetyāha hitaiṣiṇī / śāpaṃ dāsyati te kaṇvo mamāpi bhavataḥ priyā
tayāsakṛnmahārājaḥ prokto 'pi madamohitaḥ / na tatyajātha tatpārśvaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ
tatorvaśī kāmarūpā rājñe svaṃ rūpamutkaṭam / suromaśaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvadā
tasyāṃ viraktacetaskaḥ smṛtvā kaṇvābhibhāṣitam / dhiṅmāmiti viniścityatapaḥ kartuṃ samārabhat
saṃvatsaradvādaśakaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / bhūya eva dvādaśakaṃ vāyubhakṣo 'bhavannṛpaḥ
gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ bhītyā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat / vāsamapsarasā bhūyastapoyogamanuttamam
vīkṣya taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ prasanno bhagavānṛṣiḥ / kartukāmo hi nirbojaṃ tasyāghamidamabravīt
gaccha vārāṇasīṃ divyāmīśvarādhyuṣitāṃ purīm / āste mocayituṃ lokaṃ tatra devo maheśvaraḥ
snātvā saṃtarpya vidhivad gaṅgāyāndevatāḥ pitṝn / dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ liṅgaṅkilbiṣānmokṣyase 'khilāt
praṇamya śirasā kaṇvamanujñāpya ca durjayaḥ / vārāṇasyāṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpānmukto 'bhavat tataḥ
jagāma svapurīṃ śubhrāṃ pālayāmāsa medinīm / yājayāmāsa taṃ kaṇvo yācito ghṛṇayā muniḥ
tasya putro 'tha matimān supratīka iti śrutaḥ / babhūva jātamātraṃ taṃ rājānamupatasthire
urvaśyāṃ ca mahāvīryāḥ sapta devasutopamāḥ / kanyā jagṛhire sarvā jandharvadayitā dvijāḥ
eṣa va kathitaḥ samyak sahastrajita uttamaḥ / vaṃśaḥ pāpaharo nṛṇāṃ kroṣṭorapi nibodhata
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca kroṣṭoreko 'bhavat putro vṛjinīvāniti śrutiḥ / tasya putro mahān svātiruśadgustatsuto 'bhavat
uśadgorabhavat putro nāmnā citraratho balī / atha caitrarathirloke śaśabinduriti smṛtaḥ
tasya putraḥ pṛthuyaśā rājābhūd dharmatatparaḥ / pṛthukarmā ca tatputrastasmāt pṛthujayo 'bhavat
pṛthukīrtirabhūt tasmāt pṛthudānastato 'bhavat / pṛthuśravāstasya putrastasyāsīt pṛthusattamaḥ
uśanā tasya putro 'būt siteṣustatsuto 'bhavat / tasyābhūd rukmakavacaḥ parāvṛt tasya sattamāḥ
parāvṛtaḥ suto jajñe jyāmagho lokaviśrutaḥ / tasmād vidarbhaḥ saṃjajñe vidarbhāt krathakaiśikau
romapādastṛtīyastu babhrustasyātmajo nṛpaḥ / dhṛtistasyābhavat putraḥ saṃstastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ
saṃstasya putro balavān nāmnā viśvasahastu saḥ / tasya putro mahāvīryaḥ prajāvān kauśikastataḥ / abhūt tasya suto dhīmān sumantustatsuto 'nalaḥ
kaiśikasya sutaścediścaidyāstasyābhavan sutāḥ / teṣāṃ pradhāno jyotiṣmān vapuṣmāṃstatsuto 'bhavat
vapuṣmato bṛhanmedhā śrīdevastatsuto 'bhavat / tasya vītaratho viprā rudrabhakto mahābalaḥ
krathasyāpyabhavat kuntī vṛṣṇī tasyābhavat sutaḥ / vṛṣṇernivṛttirutpanno daśārhastasya tu dvijāḥ
daśārhaputropyāroho jīmūtastatsuto 'bhavat / jaimūtirabhavad vīro vikṛtiḥ paravīrahā
tasya bhīmarathaḥ putraḥ tasmānnavaratho 'bhavat / dānadharmarato nityaṃ samyakśīlaparāyaṇaḥ
kadācinmṛgayāṃ yāto dṛṣṭvā rākṣasamūrjitam / dudrāva mahātaviṣṭo bhayena munipuṅgavāḥ
anvadhāvata saṃkruddho rākṣasastaṃ mahābalaḥ / duryodhano 'gnisaṃkāśaḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ
rājā navaratho bhītyā nātidūrādanuttamam / apaśyat paramaṃ sthānaṃ sarasvatyā sugopitam
sa tadvegena mahatā saṃprāpya matimān nṛpaḥ / vavande śirasā dṛṣṭvā sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirbaddhāñjaliramitrajit / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
namasyāmi mahādevīṃ sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm / vāgdevatāmanādyantāmīśvarīṃ brahmacāriṇīm
namasye jagatāṃ yoniṃ yoginīṃ paramāṃ kalām / hiraṇyagarbhamahiṣīṃ trinetrāṃ candraśekharām
namasye paramānandāṃ citkalāṃ brahmarūpiṇīm / pāhi māṃ parameśāni bhītaṃ śaraṇamāgatam
etasminnantare kruddho rājānaṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ / hantuṃ samāgataḥ sthānaṃ yatra devī sarasvatī
samudyamya tadā śūlaṃ praveṣṭuṃ baladarpitaḥ / trilokamātustatsthānaṃ śaśāṅkādityasaṃnnibham
tadantare mahad bhūtaṃ yugāntādityasannibham / śūlenorasi nirbhidya pātayāmāsa taṃ bhuvi
gacchetyāha mahārāja na sthātavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ / idānīṃ nirbhayastūrṇaṃ sthāne 'smin rākṣaso hataḥ
tataḥ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā rājā navarathaḥ parām / purīṃ jagāma viprendrāḥ purandarapuropamām
sthāpayāmāsa deveśīṃ tatra bhaktisamanvitaḥ / īje ca vividhairyajñairhemairdevīṃ sarasvatīm
tasya cāsīd daśarathaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ / devyā bhakto mahātejāḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ
tasmāt karambhaḥ saṃbhūto devarāto 'bhavat tataḥ / īje sa cāśvamedhena devakṣatraśca tatsutaḥ
madhustasya tu dāyādastasmāt kuruvaśo 'bhavat / putradvayamabhūt tasya sutrāmā cānureva ca
anostu purukutso 'bhūdaṃśustasya ca rikthabhāk / athāṃśoḥ sattvato nāma viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān / mahātmā dānanirato dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ
sa nāradasya vacanād vāsudevārcanānvitam / śāstraṃ pravartayāmāsa kuṇḍagolādibhiḥ śrutam
tasya nāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ sāttvataṃ nāma śobhanam / pravartate mahāśāstraṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ hitāvaham
sāttvatastasya putro 'bhūt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / puṇyaśloko mahārājastena vai tatpravartitam
sāttvataḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ kauśalyāṃ suṣuve sutān / andhakaṃ vai mahābhojaṃ vṛṣṇiṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam / jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bhajamānākhyaṃ dhanurvedavidāṃ varam
teṣāṃ devāvṛdho rājā cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ / putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama bhūyāditi prabhuḥ
tasya babhruriti khyātaḥ puṇyaśloko 'bhavannṛpaḥ / dhārmiko rūpasaṃpannastattvajñānarataḥ sadā
bhajamānasya sṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānā vijajñire / teṣāṃ pradhānau vikhyātau nimiḥ kṛkaṇa eva ca
mahābhojakule jātā bhojā vaimārtikāstathā / vṛṣṇeḥ sumitro balavānanamitraḥ śinastathā
anamitrādabhūnnighno nighnasya dvau babhūvatuḥ / prasenastu mahābhāgaḥ satrājinnāma cottamaḥ
anamitrācchinirjajñe kaniṣṭhād vṛṣṇinandanāt / satyavān satyasaṃpannaḥ satyakastatsuto 'bhavat
sātyakiryuyudhānastu tasyāsaṅgo 'bhavat sutaḥ / kuṇistasya suto dhīmāṃstasya putro yugandharaḥ
mādrayā vṛṣṇeḥ suto jajñe pṛśnirvai yadunandanaḥ / jajñāte tanayau pṛśneḥ śvaphalkaścitrakaśca ha
śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata / tasyāmajanayat putramakrūraṃ nāma dhārmikam / upamaṅgustathā maṅguranye ca bahavaḥ sutāḥ
akrūrasya smṛtaḥ putro devavāniti viśrutaḥ / upadevaśca puṇyātmā tayorviśvapramāthinau
citrakasyābhavat putraḥ pṛthurvipṛthureva ca / aśvagrīvaḥ subāhuśca supārśvakagaveṣaṇau
andhakāt kāśyaduhitā lebhe ca caturaḥ sutān / kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca śuciṃ kambalabarhiṣam
kukurasya suto vṛṣṇirvṛṣṇestu tanayo 'bhavat / kapotaromā vipulastasya putro vilomakaḥ
tasyāsīt tumburusakhā vidvān putro nalaḥ kila / khyāyate tasya nāmānuranorānakadundubhiḥ
sa govardhanamāsādya tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ / varaṃ tasmai dadau devo brahmā lokamaheśvaraḥ
vaṃśasya cākṣayāṃ kīrti gānayogamanuttamam / gurorabhyadhikaṃ viprāḥ kāmarūpitvameva ca
sa labdhvā varamavyagro vareṇyaṃ vṛṣavāhanam / pūjayāmāsa gānena sthāṇuṃ tridaśapūjitam
tasya gānaratasyātha bhagavānambikāpatiḥ / kanyāratnaṃ dadau devo durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi
tayā sa saṅgato rājā gānayogamanuttamam / aśikṣayadamitraghnaḥ priyāṃ tāṃ bhrāntalocanām
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa subhujaṃ nāma śobhanam / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāṃ hrīmatīmapi kanyakām
tatastaṃ jananī putraṃ bālye vayasi śobhanam / śikṣayāmāsa vidhivad gānavidyāṃ ca kanyakām
kṛtopanayano vedānadhītya vidhivad guroḥ / udvavāhātmajāṃ kanyāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ tu mānasīm
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa pañca putrānanuttamān / vīṇāvādanatattvajñān gānaśāstraviśāradān
putraiḥ pautraiḥ sapatnīko rājā gānaviśāradaḥ / pūjayāmāsa gānena devaṃ tripuranāśanam
hrīmatī cāpi yā kanyā śrīrivāyatalocanā / subāhurnāma gandharvastāmādāya yayau purīm
tasyāmapyabhavan putrā gandharvasya sutejasaḥ / suṣeṇavīrasugrīvasubhojanaravāhanāḥ
athāsīdabhijit putro vīrastvānakadundubheḥ / punarvasuścābhijitaḥ saṃbabhūvāhukaḥ sutaḥ
āhukasyograsenaśca devakaśca dvijottamāḥ / devakasya sutā vīrā jajñire tridaśopamāḥ
devavānupadevaśca sudevo devarakṣitaḥ / teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan vasudevāya tā dadau
vṛkadevopadevā ca tathānyā devarakṣitā / śrīdevā śāntidevā ca sahadevā sahadevā ca suvratā / devakī cāpi tāsāṃ tu variṣṭhābhūt sumadhyamā
agrasenasya putro 'bhūnnyagrodhaḥ kaṃsa eva ca / subhūmī rāṣṭrapālaśca tuṣṭimāñchaṅkureva ca
bhajamānādabūt putraḥ prakhyāto 'sau vidūrathaḥ / tasya śūraḥ śamistasmāt pratikṣatrastato 'bhavat
svayaṃbhojastatastasmād hṛdikaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / kṛtavarmātha tatputro devarastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ / sa śūrastatsuto dhīmān vasudevo 'tha tatsutaḥ
vasudevāvanmahābāhurvāsudevo jagadguruḥ / babhūva devakīputro devairabhyarthito hariḥ
rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā vasudevasya śobhanā / asūta patnī saṃkarṣaṃ rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ halāyudham
sa eva paramātmāsau vāsudevo jaganmayaḥ / halāyudhaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāccheṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
bhṛguśāpacchalenaiva mānayan mānuṣīṃ tanum / babhūta tasyāṃ devakyāṃ rohiṇyāmapi mādhavaḥ
umādehasamudbhūtā yoganidrā ca kauśīkī / niyogād vāsudevasya yaśodātanayā hyabhūt
ye cānye vasudevasya vāsudevāgrajāḥ sutāḥ / prāgeva kaṃsastān sarvān jaghāna munipuṅgavāḥ
suṣeṇaśca tathodāyī bhadraseno mahābalaḥ / ṛjudāso bhadradāsaḥ kīrtimānapi pūrvajaḥ
hateṣveteṣu sarveṣu rohiṇī vasudevataḥ / asūta rāmaṃ lokeśaṃ balabhadraṃ halāyudham
jāte 'tha rāme devānāmādimātmānamacyutam / asūta devakī kṛṣṇaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam
revatī nāma rāmasya bhāryāsīt suguṇānvitā / tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putrau dvau niśaṭholmukau
ṣoḍaśastrīsahastrāṇi kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ / babhūvurātmajāstāsu śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ
cārudeṣṇaḥ sucāruśca cāruveṣo yaśodharaḥ / cāruśravāścāruyaśāḥ pradyumnaḥ śaṅkha eva ca
rukmiṇya vāsudevasyāṃ mahābalaparākramāḥ / viśiṣṭāḥ sarvaputrāṇāṃ saṃbabhūvurim sutāḥ
tān dṛṣṭvā tanayān vīrān raukmiṇeyāñjanārdanam / jāmbavatyabravīt kṛṣṇaṃ bhāryā tasya śucismitā
mama tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa viśiṣṭaṃ guṇavattamam / sureśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi dānavasūdana
jātbavatyā vacaḥ śrutvā jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / samārebhe tapaḥ kartuṃ taponidhirarindamaḥ
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhā yathāsau devakīsutaḥ / dṛṣṭvā lebhe sutaṃ rudraṃ taptvā tīvraṃ mahat tapaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca atha devo hṛṣīkeśo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ / tatāpa ghoraṃ putrārthaṃ nidānaṃ tapasastapaḥ
svecchayāpyavatīrṇo 'sau kṛtakṛtyo 'pi viśvadhṛk / cacāra svātmano mūlaṃ bodhayan bhāvamaiśvaram
jagāma yogibhirjuṣṭaṃ nānāpakṣisamākulam / āśramaṃ tūpamanyorvai munīndrasya mahātmanaḥ
tapattrirājamārūḍhaḥ suparṇamatitejasam / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam / ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ vedaghoṣanināditam
siṃharkṣaśarabhākīrṇaṃ śārdūlagajasaṃyutam / vimalasvādupānīyaiḥ sarobhirupaśobhitam
ārāmairvividhairjuṣṭaṃ devatāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ / ṛṣikairṛṣiputraiśca mahāmunigaṇaistathā
vedādhyayanasaṃpannaiḥ sevitaṃ cāgnihotribhiḥ / yogibhirdhyānaniratairnāsāgragatalocanaiḥ
upetaṃ sarvataḥ puṇyaṃ jñānibhistattvadarśibhiḥ / nadībhirabhito juṣṭaṃ jāpakairbrahmavādibhiḥ
sevitaṃ tāpasaiḥ puṇyairīśārādhanatatparaiḥ / praśāntaiḥ satyasaṃkalpairniḥ śokairnirupadravaiḥ
bhasmāvadātasarvāṅgai rudrajāpyaparāyaṇaiḥ / muṇḍitairjaṭilaiḥ śuddhaistathānyaiśca śikhājaṭaiḥ / sevitaṃ tāpasairnitya jñānibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ
tatrāśramavare ramye siddhāśramavibhūṣite / gaṅgā bhagavatī nityaṃ vahatyevāghanāśinī
sa tānanviṣya viśvātmā tāpasān vītakalmaṣān / praṇāmenātha vacasā pūjayāmāsa mādhavaḥ
te te dṛṣṭvā jagadyoniṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / praṇemurbhaktisaṃyuktā yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum
stuvanti vaidikairmantraiḥ kṛtvā hṛdi sanātanam / procuranyonyamavyaktamādidevaṃ mahāmunim
ayaṃ sa bhagavānekaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ / agacchatyadhunā devaḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ svayam
ayamevāvyayaḥ straṣṭā saṃhartā caiva rakṣakaḥ / amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā munīn draṣṭumihāgataḥ
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca samāgacchati sarvagaḥ / anādirakṣayo 'nanto mahābhūto maheśvaraḥ
śrutvā śrutvā haristeṣāṃ vacāṃsi vacanātigaḥ / yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindaḥ sthānaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ
upaspṛśyātha bhāvena tīrthe tīrthe sa yādavaḥ / cakāra devakīsūnurdevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam
nadīnāṃ tīrasaṃsthāni sthāpitāni munīśvaraiḥ / liṅgāni pūjayāmāsa śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ yatra yatra janārdanam / pūjayāñcakrire puṣpairakṣataistatra vāsinaḥ
samīkṣya vāsudevaṃ taṃ śārṅgaśaṅkhāsidhāriṇam / tasthire niścalāḥ sarve śubhāṅgaṃ tannivāsinaḥ
yāni tatrārurukṣūṇāṃ mānasāni janārdanam / dṛṣṭvā samīhitānyāsan niṣkrāmanti purāhiram
athāvagāhya gaṅgāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam / ādāya puṣpavaryāṇi munīndrasyāviśad gṛham
dṛṣṭvā taṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigraham / jaṭācīradharaṃ śāntaṃ nanāma śirasā munim
ālokya kṛṣṇamāyāntaṃ pūjayāmāsa tattvavit / āsane cāsayāmāsa yogināṃ prathamātithim
uvāca vacasāṃ yoniṃ jānīmaḥ paramaṃ padam / viṣṇumavyaktasaṃsthānaṃ śiṣyabhāvena saṃsthitam
svāgataṃ te hṛṣīkeśa saphalāni tapāṃsi naḥ / yad sākṣādeva viśvātmā madgehaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ
tvāṃ na paśyanti munayo yatanto 'pi hi yoginaḥ / tādṛśasyātha bhavataḥ kimāgamanakāraṇam
śrutvopamanyostad vākyaṃ bhagavān keśimardanaḥ / vyājahāra mahāyogī vacanaṃ praṇipatya tam
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhagavan draṣṭumicchāmi girīśaṃ kṛttivāsasam / saṃprāpto bhavataḥ sthānaṃ bhagavaddarśanotsukaḥ
kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśo dṛśyo yogavidāṃ varaḥ / mayācireṇa kutrāhaṃ drakṣyāmi tamumāpatim
ityāha bhagavānukto dṛśyate parameśvaraḥ / bhaktyā cogreṇa tapasā tatkuruṣveha yatnataḥ
iheśvaraṃ devadevaṃ munīndrā brahmavādinaḥ / dhyāyanto 'trāsate devaṃ jāpinastāpasāśca ye
iha devaḥ sapatnīko bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ / krīḍate vividhairbhūtairyogibhiḥ parivāritaḥ
ihāśrame purā rudrāt tapastaptvā sudāruṇam / lebhe maheśvarād yogaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ
ihaiva bhagavān vyasaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / dṛṣṭvā taṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ labdhavānīśvareśvaram
ihāśramavare ramye tapastaptvā kapardinaḥ / avindat putrakān rudrāt surabhirbhaktisaṃyutā
ihaiva devatāḥ pūrvaṃ kālād bhītā maheśvaram / dṛṣṭavanto haraṃ śrīmannirbhayā nirvṛtiṃ yayuḥ
ihārādhya mahādevaṃ sāvarṇistapatāṃ varaḥ / labdhavān paramaṃ yogaṃ granthakāratvamuttamam
pravartayāmāsa śubhāṃ kṛtvā vai saṃhitāṃ dvijaḥ / paurāṇikīṃ supuṇyārthāṃ sacchiṣyeṣu dvijātiṣu
ihaiva saṃhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāpeyaḥ śāṃśapāyanaḥ / mahādevaṃ cakāremāṃ paurāṇīṃ tanniyogataḥ / dvādaśaiva sahastrāṇi ślokānāṃ puruṣottama
iha pravartitā puṇyā dvyaṣṭasāhastrikottarā / vāyavīyottaraṃ nāma purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam / ihaiva khyāpitaṃ śiṣyaiḥ śāṃśapāyanabhāṣitam
yājñavalkyo mahāyogī dṛṣṭvātra tapasā haram / cakāra tanniyogena yogaśāstramanuttamam
ihaiva bhṛguṇā pūrvaṃ taptvā vai paramaṃ tapaḥ / śukro maheśvarāt putro labdho yogavidāṃ varaḥ
tasmādihaiva deveśaṃ tapastaptvā maheśvaram / draṣṭumarhasi viśveśamugraṃ bhīmaṃ kapardinam
evamuktvā dadau jñānamupamanyurmahāmuniḥ / vrataṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ kṛṣṇāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe
sa tena munivaryeṇa vyāhṛto madhusūdanaḥ / tatraiva tapasā devaṃ rudramārādhayat prabhuḥ
bhasmauddhūlitasarvāṅgo muṇḍo valkalasaṃyutaḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ śivaikāhitamānasaḥ
tato bahutithe kāle somaḥ somārdhabhūṣaṇaḥ / adṛśyata mahādevo vyomni devyā maheśvaraḥ
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ citramālaṃ pinākinaṃ śūlinaṃ devadevam / śārdūlacarmāmbarasaṃvṛtāṅgaṃ devyā mahādevamasau dadarśa
paraśvadhāsaktakaraṃ trinetraṃ nṛsiṃhacarmāvṛtasarvagātram / samudgirantaṃ praṇavaṃ bṛhantaṃ sahastrasūryapratimaṃ dadarśa
prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purastāt sanātanaṃ yoginamīśitāram / aṇoraṇīyāṃsamanantaśaktiṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ śaṃbhumasau dadarśa
na yasya devā na pitāmaho 'pi nendro na cāgnirvaruṇo na mṛtyuḥ / prabhāvamadyāpi vadanti rudraṃ tamādidevaṃ purato dadarśa
tadānvapaśyad giriśasya vāme svātmānamavyaktamanantarūpam / stuvantamīśaṃ bahubhirvacobhiḥ śaṅkhāsicakrārpitahastamādyam
kṛtāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sureśaṃ haṃsādhirūḍhaṃ puruṣaṃ dadarśa / stuvānamīśasya paraṃ prabhāvaṃ pitāmahaṃ lokaguruṃ divastham
gaṇeśvarānarkasahastrakalpān nandīśvarādīnamitaprabhāvān / trilokabhartuḥ purato 'nvapaśyat kumāramagnipatimaṃ saśākham
marīcimatriṃ pulahaṃ pulastyaṃ pracetasaṃ dakṣamathāpi kaṇvam / parāśaraṃ tatparato vasiṣṭhaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ cāpi manuṃ dadarśa
tuṣṭāva mantrairamarapradhānaṃ baddhāñjalirviṣṇurudārabuddhiḥ / praṇamya devyā giriśaṃ sabhaktyā svātmanyathātmānamasau vicintya
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca namo 'stu te śāśvata sarvayone brahmādhipaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti / tapaśca sattvaṃ ca rajastamaśca tvāmeva sarva pravadanti santaḥ
tvaṃ brahmā hariratha viśvayoniragniḥ saṃhartā dinakaramaṇḍalādhivāsaḥ / prāṇastvaṃ hutavahavāsavādibheda- satvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam
sāṃkhyāstvāṃ viguṇamathāhurekarūpaṃ yogāstvāṃ satatamupāsate hṛdistham / vedāstvāmabhidadhatīha rudramagniṃ tvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam
tvātpāde kusumamathāpi patramekaṃ dattvāsau bhavati vimuktaviśvabandhaḥ / sarvāghaṃ praṇudati siddhayogijuṣṭaṃ smṛtvā te padayugalaṃ bhavatprasādāt

yasyāśeṣavibhāgahīnamamalaṃ hṛdyantarāvasthitaṃ tattvaṃ jyotiranantamekamacalaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ sarvagam / sthānaṃ prāhuranādimadhyanidhanaṃ yasmādidaṃ jāyate nityaṃ tvāmahamupaimi satyavibhavaṃviśveśvarantaṃśivam
oṃ namo nīlakaṇṭhāya trinetrāya ca raṃhase / mahādevāya te nityamīśānāya namo namaḥ
namaḥ pinākine tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāya daṇḍine / namaste vajrahastāya digvastrāya kapardine
namo bhairavanādāya kālarūpāya daṃṣṭriṇe / nāgayajñopavītāya namaste vahniretase
namo 'stu te girīśāya svāhākārāya te namaḥ / namo muktāṭṭahāsāya bhīmāya ca namo namaḥ
namaste kāmanāśāya namaḥ kālapramāthine / namo bhairavaveṣāya harāya ca niṣaṅgiṇe
namo 'stu te tryambakāya namaste kṛttivāsase / namo 'mbikādhipataye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
namaste vyomarūpāya vyomādhipataye namaḥ / naranārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartine
namo daivatanāthāya devānugataliṅgine / kumāragurave tubhyaṃ devadevāya te namaḥ
tamo yajñādhipataye namaste brahmacāriṇe / mṛgavyādhāya mahate brahmādhipataye namaḥ
namo haṃsāya viśvāya mohanāya namo namaḥ / yogine yogagamyāya yogamāyāya te namaḥ
namaste prāṇapālāya ghaṇṭānādapriyāya ca / kapāline namastubhyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
namo namo namastubhyaṃ bhūya eva namo namaḥ / mahyaṃ sarvātmanā kāmān prayaccha parameśvara
evaṃ hi bhaktyā deveśamabhiṣṭūya sa mādhavaḥ / papāta pādayorviprā devadevyoḥ sa daṇḍavat
utthāpya bhagavān somaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ keśiniṣūdanam / babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ
kimarthaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa tapastaptaṃ tvayāvyaya / tvameva dātā sarveṣāṃ kāmānāṃ kāmināmiha
tvaṃ hi sā paramā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā / nānavāptaṃ tvayā tāta vidyate puruṣottama
vettha nārāyaṇānantamātmānaṃ parameśvaram / mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ svena yogena keśava
śrutvā tadvacanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prahasan vai vṛṣadhvajam / uvāca vīkṣya viśveśaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām
jñātaṃ hi bhavatā sarvaṃ svena yogena śaṅkara / icchāmyātmasamaṃ putraṃ tvadbhaktaṃ dehi śaṅkara
tathāstvityāha viśvātmā prahṛṣṭamanasā haraḥ / devīmālokya girijāṃ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje
tataḥ sā jagatāṃ mātā śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśaṃ devī himagirīndrajā
vatsa jāne tavānantāṃ niścalāṃ sarvadācyuta / ananyāmīśvare bhaktimātmanyapi ca keśava
tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ / prārthito daivataiḥ pūrvaṃ saṃjāto daivakīsutaḥ
paśya tvamātmanātmānamātmīyamamalaṃ padam / nāvayorvidyate bheda evaṃ paśyanti sūrayaḥ
imānimān varāniṣṭān matto gṛhṇīṣva keśava / sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ jñānaṃ tat pārameśvaram / īśvare niścalāṃ bhaktimātmanyapi paraṃ balam
evamuktastayā kṛṣṇo mahādevyā janārdanaḥ / āśiṣaṃ śirasāhṛṅṇād devo 'pyāha maheśvaraḥ
pragṛhya kṛṣṇaṃ bhagavānatheśaḥ kareṇa devyā saha devadevaḥ / saṃpūjyamāno munibhiḥ sureśai- r jagāma kailāsagiriṃ girīśaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapūrāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca praviśya meruśikharaṃ kailāsaṃ kanakaprabham / rarāma bhagavān somaḥ keśavena maheśvaraḥ
apaśyaṃstaṃ mahātmānaṃ kailāsagirivāsinaḥ / pūjayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ devadevamathācyutam
caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ kālameghasamaprabham / kirīṭinaṃ śārṅgapāṇi śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam
dīrghabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam / dadhānamurasā mālāṃ vaijayantīmanuttamām
bhrājamānaṃ śriyā divyaṃ yuvānamatikomalam / padmāṅghrinayanaṃ cāru susmitaṃ sugatipradam
kadācit tatra līlārthaṃ devakīnandavardhanaḥ / bhrājamānaḥ śrīyā kṛṣṇaścacāra girikandare
gandharvāpsarasāṃ mukhyā nāgakanyāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ / siddhā yakṣāśca gandharvāstatra tatra jaganmayam
dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatvā harṣādutphullocanāḥ / mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni mahātmanaḥ
gandharvakanyakā divyāstadvadapsarasāṃ varāḥ / dṛṣṭvā cakamire kṛṣṇaṃ strastavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ
kāścid gāyanti vividhāṃ gītiṃ gītaviśāradāḥ / saṃprekṣya devakīsūnuṃ sundaryaḥ kāmamohitāḥ
kāścidvilāsabahulā nṛtyanti sma tadagrataḥ / saṃprekṣya saṃsthitāḥ kāścit papustadvadanāmṛtam
kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi svāṅgādādāya sādaram / bhūṣayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ kāminyo lokabhūṣaṇam
kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi samādāya tadaṅgataḥ / svātmānaṃ būṣayāmāsuḥ svātmagairapi mādhavam
kāścidāgatya kṛṣṇasya samīpaṃ kāmamohitāḥ / cucumburvadanāmbhojaṃ harermugdhamṛgekṣaṇāḥ
pragṛhya kāścid govindaṃ kareṇa bhavanaṃ svakam / prāpayāmāsurlokādiṃ māyayā tasya mohitāḥ
tāsāṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kāmān kamalalocanaḥ / bahūni kṛtvā rūpāṇi pūrayāmāsa līlayā
evaṃ vai suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevapure hariḥ / reme nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat
gate bahutithe kāle dvāravatyāṃ nivāsinaḥ / babhūvurvihvalā bhītā govindavirahe janāḥ
tataḥ suparṇo balavān pūrvameva visajitaḥ / kṛṣṇena mārgamāṇastaṃ himavantaṃ yayau girim
adṛṣṭvā tatra govindaṃ praṇamya śirasā munim / ājagāmopamanyuṃ taṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ punaḥ
tadantare mahādaityā rākṣasāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ / ājagmurdvārakāṃ śubhrāṃ bhīṣayantaḥ sahastraśaḥ
sa tān suparṇo balavān kṛṣṇatulyaparākramaḥ / hatvā yuddhena mahatā rakṣati sma purīṃ śubhām
etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ / dṛṣṭvā kailāsaśikhare kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatīṃ gataḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradamṛṣiṃ sarve tatra nivāsinaḥ / procurnārāyaṇo nāthaḥ kutrāste bhagavān hariḥ
sa tānuvāca bhagavān kailasaśikhare hariḥ / ramate 'dya mahāyogīṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvāhamihāgataḥ
tasyopaśrutya vacanaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ / jagāmākāśago viprāḥ kailāsaṃ girimuttamam
dadarśa devakīsūnuṃ bhavane ratnamaṇḍite / varāsanasthaṃ govindaṃ devadevāntike harim
upāsyamānamamarairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ / mahādevagaṇaiḥ siddhairyogibhiḥ parivāritam
praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau suparṇaḥ śaṅkaraṃ śivam / nivedayāmāsa hareḥ pravṛttiṃ dvārake pure
tataḥ praṇamya śirasā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam / ājagāma purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ so 'nujñāto hareṇa tu
āruhya kaśyapasutaṃ strīgaṇairabhipūjitaḥ / vacobhiramṛtāsvādairmānito madhusūdanaḥ
vīkṣya yāntamamitraghnaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ varāḥ / anvagacchan mahoyogaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
visarjayitvā viśvātmā sarvā evāṅganā hariḥ / yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindo divyāṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm
gate muraripau naiva kāminyo munipuṅgavāḥ / niśeva candrarahitā vinā tena cakāśire
śrutvā paurajanāstūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanamuttamam / maṇḍayāñcakrire divyāṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām
patākābhirviśālābhirdhvajai ratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ / lājādibhiḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣayāñcakrire tadā
avādayanta vividhān vāditrān madhurasvanān / śaṅkhān sahastraśo dadhmurvoṇāvādān vitenire
praviṣṭamātre govinde purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām / agāyan madhuraṃ gānaṃ striyo yauvanaśālinaḥ
dṛṣṭvā nanṛturīśānaṃ sthitāḥ prāsādamūrdhasu / mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vasudevasutopari
praviśya bhavanaṃ kṛṣṇa āśīrvādābhivardhitaḥ / varāsane mahāyogī bhāti devībhiranvitaḥ
suramye maṇḍape śubhre śaṅkhādyaiḥ parivāritaḥ / ātmajairabhito mukhyaiḥ strīsahastraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
tatrāsanavare ramye jāmbavatyā sahācyutaḥ / bhrājate mālayā devo yathā devyā samanvitaḥ
ājagmurdevagandharvā draṣṭuṃ lokādimavyayam / maharṣayaḥ pūrvajātā mārkaṇḍeyādayo dvijāḥ
tataḥ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam / nanāmotthāya śirasā svāsanaṃ ca dadau hariḥ
saṃpūjya tānṛṣigaṇān praṇāmena mahābhujaḥ / visarjayāmāsa harirdattvā tadabhivāñchitān
tadā madhyāhnasamaye devadevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / snātvā śuklāmbaro bhānumupatiṣṭhat kṛtāñjaliḥ
jajāpa jāpyaṃ vidhivat prekṣamāṇo divākaram / tarpayāmāsa deveśo deveśo devān munigaṇān pitṝn
praviśya devabhavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena caiva hi / pūjayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ bhūteśaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
samāpya niyamaṃ sarvaṃ niyantāsau nṛṇāṃ svayam / bhojayitvā munivaraṃ brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca
kṛtvātmayogaṃ viprendrā mārkaṇḍeyena cācyutaḥ / kathāḥ paurāṇikīḥ puṇyāścakre putrādibhirvṛtaḥ
athaitat sarvamakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā karma mahāmuniḥ / mārkaṇḍeyo hasan kṛṣṇaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ vacaḥ
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kaḥ samārādhyate devo bhavatā karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ / brūhi tvaṃ karmabhiḥ pūjyo yogināṃ dhyeya eva ca
tvaṃ hi tat paramaṃ brahma nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam / bhārāvataraṇārthāya jāto vṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ
tamabravīnmahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ / śṛṇvatāmeva putrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prahasanniva
śrībhagavānuvāca bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tathyameva na saṃśayaḥ / tathāpi devamīśānaṃ pūjayāmi sanātanam
na me viprāsti kartavyaṃ nānavāptaṃ kathañcana / pūjayāmi tathāpīśaṃ jānannaitat paraṃ śivam
na vai paśyanti taṃ devaṃ māyayā mohitā janāḥ / tato 'haṃ svātmano mūlaṃ jñāpayan pūjayāmi tam
na ca liṅgārcanāt puṇyaṃ lokesmin bhītināśanam / tathā liṅge hitāyaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ pūjayecchivam
yo 'haṃ talliṅgamityāhurvedavādavido janāḥ / tato 'hamātmamīśānaṃ pūjayāmyātmanaiva tu
tasyaiva paramā mūrtistanmayo 'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ / nāvayordyite bhedo vedeṣvevaṃ viniścayaḥ
eṣa devo mahādevaḥ sadā saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ / dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca vandyaśca jñeyo liṅge maheśvaraḥ
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kiṃ talliṅgaṃ suraśreṣṭha liṅge saṃpūjyate ca kaḥ / brūhi kṛṣṇa viśālākṣa gahanaṃ hyetaduttamam
avyaktaṃ liṅgamityāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram / vedā mahesvaraṃ devamāhurliṅginamavyayam
purā caikārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / prabodhārthaṃ brahmaṇo me prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ
tasmāt kālāt samārabhya brahmā cāhaṃ sadaiva hi / pūjayāvo mahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathaṃ liṅgamabhūt pūrvamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam / prabodhārthaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇa vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam
śrībhagavānuvāca āsodekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam / madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvāhaṃ sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt sahastrabāhuryuktātmā śayito 'haṃ sanātanaḥ
etasminnantare dūratā paśyami hyamitaprabham / koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam
caturvaraktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham / kṛṣṇājiradharaṃ devamṛgyajuḥ sāmabhiḥ stutam
nimeṣamātreṇa sa māṃ prāpto yogavidāṃ varaḥ / vyājahāra svayaṃ brahmā smayamāno mahādyutiḥ
kastvaṃ kuto vā kiṃ ceha tiṣṭhase vaha me prabho / ahaṃ kartā hi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ
evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca ha / ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ
evaṃ vivāde vitate māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ / prabodhārthaṃ paraṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam
kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam / kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāntavarjitam
tato māmāha bhagavānadho gaccha tvamāśu vai / antamasya vijānīma ūrdhvaṃ gacche 'hamityajaḥ
tadāśu samayaṃ kṛtvā gatāvūrdhvamadhaśca dvau / pitāmaho 'pyahaṃ nāntaṃ jñātavantau samāḥ śatam
tato vismayamāpannau bhītau devasya śūlinaḥ / māyayā mohitau tasya dhyāyantau viśvamīśvaram
proccārantau mahānādamoṅkāraṃ paramaṃ padam / prahvāñjalipuṭopetau śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭuvatuḥ param
brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ / anādimalasaṃsārarogavaidyāya śaṃbhave / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
pralayārṇavasaṃsthāya pralayodbhūtihetave / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
jvālāmālāvṛtāṅgāya jvalanastambharūpiṇe / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
ādimadhyāntahīnāya svabāvāmaladīptaye / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
mahādevāya mahate jyotiṣe 'nantatejase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
pradhānapuruṣeśāya vyomarūpāya vedhase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
nirvikārāya satyāya nityāyāmalatejase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
vedāntasārarūpāya kālarūpāya dhīmate / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ / bhāti devo mahāyogī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ
vaktrakoṭisahastreṇa grasamāna ivāmbaram / sahastrahastacaraṇaḥ sūryasomāgnilocanaḥ
pinākapāṇirbhagavān kṛttivāsāstriśūlabhṛt / vyālayajñopavītaśca meghadundubhiniḥ svanaḥ
athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau / paśyetaṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ pramucyatām
yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau / ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / vāmapārśve ca me viṣṇuḥ pālako hṛdaye haraḥ
prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyak varaṃ dadmi yathepsitam / evamuktvātha māṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ / āliṅgya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prasādābhimukho 'bhavat
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇipatya maheśvaram / ūcatuḥ prekṣya tadvaktraṃ nārāyaṇapitāmahau
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau / bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva maheśvare
tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ prahasan parameśvaraḥ / uvāca māṃ mahādevaḥ prītaḥ prītena cetasā
deva uvāca pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate / vatsa vatsa hare viśvaṃ pālayaitaccarācaram
tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā / sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ
saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham / bhaviṣyatyeṣa bhagavāṃstava putraḥ sanātanaḥ
ahaṃ ca bhavato vaktrāt kalpādau ghorarūpadhṛk / śūlapāṇirbhaviṣyāmi krodhajastava putrakaḥ
evamuktvā mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ munisattama / anugṛhya ca māṃ devastatraivāntaradhīyata
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā / liṅga tallayanād brahman brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ
etalliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te mayānagha / etad budhyanti yogajñā na devā na ca dānavāḥ
etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam / yena sūkṣmamacintyaṃ tat paśyanti jñāna vakṣuṣaḥ
tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaskāraṃ prakurmahe / mahādevāya rudrāya devadevāya liṅgine
namo vedarahasyāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ / vibhīṣaṇāya śāntāya sthāṇave hetave namaḥ
brahmaṇe vāmadevāya trinetrāya mahīyase / śaṅkarāya maheśāya girīśāya śivāya ca
namaḥ kuruṣva satataṃ dhyāyasva manasā haram / saṃsārasāgarādasmādacirāduttariṣyasi
evaṃ sa vāsudevena vyāhṛto munipuṅgavaḥ / jagāma manasā devamīśānaṃ viśvatomukham
praṇamya śirasā kṛṣṇamanujñāto mahāmuniḥ / jagāma cepsitaṃ deśaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ
ya imaṃ śrāvayennityaṃ liṅgādhyāyamanuttamam / śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
śrutvā sakṛdapi hyetat tapaścaraṇamuttamam / vāsudevasya viprendrāḥ pāpaṃ muñciti mānavaḥ
japed vāharaharnityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate / evamāha mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tato labdhavaraḥ kṛṣṇo jāmbavatyāṃ maheśvarāt / ajījananmahātmānaṃ sāmbamātmajamuttamam
pradyumnasyāpyabhūt putro hyaniruddho mahābalaḥ / tāvubhau guṇasaṃpannau kṛṣṇasyaivāpare tanū
hatvā ca kaṃsaṃ narakamanyāṃśca śataśo 'surān / vijitya līlayā śakraṃ jitvā bāṇaṃ mahāsuram
sthāpayitvā jagat kṛtsnaṃ loke dharmāṃśca śāśvatān / cakre nārāyaṇo gantuṃ svasthānaṃ buddhimuttamām
etasminnantare viprā bhṛgvādyāḥ kṛṣṇamīśvaram / ājagmurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛtakāryaṃ sanātanam
sa tānuvāca viśvātmā praṇipatyābhipūjya ca / āsaneṣūpaviṣṭān vai saha rāmeṇa dhīmatā
gamiṣye tat paraṃ sthānaṃ svakīyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñitam / kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi prasīdadhvaṃ munīśvarāḥ
idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptamadhunāśubham / bhaviṣyanti janāḥ sarve hyasmin pāpānuvartinaḥ
pravartayadhvaṃ majjñānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham / yeneme kalijaiḥ pāpairmucyante hi dvijottamāḥ
ye māṃ janāḥ saṃsmaranti kalau sakṛdapi prabhum / teṣāṃ naśyatu tat pāpaṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame
yer'cayiṣyantimāṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ kaliyuge dvijāḥ / vidhānā vedadṛṣṭena te gamiṣyanti tat padam
ye brāhmaṇā vaṃśajātā yuṣmākaṃ vai sahastraśaḥ / teṣāṃ nārāyaṇe bhaktirbhaviṣyati kalau yuge
parāt parataraṃ yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ / na te tatra gamiṣyanti ye dviṣanti maheśvaram
dhyānaṃ homaṃ tapastaptaṃ jñānaṃ yajñādiko vidhiḥ / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipraṃ ye nindanti pinākinam
yo māṃ samāśrayennityamekāntaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ / vinindya devamīśānaṃ sa yāti narakāyutam
tasmāt sā parihartavyā nindā paśupatau dvijāḥ / karmaṇā manasā vācā tadbhakteṣvapi yatnataḥ
ye tu dakṣādhvare śaptā dadhīyena dvijottamāḥ / bhaviṣyanti kalau bhaktaiḥ parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ
dviṣanto devamīśānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ / śaptāśca gautamenorvyāṃ na saṃbhāṣyā dvijottamaiḥ
ityevamuktāḥ kṛṣṇena sarva eva maharṣayaḥ / omityuktvā yayustūrṇaṃsvāni sthānāni sattamāḥ
tato nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo līlayaiva jaganmayaḥ / saṃhṛtya svakulaṃ sarvaṃ yayau tat paramaṃ padam
ityeṣa vaḥ samāsena rājñāṃ vaṃśo 'nukīrtitaḥ / na śakyo vistarād vaktuṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi vaṃśānāṃ kathanaṃ śubham / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam / eṣāṃ svabhāvaṃ sūtādya kathayasva samāsataḥ
sūta uvāca gate nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe svameva paramaṃ padam / pārthaḥ paramadharmātmā pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
kṛtvā cevottaravidhiṃ śokena mahatāvṛtaḥ / apaśyat pathi gacchantaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim
śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyairabhitaḥ saṃvṛtaṃ brahmavādinam / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tyaktvā śokaṃ tadār'junaḥ
uvāca paramaprītaḥ kasmād deśānmahāmune / idānīṃ gacchasi kṣipraṃ kaṃ vā deśaṃ prati prabho
saṃdarśanād vai bhavataḥ śoko me vipulo gataḥ / idānīṃ mama yat kāryaṃ brūhi padmadalekṣaṇa
tamuvāca mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / upaviśya nadītire śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto muniḥ
idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptaṃ pāṇḍunandana / tato gacchāmi devasya vārāṇasīṃ mahāpurīm
asmin kaliyuge ghore lokāḥ pāpānuvartinaḥ / bhaviṣyanti mahāpāpā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ
nānyat paśyāmi jantūnāṃmuktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm / sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca sarveṣveteṣu vai narāḥ / bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ
tvaṃ hi lokeṣu vikhyāto dhṛtimāñ janavatsalaḥ / pālayādya paraṃ dharmaṃ svakīyaṃ mucyase bhayāt
evamukto bhagavatā pārthaḥ parapurañjayaḥ / pṛṣṭavān praṇipatyāsau yugadharmān dvijottamāḥ
tasmai provāca sakalaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / praṇamya devamīśānaṃ yugadharmān sanātanān
vakṣyāmi te samāsena yugadharmān nareśvara / na śakyate mayā pārtha vistareṇābhibhāṣitum
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tatastretāyugaṃ budhaiḥ / tṛtīyaṃ dvāparaṃ pārtha caturthaṃ kalirucyate
dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate / dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge
brahmā kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ / dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ kalau rudro maheśvaraḥ
brahmā viṣṇustathā sūryaḥ sarva eva kaliṣvapi / pūjyate bhagavān rudraścaturṣvapi pinākadhṛk
ādye kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ / tretāyuge tripādaḥ syād dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ / tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa tiṣṭhati
kṛte tu mithunotpattirvṛttiḥ sākṣād rasollasā / prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sadānandāśca bhoginaḥ
adhamottamatvaṃ nāstyāsāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ purañjaya / tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasmin kṛte yuge
viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā / dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhā mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ
tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketaḥ parantapa
rasollāsā kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate tataḥ / tasyāṃ siddhau praṇaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhiravartata
apāṃ saukṣmye pratihate tadā meghātmanā tu vai / meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam
sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale / prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣā vai gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
sarvapratyupayogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate / vartayanti sma tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyatāt / rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā / praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ / abhidhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā
prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ / vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam / amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu
tena tā vartayanti sma tretāyugamukhe prijāḥ / hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā sarvā vai vigatajvarāḥ
tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstadā / vṛkṣāṃstān paryagṛhṇanta madhu cāmākṣikaṃ balāt
tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai / praṇaṣṭāmadhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacit kvacit
śītavarṣātapaistīvrai statastā duḥ khitā bhṛśam / dvandvaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca
kṛtvā dvandvapratīghātān vārtopāyamacintayan / naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā
tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ / vārtāyāḥ sādhikā hyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ
tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyūdakānīha yāni nimnairgatāni tu / avahan vṛṣṭisaṃtatyā strotaḥ sthānāni nimnagāḥ
ye punastadapāṃ stokā āpannāḥ pṛthivītale / apāṃ bhūṇeśca saṃyogādoṣadhyastāstadābhavan
aphālakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa / ṛtupuṣpaphalaiścaiva vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire
tataḥ prādurabhūt tāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ / avaśyaṃ bhāvinār'the na tretāyugavaśena vai
tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān / vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tā oṣadhyo viviśurmahīm / pitāmahaniyogena dudoha pṛthivīṃ pṛthuḥ
tatastā jagṛhuḥ sarvā anyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ / vasudāradhanādyāṃstu balāt kālabalena tu
maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvaitad bhagavānajaḥ / sasarja kṣatriyān brahmā brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca
varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / yajñapravartanaṃ caiva paśuhiṃsāvivarjitam
dvāpareṣvatha vidyante matibhedāḥ sadā nṛṇām / rāgo lobhastathā yuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ
eko vedaścatuṣpādastretāsviha vidhīyate / vedavyāsaiścaturdhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu
ṛṣiputraiḥ punarbhedād bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ / mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ
saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥ sāmnāṃ saṃhanyante śrutarṣibhiḥ / sāmānyād vaikṛtāccaivadṛṣṭibhedaiḥ kvacit kvacit
brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca / itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi suvrata
avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vāyādhyupadravāḥ / vāṅmanaḥ kāyajairduḥ sairnirvedo jāyate nṛṇām
nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥ khamokṣavicāraṇā / vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyād doṣadarśanam
doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva dvāpare jñānasaṃbhavaḥ / eṣā rajastamoyuktā vṛttirvai dvāpare smṛtā
ādye kṛte tu dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravartate / dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām / sādhayanti narā nityaṃ tamasā vyākulīkṛtāḥ
kalau pramārako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣud bhayaṃ tathā / anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ
adhārmikā anācārā mahākopālpacetasaḥ / anṛtaṃ vadanti te lubdhāstiṣye jātāḥ suduḥ prajāḥ
duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ / viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam
nādhīyate kalau vedān na yajanti dvijātayaḥ / yajantyanyāyato vedān paṭhante cālpabuddhayaḥ
śūdrāṇāṃ mantrayaunaiśca saṃbandho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha / bhaviṣyati kalau tasmiñ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ
rājānaḥ sūdrabhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇān bādhayanti ca / bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā prajāyete nareśvara
snānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ dānaṃ devatānāṃ tathār'canam / anyāni caiva karmāṇi na kurvanti dvijātayaḥ
vinindanti mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇān puruṣottamam / āmnāyadharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni kalau yuge
kurvantyavedadṛṣṭāni karmāṇi vividhāni tu / svadharme 'bhirucirnaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ prijāyate
kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍairvṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ / bahuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam
aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ / pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge
śukladantājinākhyāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ / śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite
śasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailābhimarṣiṇaḥ / caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ
duḥ khapracuratālpāyurdehotsādaḥ sarogatā / adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam
kāṣāyiṇo 'tha nirgranthāstathā kāpālikāśca ye / vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare
āsanasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ / tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃśca śūdrā rājopajīvinaḥ
uccāsanasthāḥ śūdrāstu dvijamadhye parantapa / jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālabalena tu
puṣpaiśca hasitaiścaiva tathānyairmaṅgalairdvijāḥ / śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhagyabalānvitāḥ
na prekṣante 'rcitāṃścāpi śūdrā dvijavarān nṛpa / sevāvasaramālokya dvāri tiṣṭhanti ca dvijāḥ
vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ / sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau
adhyāpayanti vai vedāñ śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ / paṭhanti vaidikān mantrān nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ
tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ / yatayaśca bhaviṣyanti śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ
nāśayanti hyadhītāni nādhigacchanti cānagha / gāyanti laukikairgānairdaivatāni narādhipa
vāmapāśupatācārāstathā vai pāñcarātrikāḥ / bhaviṣyanti kalau tasmin brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā
jñānakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate / kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān
kurvānti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ kuleṣu vai / dadhīcaśāpanirdagdhāḥ purā dakṣādhvare dvijāḥ
nindanti ca mahādevaṃ tamasāviṣṭacetasaḥ / vṛthā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti kalau tasmin yugāntike
ye cānye śāpanirdagdhā gautamasya mahātmanaḥ / sarve te ca bhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇādyāḥ svajātiṣu
vinindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ / vedabāhyavratācārā durācārā vṛthāśramāḥ
mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni ca / tamasāviṣṭamanaso vaiḍālavṛttikādhamāḥ
kalau rudro mahādevo lokānāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ / na devatā bhavennṛṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca daivatam
kariṣyatyavatārāṇi śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ / śrautasmārtapratiṣṭhārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā
upadekṣyati tajjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ brahmasaṃjñitam / sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi dharmān vedanidarśitān
ye taṃ viprā niṣevante yena kenopacārataḥ / vijityakalijān doṣān yānti te paramaṃ padam
anāyāsena sumahat puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ / anekadoṣaduṣṭasya kalereṣa mahān guṇaḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prāpya māheśvaraṃ yugam / viśeṣād brāhmaṇo rudramīśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet
ye namanti virūpākṣamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam / prasannacetaso rudraṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam
yathā rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvam / anyadevanamaskārānna tatphalamavāpnuyāt
evaṃvidhe kaliyuge doṣāṇāmekaśodhanam / mahādevanamaskāro dhyānaṃ dānamiti śrutiḥ
tasmādanīśvarānanyān tyaktvā devaṃ maheśvaram / samāśrayed virūpākṣaṃ yadīcchet paramaṃ padam
nārcayantīha ye rudraṃ śivaṃ tridaśavanditam / teṣāṃ dānaṃ tapo yajño vṛthā jīvitameva ca
namo rudrāya mahate devadevāya śūline / tryambakāya trinetrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
namo 'stu vāmadevāya mahādevāya vedhase / śaṃbhave sthāṇave nityaṃ śivāya parameṣṭhine / namaḥ śomāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya hetave
prapadye 'haṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmacāriṇam / mahādevaṃ mahāyogamīśānaṃ cāmbikāpatim
yogināṃ yogadātāraṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam / yogināṃ kurumācāryaṃ yogigamyaṃ pinākinam
saṃsāratāraṇaṃ rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇo 'dhipam / śāśvataṃ sarvagaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam
kapardinaṃ kālamūrtimamūrti parameśvaram / ekamūrti mahāmūrti vedavedyaṃ divaspatim
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśvamūrti vyāpinaṃ viśvaretasam / kālāgniṃ kāladahanaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmanāśanam
namasye giriśaṃ devaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam / vilohitaṃ lelihānamāhityaṃ parameṣṭhinam / ugraṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasaḥ param
ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ / atītānāgatānāṃ vai yāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ
manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai / vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi
manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣu vai / tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta
evamukto bhagavatā kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ / babhāra paramāṃ bhaktimīśāne 'vyabhicāriṇīm
namaścakāra tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ skṣād viṣṇuṃ vyavasthitam
tamuvāca punarvyāsaḥ pāthaṃ parapurañjayam / karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇataṃ muniḥ
dhanyo 'syanugṛhīto 'si tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate / trailokye śaṅkare nūnaṃ bhaktaḥ parapurañjaya
dṛṣṭavānasi taṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvatomukham / pratyakṣameva sarveśaṃ rudraṃ sarvajagadgurum
jñānaṃ tadaiśvaraṃ divyaṃ yathāvad viditaṃ tvayā / svayameva hṛṣīkeśaḥ prītyovāca sanātanaḥ
gaccha gaccha svakaṃ sthānaṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi / vrajasva parayā bhaktyā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ śivam
evamuktvā sa bhagavānanugṛhyārjunaṃ prabhuḥ / jagāma śaṅkarapurīṃ samārādhayituṃ bhavam
pāṇḍaveyo 'pi tad vākyāt saṃprāpya śaraṇaṃ śivam / saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi tadbhaktiparamo 'bhavat
nārjunena samaḥ śaṃbhorbhaktyā bhūto bhaviṣyati / muktvā satyavatīsūnuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā devakīsutam
tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaḥ satyāya dhīmate / pārāśaryāya munaye vyāsāyāmitatejase
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ sākṣād viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ / ko hyanyastattvato rudraṃ vetti taṃ parameśvaram
namaḥ kurudhvaṃ tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ satyavatīsutam / pārāśaryaṃ mahātmānaṃ yoginaṃ viṣṇumavyayam
evamuktāstu munayaḥ sarva eva samīhitāḥ / preṇemustaṃ mahātmānaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ prāpya vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / kimakārṣonmahābuddhiḥ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
sūta uvāca prāpya vārāṇasī divyāmupaspṛśya mahāmuniḥ / pūjayāmāsa jāhnavyāṃ devaṃ viśveśvaraṃ śivam
tamāgataṃ puniṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra ye nivasanti vai / pūjayāñcakrire vyāsaṃ munayo munipuṅgavam
papracchuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve kathāḥ pāpavināśanīḥ / mahādevāśrayāḥ puṇyā mokṣadharmān sanātanān
sa cāpi kathayāmāsa sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya dharmān vedanidarśitān
teṣāṃ madhye munīndrāṇāṃ vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ / pṛṣṭavān jaiminirvyāsaṃ gūḍhamarthaṃ sanātanam
jaiminiruvāca bhagavan saṃśayaṃ tvekaṃ chettumarhasi tattvataḥ / na vidyate hyaviditaṃ bhavatā paramarṣiṇā
kecid dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmamevāpare janāḥ / anye sāṃkhyaṃ tathā yogaṃ tapastvanye maharṣayaḥ
brahmacaryamatho maunamanye prāharmaharṣayaḥ / ahiṃsāṃ satyamapyanye saṃnyāsamapare viduḥ
kecid dayāṃ praśaṃsanti dānamadhyayanaṃ tathā / tīrthayātrāṃ tathā kecidanye cendriyanigraham
kimeteṣāṃ bhavejjyāyaḥ prabrūhi munipuṅgava / yadi vā vidyate 'pyanyad guhyaṃ tadvaktumarhasi
śrutvā sa jaiminervākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / prāha gambhīrayā vācā praṇamya vṛṣaketanam
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mune / vakṣye guhyatamād guhyaṃ śruṇvantvanye maharṣayaḥ
īśvareṇa purā proktaṃ jñānametat sanātanam / gūḍhamaprājñavidviṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ
nāśraddadhāne dātavyaṃ nābhakte parameṣṭhinaḥ / na vedavidviṣu śubhaṃ jñānanānāṃ jñānamuttamam
meruśṛṅge purā devamīśānaṃ tripuradviṣam / devāsanagatā devī mahādevamapṛcchata
devyuvāca devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāmārtināśana / kathaṃ tvāṃ puruṣo devamacirādeva paśyati
sāṃkhyayogastathā dhyānaṃ karmayogo 'tha vaidikaḥ / āyāsabahulā loke yāni cānyāni śaṅkara
yena vibrāntacittānāṃ yogināṃ karmiṇāmapi / dṛśyo hi bhagavān sūkṣmaḥ sarveṣāmatha dehinām
etad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ gūḍhaṃ brahmādisevitama / hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ brūhi kāmāṅganāśana
īśvara uvāca avācyametad vijñānaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam / vakṣye tava yathā tattvaṃ yaduktaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ
paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ mama vārāṇasī purī / sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
tatra bhaktā mahādevi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ / nivasanti mahātmānaḥ paraṃ niyamamāsthitāḥ
uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ sthānānāmuttamaṃ ca tat / jñānānāmuttamaṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama
sthānāntaraṃ pavitrāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / śmaśānasaṃsthitānyeva divyabhūmigatāni ca
bhūrloke naiva saṃlagnamantarikṣe mamālayam / ayuktāstanna paśyanti yuktāḥ paśyanti cetasā
śmasānametad vikhyātamavimuktamiti śrutam / kālo bhūtvā jagadidaṃ saṃharāmyatra sundari
devīdaṃ sarvaguhyānāṃ sthānaṃ priyatamaṃ mama / madbhaktāstatra gacchanti māmeva praviśanti te
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat / dhyānamadhyayanaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet
janmāntarasahastreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam / avimuktaṃ praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye varṇasaṃkarāḥ / striyo mlecchāśca ye cānye saṃkīrṇāḥ pāpayonayaḥ
koṭāḥ pipīlikāścaiva ye cānye mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / kālena nidhanaṃ prāptā avimukte varānane
candrārdhamaulayastryakṣā mahāvṛṣabhavāhanāḥ / śive mama pure devi jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
nāvimukte mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī / īśvarānugṛhītā hi sarve yānti parāṃ gatim
mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam / aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ
durlabhā tapasā cāpi pūtasya parameśvari / yatra tatra vipannasya gatiḥ saṃsāramokṣaṇī
prasādājjāyate hyetanmama śailendranandini / aprabuddhā na paśyanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ
avimuktaṃ na sevanti mūḍhā ye tamasāvṛtāḥ / viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye te vasanti punaḥ punaḥ
hanyamāno 'pi yo vidvān vased vighnaśatairapi / sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati
janmamṛtyujarāmuktaṃ paraṃ yāti śivālayam / apunarmaraṇānāṃ hi sā gatirmokṣakāṅkṣiṇām / yāṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāditi manyanti paṇḍatāḥ
na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñairnāpi vidyayā / prāpyate gatirutkṛṣṭā yāvimukte tu labhyate
nānāvarṇā vivarṇāśca caṇḍālādyā jugupsitāḥ / kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehā ye viśiṣṭaiḥ pātakaistathā / bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ teṣāmavimuktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
avimuktaṃ paraṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ padam / avimuktaṃ paraṃ tattvamavimuktaṃ paraṃ śivam
kṛtvā vai naiṣṭhikīṃ dīkṣāmavimukte vasanti ye / teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ dadāmyante paraṃ padam
prāyāgaṃ naimiṣaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīśailo 'tha mahālayaḥ / kedāraṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca gayā puṣkarameva ca
kurukṣetraṃ rudrakoṭirnarmadāmrātakeśvaram / śāligrāmaṃ ca kubjāmraṃ kokāmukhamanuttamam / prabhāsaṃ vijayeśānaṃ gokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇakam
etāni puṇyasthānāni trailokye viśrutāni ha / na yāsyanti paraṃ mokṣaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtāḥ
vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa gaṅgā tripathagāminī / praviṣṭā nāśayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam
anyatra sulabhā gaṅgā śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo japaḥ / vratāni sarvamevaitad vārāṇasyāṃ sudurlabham
yajeta juhuyānnityaṃ dadātyarcayate 'marān / vāyubhakṣaśca satataṃ vārāṇasyāṃ stito naraḥ
yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi vādhārmiko naraḥ / vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya punāti sakalaṃ naraḥ
vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ yer'cayanti stuvanti vai / sarvapāpavinirmuktāste vijñeyā gaṇeśvarāḥ
anyatra yogajñānābhyāṃ saṃnyāsādathavānyataḥ / prāpyate tat paraṃ sthānaṃ sahastreṇaiva janmanā
ye bhaktā devadeveśe vārāṇasyāṃ vasanti vai / te vindanti paraṃ mokṣamekenaiva tu janmanā
yatra yogastathā jñānaṃ muktirekena janmanā / avimuktaṃ samāsādya nānyad gacchet tapovanam
yato mayā na muktaṃ tadavimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtam / tadeva guhyaṃ guhyānāmetad vijñāya mucyate
jñānājñānābhiniṣṭhānāṃ paramānandamicchatām / yā gatirvihitā subhru sāvimukte mṛtasya tu
yāni caivāvimuktasya dehe tūktāni kṛtsnaśaḥ / purī vārāṇasī tebhyaḥ sthānebhyo hyadhikāśubhā
yatra sākṣānmahādevo dehānte svayamīśvaraḥ / vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahma tatraiva hyavimuktakam
yat tat parataraṃ tattvamavimuktamiti śrutam / ekena janmanā devi vārāṇasyāṃ tadāpnuyāt
bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye ca hṛdaye caiva mūrdhani / yathāvimuktāditye vārāṇasyāṃ vyavasthitam
varaṇāyāstathā cāsyā madhye vārāṇasī purī / tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ tattvaṃ nityamevāvimuktakam
vārāṇasyāḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / yatra nārāyaṇo devo mahādevo diveśvaraḥ
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / upāsate māṃ satataṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham
mahāpātakino ye ca ye tebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ / vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya te yānti paramāṃ gatim
tasmānmumukṣurniyato vased vai maraṇāntikam / vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevājjñānaṃ labdhvā vimucyate
kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ / tato naiva caret pāpaṃ kāyena manasā girā
etad rahasyaṃ vedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca suvratāḥ / avimuktāśrayaṃ jñānaṃ na kaścid vetti tattvataḥ
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śṛṇvatāṃ parameṣṭhinām / devyai devena kathitaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam
yathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ / yatheśvarāṇāṃ giriśaḥ sthānānāṃ caitaduttamam
yaiḥ samārādhito rudraḥ pūrvasminneva janmani / te vindanti paraṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ śivālayam
kalikalmaṣasaṃbhūtā yeṣāmupahatā matiḥ / na teṣāṃ vedituṃ śakyaṃ sthānaṃ tat parameṣṭhinaḥ
ye smaranti sadā kālaṃ vindanti ca purīmimām / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipramihāmutra ca pātakam
yāni ceha prakurvanti pātakāni kṛtālayāḥ / nāśayet tāni sarvāṇi devaḥ kālatanuḥ śivaḥ
āgacchatāmidaṃ sthānaṃ sevituṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām / mṛtānāṃ ca punarjanam na bhūyo bhavasāgare
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ / yogī vāpyathavāyogī pāpī vā puṇyakṛttamaḥ
na vedavacanāt pitrorna caiva guruvādataḥ / matirutkramaṇīyā syādavimuktagatiṃ prati
sūta uvāca ityevamuktvā bhagavān vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ / sahaiva śiṣyapravarairvārāṇasyāṃ cacāra ha
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvaṃvibhāge ekonatriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca sa śiṣyaiḥ saṃvṛto dhīmān gururdvaipāyano muniḥ / jagāma vipulaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ muktidāyakam
tatrābhyarcya mahādevaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / provāca tasya māhātmyaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
idaṃ tad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ nāma śobhanam / asya smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
etat parataraṃ jñānaṃ pañcayatanamuttamam / sevitaṃ sūribhirnityaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vimokṣadam
atra sākṣānmahādevaḥ pañcāyatanavigrahaḥ / ramate bhagavān rudro jantūnāmapavargadaḥ
yat tat pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ pañcārthamiti śabdyate / tadetad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāre samavasthitam
śāntyatītā tathā śāntirvidyā caiva parā kalā / pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśca pañcārthaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram
pañcānāmapi devānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sadāśrayam / oṅkārabodhakaṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamucyate
saṃsmaredaiśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamavyayam / dehānte tatparaṃ jyotirānandaṃ viśate budhaḥ
atra devarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhā brahmarṣayastathā / upāsya devamīśānaṃ prāptavantaḥ paraṃ padam
matsyodaryāstaṭe puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ guhyatamaṃ śubham / gocarmamātraṃ viprendrā oṅkāreśvaramuttamam
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaḥ madhyameśvaramuttamam / viśveśvaraṃ tathoṅkāraṃ kapardeśvarameva ca
etāni guhyaliṅgāni vārāṇasyāṃ dvijottamāḥ / na kaścidiha jānāti vinā śaṃbhoranugrahāt
evamuktvā yayau kṛṣṇaḥ pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ / kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ draṣṭuṃ devasya śūlinaḥ
samabhyarcya tathā śiṣyairmāhātmyaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ / kathayāmāsa śiṣyebhyo bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ
asmin sthāne purā daityo hastī bhūtvā bhavāntikam / brāhmaṇān hantumāyāto ye 'tra nityamupāsate
teṣāṃ liṅgānmahādevaḥ prādurāsīt trilocanaḥ / rakṣaṇārthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
hatvā gajākṛtiṃ daityaṃ śūlenāvajñayā haraḥ / vasastasyākarot kṛttiṃ kṛttivāseśvarastataḥ
atra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā munayo munipuṅgavāḥ / tenaiva ca śarīreṇa prāptāstat paramaṃ padam
vidyā vidyeśvarā rudrāḥ śivāye ca prakīrtitāḥ / kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ nityamāvṛtya saṃsthitāḥ
jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoramadharmabahulaṃ janāḥ / kṛttivāsaṃ na muñcanti kṛtārthāste na saṃśayaḥ
janmāntarasahastreṇa mokṣo 'nyatrāpyate na vā / ekena janmanā mokṣaḥ kṛttivāse tu labhyate
ālayaḥ sarvasiddhānāmetat sthānaṃ vadanti hi / gopitaṃ devadevena mahādevena śaṃbhunā
yuge yuge hyatra dāntā brāhmaṇā vedapārāgāḥ / upāsate mahādevaṃ japanti śatarudriyam
stuvanti satataṃ devaṃ tryambakaṃ kṛttivāsasam / dhyāyanti hṛdaye devaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvāntaraṃ śivam
gāyanti siddhāḥ kila gītakāni ye vārāṇasyāṃ nivasanti viprāḥ / teṣāmathaikena bhavena muktir ye kṛttivāsaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ
saṃprāpya loke jagatāmabhīṣṭaṃ sudurlabhaṃ viprakuleṣu janma / dhyāne samādhāya japanti rudraṃ dhyāyanti citte yatayo maheśam
ārādhayanti prabhumīśitāraṃ vārāṇasīmadhyagatā munindrāḥ / yajanti yajñairabhisaṃdhihīnāḥ stuvanti rudraṃ praṇamanti śaṃbhum
namo bhavāyāmalayogadhāmne sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purāṇam / smarāmi rudraṃ hṛdaye niviṣṭaṃ jāne mahādevamanekarūpam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāgetriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca samābhāṣya munīn dhīmān devadevasya śūlinaḥ / jagāma liṅgaṃ tad draṣṭuṃ kapardeśvaramavyayam
snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayitvā pitṝn dvijāḥ / piśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinam
tatrāścaryamapaśyaṃste munayo guruṇā saha / menire kṣetramāhātmyaṃ praṇemurgiriśaṃ haram
kaścidabhyājagāmedaṃ śārdūlo ghorarūpadhṛk / mṛgīmekāṃ bhakṣayituṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam
tatra sā bhītahṛdayā kṛtvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam / dhāvamānā susaṃbhrāntā vyāghrasya vaśamāgatā
tāṃ vidārya nakhaistīkṣṇaiḥ śārdūlaḥ sumahābalaḥ / jagāma cānyaṃ vijanaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā munīśvarān
mṛtamātrā ca sā bālā kapardeśāgrato mṛgī / adṛśyata mahājvālā vyomni sūryasamaprabhā
trinetrā nīlakaṇṭhā ca śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajā / vṛṣādhirūḍhā puruṣaistādṛśaireva saṃvṛtā
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcinti khecarāstasya mūrdhani / gaṇeśvaraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā na dṛṣṭastatkṣaṇāt tataḥ
dṛṣṭvaitadāścaryavaraṃ jaiminipramukhā dvijāḥ / kapardeśvaramāhātmyaṃ papracchurgurumacyutam
teṣāṃ provāca bhagavān devāgre copaviśya saḥ / kapardeśasya māhātmyaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam
idaṃ devasya talliṅgaṃ kapardośvaramuttamam / smṛtvaivāśeṣapāpaughaṃ kṣipramasya vimuñcati
kāmakrodhādayo doṣā vārāṇasīnivāsinām / vighnāḥ sarve vinaśyanti kapardeśvarapūjanāt
tasmāt sadaiva draṣṭavyaṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam / pūjitavyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vaidikaiḥ stavaiḥ
dhyāyatāmatra niyataṃ yogināṃ śāntacetasām / jāyate yogasaṃsiddhiḥ sā ṣaṇmāse na saṃśayaḥ
brahmahatyādayaḥ pāpā vinaśyantyasya pūjanāt / piśācamocane kuṇḍe snātasyātra samīpataḥ
asmin kṣetre purā viprāstapasvī śaṃsitavrataḥ / śaṅkukarṇa iti khyātaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmarūpiṇam
puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ stotrairnamaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ / uvāsa tatra yogātmā kṛtvā dīkṣāṃ tu naiṣṭhikīma
kadācidāgataṃ pretaṃ paśyati sma kṣudhānvitam / asthicarmapinaddhāṅgaṃ niḥ śvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa muniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ / provāca ko bhavān kasmād deśād deśamimaṃśritaḥ
tasmai piśācaḥ kṣudhayā pīḍyamāno 'bravīd vacaḥ / pūrvajanmanyahaṃ vipro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ / putrapautrādibhiryuktaḥ kuṭumbabharaṇotsukaḥ
na pūjitā mayā devā gāvo 'pyatithayastathā / na kadācit kṛtaṃ puṇyamalpaṃ vā svalpameva vā
ekadā bhagavān devo govṛṣeśvaravāhanaḥ / viśveśvaro vārāṇasyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭe namaskṛtaḥ
tadācireṇa kālena pañcatvamahamāgataḥ / na dṛṣṭaṃ nanmayā ghoraṃ yamasya vadanaṃ mune
īdṛśīṃ yonimāpannaḥ paiśācīṃ kṣudhayānvitaḥ / pipāsayādhunākrānto na jānāmi hitāhitam
yadi kañcit samuddhartumupāyaṃ paśyasi prabho / kuruṣva taṃ namastubhyaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
ityuktaḥ śaṅkukarṇo 'tha piśācamidamabravīt / tvādṛśo na hi loke 'smin vidyate puṇyakṛttamaḥ
yat tvayā bhagavān pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭo viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ / saṃspṛṣṭo vandito bhūyaḥ ko 'nyastvatsadṛśo bhuvi
tena karmavipākena deśametaṃ samāgataḥ / snānaṃ kuruṣva śīghraṃ tvamasmin kuṇḍe samāhitaḥ / yenemāṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ kṣiprameva prahāsyasi
sa evamukto muninā piśāco dayālunā devavaraṃ trinetram / smṛtvā kapardeśvaramīśitāraṃ cakre samādhāya mano 'vagāham
tadāvagāḍho munisaṃnidhāne mamāra divyābharaṇopapannaḥ / adṛśyatārkapratime vimāne śaśāṅkacihnāṅkitacārumauliḥ
vibhāti rudrairabhito divasthaiḥ samāvṛto yogibhairaprameyaiḥ / sabālakhilyādibhireṣa devo yathodaye bhānuraśeṣadevaḥ
stuvanti siddhā divi devasaṅghā nṛtyanti divyāpsaraso 'bhirāmāḥ / muñcanti vṛṣṭiṃ kusumāmbumiśrāṃ gandharvavidyādharakiṃnarādyāḥ
saṃstūyamāno 'tha munīndrasaṅghai- ravāpya bodhaṃ bhagavātprasādāt / samāviśanmaṇḍalametadagryaṃ trayīmayaṃ yatra vibhāti rudraḥ
dṛṣṭvā vimuktaṃ sa piśācabhūtaṃ muniḥ prahṛṣṭo manasā maheśam / vicintya rudraṃ kavimekamagniṃ praṇamya tuṣṭāva kapardinaṃ tam
śaṅkukarṇa uvāca kapardinaṃ tvāṃ parataḥ parastād goptāramekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam / vrajāmi yogeśvaramīśitāra- mādityamagniṃ kapilādhirūḍham
tvāṃ brahmapāraṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ yoginamādimantam / vrajāmi rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ divasthaṃ mahāmuniṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram
sahastrapādākṣiśiro 'bhiyuktaṃ sahastrabāhuṃ namasaḥ parastāt / tvāṃ brahāmapāraṃ praṇamāmi śaṃbhuṃ hiraṇyagarbhādhipatiṃ trinetram
yataḥ prasūtirjagato vināśo yenāvṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ śivena / taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhagavantamīśaṃ praṇamya nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
aliṅgamālokavihīnarūpaṃ svayaṃprabhaṃ citpatimekarudram / taṃ brahmapāraṃ parameśvaraṃ tvāṃ namaskariṣye na yato 'nyadasti
yaṃ yoginastyaktasabījayogā labdhvā samādhiṃ paramārthabhūtāḥ / paśyanti devaṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam
na yatra nāmādiviśeṣakḷpti- r na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati yatsvarūpam / taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
yad vedavādābhiratā videhaṃ sabrahmavijñānamabhedamekam / paśyantyanekaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpaṃ sabrahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityam
yataḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ purāṇo vivartate yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ / namāmi taṃ jyotiṣi saṃniviṣṭaṃ kālaṃ bṛhantaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam
vrajāmi nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ guheśaṃ sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purārim / śivaṃ prapadye haramindumauliṃ pinākinaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
stutvaivaṃ śaṅkukarṇo 'sau bhagavantaṃ kapardinam / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau proccaran praṇavaṃ param
tatkṣaṇāt paramaṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam / jñānamānandamadvaitaṃ koṭikālāgnisannibham
śaṅkukarṇo 'tha muktātmā tadātmā sarvago 'malaḥ / nililye vimale liṅge tadbhutamivābhavat
etad rahasyamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vaḥ kapardinaḥ / na kaścid vetti tamasā vidvānapyatra muhyati
ya imāṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm / bhaktaḥ pāpaviśuddhātmā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
paṭhecca satataṃ śuddho brahmapāraṃ mahāstavam / prātarmadhyāhnasamaye sa yogaṃ prāpnuyāt param
ihaiva nityaṃ vatsyāmo devadevaṃ kapardinam / drakṣyāmaḥ satataṃ devaṃ pūjayāmo 'tha śūlinam
ityuktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / uvāsa tatra yuktātmā pūjayan vai kapardinam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekatriśodhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca uṣitvā tatra bhagavān kapardeśāntike punaḥ / draṣṭuṃ yayau madhyameśaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇān prabhuḥ
tatra mandākinīṃ puṇyāmṛṣisaṅganiṣevitām / nadīṃ vimalapānīyāṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭo 'bhavanmuniḥ
sa tāmanvīkṣya munibhiḥ saha dvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / cakāra bhāvapūtātmā snānaṃ snānavidhānavit
saṃtarpya vidhivad devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / pūjayāmāsa lokādiṃ puṣpairnānāvidhairbhavam
praviśya śiṣyapravaraiḥ sārdhaṃ satyavatīsutaḥ / madhyameśvaramīśānamarcayāmāsa śūlinam
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / draṣṭuṃ samāgatā rudraṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram
oṅkārāsaktamanaso vedādhyayanatatparāḥ / jaṭilā muṇḍitāścāpi śuklayajñopavītinaḥ
kaupīnavasanāḥ kecidapare cāpyavāsasaḥ / brahmacaryaratāḥ śāntā vedāntajñānatatparāḥ
dṛṣṭvā dvaipāyanaṃ viprāḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munim / pūjayitvā yathānyāyamidaṃ vacanamabruvan
ko bhavān kuta āyātaḥ saha śiṣyairmahāmune / procuḥ pailādayaḥ śiṣyāstānṛṣīn brahmabhāvitān
ayaṃ satyavatīsūnuḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / vyāsaḥ svayaṃ hṛṣīkeśo yena vedāḥ pṛthak kṛtāḥ
yasya devo mahādevaḥ sākṣādeva pinākadhṛk / aṃśāṃśenābhavat putro nāmnā śuka iti prabhuḥ
yaḥ sa sākṣānmahādevaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram / prapannaḥ parayā bhaktyā yasya tajjñānamaiśvaram
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhāḥ / nemuravyagramanasaḥ procuḥ satyavatīsutam
bhagavan bhavatā jñātaṃ vijñānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / prisādād devadevasya yat tanmāheśvaraṃ param
tadvadāsmākamavyaktaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamam / kṣipraṃ paśyema taṃ devaṃ śrutvā bhagavato mukhāt
visarjayitvā tāñchiṣyān sumantupramukhāṃstataḥ / provāca tatparaṃ jñānaṃ yogibhyo yogavittamaḥ
tatkṣaṇādeva vimalaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ jyotiruttamam / līnāstatraiva te viprāḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
tataḥ śiṣyān samāhūya bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ / provāca madhyameśasya māhātmyaṃ pailapūrvakān
asmin sthāne svayaṃ devo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / ramate bhagavān nityaṃ rudraiśca parivāritaḥ
atra pūrvaṃ hṛṣīkeśo viśvātmā devakīsutaḥ / uvāsa vatsaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā pāśupatairvṛtaḥ
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgo rudrādhyayanatatparaḥ / ārādhayan hariḥ śaṃbhuṃ kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam
tasya te bahavaḥ śiṣyā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ / labdhvā tadvacanājjñānaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram
tasya devo mahādevaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nīlalohitaḥ / dadau kṛṣṇāsya bhagavāna varado varamuttamam
yer'cayiṣyanti govindaṃ madbhaktā vidhipūrvakam / teṣāṃ tadaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyati jaganmaya
namasyor'cayitavyaśca dhyātavyo matparairjanaiḥ / bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādād dvijātibhiḥ
ye 'tra drakṣyanti deveśaṃ snātvā rudraṃ pinākinam / brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāmāśu vinaśyati
prāṇāṃstyajanti ye martyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api / te yānti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
dhanyāstu khalu te viprā mandākinyāṃ kṛtodakāḥ / arcayanti mahādevaṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tviha / ekaikaśaḥ kṛtaṃ viprāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam
saṃnihatyāmupaspṛśya rāhugraste divākare / yat phalaṃ labhate martyastasmād daśaguṇaṃ tviha
evamuktvā mahāyogī madhyameśānti ke prabhuḥ / uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjayan vai maheśvaram
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tataḥ sarvāṇi guhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / jagāma bhagavān vyāso jaiminipramukhairvṛtaḥ
prayāgaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgādadhikaṃ śubham / viśvarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tālatīrthamanuttamam
ākāśākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caivārṣabhaṃ param / svarnolaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ gaurītīrthamanuttamam
prājāpatyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ svargadvāraṃ tathaiva ca / jambukeśvaramityuktaṃ dharmākhyaṃ tīrthamuttamam
gayātīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva mahānadī / nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vāyutīrthamanuttamam
jñānatīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam / yamatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃvartakaṃ śubham
agnitīrthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kalaśeśvaramuttamam / nāgatīrthaṃ somatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca
parvatākhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ maṇikarṇamanuttamam / ghaṭotkacaṃ tīrthavaraṃ śrītīrthaṃ ca pitāmaham
gaṅgātīrthaṃ tu deveśaṃ yayātestīrthamuttamam / kāpilaṃ caiva someśaṃ brahmatīrthamanuttamam
atra liṅgaṃ purānīya brahmā snātuṃ yadā gataḥ / tadānīṃ sthāpayāmāsa viṣṇustalliṅgamaiśvaram
tataḥ snātvā samāgatya brahmā provāca taṃ harim / mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmāt sthāpitavānasi
tamāha viṣṇustvatto 'pi rudre bhaktirdṛḍhā mama / tasmāt pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃnāmnā tava bhaviṣyati
bhūteśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasamudbhavam / gandharvatīrthaṃ paramaṃ vāhneyaṃ tīrthamuttamam
daurvāsikaṃ vyomatīrthaṃ candratīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / citrāṅgadeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vidyādhareśvaram
kedāratīrthamugrākhyaṃ kālañjaramanuttamam / sārasvataṃ prabhāsaṃ ca bhadrakarṇaṃ hradaṃ śubham
laukikākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam / hiraṇyagarbhaṃ goprekṣyaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam
upaśāntaṃ śivaṃ caiva vyāghreśvaramanuttamam / trilocanaṃ mahātīrthaṃ lolārkaṃ cottarāhvayam
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam / śukreśvaraṃ mahāpuṇyamānandapuramuttamam
evamādīni tīrthāni prādhānyāt kathitāni tu / na śakyaṃ vistarād vaktuṃ tīrthasaṃkhyā dvijāttamāḥ
teṣu sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvābhyarcya pinākinam / upoṣya tatra tatrāsau pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ
tarpayitvā pitṝn devān kṛtvā piṇḍapridānakam / jagāma punarevāpi yatra viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ
snātvābhyarcya paraṃ liṅgaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / uvāca śiṣyān dharmātmā svān deśān gantumarhathā
te praṇamya mahātmānaṃ jagmuḥ pailādayo dvijāḥ / vāsaṃ ca tatra niyato vārāṇasyāṃ cakāra saḥ
śānto dāntastriṣavaṇaṃsnātvābhyarcya pinākinam / bhaikṣāhāro viśuddhātmā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ
kadācid vasatā tatra vyāsenāmitatejasā / bhramamāṇena bhikṣā tu naiva labdhā dvijottamāḥ
tataḥ krodhāvṛtatanurnarāṇāmiha vāsinām / vighnaṃ sṛjāmi sarveṣāṃ yena siddhirvihīyate
tatkṣaṇe sā mahādevī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / prādurāsīt svayaṃ prītyā veṣaṃ kṛtvā tu mānuṣam
bho bho vyāsa mahābuddhe śaptavyā bhavatā na hi / gṛhāṇa bhikṣāṃ mattastvamuktvaivaṃ pradadau śivā
uvāca ca mahādevī krodhanastvaṃ bhavān yataḥ / iha kṣetre na vastavyaṃ kṛtaghno 'si tvayā sadā
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavān dhyānājjñātvā parāṃ śivām / uvāca praṇato bhūtvā stutvā ca pravaraiḥ stavaiḥ
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ praveśaṃ dehi śāṅkari / evamastvityanujñāya devī cāntaradhīyata
evaṃ sa bhagavān vyāso mahāyogī purātanaḥ / jñātvā kṣetraguṇān sarvān sthitastasyātha pārśvataḥ
evaṃ vyāsaṃ sthitaṃ jñātvā kṣetraṃ sevanti paṇḍitāḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ
sūta uvāca yaḥ paṭhedavimuktasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyādapi / śrāvayed vā dvijān śāntān so 'piyātiparāṅgatim
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye rātrāvahani vā dvijāḥ / nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu devatāyataneṣu ca
snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ / japedīśaṃ namaskṛtya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayastriśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ māhātmyamavimuktasya yathāvat tadudīritam / idānīṃ tu prayāgasya māhātmyaṃ brūhi suvrata
yāni tīrthāni tatraiva viśrutāni mahānti vai / idānīṃ kathayāsmākaṃ sūta sarvārthavid bhavān
sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve vistareṇa bravīmi vaḥ / prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ yatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ
mārkaṇḍeyena kathitaṃ kaunteyāya mahātmane / yathā yudhiṣṭhirāyaitat tadvakṣye bhavatāmaham
nihatya kauravāna sarvān bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pārthivaḥ / śokena mahātāviṣṭā mumoha sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
acireṇātha kālena mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ / saṃprāpto hāstinapuraṃ rājadvāre sa tiṣṭhati
dvārapālo 'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājñaḥ kathitavān drutam / mārkaṇḍeyo draṣṭumicchaṃstvāmāste dvāryasau muniḥ
tvarito dharmaputrastu dvārametyāha tatparam / svāgataṃ te mahāprājña svāgataṃ te mahāmune
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me tāritaṃ kulam / adya me pitarastuṣṭāstvayi tuṣṭe mahāmune
siṃhāsanamupasthāpya pādaśaucārcanādibhiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro mahātmeti pūjayāmāsa taṃ munim
mārkaṇḍeyastatastuṣṭaḥ provāca sa yudhiṣṭhiram / kimarthaṃ muhyase vidvan sarvaṃ jñātvāhamāgataḥ
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā praṇamyāha mahāmunim / kathaya tvaṃ samāsena yena mucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ
nihatā vahavo yuddhe puṃso niraparādhinaḥ / asmābhiḥ kauravaiḥ sārdhaṃ prasaṅgānmunipuṅgava
yena hiṃsāsamudbhūtājjanmāntarakṛtādapi / mucyate pātakādasmāt tad bhavān vaktumarhati
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārat / prayāgagamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam
tatra devo mahādevo rudro viśvāmareśvaraḥ / samāste bhagavān brahmā svayaṃbhūrapi daivadaiḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi prayāgagamane phalam / mṛtānāṃ kā gatistatra snātānāmapi kiṃ phalam
ye vasanti prayāge tu brūhi teṣāṃ tu kiṃ phalam / bhavatā viditaṃ hyetat tanme brūhi namo 'stu te
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa yā ceṣṭā yacca tatphalam / purā maharṣibhiḥ samyak kathyamānaṃ mayā śrutam
etat prajāpatikṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / atra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ
tatra brahmādayo devā rakṣāṃ kurvanti saṃgatāḥ / bahūnyanyāni tīrthāni sarvapāpāpahāni tu
kathituṃ neha śaknomi bahuvarṣaśatairapi / saṃkṣepeṇa pravakṣyāmi prayāgasyeha kīrtanam
ṣaṣṭirdhanuḥ sahastrāṇi yāni rakṣanti jāhnavīm / yamunāṃ rakṣati sadā savitā saptavāhanaḥ
prayāge tu viśeṣeṇa svayaṃ vasati vāsavaḥ / maṇḍalaṃ rakṣati hariḥ sarvadevaiśca sammitam
nyagrodhaṃ rakṣate nityaṃ śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ / sthānaṃ rakṣanti vai devāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham
svakarmaṇāvṛto loko naiva gacchati tatpadam / svalpaṃ svalpataraṃ pāpaṃ yadā tasya narādhipa / prayāgaṃ smaramāṇasya sarvamāyāti saṃkṣayam
darśanāt tasya tīrthasya nāma saṃkīrtanādapi / muttikālambhanād vāpi naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate
pañca kuṇḍāni rājendra yeṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī / prayāgaṃ viśataḥ puṃsaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt
yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu gaṅgāṃ yaḥ smarate naraḥ / api duṣkṛtakarmāsau labhate paramāṃ gatim
kīrtanānmucyate pāpād dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṇi paśyati / tathopaspṛśya rājendra svargaloke mahīyate
vyādhito yadi vā dīnaḥ krūddho vāpi bhavennaraḥ / gaṅgāyamunamāsādya tyajet prāṇān prayatnataḥ
dīptakāñcanavarṇābhairvimānairbhānuvarṇibhiḥ / īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ
sarvaratnamayairdivyairnānādhvajasamākulaiḥ / varāṅganāsamākīrṇairmodate śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
gītavāditranirghoṣaiḥ prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate / yāvanna smarate janma tāpat svarge mahīyate
tasmāt svargāt paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇakarmā narottama / hiraṇyaratnasaṃpūrṇe samṛddhe jāyate kule
tadeva smarate tīrthaṃ smaraṇāt tatra gacchati / deśastho yadi vāraṇye videśe yadi vā gṛhe
prayāgaṃ smaramāṇastu yastu prāṇān parityajet / brahmalokamavāpnoti vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ
sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣā mahī yatra hiraṇmayī / ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāstatra loke sa gacchati
strīsahastrākule ramye mandākinyāstaṭe śubhe / modate munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svakṛteneha karmaṇā
siddhacāraṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyate divi daivataiḥ / tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambudvīpapatirbhavet
tataḥ śubhāni karmāṇi cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / guṇavān vittasaṃpanno bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ / karmaṇā manasā vācā satyadharmapratiṣṭhitaḥ
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu grāmaṃ pratīcchati / suvarṇamatha muktāṃ vā tathaivānyān pratigrahān
svakārye pitṛkārye vā devatābhyarcane 'pi vā / niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ yāvat tatphalamaśnute
atastīrthe na gṛhṇīyāt puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca / nimitteṣu ca sarveṣu apramatto dvijo bhavet
kapilāṃ pāṭalāvarṇāṃ yastu dhenuṃ prayacchati / svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ cailakaṇṭhāṃ payasvinīm
yāvad romāṇi tasyā vai santi gātreṣu sattama / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catustriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa tīrthayātrāvidhikramam / ārṣeṇa tu vidhānena yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam
prayāgatīrthayātrārtho yaḥ prayāti naraḥ kvacit / balīvardaṃ samārūḍhaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam
narake vasate ghore samāḥ kalpaśatāyutam / tato nivartate ghoro gavāṃ krodho hi dāruṇaḥ / salilaṃ ca na gṛhṇanti pitarastasya dehinaḥ
yastu putrāṃstathā bālān snāpayet pāyayet tathā / yathātmanā tathā sarvān dānaṃ vipreṣu dāpayet
aiśvaryāllobhamohād vā gacched yānena yo naraḥ / niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ tasamādyānaṃ vivarjayet
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu kanyāṃ prayacchati / ārṣeṇa tu vivāhena yathā vibhavavistaram
na sa paśyati taṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ tena karmaṇā / uttarān sa kurūn gatvā modate kālamakṣayam
vaṭamūlaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet / sarvalokānatikramya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
tatra brahmādayo devā diśaśca sadigīśvarāḥ / lokapālāśca siddhāśca pitaro lokasaṃmatāḥ
sanatkumārapramukhāstathā brahmarṣayo 'pare / nāgāḥ supārṇāḥ siddhāśca tathā nityaṃ samāsate / hariśca bhagavānāste prajāpatipuraskṛtaḥ
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtam / prayāgaṃ rājaśārdūla triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
tatrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame saṃśitavrataḥ / tulyaṃ phalavāpnoti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ
na mātṛvacanāt tāta na lokavacanādapi / matirutkramaṇīyā te prayāgagāmanaṃ prati
daśa tīrtha sahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathāpare / teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva tīrthānāṃ kurunandana
yā gatiryogayuktasya sattvasthasya manīṣiṇaḥ / sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇān gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame
na te jīvanti loke 'smin yatra tatra yudhiṣṭhira / ye prayāgaṃ na saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tat tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ paramaṃ padam / mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śaśāṅka iva rāhuṇā
kambalāśvatarau nāgau yamunādakṣiṇe taṭe / tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
tatra gatvā naraḥ sthānaṃ mahādevasya dhīmataḥ / ātmānaṃ tārayet pūrvaṃ daśātītān daśāparān
kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tu naraḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / svargalokamavāpnoti yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam
pūrvapārśve tu gaṅgāyāstrailokyakhyātimān nṛpa / avacaḥ sarvasāmudraḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ ca viśrutam
brahmacārī jitakrodhastrirātraṃ yadi tiṣṭhati / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
uttareṇa pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhāgīrathyāstu savyataḥ / haṃsaprapatanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tatra smṛtamātrāt tu jāyate / yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvat svarge mahīyate
urvaśīpuline ramye vipule haṃsapāṇḍure / parityajatiyaḥ prāṇān śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca / āste sa pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ svargaloke narādhipa
athaṃ saṃdhyāvaṭe ramye brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ / naraḥ śucirupāsīta brahmalokamavāpnuyāt
koṭitīrthaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet / koṭivarṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā bahutīrthatapovanā / siddhakṣetraṃ hi tajjñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
kṣitau tārayate martyān nāgāṃstārayate 'pyadhaḥ / divi tārayate devāṃstena tripathagā smṛtā
yāvadasthīni gaṅgāyāṃ tiṣṭhanti puruṣasya tu / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
