tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nadīnāṃ paramā nadī / mokṣadā sarvabhūtānāṃ mahāpātakināmapi
sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā / gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
sarveṣāme bhūtānāṃ pāpopahatacetasām / gatimanveṣamāṇānāṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā gatiḥ
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam / māheśvarāt paribhraṣṭā sarvapāpaharā śubhā
kṛte yuge tu tīrthāni tretāyāṃ puṣkaraṃ param / dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ kalau gaṅgāṃ viśiṣyate
gaṅgāmeva niṣeveta prayāge tu viśeṣataḥ / nānyat kaliyugodbhūtaṃ malaṃ hantuṃ suduṣkṛtam
akāmo vā sakāmo vā gaṅgāyāṃ yo vipadyate / sa mṛto jāyate svarge narakaṃ ca na paśyati
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ṣaṣṭistīrthasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭistīrthaśatāni ca / māghamāse gamiṣyanti gaṅgāyamunasaṃgamam
gavāṃ śatasahastrasya samyag dattasya yat phalam / prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snātasya tat phalam
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye kārṣāgniṃ yastu sādhayet / ahīnāṅgo 'pyarogaśca pañcendriyasamanvitaḥ
yāvanti romakūpāṇi tasya gātreṣu mānada / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambūdvīpapatirbhavet / sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame lokaviśrute / rāhugrasto yathā somo vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ
somalokamavāpnoti somena saha modate / ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatāni ca
svargataḥ śakraloke 'sau munigandharvasevitaḥ / tato bhraṣṭastu rājendra samṛddhe jāyate kule
adhaḥ śirāstvayodhārāmurdhvapādaḥ pibennaraḥ / śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
tasmād bhraṣṭastu rājendra agnihotrī bhavennaraḥ / bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
yaḥ svadehaṃ vikarted vā śakunibhyaḥ prayacchati / vihagairupabhuktasya śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam
śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi somaloke mahīyate / tatastasmāt paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vidvān supriyavākyavān / bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstatatīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
uttare yamunātīre prayāgasya tu dakṣiṇe / ṛṇapramocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu paramaṃ smṛtam
ekarātroṣitaḥ snātvā ṛṇaistatra pramucyate / sūryalokamavāpnoti anṛṇaśca sadā bhavet
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍaya uvāca tapanasya sutā devī triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / samāgatā mahābhāgā yamunā yatra nimnagā
yenaiva niḥ sṛtā gaṅgā tenaiva yamunā gatā / yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu kīrtanāt pāpanāśanī
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca yamunāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam / prāṇāṃstyajati yastatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
agnitīrthamiti khyātaṃ yamunādakṣiṇa taṭe / paścime dharmarājasya tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ smṛtam / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā saṃtarpayecchuciḥ / dharmarājaṃ mahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
daśa tīrthasahastrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyastathāparāḥ / prayāge saṃsthitāni syurevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
tistraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt / divi bhūmyantarikṣe ca tatsarvaṃ jāhnavī smṛtā
yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā sa deśastat tapovanam / siddhikṣetraṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam
yatra devo mahādevo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / āste vaṭeśvaro nityaṃ tat tīrthaṃ tat tapovanam
idaṃ satyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasya ca / suhṛdāṃ ca japet karṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya tu
idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ medhyamidaṃ sukham / idaṃ puṇyamidaṃ ramyaṃ pāvanaṃ dharmyamuttamam
maharṣoṇāmidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam / atrādhītya dvijo 'dhyāyaṃ nirmalatvamavāpnuyāt
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā śuciḥ / jātismaritvaṃ labhate nākapṛṣṭhe ca modate
prāpyante tānitīrthāni sadbhiḥ śiṣṭānudarśibhiḥ / snāhi tīrtheṣu kauravya na ca vakramatirbhava
evamuktvā sa bhagavān mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ / tīrtāni kathayāmāsa pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānicit
bhūsamudrādisaṃsthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ jyotiṣāṃ sthitam / pṛṣṭaḥ provāca sakalamuktvātha prayayo muniḥ
ya idaṃ kalyamutthāya paṭhate 'tha śṛṇoti vā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ purvavibhāge saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca evamuktāstu munayo naimiṣīyā mahāmatim / papracchuruttaraṃ sūtaṃ pṛthivyādivinirṇayam
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathito bhavatā sūta sargaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ śubhaḥ / idānīṃ śrotumicchāmastrilokasyāsya maṇḍalam
yāvantaḥ sāgarā dvīpāstathā varṣāṇi parvatāḥ / vanāni saritaḥ sūryagrahāṇāṃ sthitireva ca
yadādhāramidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yeṣāṃ pṛthvī purā tviyam / nṛpāṇāṃ tatsamāsena sūta vaktumihārhasi
sūta uvāca vakṣye devādidevāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave / namaskṛtvāprameyāya yaduktaṃ tena dhīmatā
svāyaṃbhuvasya tu manoḥ prāgukto yaḥ priyavrataḥ / putrastasyābhavan putrāḥ prajāpatisamā daśa
agnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca vapuṣmān dyutimāṃstathā / medhā medhātithirhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca
jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ / dhārmiko dānanirataḥ sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ
medhāgnibāhuputrāstu trayo yogaparāyaṇāḥ / jātismarā mahābhāgā na rājye dadhire matim
priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcad vai saptadvīpeṣu sapta tān / jambudvīpeśvaraṃ putramagnīdhramakaronnṛpaḥ
plakṣdvīpeśvaraścaiva tena medhātithiḥ kṛtaḥ / śālmaleśaṃ vapuṣmantaṃ narendramabhiṣiktavān
jyotiṣmantaṃ kuśadvīpe rājānaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / dyutimantaṃ ca rājānaṃ krauñcadvīpe samādiśat
śākadvīpeśvaraṃ cāpi havyaṃ cakre priyavrataḥ / puṣkarādhipatiṃ cakre savanaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ
puṣkare savanasyāpi mahāvītaḥ suto 'bhavat / dhātikiścaiva dvāvetau putrau putravatāṃ varau
mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā mahātmanaḥ / nāmnā tu dhātakeścāpi dhātakīkhaṇḍamucyate
śākadvīpeśvarasyātha havyasyāpyabhavan sutāḥ / jaladaśca kumāraśca sukumāro maṇīcakaḥ / kusumottaro 'tha modākiḥ saptamaḥ syānmahādrumaḥ
jaladaṃ jaladasyātha varṣaṃ prathamamucyate / kumārasya tu kaumāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ sukumārakam
maṇīcakaṃ caturthaṃ tu pañcamaṃ kusumottaram / modākaṃ ṣaṣṭhamityuktaṃ saptamaṃ tu mahādrumam
krauñcadvīpeśvarasyāpi sutā dyutimato 'bhavan / kuśalaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dvitīyastu manoharaḥ
uṣṇastṛtīyaḥ saṃproktaścaturthaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ / andhakāro muniścaiva dundubhiścaiva saptamaḥ / teṣāṃ svanāmabhirdeśāḥ krauñcadvīpāśrayāḥ śubhāḥ
jyotiṣmataḥ kuśadvīpe saptaivāsan mahaujasaḥ / udbhedo veṇumāṃścaivāśvaratho lambano dhṛtiḥ / ṣaṣṭhaḥ prabhākāraścāpi saptamaḥ kapilaḥ smṛtaḥ
svanāmacihnitān yatra tathā varṣāṇi suvratāḥ / jñeyāni sapta tānyeṣu dvīpeṣvevaṃ na yo mataḥ
śālmaladvīpanāthasya sutāścāsan vapuṣmataḥ / śvetaśca haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā / vaidyutau mānasaścaiva saptamaḥ suprabho mataḥ
plakṣadvīpeśvarasyāpi sapta medhātitheḥ sutāḥ / jyeṣṭhaḥ śāntabhayasteṣāṃ śiśiraśca sukhodayaḥ / ānandaśca śivaścaiva kṣemakaśca dhruvastathā
plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyaḥ śākadvīpāntikeṣu vai / varṇāśramavibhāgena svadharmo muktaye dvijāḥ
jambudvīpeśvarasyāpi putrāstvāsan mahābalāḥ / agnīdhrasya dvijaśreṣṭhāstannāmāni nibodhata
nābhiḥ kiṃpuruṣaścaiva tathā haririlāvṛtaḥ / ramyo hiraṇvāṃśca kururbhadrāśvaḥ ketumāhalakaḥ
jambudvīpeśvaro rājā sa cāgnīdhro mahāmatiḥ / vibhajya navadhā tebhyo yathānyāyaṃ dadau punaḥ
nābhestu dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ himāhvaṃ pradadau punaḥ / hemakūṭaṃ tato varṣaṃ dadau kiṃpuruṣāya tu
tṛtīyaṃ naiṣadhaṃ varṣaṃ haraye dattavān pitā / ilāvṛtāya pradadau merumadhyamilāvṛtam
nīlācalāśritaṃ varṣaṃ ramyāya pradadau pitā / śvetaṃ yaduttaraṃ varṣaṃ pitrā dattaṃ hiraṇvate
yaduttaraṃ śṛṅgavato varṣaṃ tat kuruve dadau / meroḥ pūrveṇa yad varṣaṃ bhadrāśvāya nyavedayat / gandhamādanavarṣaṃ tu ketumālāya dattavān
varṣeṣveteṣu tān putrānabhiṣicya narādhipaḥ / saṃsārakaṣṭatāṃ jñātvā tapastepe vanaṃ gataḥ
himāhvayaṃ tu yasyaitannābherāsīnmahātmanaḥ / tasyarṣabho 'bhavat putro marudevyāṃ mahādyutiḥ
ṛṣabhād bharato jajñe vīraḥ putraśatāgrajaḥ / so 'bhiṣicyarṣabhaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ / vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā tapastepe yathāvidhi
tapasā karṣito 'tyarthaṃ kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ / jñānayogarato bhūtvā mahāpāśupato 'bhavat
sumatirbharatasyābhūt putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ / sumatestaijasastasmādindridyumno vyajāyata
parameṣṭhī sutastasmāt pratīhārastadanvayaḥ / pratiharteti vikhyāta utpannastasya cātmajaḥ
bhavastasmādathodgīthaḥ prastāvastatsuto 'bhavat / pṛthustatastato rakto raktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ
naro gayasya tanayastasya putro virāḍabhūt / tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata
mahānto 'pi tataścābhūd bhauvanastatsuto 'bhavat / tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuśca virajo rajastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ
śatajid rajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ dvijāḥ / teṣāṃ pradhāno balavān viśvajyotiriti smṛtaḥ
ārādhya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kṣemakaṃ nāma pārthivam / asūta putraṃ dharmajñaṃ mahābāhumarindamam
ete purastād rājāno mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ / eṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtaiśca bhukteyaṃ pṛthivī purā
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ / trailokyasyāsya mānaṃ vo na śakyaṃ vistareṇa tu
bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarloko 'tha mahastataḥ / janastapaśca satyaṃ ca lokāstvaṇḍodbhavā matāḥ
sūryācandramasoryāvat kiraṇairavabhāsate / tāvad bhūrloka ākhyātaḥ purāṇe dvijapuṅgavāḥ
yāvatpramāṇo bhūrloko vistarāt parimaṇḍalāt / bhuvarloko 'pi tāvānsyānmaṇḍalād bhāskarasya tu
ūrdhvaṃyanmaṇḍalād vyomadhruvoyāvadvyavasthitaḥ / svarlokaḥ sa samākhyātastatra vāyostu nemayaḥ
āvahaḥ pravahaścaiva tathaivānuvahaḥ paraḥ / saṃvaho vivahaścātha tadūrdhvaṃ syāt parāvahaḥ
tathā parivahaścordhvaṃ vāyorvai sapta nemayaḥ / bhūmeryojanalakṣe tu bhānorvai maṇḍalaṃ sthitam
lakṣe divākarasyāpi maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam / nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tallakṣeṇa prakāśate
dvelakṣe hyuttare viprā budho nakṣatramaṇḍalāt / tāvatpramāṇabhāge tu budhasyāpyuśanāḥ sthitaḥ
aṅgārako 'pi śukrasya tatpramāṇo vyavasthitaḥ / lakṣadvayena bhaumasya sthito devapurohitaḥ
saurirdvilakṣeṇa guror grahāṇāmatha maṇḍalam / saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ tasmāllakṣamātre prikāśate
ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ lakṣamātre sthito dhruvaḥ / meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ / tatra dharmaḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ
navayojanasāhastro viṣkambhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ / triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ
dviguṇastasya vistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ / tulyastayostu svarbhānurbhūtvādhastāt prasarpati
addhṛtya pṛthivīcchāyāṃ nirmito maṇḍalākṛtiḥ / svarbhānostu vṛhat sthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yat tamomayam
candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate / bhārgavāt pādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ
bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurāvubhau smṛtau / vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai / budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalāt tathā
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparāt / śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane
sarvāvaranikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu / yojanānyardhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate
upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ / sauro 'ṅgirāśca vakraśca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ
tebhyo 'dhastācca catvāraḥ punaranye mahāgrahāḥ / sūryaḥ saumo budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ
dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmimān / tadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ sa sūryo 'dhastāt prasarpati
vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhvaṃ carate śaśī / nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ prasarpati
nakṣatrebhyo budhaścordhvaṃ budhādūrdhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ / vakrastu bhārgavādūrdhvaṃ vakrādūrdhvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
tasmācchanaiścaro 'puyūrdhvaṃ tasmāt saptarṣimaṇḍalam / ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saptānāndhru vaścordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ
yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava / īṣādaṇḍastathaiva syād dviguṇo dvijasattamāḥ
sārdhakoṭistathā sapta niyutānyadhikāni tu / yojanānāṃ tu tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
trinābhimati pañcāre ṣaṣṇeminyakṣayātmake / saṃvatsarameya kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
catkāriṃśat sahastrāṇi dvitīyo 'kṣo vivasvataḥ / pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya dvijottamāḥ
akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇaṃ tadyugārdhayoḥ / hrasvo 'kṣastadyugārdhena dhruvādhāre rathasya tu
dvitīye 'kṣe tu taccakraṃ saṃsthitaṃ mānasācale / hayāśca sapta chandāṃsi tannāmāni nibodhata
gāyatrī ca bṛhatyuṣṇik jagatī paṅktireva ca / anaṣṭup triṣṭubityuktāśchandāṃsi harayo hareḥ
mānasopari māhendrī prācyāṃ diśi mahāpurī / dakṣiṇe na yamasyātha varuṇasya tu paścime
uttareṇa tu somasya tannāmāni nibodhata / amarāvatī saṃyamanī sukhā caiva vibhā kramāt
kāṣṭhāṃ gato dakṣiṇataḥ kṣipteṣuriva sarpati / jyotiṣāṃ cakramādāya devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
divasasya ravirmadhye sarvakālaṃ vyavasthitaḥ / saptadvīpeṣu viprendrā niśāmadhyasya saṃmukham
udayāstamane caiva sarvakālaṃ tu saṃmukhe / aśeṣāsu diśāsveva tathaiva vidiśāsu ca
kulālacakraparyanto bhramanneṣa yatheśvaraḥ / karotyahastathā rātriṃ vimuñcan medinīṃ dvijāḥ
divākarakarairetat pūritaṃ bhuvanatrayam / trailokyaṃ kathitaṃ sadbhirlokānāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trilokaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / bhavatyasmāt jagat kṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
rudrendropendracandrāṇāṃ viprendrāṇāṃ divaukasām / dyutirdyutimatāṃ kṛtsnaṃ yattejaḥ sārvalaukikam
sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ / sūrya eva trilokasya mūlaṃ paramadaivatam
dvādaśānye tathādityā devāste ye 'dhikāriṇaḥ / nirvahanti padaṃ tasya tadaṃśā viṣṇumūrtayaḥ
sarve namasyanti sahastrabhānuṃ gandharvadevoragakinvannarādyāḥ / yajanti yajñairvividhairdvijendrā- śchandomayaṃ brahmamayaṃ purāṇam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāryā pūrvavibhāge ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca sa ratho 'dhiṣṭhito devairādityairvasubhistathā / gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ
dhātār'yamātha mitraśca varuṇaḥ śakra eva ca / vivasvānatha pūṣā ca parjanyaścāṃśureva ca
bhagastvaṣṭā ca viṣṇuśca dvādaśaite divākarāḥ / āpyāyanti vai bhānuṃ vasantādiṣu vai kramāt
pulastyaḥ pulahaścātrirvasiṣṭhaścāṅgirā bhṛguḥ / bharadvājo gautamaśca kaśyapaḥ kratureva ca
jamadagniḥ kauśikaśca munayo brahmavādinaḥ / stuvanti devaṃ vividhaiśchandobhiste yathākramam
rathakṛcca rathaujśca rathacitraḥ subāhukaḥ / rathasvano 'tha varuṇaḥ suṣeṇaḥ senajit tathā
tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca rathajit satyajit tathā / grāmaṇyo devadevasya kurvate 'bhīśusaṃgraham
atha hetiḥ prahetiśca pauruṣeyo vadhastathā / sarpo vyāghrastathāpaśca vāto vidyud divākaraḥ
brahmopetaśca viprendrā yajñopetastathaiva ca / rākṣasapravarā hyete prayānti purataḥ kramāt
vāsukiḥ kaṅkanīraśca takṣakaḥ sarpapuṅgavaḥ / elāpatraḥ śaṅkhapālastathairāvatasaṃjñitaḥ
dhanañjayo mahāpadmastathā karkoṭako dvijāḥ / kambalāśvataraścaiva vahantyenaṃ yathākramam
tumbururnārado hāhā hūhūrviśvāvasustathā / ugraseno vasurucirarvāvasurathāparaḥ
citrasenastathorṇāyurdhṛtarāṣṭro dvijottamāḥ / sūryavarcā dvādaśaite gandharvā gāyatāṃ varāḥ / gāyanti vividhairgānairbhānuṃ ṣaḍjādibhiḥ kramāt
kratusthalāpsarovaryā tathānyā puñjikasthalā / menakā sahajanyā ca pramlocā ca dvijottamāḥ
anumlocā ghṛtīcī ca viśvācī corvaśī tathā / anyā ca pūrvacittiḥ syādanyā caiva tilottamā
tāṇḍavairvividhairenaṃ vasantādiṣu vai kramāt / toṣayanti mahādevaṃ bhānumātmānamavyayam
evaṃ devā vasantyarke dvau dvau māsau krameṇa tu / sūryamāpyāyayantyete tejasā tejasāṃ nidhim
grathitaiḥ svairvacobhistu stuvanti munayo ravim / gandharvāpsarasaścainaṃ nṛtyageyairupāsate
grāmaṇīyakṣabhūtāni kurvate 'bhīṣusaṃgraham / sarpā vahanti deveśaṃ yātudhānāḥ prayānti ca
bālakhilyā nayantyastaṃ parivāryodayād ravim / ete tapanti varṣanti bhānti vānti sṛjanti ca / bhūtānāmaśubhaṃ karma vyapohantīha kīrtitāḥ
ete sahaiva sūryeṇa bhramanti divi sānugāḥ / vimāne ca sthito nityaṃ kāmage vātaraṃhasi
varṣantaśca tapantaśca hlādayantaśca vai prajāḥ / gopayantīha bhūtāni sarvāṇīhāyugakṣayāt
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathātapaḥ / yathāyogaṃ yathāsattvaṃ sa eṣa tapati prabhuḥ
ahorātravyavasthānakāraṇaṃ sa prajāpatiḥ / pitṛdevamanuṣyādīn sa sadāpyāyed raviḥ
tatra devo mahādevo bhāsvān sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ / bhāsate vedaviduṣāṃ nīlagrīvaḥ sanātanaḥ
sa eṣa devo bhagavān parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ / sthānaṃ tad vidurādityaṃ vedajñā vedavigraham
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca evameṣa mahādevo devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ / karoti niyataṃ kālaṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ
tasya ye raśmayo viprāḥ sarvalokapradīpakāḥ / teṣāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ punaḥ sapta raśmayo grahayonayaḥ
suṣumno harikeśaśca viśvakarmā tathaiva ca / viśvavyacāḥ punaścānyaḥ saṃyadvasurataḥ paraḥ
arvāvasuriti khyātaḥ svarāḍanyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / supumnaḥ sūryaraśmistu puṣṇāti śiśiradyutim
tiryagūrdhvapracāro 'sau suṣumnaḥ paripaṭhyate / harikeśastu yaḥ prokto raśmirnakṣatrapoṣakaḥ
viśvakarmā tathā raśmirbudhaṃ puṣṇāti sarvadā / viśvavyacāstu yo raśmiḥ śukraṃ puṣṇāti nityadā
saṃyadvasuriti khyātaḥ sa puṣṇāti ca lohitam / vṛhaspatiṃ prapuṣṇāti raśmirarvāvasuḥ prabhoḥ / śanaiścaraṃ prapuṣṇāti saptamastu surāṭ tathā
evaṃ sūryaprabhāvena sarvā nakṣatratārakāḥ / vardhante vardhitā nityaṃ nityamāpyāyayanti ca
divyānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca naiśānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ / ādānānnityamādityastejasāṃ tamasāṃ prabhuḥ
ādatte sa tu nāḍīnāṃ sahastreṇa samantataḥ / nādeyāṃścaiva sāmudrān kūpyāṃścaiva sahastradṛk / sthāvarāñjaṅgamāṃścaiva yacca kulyādikaṃ payaḥ
tasya raśmisahastraṃ tacchītavarṣoṣṇanistravam / tāsāṃ catuḥ śataṃ nāḍyo varṣante citramūrtayaḥ
vandanāścaiva yājyāśca ketanā bhūtanāstathā / amṛtā nāma tāḥ sarvā raśmayo vṛṣṭisarjanāḥ
himodvāhāśca tā nāḍyo raśmayastriśataṃ punaḥ / raśmyo meṣyaśca pauṣyaśca hlādinyo himasarjanāḥ / candrāstā nāmataḥ sarvāḥ pītābhāḥ syurgabhastayaḥ
śukrāśca kakubhaścaiva gāvo viśvabhṛtastathā / śukrāstā nāmataḥ sarvāstrividhā gharmasarjanāḥ
samaṃ bibharti tābhiḥ sa manuṣyapitṛdevatāḥ / manuṣyānauṣadheneha svadhayā ca pitṝnapi / amṛtena surān sarvāṃstribhistrariṃstarpayatyasau
vasante graiṣmike caiva śataiḥ sa tapati tribhiḥ / śaradyapi ca varṣāsu caturbhaiḥ saṃpravarṣati / hemante śiśire caiva himamutsṛjati tribhiḥ
varuṇo māghamāse tu sūryaḥ pūṣā tu phalgune / caitre māsi bhavedaṃśo dhātā vaiśākhatāpanaḥ
jyeṣṭhāmūle bhavedindraḥ āṣāḍhe savitā raviḥ / vivasvān śrāvaṇe māsi prauṣṭhapadyāṃ bhagaḥ smṛtaḥ
parjanyo 'śvayuji tvaṣṭākārtike māsi bhāskaraḥ / mārgaśīrṣa bhavenmitraḥ pauṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
pañcaraśmisahastrāṇi varuṇasyārkakarmaṇi / ṣaḍbhiḥ sahastraiḥ pūṣā tu devoṃśaḥ saptabhistathā
dhātāṣṭabhiḥ sahastraistu navabhistu śatakratuḥ / vivasvān daśabhiḥ pāti pātyekādaśabhirbhagaḥ
saptabhistapate mitrastvaṣṭā caivāṣṭabhistapet / aryamā daśabhaiḥ pāti parjanyo navabhistapet / ṣaḍbhī raśmisahastraistu viṣṇustapati viśvasṛk
vasante kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ / śveto varṣāsu varṇena pāṇḍuraḥ śaradi prabhuḥ / hemante tāmravarṇaḥ syācchiśire lohito raviḥ
oṣadhīṣu balaṃ dhatte svadhāmapi pitṛṣvatha / sūryo 'maratvamamṛte trayaṃ triṣu niyacchati
anye cāṣṭau grahā jñeyāḥ sūryeṇādhiṣṭhitā dvijāḥ / candramāḥ somaputraśca śukraścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ / bhaumo mandastathā rāhuḥ ketumānapi cāṣṭamaḥ
sarve dhruve nibaddhā vai grahāste vātaraśmibhiḥ / bhrāmyamāṇā yathāyogaṃ bhramantyanudivākaram
alātacakravad yānti vātacakreritā dvijāḥ / yasmād vahati tān vāyuḥ pravahastena sa smṛtaḥ
rathastricakraḥ somasya kundābhāstasya vājinaḥ / vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena niśākaraḥ
vīthyāśrayāṇi carati nakṣatrāṇi raviryathā / hrāsavṛddhī ca viprendrā dhruvādhārāṇi sarvadā
sa somaḥ śuklapakṣe tu bhāskare parataḥ sthite / āpūryate parasyāntaḥ satataṃ divasakramāt
kṣīṇāyitaṃ suraiḥ somamāpyāyati nityadā / ekena raśminā viprāḥ suṣumnākhyena bhāskaraḥ
eṣā sūryasya vīryeṇa somasyāpyāyitā tanuḥ / paurṇamāsyāṃ sa dṛśyeta saṃpūrṇe divasakramāt
saṃpūrṇamardhamāsena taṃ somamamṛtātmakam / pibanti devatā viprā yataste 'mṛtabhojanāḥ
tataḥ pañcadaśe bhāge kiñcicchiṣṭe kalātmake / aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā jaghanyaṃ paryupāsate
pibanti dvikalaṃ kālaṃ śiṣṭā tasya kalā tuyā / sudhāmṛtamayīṃ puṇyāṃ tāmandoramṛtātmikām
niḥ sṛtaṃ tadamāvāsyāṃ gabhastibhyaḥ svadhāmṛtam / māsatṛptimapāpyagryāṃ pitaraḥ santi nirvṛtāḥ
na somasya vināśaḥ syāt sudhā devaistu pīyate / evaṃ sūryanimittasya kṣayo vṛddhiśca sattamāḥ
somaputrasya cāṣṭābhirvājibhirvāyuvegibhiḥ / vārijaiḥ syandano yuktastenāsau yāti sarvataḥ
śukrasya bhūmijairaśvaiḥ syandano daśabhirvṛtaḥ / aṣṭabiścātha bhaumasya ratho haimaḥ suśobhanaḥ
bṛhaspaterathāṣṭāśvaḥ syandano hemanirmitaḥ / rathastamomayo 'ṣṭāśvo mandasyāyasanirmitaḥ / svarbhānorbhāskarāreśca tathā ṣaḍbhirhayairvṛtaḥ
ete mahāgrahāṇāṃ vai samākhyātā rathā nava / sarve dhruve mahābhāgā nibaddhā vātaraśmibhiḥ
graharkṣatārādhiṣṇyāni dhruve baddhānyeśeṣataḥ / bhramanti bhrāmayantyenaṃ sarvāṇyanilaraśmibhiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca dhruvādūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ koṭiyojanavistṛtaḥ / kalpādhikāriṇastatra saṃsthitā dvijapuṅgavāḥ
janaloko maharlokāt tathā koṭidvayātamakaḥ / sanandanādayastatra saṃsthitā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
jalokāt tapolokaḥ koṭitrayasamanvitaḥ / vairājāstatra vai devāḥ sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ
prājāpatyāt satyalokaḥ koṭiṣaṭkena saṃyutaḥ / apunarmārakāstatra brahmalokastu sa smṛtaḥ
atra lokagururbrahmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ / āste sa yogibhirnityaṃ pītvā yogāmṛtaṃ param
viśanti yatayaḥ śāntā naiṣṭhikā brahmacāriṇaḥ / yoginastāpasāḥ siddhā jāpakāḥ parameṣṭhinam
dvāraṃ tadyogināmekaṃ gacchatāṃ paramaṃ padam / tatra gatvā na śocanti sa viṣṇuḥ sa ca śaṅkaraḥ
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ puraṃ tasya durāsadam / na me varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam
tatra nārāyaṇasyāpi bhavanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pure / śete tatra hariḥ śrīmān māyī māyāmayaḥ paraḥ
sa viṣṇulokaḥ kathitaḥ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ / yānti tatra mahātmāno ye prapannā janārdanam
ūrdhvaṃ tad brahmasadanāt puraṃ jyotirmayaṃ śubham / vahninā ca parikṣiptaṃ tatrāste bhagavān bhavaḥ
devyā saha mahādevaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ / yogibhiḥ śatasāhastrairbhūtai rudraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
tatra te yānti niyatā dvijā vai brahmacāriṇaḥ / madādevaparāḥ śāntāstāpasā brahmavādinaḥ
nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ / drakṣyanti brahmaṇā yuktā rudralokaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
ete sapta mahālokāḥ pṛthivyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / mahātalādayaścādhaḥ pātālāḥ santi vai dvijāḥ
mahātalaṃ ca pātālaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam / prāsādairvividhaiḥ śubhrairdevatāyatanairyutam
anantena ca saṃyuktaṃ mucukundena dhīmatā / nṛpeṇa balinā caiva pātālasvargavāsinā
śailaṃ rasātalaṃ viprāḥ śārkaraṃ hi talātalam / pītaṃ sutalamityuktaṃ nitalaṃ vidrumaprabham / sitaṃ hi vitalaṃ proktaṃ talaṃ caiva sitetaram
suparṇena muniśreṣṭhāstathā vāsukinā śubham / rasātalamiti khyātaṃ tathānyaiśca niṣevitam
virocanahiraṇyākṣatakṣakādyaiśca sevitam / talātalamiti khyātaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
vainateyādibhiścaiva kālanemipurogamaiḥ / pūrvadevaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ sutalaṃ ca tathāparaiḥ
nitalaṃ yavanādyaiśca tārakāgnimukhaistathā / mahāntakādyairnāgaiśca prahmādenāsureṇa ca
vitalaṃ caiva vikhyātaṃ kambalāhīndrasevitam / mahājambhena vīreṇa hayagrīveṇa vai tathā
śaṅkukarṇena saṃbhinnaṃ tathā namucipūrvakaiḥ / tathānyairvivadhairnāgaistalaṃ caiva suśobhanam
teṣāmadhastānnarakā māyādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / pāpinasteṣu pacyante na te varṇayituṃ kṣamāḥ
pātālānāmadhaścāste śeṣākhyā vaiṣṇavī tanuḥ / kālāgnirudro yogātmā nārasiṃho 'pi mādhavaḥ
yo 'nantaḥ paṭhyete devo nāgarūpī janārdanaḥ / tadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ sa kālāgnimapāśritaḥ
tamāviśya mahāyogī kālastadvadanotthitaḥ / viṣajvālāmayo 'nte 'sau jagat saṃharati svayam
sahastramāyo 'pratimaḥ saṃhartā śaṅkarodbhavaḥ / tāmasī śāṃbhavī mūrtiḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etad brahmāṇḍamākhyātaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ mahat / ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūrlokasyāsya nirṇayam
jambudvīpaḥ pradhāno 'yaṃ plakṣaḥ śālmala eva ca / kuśaḥ krauñcaśca śākaśca puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ
ete sapta mahādvīpāḥ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ / dvīpād dvīpo mahānuktaḥ sāgarādapi sāgaraḥ
kṣārodekṣurasodaśca surodaśca ghṛtodakaḥ / dadhyodaḥ kṣīrasalilaḥ svādūdaśceti sāgarāḥ
pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā sasamudrā dharā smṛtā / dvīpaiśca saptabhiryuktā yojanānāṃ samāsataḥ
jambūdvīpaḥ samastānāṃ dvīpānāṃ madhyataḥ śubhaḥ / tasya madhye mahāmerurviśrutaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ
caturaśītisāhastro yojanaistasya cocchrayaḥ / praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastāddvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ
mūle ṣoḍaśasāhastro vistārastasya sarvataḥ / bhūpadmāsyāsya śailo 'sau karṇikātvena saṃsthitaḥ
himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe / nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnāstathā pare / sahastradvitayocchrāyāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te
bhārataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam / harivarṣaṃ tathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvijāḥ
ramyakaṃ cottaraṃ varṣaṃ tasyaivānuhiraṇmayam / uttarāḥ kuravaścaiva yathaite bharatāstathā
navasāhastramekaikameteṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ / ilāvṛtaṃ ca tanmadhye tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ
meroścaturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhastravistṛtam / ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāgāścātvārastatra parvatāḥ / viṣkambhā racitā meroryojanāyutamucchritāḥ
pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ / vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ
kadambasteṣu jambuśca pippalo vaṭa eva ca / jambūdvīpasya sā jambūrnāmaheturmaharṣayaḥ
mahāgajapramāṇāni jambvāstasyāḥ phalāni ca / patanti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvataḥ
rasena tasyāḥ prakhyātā tatra jambūnadīti vai / sarit pravartate cāpi pīyate tatra vāsibhiḥ
na svedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ na jarā nendriyakṣayaḥ / tatpānāt susthamanasāṃ narāṇāṃ tatra jāyate
tīramṛttatra saṃprāpya vāyunā suviśoṣitā / jāmbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam
bhadrāśvaḥ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaśca paścime / varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭhāstayormadhye ilāvṛtam
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanam / vaibhrājaṃ paścime vidyāduttare saviturvanam
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadramasitodaṃ ca mānasam / sarāṃsyetāni catvāri devayogyāni sarvadā
sitāntaśca kumudvāṃśca kururī mālyavāṃstathā / vaikaṅko maṇiśailaśca ṛkṣavāṃścācalottamāḥ
mahānīlo 'tha rucakaḥ sabindurmandarastathā / veṇumāṃścaiva meghaśca niṣadho devaparvataḥ / ityete devaracitāḥ siddhāvāsāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
aruṇodasya sarasaḥ pūrvataḥ kesarācalaḥ / trikūṭaśikharaścaiva pataṅgo rucakastathā
niṣadho vasudhāraśca kaliṅgastriśikhaḥ śubhaḥ / samūlo vasudhāraśca kuravaścaiva sānumān
tāmrātaśca viśālaśca kumudo veṇurvataḥ / ekaśṛṅgo mahāśailo gajaśailaḥ piśācakaḥ
pañcaśailo 'tha kailāso himavāṃśacācalottamaḥ / ityete devacaritā utkaṭāḥ parvatottamāḥ
mahābhadrasya saraso dakṣiṇe kesarācalaḥ / śikhivāsaśca vaidūryaḥ kapilo gandhamādanaḥ
jārudhiśca sugandhiśca śrīśṛṅgaścācalottamaḥ / supārśvaśca supakṣaśca kaṅkaḥ kapila eva ca
piñjaro bhadraśailaśca surasaśca mahābalaḥ / añjano madhumāṃstadvat kumudo mukuṭastathā
sahastraśikharaścaiva pāṇḍuraḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca / pārijāto mahāśailastathaiva kapilodakaḥ
suṣeṇaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca mahāmeghastathaiva ca / ete parvatarājānaḥ siddhagandharvasevitāḥ
asitodasya sarasaḥ paścime kesarācalaḥ / śaṅkhakūṭo 'tha vṛṣabho haṃso nāgastathā paraḥ
kālāñjanaḥ śukraśailo nīlaḥ kamala eva ca / puṣpakaśca sumeghaśca vārāho virajāstathā / mayūraḥ kapilaścaiva mahākapila eva ca
ityete devagandharvasiddhasaṅghaniṣevitāḥ / saraso mānasasyeha uttare kesarācalāḥ
eteṣāṃ śailamukhyānāmantareṣu yathākramam / santi caivāntaradroṇyaḥ sarāṃsi ca vanāni ca
vasanti tatra munayaḥ siddhāśca brahmabhāvitāḥ / prasannāḥ śāntarajasaḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitāḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ sahitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge tricatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca caturdaśasahastraṇi yojanānāṃ mahāpurī / merorupari vikhyātā devadevasya vedhasaḥ
tatrāste bhagavān brahmā viśvātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ / upāsyamāno yogīndrairmunīndropendraśaṅkaraiḥ
tatra deveśvareśānaṃ viśvātmānaṃ prajāpatim / sanatkumāro bhagavānupāste nityameva hi
sa siddhairṛṣigandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surairapi / samāste yogayuktatmā pītvā tatparamāmṛtam
tatra devādidevasya śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ / dīptamāyatanaṃ śubhraṃ purastād brahmaṇaḥ sthitam
divyakāntisamāyuktaṃ caturdhāraṃ suśobhanam / maharṣigaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ brahmavidbhirniṣevitam
devyā saha mahādevaḥ śaśāṅkārkāgnilocanaḥ / ramate tatra viśveśaḥ pramathaiḥ pramatheśvaraḥ
tatra vedavidaḥ śāntā munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ / pūjayanti mahādevaṃ tāpasāḥ satyavādinaḥ
teṣāṃ sākṣānmahādevo munīnāṃ brahmavādinām / gṛhṇāti pūjāṃ śirasā pārvatyā parameśvaraḥ
tatraiva parvatavare śakrasya paramā purī / nāmnāmarāvatī pūrve sarvaśobhāsamanvitā
tamindramapsaraḥ saṅghā gandharvā gītatatparāḥ / upāsate sahastrākṣaṃ devāstatra sahastraśaḥ
ye dhārmikā vedavido yāgahomaparāyaṇāḥ / teṣāṃ tat paramaṃ sthānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge vahneramitatejasaḥ / tejovatī nāma purī divyāścaryasamanvitā
tatrāste bhagavān vahnirbhrājamānaḥ svatejasā / japināṃ homināṃ sthānaṃ dānavānāṃ durāsadam
dakṣiṇe parvatavare yamasyāpi mahāpurī / nāmnā saṃyamanī divyā siddhagandharvasevitā
tatra vaivasvataṃ devaṃ devādyāḥ paryupāsate / sthānaṃ tat satyasaṃdhānāṃ loke puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛṇām
tasyāstu paścime bhāge nirṛtestu mahātmanaḥ / rakṣovatī nāma purī rākṣasaiḥ sarvato vṛtā
tatra taṃ nirṛtiṃ devaṃ rākṣasāḥ paryupāsate / gacchanti tāṃ dharmaratā ye vai tāmasavṛttayaḥ
paścime parvatavare varuṇasya mahāpurī / nāmnā suddhavatī puṇyā sarvakāmardhisaṃyutā
tatrāpsarogaṇaiḥ siddhaiḥ sevyamāno 'marādhipaḥ / āste sa varuṇo rājā tatra gacchanti ye 'mbudāḥ / tīrthayātrāparī nityaṃ ye ca loke 'dhamarṣiṇaḥ
tasyā uttaradigbhāge vāyorapi mahāpurī / nāmnā gandhavatī puṇyā tatrāste 'sau prabhañjanaḥ
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ sevyamāno 'maraprabhuḥ / prāṇāyāmaparāmartyāsthānantadyānti śāśvatam
tasyāḥ pūrveṇa digbhāge somasya paramā purī / nāmnā kāntimatī śubhrā tatra somo virājate
tatra ye bhoganiratā svadharmaṃ puryapāsate / teṣāṃ tad racitaṃ sthānaṃ nānābhogasamanvitam
tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge śaṅkarasya mahāpurī / nāmnā yaśovatī puṇyā sarveṣāṃ sudurāsadā
tatreśānasya bhavanaṃ rudraviṣṇutanoḥ śubham / ghameśvarasya vipulaṃ tatrāste sa gaṇairvṛtaḥ
tatra bhogābhilipsūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / nivāsaḥ kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ devadevena śūlinā
viṣṇupādād viniṣkrāntā plāvayitvendumaṇḍalam / samantād brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ gaṅgā patati vai divaḥ
sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā hyabhavad dvijāḥ / sītā cālakanandā ca sucakṣurbhadranāmikā
pūrveṇa sītā śailāt tu śailaṃ yātyantarikṣataḥ / tataśca pūrvavarṣeṇa bhadrāśvenaiti cārṇavam
tathaivālakanandā ca dakṣiṇādetya bhāratam / prayāti sāgaraṃ bhittvā saptabhedā dvijottamāḥ
sucakṣuḥ paścimagirīnatītya sakalāṃstathā / paścimaṃ ketumālākhyaṃ varṣaṃ gatvaiti cārṇavam
bhadrā tathottaragirīnuttarāṃśca tathā kurūn / atītya cottarāmbhodhiṃ samabhyeti maharṣayaḥ
ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau mālyavān gandhamādanaḥ / tayormadhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ
bhāratāḥ ketumālāśca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravastathā / patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādāśailabāhyataḥ
jaṭharo devakūṭaśca maryādāparvatāvubhau / dakṣiṇottaramāyāmāvānīlaniṣadhāyatau
gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau / aśītiyojanāyāmāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau
niṣadhaḥ pāriyātraśca maryādāparvatāvimau / meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathāpūrvau tathā sthitau
triśṛṅgo jārudhaistadvaduttare varṣaparvatau / pūrvapaścāyatāvetau arṇavāntarvyavasthitau
maryādāparvatāḥ proktā aṣṭāviha mayā dvijāḥ / jaṭharādyāḥ sthitā meroścaturdikṣu maharṣayaḥ
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ketumāle narāḥ kālāḥ sarve panasabhojanāḥ / striyaścotpalapatrābhā jīvanti ca varṣāyutam
bhadrāśve puruṣāḥ śuklāḥ striyaścandrāṃśusannibhāḥ / daśa varṣasahastrāṇi jīvante āmrabhojanāḥ
ramyake puruṣā nāryo ramante rajataprabhāḥ / daśavarṣasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti caiva sattvasthā nyagrodhaphalabhojanāḥ
hiraṇmaye hiraṇyābhāḥ sarve ca lakucāśanāḥ / ekādaśasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti puruṣā nāryo devalokasthitā iva
trayodaśasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti kuruvarṣe tu śyāmāṅgāḥ kṣīrabhojanāḥ
sarve mithunajātāśca nityaṃ sukhaniṣevinaḥ / candradvīpe mahādevaṃ yajanti satataṃ śivam
tathā kiṃpuruṣe viprā mānavā hemasannibhāḥ / daśavarṣahastrāṇi jīvanti plakṣabhojanāḥ
yajanti satataṃ devaṃ caturmūrti caturmukham / dhyāne manaḥ samādhāya sādaraṃ bhaktisaṃyutāḥ
tathā ca harivarṣe tu mahārajatasannibhāḥ / daśavarṣasahastrāṇi jīvantīkṣurasāśinaḥ
tatra nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ viśvayoniṃ sanātanam / upāsate sadā viṣṇuṃ mānavā viṣṇubhāvitāḥ
tatra candraprabhaṃ śubhraṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmitam / vimānaṃ vāsudevasya pārijātavanāśritam
caturdhāramanopamyaṃ catustoraṇasaṃyutam / prākārairdaśabhiryuktaṃ durādharṣaṃ sudurgamam
sphāṭikairmaṇḍapairyuktaṃ devarājagṛhopamam / svarṇastambhasahastraiśca sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtam
hemasopānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam / divyasiṃhāsanopetaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
sarobhiḥ svādupānīyairnadībhiścopaśobhitam / nārāyaṇaparaiḥ śuddhairvedādhyayanatatparaiḥ
yogibhiśca samākīrṇaṃ dhyāyadbhiḥ puruṣaṃ harim / stuvadbhiḥ satataṃ mantrairnamasyadbhiśca mādhavam
tatra devādidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / rājānaḥ sarvakālaṃ tu mahimānaṃ prakurvate
gāyanti caiva nṛtyanti vilāsinyo manoramāḥ / striyo yauvanaśālinyaḥ sadā maṇḍanatatparāḥ
ilāvṛte padmavarṇā jambūphalarasāśinaḥ / trayodaśa sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai sthirāyuṣaḥ
bhārate tu striyaḥ puṃso nānāvarṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / nānādevārcane yuktā nānākarmāṇi kurvate / paramāyuḥ smṛtaṃ teṣāṃ śataṃ varṣāṇi suvratāḥ
nānāhārāśca jīvanti puṇyapāpanimittataḥ / navayojanasāhastraṃ varṣametat prakīrtitam / karmabhūmiriyaṃ viprā narāṇāmadhikāriṇām
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ / vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ
indradyumnaḥ kaśerumāṃstāmravarṇo gabhastimān / nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gandharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ
ayaṃ tu navamasteṣāṃ dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ / yojanānāṃ sahastraṃ tu dvīpo 'yaṃ dakṣiṇottaraḥ
pūrve kirātāstasyānte paśicame yavanāstathā / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśya madhye śūdrāstathaiva ca
ijyāyuddhavaṇijyābhirvartayantyatra mānavāḥ / stravante pāvanā nadyaḥ parvatebhyo viniḥ sṛtāḥ
śatadruścandrabhāgā ca sarayūryamunā tathā / irāvatī vitastā ca vipāśā devikā kuhūḥ
gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī / kauśikī lohitā caiva himavatpādaniḥ sṛtāḥ
vedasmṛtirvedavatī vrataghnī tridivā tathā / parṇāśā vandanā caiva sadānīrā manoramā
carmaṇvatī tathā dūryā vidiśā vetravatyapi / śigruḥ svaśilpāpi tathā pāriyātrāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ
narmadā surasā śoṇa daśārṇā ca mahānadī / mandākinī citrakūṭā tāmasī ca piśācikā
citrotpalā vipāśā ca mañjulā vāluvāhinī / ṛkṣavatpādajā nadyaḥ sarvapāpaharā nṛṇām
tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā śīghrodā ca mahānadī / veṇyā vaitaraṇī caiva balākā ca kumudvatī
toyā caiva mahāgairī durgā cāntaḥ śilā tathā / vindhyapādaprasūtāstā nadyaḥ puṇyajalāḥ śubhāḥ
sodāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā varṇā ca matsarī / tuṅgabhdrā suprayogā kāverī ca dvijottamāḥ / dakṣiṇāpathagā nadyaḥ sahyapādaviniḥ sṛtāḥ
ṛtumālā tāmraparṇo puṣpavatyutpalāvatī / malayānniḥ sṛtā nadyaḥ sarvāḥ śītajalāḥ smṛtāḥ
ṛṣikulyā trisāmā ca mandagā mandagāminī / rūpā pālāsinī caiva ṛṣikā vaṃśakāriṇī / śuktimatpādasaṃjātāḥ sarvapāpaharā nṛṇām
āsāṃ nadyupanadyaśca śataśo dvijapuṅgavāḥ / sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ snānadānādikarmasu
tāsvime kurupāñcālā madhyadeśādayo janāḥ / pūrvadeśādikāścaiva kāmarūpanivāsinaḥ
puṇḍrāḥ kaliṅgāmagadhā dākṣiṇātyāścakṛtsnaśaḥ / tathāparāntāḥ saurāṣṭrāḥ śūdrābhīrāstathār'budāḥ
mālakā mālavāścaiva pāriyātranivāsinaḥ / sauvīrāḥ saindhavā hūṇā śālvāḥ kalpanivāsinaḥ
madrā rāmāstathāmbaṣṭhāḥ pārasīkāstathaiva ca / āsāṃ pibanti salilaṃ vasanti saritāṃ sadā
catvāri bhārate varṣe yugāni kavayo 'bruvan / kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliścānyatra na kvacit
yāni kiṃpuruṣādyāni varṣāṇyaṣṭau maharṣayaḥ / na teṣu śoko nāyāso nodvegaḥ kṣudbhayaṃ na ca
svasthāḥ prajā nirātaṅkāḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitāḥ / ramanti vividhairbhāvaiḥ sarvāśca sthirayauvanāḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca hemakūṭagireḥ śṛṅge mahākūṭaiḥ suśobhanam / sphāṭikaṃ devadevasya vimānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
atha devādidevasya bhūteśasya triśūlinaḥ / devāḥ siddhagaṇā yakṣāḥ pūjāṃ nityaṃ prakurvate
sa devo giriśaḥ sārdhaṃ mahādevyā maheśvaraḥ / bhūtaiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ bhāti tatra pinākadhṛk
vibhaktacāruśikharaḥ kailāso yatra parvataḥ / nivāsaḥ koṭiyakṣāṇāṃ kuberasya ca dhīmataḥ / tatrāpi devadevasya bhavasyāyatanaṃ mahat
mandākinī tatra divyā ramyā suvimalodakā / nadī nānāvidhaiḥ padmairanekaiḥ samalaṅkṛtā
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ / upaspṛṣṭajalā nityaṃ supuṇyā sumanoramā
anyāśca nadyaḥ śataśaḥ svarṇapadmairalaṅkṛtāḥ / tāsāṃ kūleṣu devasya sthānāni parameṣṭhinaḥ / devarṣigaṇajuṣṭāni tathā nārāyaṇasya ca
sitāntaśikhare cāpi pārijātavanaṃ śubham / tatra śakrasya vipulaṃ bhavanaṃ ratnamaṇḍitam / sphāṭikastambhasaṃyuktaṃ hemagopurasaṃyutam
tatrātha devadevasya viṣṇorviśvāmareśituḥ / supuṇyaṃ bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān lakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ / āste sarvāmaraśreṣṭhaḥ pūjyamānaḥ sanātanaḥ
tathā ca vasudhāre tu vasūnāṃ ratnamaṇḍitam / sthānānāmaṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ durādharṣaṃ suradviṣām
ratnadhāre girivare saptarṣoṇāṃ mahātmanām / saptāśramāṇi puṇyāni siddhāvāsayutāni tu
tatra haimaṃ caturdvāraṃ vajranīlādimaṇḍitam / supuṇyaṃ sumahat sthānaṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
tatra devarṣayo viprāḥ siddhā brahmarṣayo 'pare / upāsate sadā devaṃ pitāmahamajaṃ param
sa taiḥ saṃpūjito nityaṃ devyā saha caturmukhaḥ / āste hitāya lokānāṃ śāntānāṃ paramā gatiḥ
athaikaśṛṅgaśikhare mahāpadmairalaṅkṛtam / svacchāmṛtajalaṃ puṇyaṃ sugandhaṃ sumahat saraḥ
jaigīṣavyāśramaṃ tatra yogīndrairupaśobhitam / tatrāsau bhagavān nityamāste śiṣyaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / praśāntadoṣairakṣudrairbrahmavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ
śaṅkho manoharaścaiva kauśikaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca / sumanā vedanādaśca śiṣyāstasya pradhānataḥ
sarve yogaratāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / upāsate mahāvīryā brahmavidyāparāyaṇāḥ
teṣāmanugrihārthāya yatīnāṃ śāntacetasām / sānnidhyaṃ kurute bhūyo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ
anyānicāśramāṇi syustasmin girivarottame / munīnāṃ yuktamanasāṃ sarāṃsi saritastathā
teṣu yogaratā viprā jāpakāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ / brahmaṇyāsaktamanaso ramante jñānatatparāḥ
ātmanyātmānamādhāya śikhāntāntaramāsthitam / dhāyāyanti devamīśānaṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
sumeghe vāsavasthānaṃ sahastrādityasaṃnibham / tatrāste bhagavānindraḥ śacyā saha sureśvaraḥ
gajaśaile tu durgāyā bhavanaṃ maṇitāraṇam / āste bhagavatī durgā tatra sākṣānmaheśvarī
upāsyamānā vividhaiḥ śaktibhedairitastataḥ / pītvā yogāmṛtaṃ labdhvā sākṣādānandamaiśvaram
sunīlasya gireḥ śṛṅge nānādhātusamujjvale / rākṣasānāṃ purāṇi syuḥ sarāṃsi śataśo dvijāḥ
tathā puraśataṃ viprāḥ śataśṛṅge mahācale / sphāṭikastambhasaṃyuktaṃ yakṣāṇāmamitaujasām
śvetodaragireḥ śṛṅge suparṇasya mahātmanaḥ / prākāragopuropetaṃ maṇitoraṇamaṇḍitam
sa tatra garuḍaḥ śrīmān sākṣād viṣṇurivāparaḥ / dhyātvāste tat paraṃ jyotirātmānaṃ viṣṇumavyayam
anyacca bhavanaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīśṛṅge munipuṅgavāḥ / śrīdevyāḥ sarvaratnāḍhyaṃ haimaṃ sumaṇitoraṇam
tatra sā paramā śaktirviṣṇoratimanoramā / anantavibhavā lakṣmīrjagatsaṃmohanotsukā
adhyāste devagandharvasiddhacāraṇavanditā / vicintya jagatoyoniṃ svaśaktikiraṇojjvalā
tatraiva devadevasya viṣṇorāyatanaṃ mahat / sarāṃsi tatra catvāri vicitrakamalāśrayā
tathā sahastraśikhare vidyādharapurāṣṭakam / ratnasopānasaṃyuktaṃ sarobhiścopaśobhitam
nadyo vimalapānīyāścitranīlotpalākarāḥ / karṇikāravanaṃ dvivyaṃ tatrāste śaṅkaromayā
pāriyātre mahāśaile mahālakṣmyāḥ puraṃ śubham / ramyaprāsādasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam
nṛtyadbhirapsaraḥ saṅghairitaścetaśca śobhitam / mṛdaṅgamurajodghuṣṭaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam
gandharvakiṃnarākīrṇaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ siddhapuṅgavaiḥ / bhāsvadbhittisamākīrṇaṃ mahāprāsādasaṃkulam
gaṇeśvarāṅganājuṣṭaṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ sudarśanam / tatra sā vasate devī nityaṃ yogaparāyaṇā
mahālakṣmīrmahādevī triśūlavaradhāriṇī / trinetrā sarvaśasaktībhiḥ saṃvṛtā sadasanmayā / paśyanti tatra munayaḥ siddhā ye brahmavādinaḥ
supārśvasyottare bhāge sarasvatyāḥ purottamam / sarāṃsi siddhajuṣṭāni devabhogyāni sattamāḥ
pāṇḍurasya gireḥ śṛṅge vicitradrumasaṃkule / sandharvāṇāṃ puraśataṃ divyastrībhiḥ samāvṛtam
teṣu nityaṃ madotsiktā varanāryastathaiva ca / krīḍanti muditā nityaṃ vilāsairbhogatatparāḥ
añjanasya gireḥ śṛṅge nārīṇāṃ puramuttamam / vasanti tatrāpsaraso rambhādyā ratilālasāḥ
citrasenādayo yatra samāyāntyarthinaḥ sadā / sā purī sarvaratnāḍhyā naikaprastravaṇairyutā
anekāni purāṇi syuḥ kaumude cāpi suvratāḥ / rudrāṇāṃ śāntarajasāmīśvarārpitacetasām
teṣu rudrā mahāyogā maheśāntaracāriṇaḥ / samāsate paraṃ jyotirārūḍhāḥ sthānamuttamam
piñjarasya gireḥ śṛṅge gaṇeśānāṃ puratrayam / nandīśvarasya kapile tatrāste suyaśā yatiḥ
tathā ca jārudhaiḥ śṛṅge devadevasya dhīmataḥ / dīptamāyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ
tasyaivottaradigbhāge candrasthānamanuttamam / ramate tatra ramyo 'sau bhagavān śītadīdhitiḥ
anyacca bhavanaṃ divyaṃ haṃsaśaile maharṣayaḥ / sahastrayojanāyāmaṃ suvarṇamaṇitoraṇam
tatrāste bhagavān brahmā siddhasaṅghairabhiṣṭutaḥ / sāvitryā saha viśvātmā vāsudevādibhiryutaḥ
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge siddhānāṃ puramuttamam / sanandanādayo yatra vasanti munipuṅgavāḥ
pañcaśailasya śikhare dānavānāṃ puratrayam / nātidūreṇa tasyātha daityacāryasya dhīmataḥ
sugandhaśailaśikhare saridbhirupaśobhitam / kardamasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ tatrāste bhagavānṛṣiḥ
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcid vai dakṣiṇāśrite / sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstatrāste brahmavittamaḥ
sarveṣveteṣu śaileṣu tatānyeṣu munīśvarāḥ / sarāṃsi vimalā nadyo devānāmālayāni ca
siddhaliṅgāni puṇyāni munibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu / vanyānyāśramavaryāṇi saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śaknuyām
eṣa saṃkṣepataḥ prokto jambūdvīpasya vistaraḥ / na śakyaṃ vistarād vaktuṃ mayā varṣaśatairapi
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṭcatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca jambūdvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭayitvā kṣārodaṃ plakṣadvīpo vyavasthitaḥ
plakṣadvīpe ca viprendrāḥ saptāsan kulaparvatāḥ / ṛjvāyatāḥ suparvāṇaḥ siddhasaṅghaniṣevitāḥ
gomedaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dvitīyaścandra ucyate / nārādo dundubhiścaiva somaśca ṛṣabhastathā / vaibhrājaḥ saptamaḥ prokto brahmaṇo 'tyantavallabhaḥ
tatra devarṣigandharvaiḥ siddhaiśca bhagavānajaḥ / upāsyate sa viśvātmā sākṣī sarvasya viśvasṛk
teṣu puṇyā janapadā nādhayo vyādhayo na ca / na tatra pāpakartāraḥ puruṣā vā kathañcana
teṣāṃ nadyaśca saptaiva varṣāṇāṃ tu samudragāḥ / tāsu brahmarṣayo nityaṃ pitāmahapupāsate
anutaptā śikhī caiva vipāpā tridivā kṛtā / amṛtā sukṛtā caiva nāmataḥ parikīrtitāḥ
kṣudranadyastvasaṃkhyātāḥ sarāṃsi subahūnyapi / na caiteṣu yugāvasthā puruṣā vai cirāyuṣaḥ
āryakāḥ kuravāścaiva vidaśā bhāvinastathā / brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāstasmin dvīpe prakīrtitāḥ
ijyate bhagavān somo varṇaistatra nivāsibhiḥ / teṣāṃ ca somasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
sarve dharmaparā nityaṃ nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / pañcavarṣasahastrāṇi jīvanti ca nirāmayāḥ
plakṣadvīpapramāṇaṃ tu dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭyekṣurasāmbhodhiṃ śālmaliḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ
sapta varṣāṇi tatrāpi saptaiva kulaparvatāḥ / ṛjvāyatāḥ suparvāṇaḥ sapta nadyaśca suvratāḥ
kumudaśconnataścaiva tṛtīyaśca balāhakaḥ / droṇaḥ kaṅkastu mahiṣaḥ kakudvān sapta parvatāḥ
yonī toyā vitṛṣṇā ca candrā śuklā vimocanī / nivṛttiścaiti tā nadyaḥ smṛtā pāpaharā nṛṇām
na teṣu vidyate lobhaḥ krodho vā dvijasattamāḥ / na caivāsti yugāvasthā janā jīvantyanāmayāḥ
yajanti satataṃ tatra varṇā vāyuṃ sanātanam / teṣāṃ tasyātha sāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca salokatā
kapilā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā rājānaścāruṇāstathā / pītā vaiśyāḥ smṛtāḥ kṛṣṇā dvīpe 'smin vṛṣalā dvijāḥ
śālmalasya tu vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭya tu surodābdhiṃ kuśadvīpo vyavasthitaḥ
vidrumaścaiva hemaśca dyutimān puṣpavāṃstathā / kuśeśayo hariścātha mandaraḥ sapta parvatāḥ
dhutapāpā śivā caiva pavitrā saṃmatā tathā / vidyudambhā mahī ceti nadyastatra jalāvahāḥ
anyāśca śataśoviprā nadyo maṇijalāḥ śubhāḥ / tāsu brahmāṇamīśānaṃ devādyāḥ paryupāsate
brāhmaṇā draviṇo viprāḥ kṣatriyāḥ śuṣmiṇastathā / vaiśyāḥ snehāstu mandehāḥ śūdrāstatra prakīrtitāḥ
sarve vijñānasaṃpannā maitrādiguṇasaṃyutāḥ / yathoktakāriṇaḥ sarve sarve bhūtahite ratāḥ
yajanti vividhairyajñairbrahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / teṣāṃ ca brahmasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca salokatā
kuśadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / krauñcadvīpastato viprā veṣṭayitvā ghṛtodadhim
krauñco vāmanakaścaiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ / devāvṛcca vivindaśca puṇḍarīkastathaiva ca / nāmnā ca saptamaḥ proktaḥ parvato dundubhisvanaḥ
gaurī kumudvitī caiva saṃdhyā rātrirmanojavā / khyātiśca puṇḍarīkāca nadyaḥ prādhānyataḥ smṛtāḥ
puṣkarāḥ puṣkalā dhanyāstiṣyāstasya krameṇa vai / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaiva dvijottamāḥ
arcayanti mahādevaṃ yajñadānasamādhibhiḥ / vratopavāsairvividhairhemaiḥ svādhyāyatarpaṇaiḥ
teṣāṃ vai rudrasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ cātidurlabham / salokatā ca sāmīpyaṃ jāyate tatprasādataḥ
krauñcadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / śākadvīpaḥ sthito viprā āveṣṭya dadhisāgaram
udayo raivataścaiva śyāmāko 'stagiristathā / āmbikeyastathā ramyaḥ keśarī ceti parvatāḥ
sukumārī kumārī ca nalinī reṇukā tathā / ikṣukā dhenukā caiva gabhastiśceti nimnagāḥ
āsāṃ pibantaḥ salilaṃ jīvante tatra mānavāḥ / anāmayā hyaśokāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ
magāśca magadhāścaiva mānavā mandagāstathā / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścātra krameṇa tu
yajanti satataṃ devaṃ sarvalokaikasākṣiṇam / vratopavāsairvividhairdevadevaṃ divākaram
teṣāṃ sūryeṇa sāyujyaṃ sāmīpyaṃ ca sarūpatā / salokatā ca viprendrā jāyate tatprasādataḥ
śākadvīpaṃ samāvṛtya kṣīrodaḥ sāgaraḥ sthitaḥ / śvetadvīpaśca tanmadhye nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
tatra puṇyā janapadā nānāścaryasamanvitāḥ / śvetāstatra narā nityaṃ jāyante viṣṇutatparāḥ
nādhayo vyādhayastatra jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ na ca / krodhalobhavinirmuktā māyāmātsaryavarjitāḥ
nityapuṣṭā nirātaṅkā nityānandāśca bhoginaḥ / nārāyaṇaparāḥ sarve nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
kecid dhyānaparā nityaṃ yoginaḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ / kecijjapanti tapyanti kecid vijñānino 'pare
anye nirbojayogena brahmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ / dhyāyanti tat paraṃ vyoma vāsudevaṃ paraṃ padam
ekāntino nirālambā mahābhāgavatāḥ pare / paśyanti paramaṃ brahma viṣṇavākhyaṃ tamasaḥ paraṃ
sarve caturbhujākārāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ / supītavāsasaḥ sarve śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasaḥ
anye maheśvaraparāstripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ / svayogodbhūtakiraṇā mahāgaruḍavāhanāḥ
sarvaśaktisamāyuktā nityānandāśca nirmalāḥ / vasanti tatra puruṣā viṣṇorantaracāriṇaḥ
tatra nārāyaṇasyānyad durgamaṃ duratikramam / nārāyaṇaṃ nāma puraṃ vyāsādyairupaśobhitam
hemaprākārasaṃsuktaṃ sphāṭikairmaṇḍapairyutam / prabhāsahastrakalilaṃ durādharṣaṃ suśobhanam / harmyaprākārasaṃyuktamaṭṭālakasamākulam
hemagopurasāhastrairnānāratnopaśobhitaiḥ / śubhrāstaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ vicitraiḥ samalaṅkṛtam
nandanairvividhākāraiḥ stravantībhīśca śobhitam / sarobhiḥ sarvato yuktaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam
patākābhirvicitrābhiranekābhiśca śobhitam / vīthībhiḥ sarvato yuktaṃ sopānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ
nārīśatasahastrāḍhyaṃ divyagoyasamanvitam / haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam / caturdvāramanaupamyamagamyaṃ devavidviṣām
tatra tatrāpsaraḥ saṅdhairnṛtyadbhirupaśobhitam / nānāgītavidhānajñairdevānāmapi durlabhaiḥ
nānāvilāsasaṃpannaiḥ kāmukairatikomalaiḥ / prabhūtacandravadanairnūpurārāvasaṃyutaiḥ
īṣatsmitaiḥ subimboṣṭhairbālamugdhamṛgekṣaṇaiḥ / aśeṣavibhavopetairbhūṣitaistanumadhyamaiḥ
surājahaṃsacalanaiḥ suveṣairmadhurasvanaiḥ / saṃlāpālāpakuśalairdivyābharaṇabhūṣaitaiḥ
stanabhāravinamraiśca madaghūrṇitalocanaiḥ / nānāvarṇavicitrāṅgairnānābhogaratipriyaiḥ
praphullakusumodyānairitaścetaśca śobhitam / asaṃkhyeyaguṇaṃ śuddhamāgamyaṃ tridaśairapi
śrīmatpavitraṃ devasya śrīpateramitaujasaḥ / tasya madhye 'titejaskamuccaprākāratoraṇam
sthānaṃ pad vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ yogināmapi durlabham / tanmadhye bhagavānekaḥ puṇḍarīkadaladyutiḥ / śete 'śeṣajagatsūtiḥ śeṣāhiśayane hariḥ
vicintyamāno yogīndraiḥ sanandanapurogamaiḥ / svātmānandāmṛtaṃ pītvā paraṃ tat tamasaḥ param
supītavasano 'nanto mahāmāyo mahābhujaḥ / kṣīrodakanyayā nityaṃ gṛhītacaraṇadvayaḥ
sā ca devī jagadvandyā pādamūle haripriyā / samāste tanmanā nityaṃ pītvā nārāyaṇāmṛtam
na tatrādhārmikā yānti na ca devāntarāśrayāḥ / vaikuṇṭhaṃ nāma tat sthānaṃ tridaśairapi vanditam
na me 'tra bhavati prajñā kṛtsnaśastannirūpaṇe / etāvacchakyate vaktuṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ hi tat
sa eva paramaṃ brahma vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ / śete nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat
nārāyaṇādidaṃ jātaṃ tasminneva vyavasthitam / tamevābhyeti kalpānte sa eva paramā gatiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhstryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca śākadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena vyavasthitaḥ / kṣīrārṇavaṃ samāśritya dvīpaḥ puṣkarasaṃvṛtaḥ
eka evātra viprendrāḥ parvato mānasottaraḥ / yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi sārdhaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ / tāvadeva ca vistīrṇaḥ sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ
sa eva dvīpaḥ paścārdhe mānasottarasaṃjñitaḥ / eka eva mahāsānuḥ saṃniveśād dvidhā kṛtaḥ
tasmin dvīpe smṛtau dvau tu puṇyau janapadau śubhau / aparau mānasasyātha parvatasyānumaṇḍalau / mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ dhātakīkhaṇḍameva ca
svādūdakenodadhinā puṣkaraḥ parivāritaḥ / tasmin dvīpe mahāvṛkṣo nyagrodho 'marapūjitaḥ
tasmin nivasati brahmā viśvātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ / tatraiva muniśārdūlāḥ śivanārāyaṇālayaḥ
vasatyatra mahādevo haror'ddhahariravyayaḥ / saṃpūjyamāno brahmādyaiḥ kumārādyaiśca yogibhiḥ / gandharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣairīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ
svasthāstatra prajāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā sadṛśatviṣaḥ / nirāmayā viśokāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ
satyānṛte na tatrāstāṃ nottamādhamamadhyamāḥ / na varṇāśramadharmāśca na nadyo na ca parvatāḥ
pareṇa puṣkarasyātha sthito mahān / svādūdakasamudrastu samantād dvijasattamāḥ
pareṇa tasya mahatī dṛśyate lokasaṃsthitiḥ / kāñcanī dviguṇā bhūmiḥ sarvā caiva śilopamā
tasyāḥ pareṇa śailastu maryādātmātmamaṇḍalaḥ / prakāśaścāprakāśaśca lokālokaḥ sa ucyate
yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi daśa tasyocchrayaḥ smṛtaḥ / tāvāneva ca vistāro lokāloko mahāgiriḥ
samāvṛtya tu taṃ śailaṃ sarvato vai tamaḥ sthitam / tamaścāṇḍakaṭāhena samantāt pariveṣṭitam
etai sapta mahālokāḥ pātālāḥ saptakīrtitāḥ / brahmāṇḍasyaiṣa vistāraḥ saṃkṣepeṇa mayoditaḥ
aṇḍānāmīdṛśānāṃ tu koṭyo jñeyāḥ sahastraśaḥ / sarvagatvāt pradhānasya kāraṇasyāvyayātmanaḥ
aṇḍeṣveteṣu sarveṣu bhuvanāni caturdaśa / tatra tatra caturvaktrā rudrā nārāyaṇādayaḥ
daśottaramathaikaikamaṇḍāvaraṇasaptakam / samantāt saṃsthitaṃ viprā yatra yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
anantamekamavyaktanādinidhanaṃ mahat / atītya vartate sarvaṃ jagat prakṛtirakṣaram
anantatvamanantasya yataḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate / tadavyaktamiti jñeyaṃ tad brahma paramaṃ padam
ananta eṣa sarvatra sarvasthāneṣu paṭhyate / tasya pūrvaṃ mayāpyuktaṃ yattanmāhātmyamavyayam
gataḥ sa eṣa sarvatra sarvasthāneṣu vartate / bhūmau rasātale caiva ākāśe pavane 'nale / arṇaveṣu ca sarveṣu divi caiva na saśayaḥ
tathā tamasi sattve ca eṣa eva mahādyutiḥ / anekadhā vibhaktāṅgaḥ krīḍate puruṣottamaḥ
maheśvaraḥ paro 'vyaktādaṇḍamavyaktasaṃbhavam / aṇḍād brahmā samutpannastena sṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ atītānāgatānīha yāni manvantarāṇi tu / tāni tvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ vyāsāṃśca dvāpare yuge
vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / tathāvatārān dharmārthamīśānasya kalau yuge
kiyanto devadevasya śiṣyāḥ kaliyugeṣu vai / etat sarvaṃ samāsena sūta vaktumihārhasi
sūta uvāca manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ svārociṣo manuḥ / uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā
ṣaḍete manavo 'tītāḥ sāṃprataṃ tu raveḥ sutaḥ / vaivasvato 'yaṃ yasyaitat saptamaṃ vartate 'ntaram
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tu kathitaṃ kalpādāvantaraṃ mayā / ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhadhvaṃ manoḥ svārociṣasya tu
pārāvatāśca tuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe 'ntare / vipaścinnāma devendro babhūvāsurasūdanaḥ
ūrjastambhastathā prāṇo dānto 'tha vṛṣabhastathā / timiraścārvarīvāṃśca sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
caitrakiṃpuruṣādyāśca sutāḥ svārociṣasya tu / dvitīyamatadākhyātamantaraṃ śṛṇu cottaram
tṛtīye 'pyantare viprā uttamo nāma vai manuḥ / suśāntistatra devendro babhūvāmitrakarṣaṇaḥ
sudhāmānastathā satyāḥ śivāścātha pratardanāḥ / vaśavartinaśca pañcaite gaṇā dvādaśakāḥ smṛtāḥ
rajordhvaścordhvabāhuśca sabalaścānayastathā / sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
tāmasasyāntare devāḥ surā vāharayastathā / satyāśca sudhiyaścaiva saptaviṃśatikā gaṇāḥ
śibirindrastathaivāsīcchatayajñopalakṣaṇaḥ / babhūva śaṅkare bhakto mahādevārcane rataḥ
jyotirdharmā pṛthuḥ kāvyaścaitrognirvanakastathā / pīvarastvṛṣayo hyete sapta tatrāpi cāntare
pañcame cāpi viprendrā raivato nāma nāmataḥ / manurvasuśca tatrendro babhūvāsuramardanaḥ
amitābhā bhūtarayā vaikuṇṭhāḥ svacchamedhasaḥ / ete devagaṇāstatra caturdaśa caturdaśa
hiraṇyaromā vedaśrīrūrdhvabāhustathaiva ca / vedabāhuḥ sudhāmā ca parjanyaśca mahāmuniḥ / ete saptarṣayo viprāstatrāsan raivate 'ntare
svārociṣaścottamaśca tāmaso raivatastathā / priyavratānvayā hyete catvāro manavaḥ smṛtāḥ
ṣaṣṭhe manvantare cāsīccākṣuṣastu manurdvijāḥ / manojavastathaivendro devānapi nibodhataḥ
ādyāḥ prasūtā bhāvyāśca pṛthugāśca divaukasaḥ / mahānubhāvā lekhyāśca pañcaite hyaṣṭakā gaṇāḥ
sumedhā virajāścaiva haviṣmānuttamo madhuḥ / atināmā sahiṣṇuśca saptāsannṛṣayaḥ śubhāḥ
vivasvataḥ suto viprāḥ śrāddhadevo mahādyutiḥ / manuḥ sa vartate dhīmān sāṃprataṃ saptame 'ntare
ādityā vasavo rudrā devāstatra marudgaṇāḥ / purandarastathaivendro babhūva paravīrahā
vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaścātrirjamadagniśca gautamaḥ / viśvāmitro bharadvājaḥ sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
viṣṇuśaktiranaupamyā sattvodriktā sthitā sthitau / tadaṃśabhūtā rājānaḥ sarve ca tridivaukasaḥ
svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare pūrvamākūtyāṃ mānasaḥ sutaḥ / ruceḥ prajāpateryajñastadaṃśenābhavad dvijāḥ
tataḥ punarasau devaḥ prāpte svārociṣe 'ntare / tuṣitāyāṃ samutpannastuṣitaiḥ saha daivataiḥ
auttame 'pyantare viṣṇuḥ satyaiḥ saha surottamaiḥ / satyāyāmabhavat satyaḥ satyarūpo janārdanaḥ
tāmasasyāntare caiva saṃprāpte punareva hi / haryāyāṃ haribhirdevairharirevābhavaddhariḥ
raivate 'pyantare caiva saṃbhūtyāṃ mānaso 'bhavat / saṃbhūto mānasaiḥ sārdhaṃ devaiḥ saha mahādyutiḥ
cākṣuṣe 'pyantare caiva vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ / vikuṇṭhāyāmasau jajñe vaikuṇṭhairdaivataiḥ saha
manvantare 'tra saṃprāpte tathā vaivasvate 'ntare / vāmanaḥ kaśyapād viṣṇuradityāṃ saṃbabhūva ha
tribhiḥ kramairimāṃllokāñjitvā yena mahātmanā / purandarāya trailokyaṃ dattaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam
ityetāstanavastasya sapta manvantareṣu vai / sapta caivābhavan viprā yābhiḥ saṃrakṣitāḥ prajāḥ
yasmād viṣṭamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vāmanena mahātmanā / tasmāt sa vai smṛto viṣṇurviśerdhātoḥ praveśanāt
eṣa sarvaṃ sṛjatyādau pāti hanti ca keśavaḥ / bhūtāntarātmā bhagavān nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
ekāṃśena jagat sarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ / caturdhā saṃsthito vyāpī saguṇo nirguṇo 'pi ca
ekā bhagavato mūrtirjñānarūpā śivāmalā / vāsudevābhidhānā sā guṇātītā suniṣkalā
dvitīyā kālasaṃjñānyā tāmasī śeṣasaṃjñitā / nihanti sakalaṃ cānte vaiṣṇavī paramā tanuḥ
sattvodriktā tathaivānyā pradyumneti ca saṃjñitā / jagat sthāpayate sarvaṃ sa viṣṇuḥ prakṛtirdhruvā
caturtho vāsudevasya mūrtirbrāhmīti saṃjñitā / rājasī cāniruddhākhyā pradyumnaḥ sṛṣṭikārikā
yaḥ svapityakhilaṃ bhūtvā pradyumnena saha prabhuḥ / nārāyaṇākhyo brahmāsau prijāsargaṃ karoti saḥ
yā sā nārāyaṇatanuḥ pradyumnākhyā munīśvarāḥ / tayā saṃmohayed viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
saiva sarvajagatsūtiḥ prakṛtiḥ parikīrtitā / vāsudevo hyanantātmā kevalo nirguṇo hariḥ
pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ kālastattvatrayamanuttamam / vāsudevātmakaṃ nityametad vijñāya mucyate
ekaṃ cedaṃ catuṣpādaṃ caturdhā punaracyutaḥ / bibheda vāsudevo 'sau pradyumno hariravyayaḥ
kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāso viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ svayam / apāntaratamāḥ pūrvaṃ svecchayā hyabhavaddhariḥ
anādyantaṃ paraṃ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ / eko 'yaṃ veda bhagavān vyāso nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
ityetad viṣṇumāhātmyamuktaṃ vo munipuṅgavāḥ / etat satyaṃ punaḥ satyamevaṃ jñātvā na muhyati
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekonapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca asmin manvantare pūrvaṃ vartamāne mahān vibhuḥ / dvāpare prathame vyāso manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo mataḥ
bibheda bahudhā vedaṃ niyogād brahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ / dvitīye dvāpare caiva vedavyāsaḥ prajāpatiḥ
tṛtīye cośanā vyāsaścaturthe syād bṛhaspatiḥ / savitā pañcame vyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhe mṛtyuḥ prakīrtitaḥ
saptame ca tathaivendro vasiṣṭhaścāṣṭame mataḥ / sārasvataśca navame tridhāmā daśame smṛtaḥ
ekādaśe tu trivṛṣaḥ śatatejāstataḥ paraḥ / trayodaśe tathā dharmastarakṣustu caturdaśe
tryāruṇirvai pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe tu dhanañjayaḥ / kṛtañjayaḥ saptadaśe hyaṣṭādaśe ṛtañjayaḥ
tato vyāso bharadvājastasmādūrdhvaṃ tu gautamaḥ / rājaśravāścaikaviṃśastasmācchuṣmāyaṇaḥ paraḥ
tṛṇabindustrayoviṃśe vālmīkistatparaḥ smṛtaḥ / pañcaviśe tathā śaktiḥ ṣaḍviṃśe tu parāśaraḥ
saptaviṃśe tathā vyāso jātūkarṇo mahāmuniḥ / aṣṭāviṃśe punaḥ prāpte hyasmin vai dvāpare dvijāḥ / parāśarasuto vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano 'bhavat
sa eva sarvavedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ pradarśakaḥ / pārāśaryo mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyano hariḥ
ārādhya devamīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmbaṃ trilocanam / tatprasādādasau vyāsaṃ vedānāmakarot prabhuḥ
atha śiṣyān prijagrāha caturo vedapāragān / jaiminiṃ ca sumantuṃ ca vaiśampāyanameva ca / pailaṃ teṣāṃ caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ māṃ mahāmuniḥ
ṛgvedaśrāvakaṃ pailaṃ jagrāha sa mahāmuniḥ / yajurvedapravaktāraṃ vaiśampāyanameva ca
jaiminiṃ sāmavedasya śrāvakaṃ sonvapadyata / tathaivātharvavedasya sumantumṛṣisattamam / itihāsapurāṇāni pravaktuṃ māmayojayat
eka āsīdyajurvedastaṃ caturdhā vyakalpayat / cāturhetramabhūd yasmiṃstena yajñamathākarot
ādhvaryavaṃ yajurbhiḥ syādṛgbhirhetraṃ dvijottamāḥ / audgātraṃ sāmabhiścakre brahmatvaṃ cāpyatharvabhiḥ
tataḥ sa ṛca uddhṛtya ṛgvedaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / yajūṃṣi ca yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca sāmabhiḥ
ekaviṃśatibhedena ṛgvedaṃ kṛtavān purā / śākhānāṃ tu śatenaiva yajurvedamathākarot
sāmavedaṃ sahastreṇa śākhānāṃ prabibheda saḥ / atharvāṇamatho vedaṃ bibheda navakena tu
bhedairaṣṭādaśairvyāsaḥ purāṇaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / so 'yamekaścatuṣpādo vedaḥ pūrvaṃ purātanāt
oṅkāro brahmaṇo jātaḥ sarvadoṣaviśodhanaḥ / vedavedyo hi bhagavān vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ
sa gīyate paro vede yo vedainaṃ sa vedavit / etat parataraṃ brahma jyotirānandamuttamam
vedavākyoditaṃ tattvaṃ vāsudevaḥ paraṃ padam / vedavedyamimaṃ vetti vedaṃ vedaparo muniḥ
avedaṃ paramaṃ vetti vedaniṣṭhaḥ sadeśvaraḥ / sa vedavedyo bhagavān vedamūrtirmaheśvaraḥ / sa eva vedo vedyaśca tamevāśritya mucyate
ityedakṣaraṃ vedyamoṅkāraṃ vedamavyayam / avedaṃ ca vijānāti pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca vedavyāsāvatārāṇi dvāpare kathitāni tu / mahādevāvatārāṇi kalau śṛṇuta suvratāḥ
ādye kaliyuge śveto devadevo mahādyutiḥ / nāmnā hitāya viprāṇāmabhūd vaivasvate 'ntare
himavacchikhare ramye chagale parvatottame / tasya śiṣyāḥ śikhāyuktā vabhūvuramitaprabhāḥ
śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ / catvāraste mahātmāno brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
subhāno damanaścātha suhotraḥ kaṅkaṇastathā / lokākṣiratha yogīndro jaigīṣavyastu saptame
aṣṭame dadhivāhaḥ syānnavame vṛṣabhaḥ prabhuḥ / bhṛgustu daśame proktastasmādugraḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ
dvādaśe 'triḥ samākhyāto balī cātha trayodaśe / caturdaśe gautamastu vedaśīrṣā tataḥ param
gokarṇaścābhavat tasmād guhāvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍyatha / jaṭāmālyaṭṭahāsaśca dāruko lāṅgalī kramāt
śvetastathā paraḥ śūlī ḍiṇḍī muṇḍī ca vai kramāt / sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca nakulīśo 'ntime prabhuḥ
vaivasvate 'ntare śaṃbhoravatārāstriśūlinaḥ / aṣṭāviṃśatirākhyātā hyante kaliyuge prabhoḥ / tīrthe kāyāvatāre syād deveśo nakulīśvaraḥ
tatra devādidevasya catvāraḥ sutapodhanāḥ / śiṣyā babhūvuścānyeṣāṃ pratyekaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
prasannamanaso dāntā aiśvarīṃ bhaktimāśritāḥ / krameṇa tān pravakṣyāmi yogino yogavittamān
śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ / dundubhiḥ śatarūpaśca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstathā / vikeśaśca viśokaśca viśāpaśśāpanāśanaḥ
sumukho durmukhaścaiva durdamo duratikramaḥ / sanaḥ sanātanaścaiva mukāraśca sanandanaḥ
dālabhyaśca mahāyogī dharmātmano mahaujasaḥ / sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhapātraja eva ca
sārasvatastathā megho ghanavāhaḥ suvāhanaḥ / kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho muniḥ
parāśaraśca gargaśca bhārgavaścāṅgirāstathā / balabandhurnirāmitraḥ ketuśṛṅgastapodhanaḥ
lambodaraśca lambaśca lāmbākṣo lambakeśakaḥ / sarvajñaḥ samabuddhiśca sādhyaḥ satyastathaiva ca
śudhāmā kāśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho virajāstathā / atrirugrastathā caiva śravaṇo 'tha śraviṣṭhakaḥ
kuṇiśca kuṇibāhuśca kuśarīraḥ kunetrakaḥ / kaśyapohyuśanā caiva cyavano 'tha bṛhaspatiḥ
utathyo vāmadevaśca mahākāyo mahānilaḥ / vācaśravāḥ supīkaśca śyāvāśvaḥ sapathīśvaraḥ
hariṇyanābhaḥ kauśalyo lokākṣiḥ kuthumistathā / sumanturvarcarī vidvān kabandhaḥ kuśikandharaḥ
plakṣo dārbhāyaṇiścaiva ketumān gautamastathā / bhallāpī madhupiṅgaśca śvetaketustaponidhiḥ
uśijo bṛhadukthaśca devalaḥ kapireva ca / śālihotro 'gniveśyaśca yuvanāśvaḥ śaradvasuḥ
chagalaḥ kuṇḍakarṇaśca kumbhaścaiva pravāhakaḥ / ulūko vidyutaścaiva śādvalo hyāśvalāyanaḥ
akṣapādaḥ kumāraśca ulūko vatsa eva ca / kuśikaścaiva gargaśca mitrako ṛṣya eva ca
śiṣyā ete mahātmānaḥ sarvovarteṣu yoginām / vimalā brahmabhūyiṣṭhā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
kurvanti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya hi / yogeśvarāṇāmādeśād vedasaṃsthāpanāya vai
ye brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsmaranti namasyanti ca sarvadā / tarpayantyarcayantyetān brahmavidyāmavāpnuyuḥ
idaṃ vaivasvataṃ proktamantaraṃ vistareṇa tu / bhaviṣyati ca sāvarṇo dakṣasāvarṇa eva ca
daśamo brahmasāvarṇo dharmasāvarṇa eva ca / dvādaśo rudrasāvarṇo rocamānastrayodaśaḥ / bhautyaścaturdaśaḥ prokto bhaviṣyā manavaḥ kramāt
ayaṃ vaḥ kathito hyaṃśaḥ pūrvo nārāyaṇeritaḥ / bhūtabhavyairvartamānairākhyānairupabṛṃhitaḥ
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi śrāvayed vā dvijottamān / sa sarvapāpanirmukto brahmaṇā saha modate
paṭhed devālaye snātvā nadītīreṣu caiva hi / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya bhāvena puruṣottamam
namo devādidevāya devānāṃ paramātmane / puruṣāya purāṇāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ uparivibhāgaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ bhavatā kathitaḥ samyak sargaḥ svāyaṃbhuvastataḥ / brahmāṇḍasyāsya vistāro manvantaraviniścayaḥ
tatreśvareśvaro devo varṇibhirdharmatatparaiḥ / jñānayogaratairnityamārādhyaḥ kathitastvayā
tadvadāśeṣasaṃsāraduḥ khanāśamanuttamam / jñānaṃ brahmaikaviṣayaṃ yena paśyema tatparam
tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇātsākṣāt kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāt prabho / avāptākhilavijñānastattvāṃ pṛcchāmahe punaḥ
śrutvā munīnāṃ tad vākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sūtaḥ paurāṇikaḥ smṛtvā bhāṣituṃ hyupacakrame
athāsminnantare vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / ājagāma muniśreṣṭhā yatra satraṃ samāsate
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vedavidvāṃsaṃ kālameghasamadyutim / vyāsaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ praṇemurdvijapuṅgavāḥ
papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau dṛṣṭvāsau romaharṣaṇaḥ / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guruṃ prāñjaliḥ pārśvago 'bhavat
pṛṣṭāste 'nāmayaṃ viprāḥ śaunakādyā mahāmunim / samāśvāsyāsanaṃ tasmai tadyogyaṃ samakalpayan
athaitānabravīd vākyaṃ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ / kaccinna tapaso hāniḥ svādhyāyasya śrutasya ca
tataḥ sa sūtaḥ svaguruṃ praṇamyāha mahāmunim / jñānaṃ tad brahmaviṣayaṃ munīnāṃ vaktumarhasi
ime hi munayaḥ śāntāstāpasā dharmatatparāḥ / śuśrūṣā jāyate caiṣāṃ vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ
jñānaṃ vimuktidaṃ divyaṃ yanme sākṣāt tvayoditam / munīnāṃ vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kūrmarūpiṇā
śrutvā sūtasya vacanaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / praṇamya śirasā rudraṃ vacaḥ prāha sukhāvaham
vyāsa uvāca vakṣye devo mahādevaḥ pṛṣṭo yogīśvaraiḥ purā / sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ svayaṃ yatsamabhāṣata
sanatkumāraḥ sanakastathaiva ca sanandanaḥ / aṅgirā rudrasahito bhṛguḥ paramadharmavit
kaṇādaḥ kapilo yogī vāmadevo mahāmuniḥ / śukro vasiṣṭho bhagavān sarve saṃyatamānasāḥ
parasparaṃ vicāryaite saṃśayāviṣṭacetasaḥ / taptavantastapo ghoraṃ puṇye badarikāśrame
apaśyaṃste mahāyogamṛṣiṃ dharmasutaṃ śucim / nārāyaṇamanādyantaṃ nareṇa sahitaṃ tadā
saṃstūya vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ sarve vedasamudbhavaiḥ / praṇemurbhaktisaṃyuktā yogino yogavittamam
vijñāya vāñchitaṃ teṣāṃ bhagavānapi sarvavit / prāha gambhīrayā vācā kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ
abruvan hṛṣṭamanaso viśvātmānaṃ sanātanam / sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ devamāgataṃ siddhisūcakam
vayaṃ saṃśayamāpannāḥ sarve vai brahmavādinaḥ / bhavantamekaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ puruṣottamam
tvaṃ hi tad vettha paramaṃ sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ / nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāt purāṇo 'vyaktapūruṣaḥ
nahyanyo vidyate vettā tvāmṛte parameśvara / śuśrūṣāsmākamakhilaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi
kiṃ kāraṇamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ ko 'nusaṃsarate sadā / kaścidātmā ca kā muktiḥ saṃsāraḥ kiṃnimittakaḥ
kaḥ saṃsārayatīśānaḥ ko vā sarvaṃ prapaśyati / kiṃ tat parataraṃ brahma sarvaṃ no vaktumarhasi
evamukte tu munayaḥ prāpaśyan puruṣottamam / vihāya tāpasaṃ rūpaṃ saṃsthitaṃ svena tejasā
vibhrājamānaṃ vimalaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabham
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ śārṅgahastaṃ śriyāvṛtam / na dṛṣṭastatkṣaṇādeva narastasyaiva tejasā
tadantare mahādevaḥ śaśāṅkāṅkitaśekharaḥ / prasādābhimukho rudraḥ prādurāsīnmaheśvaraḥ
nirīkṣya te jagannāthaṃ trinetraṃ candrabhūṣaṇam / tuṣṭuvurhṛṣṭamanaso bhaktyā taṃ parameśvaram
jayeśvara mahādeva jaya bhūtapate śiva / jayāśeṣamunīśāna tapasābhiprapūjita
sahasramūrte viśvātman jagadyantrapravartaka / jayānanta jagajjanmatrāṇasaṃhārakāraṇa
sahasracaraṇeśāna śaṃbho yogīndravandita / jayāmbikāpate deva namaste parameśvara
saṃstuto bhagavānīśastryambako bhaktavatsalaḥ / samāliṅgya hṛṣīkeśaṃ prāha gambhīrayā girā
kimarthaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa munīndrā brahmavādinaḥ / imaṃ samāgatā deśaṃ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ mayācyuta
ākarṇya bhagavadvākyaṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ / prāha devo mahādevaṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ sthitam
ime hi munayo deva tāpasāḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ / abhyāgatā māṃ śaraṇaṃ samyagdarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
yadi prasanno bhagavān munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām / sannidhau mama tajjñānaṃ divyaṃ vaktumihārhasi
tvaṃ hi vettha svamātmānaṃ na hyanyo vidyate śiva / tatastvamātmanātmānaṃ munīndrebhyaḥ pradarśaya
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ provāca munipuṅgavān / pradarśayan yogasiddhiṃ nirīkṣya vṛṣabhadhvajam
saṃdarśanānmaheśasya śaṅkarasyātha śūlinaḥ / kṛtārthaṃ svayamātmānaṃ jñātumarhatha tattvataḥ
praṣṭumarhatha viśveśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam / mamaiva sannidhāveṣa yathāvad vaktumīśvaraḥ
niśamya viṣṇuvacanaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam / sanatkumārapramukhāḥ pṛcchanti sma maheśvaram
athāsminnantare divyamāsanaṃ vimalaṃ śivam / kimapyacintyaṃ gaganādīśvarārhaṃ samudbabhau
tatrāsasāda yogātmā viṣṇunā saha viśvakṛt / tejasā pūrayan viśvaṃ bhāti devo maheśvaraḥ
taṃ te devādideveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ brahmavādinaḥ / vibhrājamānaṃ vimale tasmin dadṛśurāsane
yaṃ prapaśyantiyogasthāḥ svātmanyātmānamīśvaramā / ananyatejasaṃ śāntaṃ śivaṃ dadṛśire kila
yataḥ prasūtirbhūtānāṃ yatraitat pravilīyate / tamāsanasthaṃ bhūtānāmīśaṃ dadṛśire kila
yadantarā sarvametad yato 'bhinnamidaṃ jagat / sa vāsudevamāsīnaṃ tamīśaṃ dadṛśuḥ kila
provāca pṛṣṭo bhagavān munīnāṃ parameśvaraḥ / nirīkṣya puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ svātmayogamanuttamam
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ yathānyāyamucyamānaṃ mayānaghāḥ / praśāntamānasāḥ sarve jñānamīśvarabhāṣitam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca avācyametad vijñānamātmaguhyaṃ sanātanam / yanna devā vijānanti yatanto 'pi dvijātayaḥ
idaṃ jñānaṃ samāśritya brahmabhūtā dvijottamāḥ / na saṃsāraṃ prapadyante pūrve 'pi brahmavādinaḥ
guhyād guhyatamaṃ sākṣād gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ / vakṣye bhaktimatāmadya yuṣmākaṃ brahmavādinām
ātmāyaḥ kevalaḥ svasthaḥ śāntaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ / asti sarvāntaraḥ sākṣāccinmātrastamasaḥ paraḥ
so 'ntaryāmī sa puruṣaḥ sa prāṇaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ / sa kālo 'gnistadavyaktaṃ sa evedamiti śrutiḥ
asmād vijāyate viśvamatraiva pravilīyate / sa māyī māyayā baddhaḥ karoti vividhāstanūḥ
na cāpyayaṃ saṃsarati na ca saṃsārayet prabhuḥ / nāyaṃ pṛthvī na salilaṃ na tejaḥ pavano nabhaḥ
na prāṇe na mano 'vyaktaṃ na śabdaḥ sparśa eva ca / na rūparasagandhāśca nāhaṃ kartā na vāgapi
na pāṇipādau no pāyurna copasthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / na kartā na ca bhoktā vā na ca prakṛtipūruṣau / na māyā naiva ca prāścaitanyaṃ paramārthataḥ
yathā prakāśatamasoḥ sambandho nopapadyate / tadvadaikyaṃ na saṃbandhaḥ prapañcaparamātmanoḥ
chāyātapau yathā loke parasparavilakṣaṇau / tadvat prapañcapuruṣau vibhinnau paramārthataḥ
yadyātmā malino 'svastho vikārī syāt svabhāvataḥ / nahi tasya bhavenmuktirjanmāntaraśatairapi
paśyanti munayo yuktāḥ svātmānaṃ paramārthataḥ / vikārahīnaṃ nirduḥ khamānandātmānamavyayam
ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥ khī kṛśaḥ sthūleti yā matiḥ / sā cāhaṅkārakartṛtvādātmanyāropyate janaiḥ
vadanti vedavidvāṃsaḥ sākṣiṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param / bhoktāramakṣaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvatra samavasthitam
tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ sarvadehinām / ajñānādanyathā jñānaṃ tacca prakṛtisaṃgatam
nityoditaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ sarvagaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ / ahaṅkārāvivekena kartāhamiti manyate
paśyanti ṛṣayo 'vyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam / pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃ buddhvā kāraṇaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
tenāyaṃ saṃgato hyātmā kūṭastho 'pi nirañjanaḥ / svātmānamakṣaraṃ brahma nāvabuddhyeta tattvataḥ
anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ tasmād duḥ khaṃ tathetaram / ragadveṣādayo doṣāḥ sarve bhrāntinibandhanāḥ
karmaṇyasya bhaved doṣaḥ puṇyāpuṇyamiti sthitiḥ / tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ sarvadehasamudbhavaḥ
nityaḥ sarvatrago hyātmā kūṭastho doṣavarjitaḥ / ekaḥ sa bhidyate śaktyā māyayā na svabhāvataḥ
tasmādadvaitamevāhurmunayaḥ paramārthataḥ / bhedo vyaktasvabhāvena sā ca māyātmasaṃśrayā
yathā hi dhūmasaṃparkānnākāśo malino bhavet / antaḥ karaṇajairbhāvairātmā tadvanna lipyate
yathā svaprabhayā bhāti kevalaḥ sphaṭiko 'malaḥ / upādhihīno vimalastathaivātmā prakāśate
jñānasvūpamevāhurjagadetad vicakṣaṇāḥ / arthasvarūpamevājñāḥ paśyantyanye kudṛṣṭayaḥ
kūṭastho nirguṇo vyāpī caitanyātmā svabhāvataḥ / dṛśyate hyartharūpeṇa puruṣairbhrāntidṛṣṭibhiḥ
yathā saṃlakṣyate raktaḥ kevalaḥ sphaṭiko janaiḥ / raktikādyupadhānena tadvat paramapūruṣaḥ
tasmādātmākṣaraḥ śuddho nityaḥ sarvagato 'vyayaḥ / upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaśca mumukṣubhiḥ
yadā manasi caitanyaṃ bhāti sarvatragaṃ sadā / yogino 'vyavadhānena tadā saṃpadyate svayam
yadā sarvāṇi būtāni svātmanyevābhipaśyati / sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
yadā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samādhistho na paśyati / ekībhūtaḥ pareṇāsau tadā bhavati kevalaḥ
yadā sarve pramucyante kāmā ye 'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ / tadāsāvamṛtībhūtaḥ kṣemaṃ gacchati paṇḍitaḥ
yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyati / tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
yadā paśyati cātmānaṃ kevalaṃ paramārthataḥ / māyāmātraṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ tadā bhavati nirvṛtaḥ
yadā janmajarāduḥ khavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam / kevalaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ jāyate 'sau tadā śivaḥ
yathā nadīnadā loke sāgareṇaikatāṃ yayuḥ / tadvadātmākṣareṇāsau niṣkalenaikatāṃ vrajet
tasmād vijñānamevāsti na prapañco na saṃsṛtiḥ / ajñānenāvṛtaṃ loko vijñānaṃ tena muhyati
tajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ yadavyayam / ajñānamitarat sarvaṃ vijñānamiti me matam
etad vaḥ paramaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ jñānamuttamam / sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi yogastatraikacittatā
yogāt saṃjāyate jñānaṃ jñānād yogaḥ pravartate / yogajñānābhiyuktasya nāvāpyaṃ vidyate kvacit
yadeva yogino yānti sāṃkhyaistadadhigamyate / ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa tattvavit
anye ca yogino viprā aiśvaryāsaktacetasaḥ / majjanti tatra tatraiva na tvātmaiṣāmiti śrutiḥ
yattat sarvagataṃ divyamaiśvaryamacalaṃ mahat / jñānayogābhiyuktastu dehānte tadavāpnuyāt
eṣa ātmāhamavyakto māyāvī parameśvaraḥ / kīrtitaḥ sarvavedeṣu sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ
sarvakāmaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandho 'jaro 'maraḥ / sarvataḥ pāṇipādo 'hamantaryāmī sanātanaḥ
apāṇipādo javano grahītā hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ / acakṣurapi paśyāmi tathākarṇaḥ śṛṇomyaham
vedāhaṃ sarvamevedaṃ na māṃ jānāti kaścana / prāhurmahāntaṃ puruṣaṃ māmekaṃ tattvadarśinaḥ
paśyanti ṛṣayo hetumātmanaḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ / nirguṇāmalarūpasya yattadaiśvaryamuttamam
yanna devā vijānanti mohitā mama māyayā / vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
nāhaṃ praśāstā sarvasya māyātītaḥ svabhāvataḥ / prerayāmi tathāpīdaṃ kāraṇaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
yanme guhyatamaṃ dehaṃ sarvagaṃ tattvadarśinaḥ / praviṣṭā mama sāyujyaṃ labhante yogino 'vyayam
teṣāṃ hi vaśamāpannā māyā me viśvarūpiṇī / labhante paramāṃ śuddhiṃ nirvāṇaṃ te mayā saha
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi / prasādānmama yogīndrā etad vedānuśāsanam
nāputraśiṣyayogibhyo dātavyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / maduktametad vijñānaṃ sāṃkhyayogasamāśrayam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca avyaktādabhavat kālaḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ paraḥ / tebhyaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tat sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham / sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam / sarvādhāraṃ sadānandamavyaktaṃ dvaitavarjitam
sarvopamānarahitaṃ pramāṇātītagocaram / nirvikalpaṃ nirābhāsaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ parāmṛtam
abhinnaṃ bhinnasaṃsthānaṃ śāśvataṃ dhru vamavyayam / nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ vyoma tajjñānaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ paraḥ / so 'haṃ sarvatragaḥ śānto jñānātmā parameśvaraḥ
mayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā / matsthāni sarvabhūtāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva tattvadvayamudāhṛtam / tayoranādiruddiṣṭaḥ kālaḥ saṃyojakaḥ paraḥ
trayametadanādyantamavyakte samavasthitam / tadātmakaṃ tadanyat syāt tadrūpaṃ māmakaṃ viduḥ
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ saṃprasūte 'khilaṃ jagat / yā sā prakṛtiruddiṣṭā mohinī sarvadehinām
puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkteyaḥ prākṛtān guṇān / ahaṅkāravimuktatvāt procyate pañcaviṃśakaḥ
ādyo vikāraḥ prakṛtermahānātmeti kathyate / vijñānaśaktirvijñātā hyahaṅkārastadutthitaḥ
eka eva mahānātmā so 'haṅkāro 'bhidhīyate / sa jīvaḥ so 'ntarātmeti gīyate tattvacintakaiḥ
tena vedayate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janmasu / sa vijñānātmakastasya manaḥ syādupakārakam
tenāvivekatastasmāt saṃsāraḥ puruṣasya tu / sa cāvivekaḥ prakṛtau saṅgāt kālena so 'bhavat
kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharati prajāḥ / sarve kālasya vaśagā na kālaḥ kasyacid vaśe
so 'ntarā sarvamevedaṃ niyacchati sanātanaḥ / procyate bhagavān prāṇaḥ sarvajñaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
sarvendriyebhyaḥ paramaṃ mana āhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / manasaścāpyahaṅkāramahaṅkārānmahān paraḥ
mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktāt puruṣaḥ paraḥ / puruṣād bhagavān prāṇastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat
prāṇāt parataraṃ vyoma vyomātīto 'gnirīśvaraḥ / so 'haṃ sarvatragaḥ śānto jñānātmā parameśvaraḥ / nāsti mattaḥ paraṃ bhūtaṃ māṃ vijñāya vimucyate
nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam / ṛte māmekamavyaktaṃ vyomarūpaṃ maheśvaram
so 'haṃ sṛjāmi sakalaṃ saṃharāmi sadā jagat / māyī māyāmayo devaḥ kālena saha saṅgataḥ
matsannidhāveṣa kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ jagat / niyojayatyanantātmā hyetad vedānuśāsanam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya yenedaṃ saṃpravartate
nāhaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā / śakyo hi puruṣairjñātumṛte bhaktimanuttamām
ahaṃ hi sarvabhāvānāmantastiṣṭhāmi sarvagaḥ / māṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ loko na jānāti munīśvarāḥ
yasyāntarā sarvamidaṃ yo hi sarvāntaraḥ paraḥ / so 'handhātā vidhātā ca kālo 'gnirviśvatomukhaḥ
na māṃ paśyanti munayaḥ sarve 'pi tridivaukasaḥ / brahmā ca manavaḥ śakro ye cānye prathitaujasaḥ
gṛṇanti satataṃ vedā māmekaṃ parameśvaram / yajanti vividhairagniṃ brāhmaṇā vaidikairmakhaiḥ
sarve lokā namasyanti brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / dhyāyanti yogino devaṃ bhūtādhipatimīśvaram
ahaṃ hi sarvahaviṣāṃ bhoktā caiva phalapradaḥ / sarvadevatanurbhūtvā sarvātmā sarvasaṃsthitaḥ
māṃ paśyantīha vidvāṃśo dhārmikā vedavādinaḥ / teṣāṃ sannihito nityaṃ ye bhaktyā māmupāsate
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā dhārmikā māmupāsate / teṣāṃ dadāmi tat sthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam
anye 'pi ye vikarmasthāḥ śūdrādyā nīcajātayaḥ / bhaktimantaḥ pramucyante kālena mayi saṃgatāḥ
na madbhaktā vinaśyanti madbhaktā vītakalmaṣāḥ / ādāvetat pratijñātaṃ na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
yo vai nindati taṃ mūḍho devadevaṃ sa nindati / yo hi taṃ pūjayed bhaktyā sa pūjayati māṃ sadā
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ madārādhanakāraṇāt / yo me dadāti niyataḥ sa me bhaktaḥ priyo mataḥ
ahaṃ hi jagatāmādau brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / vidhāya dattavān vedānaśeṣānātmaniḥ sṛtān
ahameva hi sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ gururavyayaḥ / dhārmikāṇāṃ ca goptāhaṃ nihantā vedavidviṣām
ahaṃ vai sarvasaṃsārānmocako yogināmiha / saṃsāraheturevāhaṃ sarvasaṃsāravarjitaḥ
ahameva hi saṃhartā straṣṭāhaṃ paripālakaḥ / māyāvī māmīkā śaktirmāyā lokavimohinī
mamaiva ca parā śaktiryā sā vidyeti gīyate / nāśayāmi tayā māyāṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ
ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ / ādhārabhūtaḥ sarvāsāṃ nidhānamamṛtasya ca
ekā sarvāntarā śaktiḥ karoti vividhaṃ jagat / āsthāya brahmāṇo rūpaṃ manmayī madadhiṣṭhitā
anyā ca śaktirvipulā saṃsthāpayati me jagat / bhūtvā nārāyaṇo 'nanto jagannātho jaganmayaḥ
tṛtīyā mahatī śaktirnihanti sakalaṃ jagat / tāmasī me samākhyātā kālākhyā rudrarūpiṇī
dhyānena māṃ prapaśyanti kecijjñānena cāpare / apare bhaktiyogena karmayogena cāpare
sarveṣāmeva bhaktānāmiṣṭaḥ priyataro mama / yo hi jñānena māṃ nityamārādhayati nānyathā
anye ca ye trayo bhaktā madārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / te 'pi māṃ prāpnuvantyeva nāvartante ca vai punaḥ
mayā tatamidaṃ kṛtsanaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam / mayyeva saṃsthitaṃ viśvaṃ mayā saṃpreryate jagat
nāhaṃ prerayitā viprāḥ paramaṃ yogamāśritaḥ / prerayāmi jagatkṛtsnametadyo veda so 'mṛtaḥ
paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ vartamānaṃ svabhāvataḥ / karoti kālo bhagavān mahāyogeśvaraḥ svayam
yogaḥ saṃprocyate yogī māyā śāstreṣu sūribhiḥ / yogeśvaro 'sau bhagavān mahādevo mahān prabhuḥ
mahattvaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ paratvāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / procyate bhagavān brahmā mahān brahmamayo 'malaḥ
yo māmevaṃ vijānāti mahāyogeśvareśvaram / so 'vikalpena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
so 'haṃ prerayitā devaḥ paramānandamāśritaḥ / nṛtyāmi yogī satataṃ yastad veda sa vedavit
iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ sarvavedeṣu niṣṭhitam / prasannacetase deyaṃ dhārmikāyāhitāgnaye
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca etāvaduktvā bhagavān yogināṃ parameśvaraḥ / nanarta paramaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ saṃpradarśayan
taṃ te dadṛśurīśānaṃ tejasāṃ paramaṃ nidhim / nṛtyamānaṃ mahādevaṃ viṣṇunā gagane 'male
yaṃ viduryogatattvajñā yogino yatamānasāḥ / tamīśaṃ sarvabhūtānāmākaśe dadṛśuḥ kila
yasya māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ yenedaṃ preryate jagat / nṛtyamānaḥ svayaṃ viprairviśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate
yat pādapaṅkajaṃ smṛtvā puruṣo 'jñānajaṃ bhayam / jahati nṛtyamānaṃ taṃ bhūteśaṃ dadṛśuḥ kila
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ śāntā bhaktisamanvitāḥ / jyotirmayaṃ prapaśyanti sa yogī dṛśyate kila
yo 'jñānānmocayet kṣipraṃ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ / tameva mocakaṃ rudramākāśe dadṛśuḥ param
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasracaraṇākṛtim / sahasrabāhuṃ jaṭilaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam
vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram / daṇḍapāṇiṃ trayīnetraṃ sūryasomāgnilocanam
brahmāṇḍaṃ tejasā svena sarvamāvṛtya ca sthitam / daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham
aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamabhyantaraṃ param / sṛjantamanalajvālaṃ dahantamakhilaṃ jagat / nṛtyantaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ viśvakarmāṇamīśvaram
mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ devānāmapi daivatam / paśūnāṃ patimīśānaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiravyayam
pinākinaṃ viśālākṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām / kālātmānaṃ kālakālaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram
umāpatiṃ virūpākṣaṃ yogānandamayaṃ param / jñānavairāgyanilayaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam
śāśvataiśvaryavibhavaṃ dharmādhāraṃ durāsadam / mahendropendranamitaṃ maharṣigaṇavanditam
ādhāraṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ mahāyogeśvareśvaram / yogināṃ paramaṃ brahma yogināṃ yogavanditam / yogināṃ hṛdi tiṣṭhantaṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam
kṣaṇena jagato yoniṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / īśvareṇaikatāpannamapaśyan brahmavādinaḥ
dṛṣṭvā tadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rudranārāyaṇātmakam / kṛtārthaṃ menire santaḥ svātmānaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
sanatkumāraḥ sanako bhṛguśca sanātanaścaiva sanandanaśca / rudro 'ṅgirā vāmadevātha śukro maharṣiratriḥ kapilo marīciḥ
dṛṣṭvātha rudraṃ jagadīśitāraṃ taṃ padmanābhāśritavāmabhāgam / dhyātvā hṛdisthaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā baddhvāñjaliṃ sveṣu śiraḥsu bhūyaḥ
oṅkāramuccārya vilokya devam antaḥśarīre nihitaṃ guhāyām / samastuvan brahmamayairvacobhir ānandapūrṇāyatamānasāste
munaya ūcuḥ tvāmekamīśaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ rudramanantayogam / namāma sarve hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ pracetasaṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram
tvāṃ paśyanti munayo brahmayoniṃ dāntāḥ śāntā vimalaṃ rukmavarṇam / dhyātvātmasthamacalaṃ sve śarīre kaviṃ parebhyaḥ paramaṃ tatparaṃ ca
tvattaḥ prasūtā jagataḥ prasūtiḥ sarvātmabhūstvaṃ paramāṇubhūtaḥ / aṇoraṇīyān mahato mahīyāṃ- stvāmeva sarvaṃ pravadanti santaḥ
hiraṇyagarbho jagadantarātmā tvatto 'dhijātaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ / saṃjāyamāno bhavatā visṛṣṭo yathāvidhānaṃ sakalaṃ sasarja
tvatto vedāḥ sakalāḥ saṃprasūtā- stvayyevānte saṃsthitiṃ te labhante / paśyāmastvāṃ jagato hetubhūtaṃ nṛtyantaṃ sve hṛdaye sanniviṣṭam
tvayaivedaṃ bhrāmyate brahmacakraṃ māyāvī tvaṃ jagatāmekanāthaḥ / namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannā yogātmānaṃ citpatiṃ divyanṛtyam
paśyāmastvāṃ paramākāśamadhye nṛtyantaṃ te mahimānaṃ smarāmaḥ / sarvātmānaṃ bahudhā sanniviṣṭaṃ brahmānandamanubhūyānubhūya
oṅkāraste vācako muktibījaṃ tvamakṣaraṃ prakṛtau gūḍharūpam / tattvāṃ satyaṃ pravadantīha santaḥ svayaṃprabhaṃ bhavato yatprakāśam
stuvanti tvāṃ satataṃ sarvavedā namanti tvāmṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ / śāntātmānaḥ satyasaṃdhā variṣṭhaṃ viśanti tvāṃ yatayo brahmaniṣṭhāḥ
eko vedo bahuśākho hyanantas tvāmevaikaṃ bodhayatyekarūpam / vedyaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ ye prapannā- steṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām
bhavānīśo 'nādimāṃstejorāśir brahmā viśvaṃ parameṣṭhī variṣṭhaḥ / svātmānandamanubhūyādhiśete svayaṃ jyotiracalo nityamuktaḥ
eko rudrastvaṃ karoṣīha viśvaṃ tvaṃ pālayasyakhilaṃ viśvarūpaḥ / tvāmevānte nilayaṃ vindatīdaṃ namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannāḥ
tvāmekamāhuḥ kavimekarudraṃ prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ harimagnimīśam / indraṃ mṛtyumanilaṃ cekitānaṃ dhātāramādityamanekarūpam
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam / tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣottamo 'si
tvameva viṣṇuścaturānanastvaṃ tvameva rudro bhagavānadhīśaḥ / tvaṃ viśvanābhiḥ prakṛtiḥ pratiṣṭhā sarveśvarastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si
tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇa- mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt / cinmātramavyaktamacintyarūpaṃ khaṃ brahma śūnyaṃ prakṛtiṃ nirguṇaṃ ca
yadantarā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti yadavyayaṃ nirmalamekarūpam / kimapyacintyaṃ tava rūpametat tadantarā yatpratibhāti tattvam
yogeśvaraṃ rudramanantaśaktiṃ parāyaṇaṃ brahmatanuṃ pavitram / namāma sarve śaraṇārthinastvāṃ prasīda bhūtādhipate maheśa
tvatpādapadmasmaraṇādaśeṣa- saṃsārabījaṃ vilayaṃ prayāti / mano niyamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ prasādayāmo vayamekamīśam
namo bhavāyāstu bhavodbhavāya kālāya sarvāya harāya tubhyam / namo 'stu rudrāya kapardine te namo 'gnaye deva namaḥ śivāya
tataḥ sa bhagavān devaḥ kapardī vṛṣavāhanaḥ / saṃhṛtya paramaṃ rūpaṃ prakṛtistho 'bhavad bhavaḥ
