te bhavaṃ bhūtabhavyeśaṃ pūrvavat samavasthitam / dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vismitā vākyamabruvan
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa govṛṣāṅkitaśāsana / dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ rūpaṃ nirvṛtāḥ sma sanātana
bhavatprasādādamale parasmin parameśvare / asmākaṃ jāyate bhaktistvayyevāvyabhicāriṇī
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmo māhātmyaṃ tava śaṅkara / bhūyo 'pi tava yannityaṃ yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
sa teṣāṃ vākyamākarṇya yogināṃ yogasiddhidaḥ / prāhaḥ gambhīrayā vācā samālokya ca mādhavam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve yathāvat parameṣṭhinaḥ / vakṣyāmīśasya māhātmyaṃ yattadvedavido viduḥ
sarvalokaikanirmātā sarvalokaikarakṣitā / sarvalokaikasaṃhartā sarvātmāhaṃ sanātanaḥ
sarveṣāmeva vastūnāmantaryāmī pitā hyaham / madhye cāntaḥ sthitaṃ sarvaṃ nāhaṃ sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ
bhavadbhiradbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yatsvarūpaṃ tu māmakam / mamaiṣā hyupamā viprā māyayā darśitā mayā
sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāmantarā samavasthitaḥ / prerayāmi jagat kṛtsnaṃ kriyāśāktiriyaṃ mama
yayedaṃ ceṣṭate viśvaṃ tatsvabhāvānuvarti ca / so 'haṃ kālo jagat kṛtsnaṃ prerayāmi kalātmakam
ekāṃśena jagat kṛtsnaṃ karomi munipuṅgavāḥ / saṃharāmyekarūpeṇa dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu
ādimadhyāntanirmukto māyātattvapravartakaḥ / kṣobhayāmi ca sargādau pradhānapuruṣāvubhau
tābhyāṃ saṃjāyate viśvaṃ saṃyuktābhyāṃ parasparam / mahadādikrameṇaiva mama tejo vijṛmbhate
yo hi sarvajagatsākṣī kālacakrapravartakaḥ / hiraṇyagarbho mārtaṇḍaḥ so 'pi maddehasaṃbhavaḥ
tasmai divyaṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam / dattavānātmajān vedān kalpādau caturo dvijāḥ
sa manniyogato devo brahmā madbhāvabhāvitaḥ / divyaṃ tanmāmakaiśvaryaṃ sarvadā vahati svayam
sa sarvalokanirmātā manniyogena sarvavit / bhūtvā caturmukhaḥ sargaṃ sṛjatyevātmasaṃbhavaḥ
yo 'pi nārāyaṇo 'nanto lokānāṃ prabhavāvyayaḥ / mamaiva paramā mūrtiḥ karoti paripālanam
yo 'ntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudraḥ kālātmakaḥ prabhuḥ / madājñayāsau satataṃ saṃhariṣyati me tanuḥ
havyaṃ vahati devānāṃ kavyaṃ kavyāśināmapi / pākaṃ ca kurute vahniḥ so 'pi macchakticoditaḥ
bhuktamāhārajātaṃ ca pacate tadaharniśam / vaiśvānaro 'gnirbhagavānīśvarasya niyogataḥ
yo 'pi sarvāmbhasāṃ yonirvaruṇo devapuṅgavaḥ / so 'pi saṃjīvayet kṛtsnamīśasyaiva niyogataḥ
yo 'ntastiṣṭhati bhūtānāṃ bahirdevaḥ prabhañjanaḥ / madājñayāsau bhūtānāṃ śarīrāṇi bibharti hi
yo 'pi saṃjīvano nṝṇāṃ devānāmamṛtākaraḥ / somaḥ sa manniyogena coditaḥ kila vartate
yaḥ svabhāsā jagat kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati sarvadā / sūryo vṛṣṭiṃ vitanute śāstreṇaiva svayaṃbhuvaḥ
yo 'pyaśeṣajagacchāstā śakraḥ sarvāmareśvaraḥ / yajvanāṃ phalado devo vartate 'sau madājñayā
yaḥ praśāstā hyasādhūnāṃ vartate niyamādiha / yamo vaivasvato devo devadevaniyogataḥ
yo 'pi sarvadhanādhyakṣo dhanānāṃ saṃpradāyakaḥ / so 'pīśvaraniyogena kubero vartate sadā
yaḥ sarvarakṣasāṃ nāthastāmasānāṃ phalapradaḥ / manniyogādasau devo vartate nirṛtiḥ sadā
vetālagaṇabhūtānāṃ svāmī bhogaphalapradaḥ / īśānaḥ kila bhaktānāṃ so 'pi tiṣṭhanmamājñayā
yo vāmadevo 'ṅgirasaḥ śiṣyo rudragaṇāgraṇīḥ / rakṣako yogināṃ nityaṃ vartate 'sau madājñayā
yaśca sarvajagatpūjyo vartate vighnakārakaḥ / vināyako dharmanetā so 'pi madvacanāt kila
yo 'pi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho devasenāpatiḥ prabhuḥ / skando 'sau vartate nityaṃ svayaṃbhūrvidhicoditaḥ
ye ca prajānāṃ patayo marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ / sṛjanti vividhaṃ lokaṃ parasyaiva niyogataḥ
yā ca śrīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyam / patnī nārāyaṇasyāsau vartate madanugrahāt
vācaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ yā ca devī sarasvatī / sāpīśvaraniyogena coditā saṃpravartate
yāśeṣapuruṣān ghorānnarakāt tārayiṣyati / sāvitrī saṃsmṛtā devī devājñānuvidhāyinī
pārvatī paramā devī brahmavidyāpradāyinī / yāpi dhyātā viśeṣeṇa sāpi madvacanānugā
yo 'nantamahimānantaḥ śeṣo 'śeṣāmaraprabhuḥ / dadhāti śirasā lokaṃ so 'pi devaniyogataḥ
yo 'gniḥ saṃvartako nityaṃ vaḍavārūpasaṃsthitaḥ / pibatyakhilamambhodhimīśvarasya niyogataḥ
ye caturdaśa loke 'smin manavaḥ prathitaujasaḥ / pālayanti prajāḥ sarvāste 'pi tasya niyogataḥ
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaśca tathāśvinau / anyāśca devatāḥ sarvā macchāstreṇaiva dhiṣṭhitāḥ
gandharvā garuḍā ṛkṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāścacāraṇāḥ / yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācāśca sthitāḥ śāstre svayaṃbhuvaḥ
kalākāṣṭhānimeṣāśca muhūrtā divasāḥ kṣapāḥ / ṛtavaḥ pakṣamāsāśca sthitāḥ śāstre prajāpateḥ
yugamanvantarāṇyeva mama tiṣṭhanti śāsane / parāścaiva parārdhāśca kālabhedāstathā pare
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / niyogādeva vartante devasya paramātmanaḥ
pātālāni ca sarvāṇi bhuvanāni ca śāsanāt / brahmāṇḍāni ca vartante sarvāṇyeva svayaṃbhuvaḥ
atītānyapyasaṃkhyāni brahmāṇḍāni mamājñayā / pravṛttāni padārthaughaiḥ sahitāni samantataḥ
brahmāṇḍāni bhaviṣyanti saha vastubhirātmagaiḥ / vahiṣyanti sadaivājñāṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ
bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca / bhūtādirādiprakṛtirniyoge mama vartate
yāśeṣajagatāṃ yonirmohinī sarvadehinām / māyā vivartate nityaṃ sāpīśvaraniyogataḥ
yo vai dehabhṛtāṃ devaḥ puruṣaḥ paṭhyate paraḥ / ātmāsau vartate nityamīśvarasya niyogataḥ
vidhūya mohakalilaṃ yayā paśyati tat padam / sāpi vidyā maheśasya niyogavaśavartinī
bahunātra kimuktena mama śaktyātmakaṃ jagat / mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ mayyeva pralayaṃ vrajet
ahaṃ hi bhagavānīśaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ / paramātmā paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate
ityetat paramaṃ jñānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ mayā / jñātvā vimucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve prabhāvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / yaṃ jñātvā puruṣo mukto na saṃsāre patet punaḥ
parāt parataraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ niṣkalaṃ dhruvam / nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ mama
ahaṃ brahmavidāṃ brahmā svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ / māyāvināmahaṃ devaḥ purāṇo hariravyayaḥ
yogināmasmyahaṃ śaṃbhuḥ strīṇāṃ devī girīndrajā / ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurvasūnāmasmi pāvakaḥ
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāhaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāmaham / airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭho 'haṃ devānāṃ ca śatakratuḥ / śilpināṃ viśvakarmāhaṃ prahlādo 'smyamaradviṣām
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāso gaṇānāṃ ca vināyakaḥ / vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadro 'haṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
parvatānāmahaṃ merurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ / vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyamasmyaham
ananto bhogināṃ devaḥ senānīnāṃ ca pāvakiḥ / āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ
mahākalpaśca kalpānāṃ yugānāṃ kṛtamasmyaham / kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ ca vīrakaḥ
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo 'haṃ nirṛtiḥ sarvarakṣasām / vāyurbalavatāmasmi dvīpānāṃ puṣkaro 'smyaham
mṛgendrāṇāṃ ca siṃho 'haṃ yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca / vedānāṃ sāmavedo 'haṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam
sāvitrī sarvajapyānāṃ guhyānāṃ praṇavo 'smyaham / sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu
sarvavedārthaviduṣāṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo 'smyaham / brahmāvartastu deśānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmavimuktakam
vidyānāmātmavidyāhaṃ jñānānāmaiśvaraṃ param / bhūtānāmasmyahaṃ vyoma sattvānāṃ mṛtyureva ca
pāśānāmasmyahaṃ māyā kālaḥ kalayatāmaham / gatīnāṃ muktirevāhaṃ pareṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ
yaccānyadapi loke 'smin sattvaṃ tejobalādhikam / tatsarvaṃ pratijānīdhvaṃ mama tejovijṛmbhitam
ātmānaḥ paśavaḥ proktāḥ sarve saṃsāravartinaḥ / teṣāṃ patirahaṃ devaḥ smṛtaḥ paśupatirbudhaiḥ
māyāpāśena badhnāmi paśūnetān svalīlayā / māmeva mocakaṃ prāhuḥ paśūnāṃ vedavādinaḥ
māyāpāśena baddhānāṃ mocako 'nyo na vidyate / māmṛte paramātmānaṃ bhūtādhipatimavyayam
caturviṃśatitattvāni māyā karma guṇā iti / ete pāśāḥ paśupateḥ kleśāśca paśubandhanāḥ
mano buddhirahaṅkāraḥ khānilāgnijalāni bhūḥ / etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāśca tathāpare
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu pañcamam / pāyūpasthaṃ karau pādau vāk caiva daśamī matā
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca / trayoviṃśatiretāni tattvāni prākṛtāni tu
caturviṃśakamavyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam / anādimadhyanidhanaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ param
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti guṇatrayamudāhṛtam / sāmyāvasthitimeteṣāmavyaktaṃ prakṛtiṃ viduḥ
sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo 'jñānaṃ rajo miśramudāhṛtam / guṇānāṃ buddhivaiṣamyād vaiṣamyaṃ kavayo viduḥ
dharmādharmāviti proktau pāśau dvau bandhasaṃjñitau / mayyarpitāni karmāṇi nibandhāya vimuktaye
avidyāmasmitāṃ rāgaṃ dveṣaṃ cābhiniveśakam / kleśākhyānacalān prāhuḥ pāśānātmanibandhanān
eteṣāmeva pāśānāṃ māyā kāraṇamucyate / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sā śaktirmayi tiṣṭhati
sa eva mūlaprakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣo 'pi ca / vikārā mahadādīni devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ
sa eva bandhaḥ sa ca bandhakartā sa eva pāśaḥ paśavaḥ sa eva / sa veda sarvaṃ na ca tasya vettā tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca anyad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ vakṣye brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ / yenāsau tarate janturghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram
ahaṃ brahmamayaḥ śāntaḥ śāśvato nirmalo 'vyayaḥ / ekākī bhagavānuktaḥ kevalaḥ parameśvaraḥ
mama yonirmahad brahma tatra garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham / mūlaṃ māyābhidhānaṃ tu tato jātamidaṃ jagat
pradhānaṃ puruṣo hyatmā mahān bhūtādireva ca / tanmātrāṇi mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi ca jajñire
tato 'ṇḍamabhavaddhaimaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham / tasmin jajñe mahābrahmā macchaktyā copabṛṃhitaḥ
ye cānye bahavo jīvā manmayāḥ sarva eva te / na māṃ paśyanti pitaraṃ māyayā mama mohitāḥ
yāśca yoniṣu sarvāsu saṃbhavanti hi mūrtayaḥ / tāsāṃ māyā parā yonirmāmeva pitaraṃ viduḥ
yo māmevaṃ vijānāti bījinaṃ pitaraṃ prabhum / sa dhīraḥ sarvalokeṣu na mohamadhigacchati
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / oṅkāramūrtirbhagavānahaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram / vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram / na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṅgatim
viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca maheśvaram / pradhānaviniyogajñaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati
sarvajñatā tṛptiranādibodhaḥ svatantratā nityamaluptaśaktiḥ / anantaśaktiśca vibhorviditvā ṣaḍāhuraṅgāni maheśvarasya
tanmātrāṇi mana ātmā ca tāni sūkṣmāṇyāhuḥ sapta tattvātmakāni / yā sā hetuḥ prakṛtiḥ sā pradhānaṃ bandhaḥ prokto viniyogo 'pi tena
yā sā śaktiḥ prakṛtau līnarūpā vedeṣūktā kāraṇaṃ brahmayoniḥ / tasyā ekaḥ parameṣṭhī parastā- nmaheśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ satyarūpaḥ
brahmā yogī paramātmā mahīyān vyomavyāpī vedavedyaḥ purāṇaḥ / eko rudro mṛtyuravyaktamekaṃ bījaṃ viśvaṃ deva ekaḥ sa eva
tamevaikaṃ prāhuranye 'pyanekaṃ tvekātmānaṃ kecidanyattathāhuḥ / aṇoraṇīyān mahato 'sau mahīyān mahādevaḥ procyate vedavidbhiḥ
evaṃ hi yo veda guhāśayaṃ paraṃ prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam / hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimān buddhimatītya tiṣṭhati
iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ niṣkalo nirmalo nityo niṣkriyaḥ parameśvaraḥ / tanno vada mahādeva viśvarūpaḥ kathaṃ bhavān
īśvara uvāca nāhaṃ viśvo na viśvaṃ ca māmṛte vidyate dvijāḥ / māyānimittamatrāsti sā cātmānamapāśritā
anādinidhanā śaktirmāyāvyaktasamāśrayā / tannimittaḥ prapañco 'yamavyaktādabhavat khalu
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ prāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram / ahameva paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate
tasmānme viśvarūpatvaṃ niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca proktametannidarśanam
ahaṃ tat paramaṃ brahma paramātmā sanātanaḥ / akāraṇaṃ dvijāḥ prokto na doṣo hyātmanastathā
anantā śaktayo 'vyakte māyādyāḥ saṃsthitā dhruvāḥ / tasmin divi sthitaṃ nityamavyaktaṃ bhāti kevalam
yābhistallakṣyate bhinnamabhinnaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ / ekayā mama sāyujyamanādinidhanaṃ dhruvam
puṃso 'bhūdanyayā bhūtiranyayā tattirohitam / anādimadhyaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ yujyate 'vidyayā kila
tadetat paramaṃ vyaktaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / tadakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat / tadeva ca jagat kṛtsnaṃ tad vijñāya vimucyate
yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha / ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān vibheti na kutaścana
vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahānta- mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt / tad vijñāya parimucyeta vidvān nityānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ
yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti kiñcit yajjyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ divistham / tadevātmānaṃ manyamāno 'tha vidvān ātmānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ
tadavyayaṃ kalilaṃ gūḍhadehaṃ brahmānandamamṛtaṃ viśvadhāma / vadantyevaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmaniṣṭhā yatra gatvā na nivarteta bhūyaḥ
hiraṇmaye paramākāśatattve yadarciṣi pravibhātīva tejaḥ / tadvijñāne paripaśyanti dhīrā vibhrājamānaṃ vimalaṃ vyoma dhāma
tataḥ paraṃ paripaśyanti dhīrā ātmanyātmānamanubhūyānubhūya / svayaṃprabhaḥ parameṣṭhī mahīyān brahmānandī bhagavānīśa eṣaḥ
eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā / tamevaikaṃ ye 'nupaśyanti dhīrās teṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām
sarvānanaśirogrīvaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ / sarvavyāpī ca bhagavān na tasmādanyadiṣyate
ityetadaiśvaraṃ jñānamuktaṃ vo munipuṅgavāḥ / gopanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa yogināmapi durlabham
iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) navamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca aliṅgamekamavyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeti niścitam / svayañjyotiḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ pare vyomni vyavasthitam
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattadakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam / nirguṇaṃ śuddhavijñānaṃ tad vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ
tanniṣṭhāḥ śāntasaṃkalpā nityaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitāḥ / paśyanti tat paraṃ brahma yattalliṅgamiti śrutiḥ
anyathā nahi māṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ vai munipuṅgavāḥ / nahi tad vidyate jñānaṃ yatastajjñāyate param
etattatparamaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ kavayo viduḥ / ajñānamitarat sarvaṃ yasmānmāyāmayaṃ jagat
yajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ yadavyayam / mamātmāsau tadevemiti prāhurvipaścitaḥ
ye 'pyanekaṃ prapaśyanti te 'pi paśyanti tatparam / āśritāḥ paramāṃ niṣṭhāṃ buddhvaikaṃ tattvamavyayam
ye punaḥ paramaṃ tattvamekaṃ vānekamīśvaram / bhaktyā māṃ saṃprapaśyanti vijñeyāste tadātmakāḥ
sākṣādeva prapaśyanti svātmānaṃ parameśvaram / nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ satyarūpamiti sthitiḥ
bhajante paramānandaṃ sarvagaṃ yattadātmakam / svātmanyavasthitāḥ śāntāḥ pare 'vyakte parasya tu
eṣā vimuktiḥ paramā mama sāyujyamuttamam / nirvāṇaṃ brahmaṇā caikyaṃ kaivalyaṃ kavayo viduḥ
tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vastvekaṃ paramaṃ śivam / sa īśvaro mahādevastaṃ vijñāya vimucyate
na tatra sūryaḥ pravibhātīha candro na nakṣatrāṇi tapano nota vidyut / tadbhāsedamakhilaṃ bhāti nityaṃ tannityabhāsamacalaṃ sadvibhāti
nityoditaṃ saṃvidā nirvikalpaṃ śuddhaṃ bṛhantaṃ paramaṃ yadvibhāti / atrāntaraṃ brahmavido 'tha nityaṃ paśyanti tattvamacalaṃ yat sa īśaḥ
nityānandamamṛtaṃ satyarūpaṃ śuddhaṃ vadanti puruṣaṃ sarvavedāḥ / tadevedamiti praṇaveneśitāraṃ dhāyāyanti vedārthaviniścitārthāḥ
na bhūmirāpo na mano na vahniḥ prāṇo 'nilo gaganaṃ nota buddhiḥ / na cetano 'nyat paramākāśamadhye vibhāti devaḥ śiva eva kevalaḥ
ityetaduktaṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ sarvavedeṣu gūḍham / jānāti yogī vijane 'tha deśe yuñjīta yogaṃ prayato hyajasram
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaṃ paramadurlabham / yenātmānaṃ prapaśyanti bhānumantamiveśvaram
yogāgnirdahati kṣipramaśeṣaṃ pāpapañjaram / prasannaṃ jāyate jñānaṃ sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam
yogātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ jñānād yogaḥ pravartate / yogajñānābhiyuktasya prasīdati maheśvaraḥ
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva vā / ye yuñjantīha madyogaṃ te vijñeyā maheśvarāḥ
yogastu dvividho jñeyo hyabhāvaḥ prathamo mataḥ / aparastu mahāyogaḥ sarvayogottamottamaḥ
śūnyaṃ sarvanirābhāsaṃ svarūpaṃ yatra cintyate / abhāvayogaḥ sa prokto yenātmānaṃ prapaśyati
yatra paśyati cātmānaṃ nityānandaṃ nirañjanam / mayaikyaṃ sa mahāyogo bhāṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
ye cānye yogināṃ yogāḥ śrūyante granthavistare / sarve te brahmayogasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
yatra sākṣāt prapaśyanti vimuktā viśvamīśvaram / sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ sa yogaḥ paramo mataḥ
sahasraśo 'tha śataśo ye ceśvarabahiṣkṛtāḥ / na te paśyanti māmekaṃ yogino yatamānasāḥ
prāṇāyāmastathā dhyānaṃ pratyāhāro 'tha dhāraṇā / samādhiśca muniśreṣṭhā yamo niyama āsanam
mayyekacittatāyogo vṛttyantaranirodhataḥ / tatsādhanānyaṣṭadhā tu yuṣmākaṃ kathitāni tu
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau / yamāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ proktāścittaśuddhipradā nṛṇām
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā / akleśajananaṃ proktaṃ tvahiṃsā paramarṣibhiḥ
ahiṃsāyāḥ paro dharmo nāstyahiṃsā paraṃ sukham / vidhinā yā bhaveddhiṃsā tvahiṃsaiva prakīrtitā
satyena sarvamāpnoti satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / yathārthakathanācāraḥ satyaṃ proktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ
paradravyāpaharaṇaṃ cauryād vātha balena vā / steyaṃ tasyānācaraṇādasteyaṃ dharmasādhanam
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā / sarvatra maithunatyāgaṃ brahmacaryaṃ pracakṣate
dravyāṇāmapyanādānamāpadyapi yathecchayā / aparigraha ityāhustaṃ prayatnena pālayet
tapaḥ svādhyāyasaṃtoṣāḥ śaucamīśvarapūjanam / samāsānniyamāḥ proktā yogasiddhipradāyinaḥ
upavāsaparākādikṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ / śarīraśoṣaṇaṃ prāhustāpasāstapa uttamam
vedāntaśatarudrīyapraṇavādijapaṃ budhāḥ / sattvaśuddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ svādhyāyaṃ paricakṣate
svādhyāyasya trayo bhedā vācikopāṃśumānasāḥ / uttarottaravaiśiṣṭyaṃ prāhurvedārthavedinaḥ
yaḥ śabdabodhajananaḥ pareṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sphuṭam / svādhyāyo vācikaḥ prokta upāṃśoratha lakṣaṇam
oṣṭhayoḥ spandamātreṇa parasyāśabdabodhakaḥ / upāṃśureṣa nirdiṣṭaḥ sāhasro vācikājjapaḥ
yatpadākṣarasaṅgatyā parispandanavarjitam / cintanaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ mānasaṃ taṃ japaṃ viduḥ
yadṛcchālābhato nityamalaṃ puṃso bhavediti / yā dhīstāmṛṣayaḥ prāhuḥ saṃtoṣaṃ sukhalakṣaṇam
bāhyamābhyantaraṃ śaucaṃ dvidhā proktaṃ dvijottamāḥ / mṛjjalābhyāṃ smṛtaṃ bāhyaṃ manaḥśuddhirathāntaram
stutismaraṇapūjābhirvāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ / suniścalā śive bhaktiretadīśvarapūjanam
yamāḥ saniyamāḥ proktāḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ nibodhata / prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyurāyāmastannirodhanam
uttamādhamamadhyatvāt tridhāyaṃ pratipāditaḥ / sa eva dvividhaḥ proktaḥ sagarbho 'garbha eva ca
mātrādvādaśako mandaścaturviṃśatimātrikaḥ / madhyamaḥ prāṇasaṃrodhaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmātrikottamaḥ
prasvedakampanotthānajanakatvaṃ yathākramam / mandamadhyamamukhyānāmānandāduttamottamaḥ
sagarbhamāhuḥ sajapamagarbhaṃ vijapaṃ budhāḥ / etad vai yogināmuktaṃ prāṇāyāmasya lakṣaṇam
savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha / trirjapedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate
recakaḥ pūrakaścaiva prāṇāyāmo 'tha kumbhakaḥ / procyate sarvaśāstreṣu yogibhiryatamānasaiḥ
recako 'jastraniśvāsāt pūrakastannirodhataḥ / sāmyena saṃsthitiryā sā kumbhakaḥ parigīyate
indriyāṇāṃ vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣu svabhāvataḥ / nigrahaḥ procyate sadbhiḥ pratyāhārastu sattamāḥ
hṛtpuṇḍarīke nābhyāṃ vā mūrdhni parvatamastake / evamādiṣu deśeṣu dhāraṇā cittabandhanam
deśāvasthitimālambya buddheryā vṛttisaṃtatiḥ / vṛttyantarairasaṃsṛṣṭā taddhyānaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
ekākāraḥ samādhiḥ syād deśālambanavarjitaḥ / pratyayo hyarthamātreṇa yogasādhanamuttamam
dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṃ dvādaśadhāraṇāḥ / dhyānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yāvat samādhirabhidhīyate
āsanaṃ svastikaṃ proktaṃ padmamardhāsanaṃ tathā / sādhanānāṃ ca sarveṣāmetatsādhanamuttamam
ūrvorupari viprendrāḥ kṛtvā pādatale ubhe / samāsītātmanaḥ padmametadāsanamuttamam
ekaṃ pādamathaikasmin vinyasyoruṇi sattamāḥ / āsītārdhāsanamidaṃ yogasādhanamuttamam
ubhe kṛtvā pādatale jānūrvorantareṇa hi / samāsītātmanaḥ proktamāsanaṃ svastikaṃ param
adeśakāle yogasya darśanaṃ hi na vidyate / agnyabhyāse jale vāpi śuṣkaparṇacaye tathā
jantuvyāpte śmaśāne ca jīrṇagoṣṭhe catuṣpathe / saśabde sabhaye vāpi caityavalmīkasaṃcaye
aśubhe durjanākrānte maśakādisamanvite / nācared dehabādhe vā daurmanasyādisaṃbhave
sugupte suśubhe deśe guhāyāṃ parvatasya tu / nadyāstīre puṇyadeśe devatāyatane tathā
gṛhe vā suśubhe ramye vijane jantuvarjite / yuñjīta yogī satatamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
namaskṛtya tu yogīndrān saśiṣyāṃśca vināyakam / guruṃ caivātha māṃ yogī yuñjīta susamāhitaḥ
āsanaṃ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmamardhamathāpi vā / nāsikāgre samāṃ dṛṣṭimīṣadunmīlitekṣaṇaḥ
kṛtvātha nirbhayaḥ śāntastyaktvā māyāmayaṃ jagat / svātmanyavasthitaṃ devaṃ cintayet parameśvaram
śikhāgre dvādaśāṅgulye kalpayitvātha paṅkajam / dharmakandasamudbhūtaṃ jñānanālaṃ suśobhanam
aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ śvetaṃ paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam / cintayet paramaṃ kośaṃ karṇikāyāṃ hiraṇmayam
sarvaśaktimayaṃ sākṣād yaṃ prāhurdivyamavyayam / oṅkāravācyamavyaktaṃ raśmijālasamākulam
cintayet tatra vimalaṃ paraṃ jyotiryadakṣaram / tasmin jyotiṣi vinyasyasvātmānaṃ tadabhedataḥ
dhyāyītākāśamadhyasthamīśaṃ paramakāraṇam / tadātmā sarvago bhūtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet
etad guhyatamaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānāntaramathocyate / cintayitvā tu pūrvoktaṃ hṛdaye padmamuttamam
ātmānamatha kartāraṃ tatrānalasamatviṣam / madhye vahniśikhākāraṃ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
cintayet paramātmānaṃ tanmadhye gaganaṃ param / oṅkarabodhitaṃ tattvaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam
avyaktaṃ prakṛtau līnaṃ paraṃ jyotiranuttamam / tadantaḥ paramaṃ tattvamātmādhāraṃ nirañjanam
dhyāyīta tanmayo nityamekarūpaṃ maheśvaram / viśodhya sarvatattvāni praṇavenāthavā punaḥ
saṃsthāpya mayi cātmānaṃ nirmale parame pade / plāvayitvātmano dehaṃ tenaiva jñānavāriṇā
madātmā manmayo bhasma gṛhītvā hyagnihotrajam / tenoddhṛtya tu sarvāṅgamagnirityādimantrataḥ / cintayet svātmanīśānaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ svarūpiṇam
eṣa pāśupato yogaḥ paśupāśavimuktaye / sarvavedāntasāro 'yamatyāśramamiti śrutiḥ
etat parataraṃ guhyaṃ matsāyujyopapādakam / dvijātīnāṃ tu kathitaṃ bhaktānāṃ brahmacāriṇām
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca kṣamā śaucaṃ tapo damaḥ / saṃtoṣaḥ satyamāstikyaṃ vratāṅgāni viśeṣataḥ
ekenāpyatha hīnena vratamasya tu lupyate / tasmādātmaguṇopeto madvrataṃ voḍhumarhati
vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ / bahavo 'nena yogena pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham / jñānayogena māṃ tasmād yajeta parameśvaram
athavā bhaktiyogena vairāgyeṇa pareṇa tu / cetasā bodhayuktena pūjayenmāṃ sadā śuciḥ
sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya bhikṣāśī niṣparigrahaḥ / prāpnoti mama sāyujyaṃ guhyametanmayoditam
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca / nirmamo nirahaṅkāro yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ / mayyarpitamano buddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ / harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa hi me priyaḥ
anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ / sarvārambhaparityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ
tulyanindāstutirmaunī saṃtuṣṭo yena kenacit / aniketaḥ sthiramatirmadbhakto māmupaiṣyati
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo matparāyaṇaḥ / matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ / nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet
tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ / karmaṇyabhipravṛtto 'pi naiva tena nibadhyate
nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ / śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti tatpadam
yadṛcchālābhatuṣṭasya dvandvātītasya caiva hi / kurvato matprasādārthaṃ karma saṃsāranāśanam
manmanā mannamaskāro madyājī matparāyaṇaḥ / māmupaiṣyati yogīśaṃ jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram
madbuddhayo māṃ satataṃ bodhayantaḥ parasparam / kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ mama sāyujyamāpnuyuḥ
evaṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ māyeyaṃ karmasānvagam / nāśayāmi tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
madbuddhayo māṃ satataṃ pūjayantīha ye janāḥ / teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
ye 'nye ca kāmabhogārthaṃ yajante hyanyadevatāḥ / teṣāṃ tadantaṃ vijñeyaṃ devatānugataṃ phalam
ye cānyadevatābhaktāḥ pūjayantīha devatāḥ / madbhāvanāsamāyuktā mucyante te 'pi bhāvataḥ
tasmādanīśvarānanyāṃstyaktvā devānaśeṣataḥ / māmeva saṃśrayedīśaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam
tyaktvā putrādiṣu snehaṃ niḥ śoko niṣparigrahaḥ / yajeccāmaraṇālliṅge viraktaḥ parameśvaram
ye 'rcayanti sadā liṅgaṃ tyaktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ / ekena janmanā teṣāṃ dadāmi paramaiśvaram
parānandātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ kevalaṃ sannirañjanam / jñānātmakaṃ sarvagataṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam
ye cānye niyatā bhaktā bhāvayitvā vidhānataḥ / yatra kvacana talliṅgamarcayanti maheśvaram
jale vā vahnimadhye vāvyomni sūrye 'thavānyataḥ / ratnādau bhāvayitveśamarcayelliṅgamaiśvaram
sarvaṃ liṅgamayaṃ hyetat sarvaṃ liṅge pratiṣṭhitam / tasmālliṅge 'rcayedīśaṃ yatra kvacana śāśvatam
agnau kriyāvatāmapsu vyomni sūrye manīṣiṇām / kāṣṭhādiṣveva mūrkhāṇāṃ hṛdi liṅgantuyoginām
yadyanutpannavijñāno viraktaḥ prītisaṃyutaḥ / yāvajjīvaṃ japed yuktaḥ praṇavaṃ brahmaṇo vapuḥ
athavā śatarudrīyaṃ japedāmaraṇād dvijaḥ / ekākī yatacittātmā sa yāti paramaṃ padam
vased vāmaraṇād vipro vārāṇasyāṃ samāhitaḥ / so 'pīśvaraprasādena yāti tat paramaṃ padam
tatrotkramaṇakāle hi sarveṣāmeva dehinām / dadāti tat paraṃ jñānaṃ yena mucyeta bandhanāt
varṇāśramavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kurvāṇo matparāyaṇaḥ / tenaiva janmanā jñānaṃ labdhvā yāti śivaṃ padam
ye 'pi tatra vasantīha nīcā vā pāpayonayaḥ / sarve taranti saṃsāramīśvarānugrahād dvijāḥ
kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahatacetasām / dharmaṃ samāśrayet tasmānmuktaye niyataṃ dvijāḥ
etad rahasyaṃ vedānāṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit / dhārmikāyaiva dātavyaṃ bhaktāya brahmacāriṇe
vyāsa uvāca ityetaduktvā bhagavānātmayogamanuttamam / vyājahāra samāsīnaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
mayaitad bhāṣitaṃ jñānaṃ hitārthaṃ brahmavādinām / dātavyaṃ śāntacittebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyo bhavatā śivam
uktvaivamatha yogīndrānabravīd bhagavānajaḥ / hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ dvijātīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ
bhavanto 'pi hi majjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam / upadekṣyanti bhaktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vacanānmama
ayaṃ nārāyaṇo yo 'hamīśvaro nātra saṃśayaḥ / nāntaraṃ ye prapaśyanti teṣāṃ deyamidaṃ param
mamaiṣā paramā mūrtirnārāyaṇasamāhvayā / sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthā śāntā cākṣarasaṃjñitā
ye tvanyathā prapaśyanti loke bhedadṛśo janāḥ / na te māṃ saṃprapaśyanti jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
ye tvimaṃ viṣṇumavyaktaṃ māṃ vā devaṃ maheśvaram / ekībhāvena paśyanti na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ
tasmādanādinidhanaṃ viṣṇumātmānamavyayam / māmeva saṃprapaśyadhvaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ tathaiva hi
ye 'nyathā māṃ prapaśyanti matvemaṃ devatāntaram / te yānti narakān ghorān nāhaṃ teṣuvyavasthitaḥ
mūrkhaṃ vā paṇḍitaṃ vāpi brāhmaṇaṃ vā madāśrayam / mocayāmi śvapākaṃ vā na nārāyaṇanindakam
tasmādeṣa mahāyogī madbhaktaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ / arcanīyo namaskāryo matprītijananāya hi
evamuktvā samāliṅgya vāsudevaṃ pinākadhṛk / antarhito 'bhavat teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām
nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavāṃstāpasaṃ veṣamuttamam / jagrāha yoginaḥ sarvāṃstyaktvā vai paramaṃ vapuḥ
jñātaṃ bhavadbhiramalaṃ prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / sākṣādeva maheśasya jñānaṃ saṃsāranāśanam
gacchadhvaṃ vijvarāḥ sarve vijñānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / pravartayadhvaṃ śiṣyebhyo dhārmikebhyo munīśvarāḥ
idaṃ bhaktāya śāntāya dhārmikāyāhitāgnaye / vijñānamaiśvaraṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ
evamuktvā sa viśvātmā yogināṃ yogavittamaḥ / nārāyaṇo mahāyogī jagāmādarśanaṃ svayam
te 'pi devādideveśaṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram / nārāyaṇaṃ ca bhūtādiṃ svāni sthānāni bhejire
sanatkumāro bhagavān saṃvartāya mahāmuniḥ / dattavānaiśvaraṃ jñānaṃ so 'pi satyavratāya tu
sanandano 'pi yogīndraḥ pulahāya maharṣaye / pradadau gautamāyātha pulaho 'pi prajāpatiḥ
aṅgirā vedaviduṣe bharadvājāya dattavān / jaigīṣavyāya kapilastathā pañcaśikhāya ca
parāśaro 'pi sanakāt pitā me sarvatattvadṛk / lebhetatparamaṃ jñānaṃ tasmād vālmīkirāptavān
mamovāca purā devaḥ satīdehabhavāṅgajaḥ / vāmadevo mahāyogī rudraḥ kila pinākadhṛk
nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavān devakītanayo hariḥ / arjunāya svayaṃ sākṣāt dattavānidamuttamam
yadahaṃ labdhavān rudrād vāmadevādanuttamam / viśeṣād giriśe bhaktistasmādārabhya me 'bhavat
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ prapanno 'haṃ viśeṣataḥ / bhūteśaṃ giraśaṃ sthāṇuṃ devadevaṃ triśūlinam
bhavanto 'pi hi taṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ govṛṣavāhanam / prapadyadhvaṃ sapatnīkāḥ saputrāḥ śaraṇaṃ śivam
vartadhvaṃ tatprasādena karmayogena śaṅkaram / pūjayadhvaṃ mahādevaṃ gopatiṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
evamukte 'tha munayaḥ śaunakādyā maheśvaram / praṇemuḥ śāśvataṃ sthāṇuṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam
abruvan hṛṣṭamanasaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sākṣādeva hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram
bhavatprasādādacalā śaraṇye govṛṣadhvaje / idānīṃ jāyate bhaktiryā devairapi durlabhā
kathayasva muniśreṣṭha karmayogamanuttamam / yenāsau bhagavānīśaḥ samārādhyo mumukṣubhiḥ
tvatsaṃnidhāveṣa sūtaḥ śṛṇotu bhagavadvacaḥ / tadvadākhilalokānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharmasaṃgraham
yaduktaṃ devadevena viṣṇunā kūrmarūpiṇā / pṛṣṭena munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ śakreṇāmṛtamanthane
śrutvā satyavatīsūnuḥ karmayogaṃ sanātanam / munīnāṃ bhāṣitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ provāca susamāhitaḥ
ya imaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ saṃvādaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ / sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
śrāvayed vā dvijān śuddhān brahmacaryaparāyaṇān / yo vā vicārayedarthaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ bhaktiyukto dṛḍhavrataḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paṭhitavyo manīṣibhiḥ / śrotavyaścātha mantavyo viśeṣād brāhmaṇaiḥ sadā
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve vakṣyamāṇaṃ sanātanam / karmayogaṃ brāhmaṇānāmātyantikaphalapradam
āmnāyasiddhamakhilaṃ brihmaṇānupradarśitam / ṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pūrvaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam / samāhitadhiyo yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama
kṛtopanayano vedānadhīyīta dvijottamāḥ / garbhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame vābde svasūtroktavidhānataḥ
daṇḍī ca mekhalī sūtrī kṛṣṇājinadharo muniḥ / bhikṣāhāro guruhito vīkṣamāṇo gururmukham
kārpāsamupavītārthaṃ nirmitaṃ brahmaṇā purā / brāhmaṇānāṃ trivit sūtraṃ kauśaṃ vā vastrameva vā
sadopavītī caiva syāt sadā baddhaśikho dvijaḥ / anyathā yat kṛtaṃ karma tad bhavatyayathākṛtam
vasedavikṛtaṃ vāsaḥ kārpāsaṃ vā kaṣāyakam / tadeva paridhānīyaṃ śuklamacchidramuttamam
uttaraṃ tu samākhyātaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śubham / abhāve gavyamajinaṃ rauravaṃ vā vidhīyate
uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ savye bāhau samarpitam / upavītaṃ bhavennityaṃ nivītaṃ kaṇṭhasajjane
savyaṃ bāhuṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇe tu dhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ / prācīnāvītamityuktaṃ pitrye karmaṇi yojayet
agnyagāre gavāṃ goṣṭhe home japye tathaiva ca / svādhyāye bhojane nityaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau
upāsane gurūṇāṃ ca saṃdhyayoḥ sādhusaṃgame / upavītī bhavennityaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
mauñjī trivṛt samā ślakṣaṇā kāryā viprasya mekhalā / muñjābhāve kuśenāhurgranthinaikena vā tribhiḥ
dhārayed bailvapālāśau daṇḍau keśāntakau dvijaḥ / yajñārhavṛkṣajaṃ vātha saumyamavraṇameva ca
sāyaṃ prātardvijaḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta samāhitaḥ / kāmāllobhād bhayānmohāt tyaktena patito bhavet
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sāyaṃ prātaḥ prasannadhīḥ / snātvā saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā
devatābhyarcanaṃ kuryāt puṣpaiḥ patreṇa vāmbubhiḥ / abhivādanaśīlaḥ syānnityaṃ vṛddheṣu dharmataḥ
asāvahaṃ bho nāmeti samyak praṇatipūrvakam / āyurārogyasiddhyarthaṃ tandrādiparivarjitaḥ
āyuṣṇān bhava saumyeti vācyo vipro 'bhivādane / akāraścāsya nāmno 'nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ
na kuryād yo 'bhivādasya dvijaḥ pratyabhivādanam / nābhivādyaḥ sa viduṣā yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ
vyatyastapāṇinā kāryamupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ guroḥ / savyena savyaḥ spraṣṭavyo dakṣiṇena tu dakṣiṇaḥ
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ cāpi tathādhyātmikameva vā / ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ pūrvamabhivādayet
nodakaṃ dhārayed bhaikṣaṃ puṣpāṇi samidhastathā / evaṃvidhāni cānyāni na daivādyeṣu karmasu
brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchet kṣatrabandhumanāmayam / vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamya śūdramārogyameva tu
upādhyāyaḥ pitā jyeṣṭho bhrātā caiva mahīpatiḥ / mātulaḥ śvaśurastrātā mātāmahapitāmahau / varṇajyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyaśca puṃso 'tra guravaḥ smṛtāḥ
mātā mātāmahī gurvo piturmātuśca sodarāḥ / śvaśrūḥ pitāmahījyeṣṭhā dhātrī ca guravaḥ striyaḥ
ityukto guruvargo 'yaṃ mātṛtaḥ pitṛto dvijāḥ / anuvartanameteṣāṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ
guruṃ dṛṣṭvā samuttiṣṭhedabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ / naitairupaviśet sārdhaṃ vivadennātmakāraṇāt
jīvitārthamapi dveṣād gurubhirnaiva bhāṣaṇam / udito 'pi guṇairanyairgurudveṣī patatyadhaḥ
gurūṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ pūjyāḥ pañca viśeṣataḥ / teṣāmādyāstrayaḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ mātā supūjitā
yo bhāvayati yā sūte yena vidyopadiśyate / jyeṣṭho bhrātā ca bhartā ca pañcaite guravaḥ smṛtāḥ
ātmanaḥ sarvayatnena prāṇatyāgena vā punaḥ / pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa pañcaite bhūtimicchatā
yāvat pitā ca mātā ca dvāvetau nirvikāriṇau / tāvat sarvaṃ parityajya putraḥ syāt tatparāyaṇaḥ
pitā mātā ca suprītau syātāṃ putraguṇairyadi / sa putraḥ sakalaṃ dharmamāpnuyāt tena karmaṇā
nāsti mātṛsamaṃ daivaṃ nāsti pitṛsamo guruḥ / tayoḥ pratyupakāro 'pi na kathañcana vidyate
tayornityaṃ priyaṃ kuryāt karmaṇā manasā girā / na tābhyāmananujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācaret
varjayitvā muktiphalaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā / dharmasāraḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ pretyānantaphalapradaḥ
samyagārādhya vaktāraṃ visṛṣṭastadanujñayā / śiṣyo vidyāphalaṃ bhuṅkte pretya cāpadyate divi
yo bhrātaraṃ pitṛsamaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ mūrkho 'vamanyate / tena doṣeṇa sa pretya nirayaṃ ghoramṛcchati
puṃsā vartmaniviṣṭena pūjyo bhartā tu sarvadā / yāti dātari loke 'smin upakārāddhi gauravam
yenarā bhartṛpiṇḍārthaṃ svān prāṇān saṃtyajanti hi / teṣāmathākṣayāṃllokān provāca bhagavān manuḥ
mātulāṃśca pitṛvyāṃśca śvaśurānṛtvijo gurūn / asāvahamiti brūyuḥ pratyutthāya yavīyasaḥ
avācyo dīkṣito nāmnā yavīyānapi yo bhavet / bhobhavatpūrvakaṃ tvenamabhibhāṣeta dharmavit
abhivādyāśca pūjyaśca śirasā vandya eva ca / brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyādyaiśca śrīkāmaiḥ sādaraṃ sadā
nābhivādyāstu vipreṇa kṣatriyādyāḥ kathañcana / jñānakarmaguṇopetā yadyapyete bahuśrutāḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ svasti kuryāditi sthitiḥ / savarṇeṣu savarṇānāṃ kāryamevābhivādanam
gururagnirdvijātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ / patireko guruḥ strīṇāṃ sarvatrābhyāgato guruḥ
vidyā karma vayo bandhurvittaṃ bhavati pañcamam / mānyasthānāni pañcāhuḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurūttarāt
pañcānāṃ triṣu varṇeṣu bhūyāṃsi balavanti ca / yatra syuḥ so 'tra mānārhaḥ śūdro 'pi daśamīṃ gataḥ
panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya striyai rājñe hyacakṣuṣe / vṛddhāya bhārabugnāya rogiṇe durbalāya ca
bhikṣāmāhṛtya śiṣṭānāṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato 'nvaham / nivedya gurave 'śnīyād vāgyatastadanujñayā
bhavatpūrvaṃ cared bhaikṣyamupanīto dvijottamaḥ / bhavanmadhyaṃ tu rājanyo vaiśyastu bhavaduttaram
mātaraṃ vā svasāraṃ vā māturvā bhaginīṃ nijām / bhikṣeta bhikṣāṃ prathamaṃ yā cainaṃ na vimānayet
sajātīyagṛheṣveva sārvavarṇikameva vā / bhaikṣyasya caraṇaṃ proktaṃ patitādiṣu varjitam
vedayajñairahīnānāṃ praśastānāṃ svakarmasu / brahmacaryāhared bhaikṣaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato 'nvaham
guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta na jñātikulabandhuṣu / alābhe tvanyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet
sarvaṃ vā vicared grāmaṃ pūrvoktānāmasaṃbhave / niyamya prayato vācaṃ diśastvanavalokayan
samāhṛtya tu tad bhaikṣaṃ yāvadarthamamāyayā / bhuñjīta prayato nityaṃ vāgyato 'nanyamānasaḥ
bhaikṣyeṇa vartayennityaṃ naikānnādī bhaved vratī / bhaikṣyeṇa vratino vṛttirupavāsasamā smṛtā
pūjayedaśanaṃ nityamadyāccaitadakutsayan / dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet prasīdecca pratinandecca sarvaśaḥ
anārogyamanāyuṣyamasvargyaṃ cātibhojanam / apuṇyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ tasmāt tatparivarjayet
prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta sūryābhimukha eva vā / nādyādudaṅmukho nityaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca bhuñjāno dvirupaspṛśet / śucau deśe samāsīno bhuktvā ca dvirupaspṛśet
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca bhuktvā pītvā ca suptvā ca snātvā rathyopasarpaṇe / oṣṭhāvalamokau spṛṣṭvā vāso viparidhāya ca
retomūtrapurīṣāṇāmutsarge 'yuktabhāṣaṇe / ṣṭhīvitvādhyayanārambhe kāsaśvāsāgame tathā
catvaraṃ vā śmaśānaṃ vā samākramya dvijottamaḥ / saṃdhyayorubhayostadvadācānto 'pyācamet punaḥ
caṇḍālamlecchasaṃbhāṣe strīśūdrocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇe / ucchiṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhojyaṃ cāpi tathāvidham / ācāmedaśrupāte vā lohitasya tathaiva ca
bhojane saṃdhyayoḥ snātvā pītvā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ / ācānto 'pyācamet suptvā sakṛtsakṛdathānyataḥ
agnergavāmathālambhe spṛṣṭvā prayatameva vā / strīṇāmathātmanaḥ sparśe nīvīṃ vā paridhāya ca
upaspṛśejjalaṃ vārdraṃ tṛṇaṃ vā bhūmimeva vā / keśānāṃ cātmanaḥ sparśe vāsaso 'kṣālitasya ca
anuṣṇābhiraphenābiraduṣṭābhiśca dharmataḥ / śaucepsuḥ sarvadācāmedāsīnaḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ
śiraḥ prāvṛtya kaṇṭhaṃ vā muktakacchasikho 'pi vā / akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucamācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet
sopānatko jalastho vā noṣṇīṣī vācamed budhaḥ / na caiva varṣadhārābhirna tiṣṭhan noddhṛtodakaiḥ
naikahastārpitajalairvinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ / na pādukāsanastho vā bahirjānurathāpi vā
na jalpan na hasan prekṣan śayānaḥ prahva eva ca / nāvīkṣitābhiḥ phenādyairupetābhirathāpi vā
śūdrāśucikaronmuktairna kṣārābhistathaiva ca / na caivāṅgulibhiḥ śabdaṃ na kurvan nānyamānasaḥ
na varṇarasaduṣṭābhirna caiva pradarodakaiḥ / na pāṇikṣubhitābhirvā na bahiṣkakṣa eva vā
hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ / prāśitābhistathāvaiśyaḥ strīśūdrau sparśato 'ntataḥ
aṅguṣṭhamūlāntarato rekhāyāṃ brāhmamucyate / antarāṅguṣṭhadeśinyo pitṝṇāṃ tīrthamuttamam
kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ paścāt prājāpatyaṃ pracakṣate / aṅgulyagre smṛtaṃ daivaṃ tadevārṣaṃ prakīrtitam
mūle vā daivamārṣaṃ syādāgneyaṃ madhyataḥ smṛtaṃ / tadeva saumikaṃ tīrthametajjñātvā na muhyati
brāhmeṇaiva tu tīrthena dvijo nityamupaspṛśet / kāyena vātha daivena tu pitryeṇa vai dvijāḥ
triḥ prāśnīyādapaḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prayatastataḥ / saṃmṛjyāṅguṣṭhamūlena mukhaṃ vai samupaspṛśet
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu spṛśennetradvayaṃ tataḥ / tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśennāsāpṛṭadvayam
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena śravaṇe samupaspṛśet / sarvāsāmatha yogena hṛdayaṃ tu talena vā / saṃspṛśed vā śirastadvadaṅguṣṭhenāthavā dvayam
triḥ prāśnīyād yadambhastu suprītāstena devatāḥ / brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca bhavantītyanuśuśrumaḥ
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva prīyete parimārjanāt / saṃspṛṣṭayorlocanayoḥ prīyete śaśibhāskarau
nāsatyadastrau prīyete spṛṣṭe nāsāpuṭadvaye / karṇayoḥ spṛṣṭayostadvat prīyete cānilānalau
saṃspṛṣṭe hṛdaye cāsya prīyante sarvadevatāḥ / mūrdhni saṃsparśanādekaḥ prītaḥ sa puruṣo bhavet
nocchiṣṭaṃ kurvate mukhyā vipruṣo 'ṅgaṃ nayanti yāḥ / dantavad dantalagneṣu jihvāsparśe 'śucirbhavet
spṛśānti bindavaḥ pādau ya ācāmayataḥ parān / bhūmigaiste samā jñeyā na tairaprayato bhavet
maduparke ca some ca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇe / phalamūle cekṣudaṇḍe na doṣaṃ prāha ve manuḥ
pracaraṃścānnapāneṣu dravyahasto bhavennaraḥ / bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyamācamyābhyukṣayet tu tat
taijasaṃ vai samādāya yadyucchiṣṭo bhaved dvijaḥ / bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyamācamyābhyukṣayet tu tat
yadyamatraṃ samādāya bhaveduccheṣaṇānvitaḥ / anidhāyaiva tad dravyamācāntaḥ śucitāmiyāt / vastrādiṣu vikalpaḥ syāt tatsaṃspṛṣṭvācamediha
araṇye 'nudake rātrau cauravyāghrākule pathi / kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā dravyahasto na duṣyati
nidhāya dakṣiṇe karṇe brahmasūtramudaṅmukhaḥ / ahni kuryācchakṛnmūtraṃ rātrau ced dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
antardhāya mahīṃ kāṣṭhaiḥ patrairloṣṭhatṛṇena vā / prāvṛtya ca śiraḥ kuryād viṇmūtrasya visarjanam
chāyākūpanadīgoṣṭhacaityāmbhaḥ pathi bhasmasu / agnau caiva śmaśāne ca viṇmūtre na samācaret
na gomaye na kṛṣṭe vā mahāvṛkṣe na śāḍvale / na tiṣṭhan vā na nirvāsā na ca parvatamastake
na jīrṇadevāyatane na valmīke kadācana / na sasattveṣu garteṣu na gacchan vā samācaret
tuṣāṅgārakapāleṣu rājamārge tathaiva ca / na kṣetre na vile vāpi na tīrthe na catuṣpathe
nodyānodasamīpe vā noṣare na parāśucau / na sopānatpāduko vā chatrī vā nāntarikṣake
na caivābhimukhe strīṇāṃ gurubrāhmaṇayorgavām / na devadevālayayorapāmapi kadācana
na jyotīṃṣi nirīkṣanvānasaṃdhyābhimukho 'pivā / pratyādityaṃ pratyanalaṃ pratisomaṃ tathaiva ca
āhṛtya mṛttikāṃ kūlāllepagandhāpakarṣaṇam / kuryādatandritaḥ śaucaṃ viśuddhairuddhṛtodakaiḥ
nāharenmṛttikāṃ vipraḥ pāṃśulānna ca kardamāt / na mārgānnoṣarād deśācchaucaśiṣṭāṃ parasya ca
na devāyatanāt kūpād grāmānna ca jalāt tathā / upaspṛśet tato nityaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ daṇḍādibhiryuktaḥ śaucācārasamanvitaḥ / āhūto 'dhyayanaṃ kuryād vīkṣamāṇo gurormukham
nityamudyatapāṇiḥ syāt sādhvācāraḥ susaṃyataḥ / āsyatāmiti coktaḥ sannāsītābhimukhaṃ guroḥ
pratiśravaṇasaṃbhāṣe śayāno na samācaret / nāsīno na ca bhuñjāno na tiṣṭhanna parāṅmukhaḥ
nīcaṃ śayyāsanaṃ cāsya sarvadā gurusannidhau / gurostu cakṣurviṣaye na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet
nodāharedasya nāma parokṣamapi kevalam / na caivāsyānukurvota gatibhāṣaṇaceṣṭitam
guroryatra parīvādo nindā cāpi pravartate / karṇaiṃ tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato 'nyataḥ
dūrastho nārcayedenaṃ na kruddho nāntike striyāḥ / na caivāsyottaraṃ brūyāt sthito nāsīta sannidhau
udakumbhaṃ kuśān puṣpaṃ samidho 'syāharet sadā / mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ nityamaṅgānāṃ vai samācaret
nāsya nirmālyaśayanaṃ pādukopānahāvapi / ākramedāsanaṃ cāsya chāyādīn vā kadācana
sādhayed dantakāṣṭhādīn labdhaṃ cāsmai nivedayet / anāpṛcchya na gantavyaṃ bhavet priyahite rataḥ
na pādau sārayedasya saṃnidhāne kadācana / jṛmbhitaṃ hasitaṃ caiva kaṇṭhaprāvaraṇaṃ tathā / varjayet sannidhau nityamavasphocanameva ca
yathākālamadhīyīta yāvanna vimanā guruḥ / āsītādho guroḥ kūrce phalake vā samāhitaḥ
āsane śayane yāne naiva tiṣṭhet kadācana / dhāvantamanudhāveta gacchantamanugacchati
go 'śvoṣṭrayānaprāsādaprastareṣu kaṭeṣu ca / āsīta guruṇā sārdhaṃ śilāphalakanauṣu ca
jitendriyaḥ syāt satataṃ vaśyātmākrodhanaḥ śuciḥ / prayuñjīta sadā vācaṃ madhurāṃ hitabhāṣiṇīm
gandhamālyaṃ rasaṃ kalyāṃ śuktaṃ prāṇivihiṃsanam / abhyaṅgaṃ cāñcanopānacchatradhāraṇameva ca
kāmaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ nidrāṃ gītavāditranartanam / ātarjanaṃ parīvādaṃ strīprekṣālambhanaṃ tathā / paropaghātaṃ paiśunyaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet
udakumbhaṃ sumanaso gośakṛnmṛttikāṃ kuśān / āhared yāvadarthāni bhaikṣyaṃ cāharahaścaret
kṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat / anṛtyadarśo satataṃ bhaved gītādiniḥ spṛhaḥ
nādityaṃ vai samīkṣeta na cared dantadhāvanam / ekāntamaśucistrībhiḥ śūdrāntyairabhibhāṣaṇam
gurūcchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ prayuñjīta na kāmataḥ / kalāpakarṣaṇasnānaṃ nācareddhi kadācana
na kuryānmānasaṃ vipro gurostyāge kadācana / mohādvā yadi vā lobhāt tyaktena patito bhavet
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ cāpi tathādhyātmikameva ca / ādadīta yato jñānaṃ na taṃ druhyet kadācana
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ / utpathapratipannasya manustyāgaṃ samabravīt
gurorgurau sannihite guruvad bhaktimācaret / na cātisṛṣṭo guruṇā svān gurūnabivādayet
vidyāguruṣvetadeva nityā vṛttiḥ svayoniṣu / pratiṣedhatsu cādharmāddhitaṃ copadiśatsvapi
śreyaḥsu guruvad vṛttiṃ nityameva samācaret / guruputreṣu dāreṣu guroścaiva svabandhuṣu
bālaḥ samānajanmā vā śiṣyo vā yajñakarmaṇi / adhyāpayan gurusuto guruvanmānamarhati
utsādanaṃ vai gātrāṇāṃ snāpanocchiṣṭabhojane / na kuryād guruputrasya pādayoḥ śaucameva ca
guruvat paripūjyāstu savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ / asavarṇāstu saṃpūjyāḥ pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ
abhyañjanaṃ snāpanaṃ ca gātrotsādanameva ca / gurupatnyā na kāryāṇi keśānāṃ ca prasādhanam
gurupatnī tu yuvatī nābhivādyeha pādayoḥ / kurvota vandanaṃ bhūmyāmasāvahamiti bruvan
viproṣya pādagrahaṇamanvahaṃ cābhivādanam / gurudāreṣu kurvota satāṃ dharmamanusmaran
mātṛṣvasā mātulānī śvaśrūścātha pitṛṣvasā / saṃpūjyā gurupatnīva samāstā gurubhāryayā
bhrāturbhāryopasaṃgrāhyā savarṇāhanyahanyapi / viproṣya tūpasaṃgrāhyā jñātisaṃbandhiyoṣitaḥ
piturbhaginyāṃ mātuśca jyāyasyāṃ ca svasaryapi / mātṛvad vṛttimātiṣṭhenmāt tābhyo garīyasī
evamācārasaṃpannamātmavantamadāmbhikam / vedamadhyāpayed dharmaṃ purāṇāṅgāni nityaśaḥ
saṃvatsaroṣite śiṣye gururjñānamanirdiśan / harate duṣkṛtaṃ tasya śiṣyasya vasato guruḥ
ācāryaputraḥ śuśrūṣurjñānado dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ / śakto 'nnador'tho svaḥsādhuradhyāpyā daśa dharmataḥ
kṛtajñaśca tathādrohī medhāvī śubhakṛnnaraḥ / āptaḥ priyo 'tha vidhivat ṣaḍadhyāpyā dvijātayaḥ / eteṣu brahmaṇo dānamanyatra tu yathoditān
ācamya saṃyato nityamadhīyīta udaṅmukhaḥ / upasaṃgṛhya tatpādau vīkṣamāṇo gurormukham / adhīṣva bho iti brūyād virāmo 'stviti cāramet
prākkūlān paryupāsīnaḥ pavitraiścaiva pāvitaḥ / prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṅkāramarhati
brāhmaṇaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryādante ca vidhivad dvijaḥ / kuryādadhyayanaṃ nityaṃ sa brahmāñjalipūrvataḥ
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ vedaścakṣuḥ sanātanam / adhīyītāpyayaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇyāccyavate 'nyathā
yo 'dhīyīta ṛco nityaṃ kṣīrāhutyā sa devatāḥ / prīṇāti tarpayantyenaṃ kāmaistṛptāḥ sadaiva hi
yajūṃṣyadhīte niyataṃ dadhnā prīṇāti devatāḥ / sāmānyadhīte prīṇāti ghṛtāhutibhiranvaham
atharvāṅgiraso nityaṃ madhvā prīṇāti devatāḥ / dharmāṅgāni purāṇāni māṃsaistarpayate surān
apāṃ samīpe niyato naityakaṃ vidhimāśritaḥ / gāyatrīmapyadhīyīta gatvāraṇyaṃ samāhitaḥ
sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām / gāyatrīṃ vai japennityaṃ japayajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
gāyatrīṃ caiva vedāṃśca tulayātolayat prabhuḥ / ekataścaturo vedān gāyatrīṃ ca tathaikataḥ
oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vyāhṛtīstadanantaram / tato 'dhīyīta sāvitrīmekāgraḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ
purākalpe samutpannā bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ sanātanāḥ / mahāvyāhṛtayastistraḥ sarvāśubhanibarhaṇāḥ
pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ kālo viṣṇurbrahmā maheśvaraḥ / sattvaṃ rajastamastistraḥ kramād vyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ
oṅkārastat paraṃ brahma sāvitrī syāt tadakṣaram / eṣa mantro mahāyogaḥ sārāt sāra udāhṛtaḥ
yo 'dhīte 'hanyahanyetāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / vijñāyārthaṃ brahmacārī sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
gāyatrī vedajananī gāyatrī lokapāvanī / na gāyatryāḥ paraṃ japyametad vijñāya mucyate
śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya paurṇamāsyāṃ dvijottamāḥ / āṣāḍhyāṃ proṣṭhapadyāṃ vā vedopākaraṇaṃ smṛtam
utsṛjya grāmanagaraṃ māsān vipror'ddhapañcamān / adhīyīta śucau deśe brahmacārī samāhitaḥ
puṣye tu chandasāṃ kuryād bahirutsarjanaṃ dvijaḥ / māghaśuklasya vā prāpte pūrvāhne prathame 'hani
chandāṃsyūrdhvamathobhyasyecchuklapakṣeṣu vai dvijaḥ / vedāṅgāni purāṇāni kṛṣṇapakṣe ca mānavam
imān nityamanadhyāyānadīyāno vivarjayet / adhyāpanaṃ ca kurvāṇo hyabhyasyannapi yatnataḥ
karṇaśrave 'nile rātrau divā pāṃśusamūhane / vidyutstanitavarṣeṣu maholkānāṃ ca saṃplave / ākālikamanadhyāyameteṣvāha prajāpatiḥ
etānabhyuditān vidyād yadā prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu / tadā vidyādanadhyāyamanṛtau cābhradarśane
nirghāte bhūmicalane jyotiṣāṃ copasarjane / etānākālikān vidyādanadhyāyānṛtāvapi
prāduṣkṛteṣvagniṣu tu vidyutstanitanisvane / sajyotiḥ syādanadhyāyaḥ śeṣarātrau yathā divā
nityānadhyāya eva syād grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca / dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ pūtigandhe ca nityaśaḥ
antaḥ śavagate grāme vṛṣalasya ca sannidhau / anadhyāyo rudyamāne samavāye janasya ca
udake madhyarātre ca viṇmūtre ca visarjane / ucchiṣṭaḥ śrāddhabuk caiva manasāpi na cintayet
pratigṛhya dvijo vidvānekodiṣṭasya ketanam / tryahaṃ na kīrtayed brahma rājño rāhośca sūtake
yāvadeko 'nudiṣṭasya sneho gandhaśca tiṣṭhati / viprasya viduṣo dehe tāvad brahma na kīrtayet
śayānaḥ prauḍhapādaśca kṛtvā caivāvasakthikām / nādhīyītāmiṣaṃ jagdhvā sūtakānnādyameva ca
nīhāre bāṇaśabde ca saṃdhyayorubhayorapi / amāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyaṣṭamīṣu ca
upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam / aṣṭakāsu tvahorātraṃ ṛtvantyāsu ca rātriṣu
mārgaśīrṣe tathā pauṣe māghamāse tathaiva ca / tistro 'ṣṭakāḥ samākhyātā kṛṣṇapakṣetu sūribhiḥ
śleṣmātakasya chāyāyāṃ śālmalermadhukasya ca / kadācidapi nādhyeyaṃ kovidārakapitthayoḥ
samānavidye ca mṛte tathā sabrahmacāriṇi / ācārye saṃsthite vāpi trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam
chidrāṇyetāni viprāṇāṃye 'nadhyāyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ / hiṃsanti rākṣasāsteṣu tasmādetān vivarjayet
naityake nāstyanadhyāyaḥ saṃdhyopāsana eva ca / upākarmaṇi karmānte homamantreṣu caiva hi
ekāmṛcamathaikaṃ vā yajuḥ sāmāthavā punaḥ / aṣṭakādyāsvadhīyīta mārute cātivāyati
anadhyāyastu nāṅgeṣu netihāsapurāṇayoḥ / na dharmaśāstreṣvanyeṣu parvaṇyetāni varjayet
eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena kīrtito brahmacāriṇām / brahmaṇābhihitaḥ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
yo 'nyatra kurute yatnamanadhītya śrutiṃ dvijaḥ / sa saṃmūḍho na saṃbhāṣyo vedabāhyo dvijātibhiḥ
na vedapāṭhamātreṇa saṃtuṣṭo vai bhaved dvijaḥ / pāṭhamātrāvasannastu paṅke gauriva sīdati
yo 'dhītya vidhivad vedaṃ vedārthaṃ na vicārayet / sasānvayaḥ śūdrakalpaḥ pātratāṃ na prapadyate
yadi tvātyantikaṃ vāsaṃ kartumicchati vai gurau / yuktaḥ paricaredenamāśarīravimokṣaṇāt
gatvā vanaṃ vā vidhivajjuhuyājjātavedasam / adhīyīta sadā nityaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaḥ samāhitaḥ
sāvitrīṃ śatarudrīyaṃ vedāntāṃśca viśeṣataḥ / abhyaset satataṃ yukte bhasmasnānaparāyaṇaḥ
etad vidhānaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ vedāgame samyagiheritaṃ vaḥ / purā maharṣipravarābhipṛṣṭaḥ svāyaṃbhuvo yanmanurāha devaḥ
evamīśvarasamarpitāntaro yo 'nutiṣṭhati vidhiṃ vidhānavit / mohajālamapahāya so 'mṛto yāti tat padamanāmayaṃ śivam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca vedaṃ vedau tathā vedān vedān vā caturo dvijāḥ / adhītya cādhigamyārthaṃ tataḥ snāyād dvijottamaḥ
gurave tu varaṃ dattvā snāyīta tadanujñayā / cīrṇavrato 'tha yuktātmā saśaktaḥ snātumarhati
vaiṇavīṃ dhārayed yaṣṭimantarvāsastathottaram / yajñopavītadvitayaṃ sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum
chatraṃ coṣṇīṣamamalaṃ pāduke cāpyupānahau / raukme ca kuṇḍale vedaṃ kṛttakeśanakhaḥ śuciḥ
svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syād bahirmālyaṃ na dhārayet / anyatrakāñcanād vipronaraktāṃ bibhṛyāt strajam
śuklāmbaradharo nityaṃ sugandhaḥ priyadarśanaḥ / na jīrṇamalavadvāsā bhaved vai vibhave sati
na raktamulbaṇaṃ cānyadhṛtaṃ vāso na kuṇḍikām / nopānahau strajaṃ cātha pāduke ca prayojayet
upavītamalaṅkāraṃ darbhān kṛṣṇājināni ca / nāpasavyaṃ parīdadhyād vāso na vikṛtaṃ vaset
āhared vidhivad dārān sadṛśānātmanaḥ śubhān / rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyuktān yonidoṣavivarjitān
amātṛgotraprabhavāmasamānarṣigotrajām / āhared brāhmaṇo bhāryāṃ śīlaśaucasamanvitām
ṛtukālābhigāmī syād yāvat putro 'bhijāyate / varjayet pratiṣiddhāni prayatnena dināni tu
ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīṃ pañcadaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca caturdaśīm / brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ tadvajjanmatrayāhani
ādadhītāvasathyāgniṃ juhuyājjātavedasam / vratāni snātako nityaṃ pāvanāni ca pālayet
vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ / akurvāṇaḥ patatyāśu narakānatibhīṣaṇān
abyaset prayato vedaṃ mahāyajñān na hāpayet / kuryād gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi saṃdhyopāsanameva ca
sakhyaṃ samādhaikaiḥ kuryādupeyādīśvaraṃ sadā / daivatānyapi gaccheta kuryād bhāryābhipoṣaṇam
na dharmaṃ khyāpayed vidvān na pāpaṃ gūhayedapi / kurvotātmahitaṃ nityaṃ sarvabhūtānikampakaḥ
vayasaḥ karmaṇor'thasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca / veṣavāgbuddhisārūpyamācaran vicaret sadā
śrutismṛtyuditaḥ samyak sādhubhiryaśca sevitaḥ / tamācāraṃ niṣeveta nehetānyatra karhicit
yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ / tena yāyāt satāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchan na riṣyati
nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlaḥ syānnityaṃ yajñopavītavān / satyavādī jitakrodho brahmabhūyāya kalpate
saṃdhyāsnānaparo nityaṃ brahmayajñuparāyaṇaḥ / anasūyī mṛdurdānto gṛhasthaḥ pretya vardhate
vītarāgabhayakrodho lobhamohavivarjitaḥ / sāvitrījāpyanirataḥ śrāddhakṛnmucyate gṛhī
mātāpitrorhite yukto gobrāhmaṇahite rataḥ / dānto yajvā devabhakto brahmaloke mahīyate
trivargasevī satataṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjanam / kuryādaharaharnityaṃ namasyet prayataḥ surān
vibhāgaśīlaḥ satataṃ kṣamāyukto dayālukaḥ / gṛhasthastu samākhyāto na gṛheṇa gṛhī bhavet
kṣamā dayā ca vijñānaṃ satyaṃ caiva damaḥ śamaḥ / adhyātmanirataṃ jñānametad brāhmaṇalakṣaṇam
etasmānna pramādyeta viśeṣeṇa dvijottamaḥ / yathāśaktiṃ caran karma ninditāni vivarjayet
vidhūya mohakalilaṃ labdhvā yogamanuttamam / gṛhastho mucyate bandhāt nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
vigarhātikramākṣepahiṃsābandhavadhātmanām / anyamanyusamutthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ marṣaṇaṃ kṣamā
svaduḥ kheṣviva kāruṇyaṃ paraduḥ kheṣu sauhṛdāt / dayeti munayaḥ prāhuḥ sākṣād dharmasya sādhanam
caturdaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ hi yatārthataḥ / vijñānamiti tad vidyād yena dharmo vivardhate
adhītya vidhivad vidyāmarthaṃ caivopalabhya tu / dharmakāryānnivṛttaścenna tad vijñānamiṣyate
satyena lokāñjayati satyaṃ tatparamaṃ padam / yathābhūtapravād tu satyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
damaḥ śarīroparamaḥ śamaḥ prajñāprisādajaḥ / adhyātmamakṣaraṃ vidyād yatra gatvā na śocati
yayā sa devo bhagavān vidyayā vedyate paraḥ / sākṣād devo mahādevastajjñānamiti kīrtitam
tanniṣṭhastatparo vidvānnityamakrodhanaḥ śuciḥ / mahāyajñaparo vipro labhate tadanuttamam
dharmasyāyatanaṃ yatnāccharīraṃ paripālayet / na hi dehaṃ vinā rudraḥ puruṣairvidyate paraḥ
nityadharmārthakāmeṣu yujyeta niyato dvijaḥ / na dharmavarjitaṃ kāmamarthaṃ vā manasā smaret
sīdannapi hi dharmeṇa na tvadharmaṃ samācaret / dharmo hi bhagavān devo gatiḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu
bhūtānāṃ priyakārī syāt na paradrohakarmadhīḥ / na vedadevatānindāṃ kuryāt taiśca na saṃvaset
yastvimaṃ niyataṃ vipro dharmādhyāyaṃ paṭhecchuciḥ / adhyāpayet śrāvayed vā brahmaloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāninānṛtaṃ vāvadet kvacit / nāhitaṃ nāpriyaṃ vākyaṃ na stenaḥ syād kadācana
tṛṇaṃ vā yadi vā śākaṃ mṛdaṃ vā jalameva vā / parasyāpaharañjanturnarakaṃ pratipadyate
na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna śūdrapatitādapi / na cānyasmādaśaktaśca ninditān varjayed budhaḥ
nityaṃ yācanako na syāt punastaṃ naiva yācayet / prāṇānapaharatyevaṃ yācakastasya durmatiḥ
na devadravyahārī syād viśeṣeṇa dvijottamaḥ / brahmasvaṃ vā nāpaharedāpadyapi kadācana
na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhurbrahmasvaṃ viṣamucyate / devasvaṃ cāpi yatnena sadā pariharet tataḥ
puṣpe śākrodake kāṣṭhe tathā mūle phale tṛṇe / adattādānamasteyaṃ manuḥ prāha prajāpatiḥ
grahītavyāni puṣpāṇi devārcanavidhau dvijāḥ / naikasmādeva niyatamananujñāya kevalam
tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ prakāśaṃ vai hared budhaḥ / dharmārthaṃ kevalaṃ viprā hyanyathā patito bhavet
tilamudgayavādīnāṃ muṣṭirgrāhyā pathi sthitaiḥ / kṣudhārtairnānyathā viprā dharmavidbhiriti sthitiḥ
na dharmasyāpadeśena pāpaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret / vratena pāpaṃ pracchādya kurvan strīśūdradambhanam
pretyeha cedṛśo vipro garhyate brahmavādibhiḥ / chadmanācaritaṃ yacca vrataṃ rakṣāṃsi gacchati
aliṅgī liṅgiveṣeṇa yo vṛttimupajīvati / sa liṅgināṃ haredenastiryagyonau ca jāyate
baiḍālavratinaḥ pāpā loke dharmavināśakāḥ / sadyaḥ patanti pāpeṣu karmaṇastasya tat phalam
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān vāmācārāṃstathaiva ca / pañcarātrān pāśupatān vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet
vedanindāratān martyān devanindāratāṃstathā / dvijanindāratāṃścaiva manasāpi na cintayet
yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ sahavāsaṃ ca bhāṣaṇam / kurvāṇaḥ patate jantustasmād yatnena varjayet
devadrohād gurudrohaḥ koṭikoṭiguṇādhikaḥ / jñānāpavādo nāstikyaṃ tasmāt koṭiguṇādhikam
gobhiśca daivatairvipraiḥ kṛṣyā rājopasevayā / kulānyakulatāṃ yānti yāni hīnāni dharmataḥ
kuvivāhaiḥ kriyālopairvedānadhyayanena ca / kulānyakulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca
anṛtāt pāradāryācca tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇāt / aśrautadharmācaraṇāt kṣipraṃ naśyati vai kulam
aśrotriyeṣu vai dānād vṛṣaleṣu tathaiva ca / vihitācārahīneṣu kṣipraṃ naśyati vai kulam
nādhārmikairvṛte grāme na vyādhibahule bhṛśam / na śūdrarājye nivasenna pāṣaṇḍajanairvṛte
himavadvindhyayormadhye pūrvapaścimayoḥ śubham / muktvā samudrayordeśaṃ nānyatra nivased dvijaḥ
kṛṣṇo vā yatra carati mṛgo nityaṃ svabhāvataḥ / puṇyāśca viśrutā nadyastatra vā nivased dvijaḥ
ardhakrośānnadīkūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottamaḥ / nānyatra nivaset puṇyaṃ nāntyajagrāmasannidhau
na saṃvasecca patitairna caṇḍālairna pukkasaiḥ / na mūrkhairnāvaliptaiśca nāntyairnāntyāvasāyibhiḥ
ekaśayyāsanaṃ paṅktirbhāṇḍapakvānnamiśraṇam / yājanādhyāpane yonistathaiva sahabhojanam
sahādhyāyastu daśamaḥ sahayājanameva ca / ekādaśa samuddiṣṭā doṣāḥ sāṅkaryasaṃjñitāḥ
samīpe vā vyavasthānāt pāpaṃ saṃkramate nṛṇām / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sāṅkaryaṃ parivarjayet
ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭā ye na spṛśanti parasparam / bhasmanā kṛtamaryādā na teṣāṃ saṃkaro bhavet
agninā bhasmanā caiva salilenāvasekataḥ / dvāreṇa stambhamārgeṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ paṅktirvibhidyate
na kuryācchuṣkavairāṇi vivādaṃ ca na paiśunam / parakṣetre gāṃ dhayantīṃ na cācakṣīta kasyacit / na saṃvadet sūtake ca na kañcinmarmaṇi spṛśet
na sūryapariveṣaṃ vā nendracāpaṃ śavāgnikam / parasmai kathayed vidvān śaśinaṃ vā kadācana
na kuryād bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ virodhaṃ bandhubhistathā / ātmanaḥ pratikūlāni pareṣāṃ na samācaret
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāt na nakṣatrāṇi nirdiśet / nodakyāmabhibhāṣeta nāśuciṃ vā dvijottamaḥ
na devaguruviprāṇāṃ dīyamānaṃ tu vārayet / na cātmānaṃ praśaṃsed vā paranindāṃ ca varjayet / vedanindāṃ devanindāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet
yastu devānṛṣīn viprānvedān vā nindati dvijaḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā śāstreṣviha munīśvarāḥ
nindayed vai guruṃ devaṃ vedaṃ vā sopabṛṃhaṇam / kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ raurave pacyate naraḥ
tūṣṇīmāsīta nindāyāṃ na brūyāt kiñciduttaram / karṇau pidhāya gantavyaṃ na caitānavalokayet
varjayed vai rahasyāni pareṣāṃ gūhayed budhaḥ / vivādaṃ svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ na kuryād vai kadācana
na pāpaṃ pāpināṃ brūyādapāpaṃ vā dvijāttamāḥ / satenatulyadoṣaḥ syānmithyā dvirdeṣavān bhavet
yāni mithyābhiśastānāṃ patantyaśrūṇi rodanāt / tāniputrān paśūnghninti teṣāṃ mithyābhiśaṃsinām
brihmahatyāsurāpāne steyagurvaṅganāgame / dṛṣṭaṃ viśodhanaṃ vṛddhairnāsti mithyābhiśaṃsane
nekṣetodyantamādityaṃ śaśinaṃ cānimittataḥ / nāstaṃ yāntaṃ na vāristhaṃ nopasṛṣṭaṃ na maghyagam / tirohitaṃ vāsasā vā nādarśāntaragāminam
na nagnāṃ striyamīkṣeta puruṣaṃ vā kadācana / na ca mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā na ca saṃspṛṣṭamaithunam / nāśuciḥ sūryasomādīn grahānālokayed budhaḥ
patitavyaṅgacaṇḍālānucchiṣṭān nāvalokayet / nābhibhāṣeta ca paramucchiṣṭo vāvaguṇṭhitaḥ
na paśyet pretasaṃsparśaṃ na kruddhasya gurormukham / na tailodakayośchāyāṃ na patnīṃ bhojane sati / nāmuktabandhanāṅgāṃ vā nonmattaṃ mattameva vā
nāśnīyāt bhāryayā sārdhaṃnaināmīkṣeta cāśnatīm / kṣuvantīṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ vā nāsanasthāṃ yathāsukham
nodake cātmano rūpaṃ na kūlaṃ śvabhrameva vā / na laṅghayecca mūtraṃ vā nādhitiṣṭhet kadācana
na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt kṛśaraṃ pāyasaṃ dadhi / nocchiṣṭaṃ vā madhu ghṛtaṃ na ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ haviḥ
na caivāsmai vrataṃ dadyānna ca dharmaṃ vaded budhaḥ / na ca krodhavaśaṃ gacched dveṣaṃ rāgaṃ ca varjayet
lobhaṃ dambhaṃ tathā yatnādasūyāṃ jñānakutsanam / īrṣyāṃ madaṃ tathā śokaṃ mohaṃ ca parivarjayet
na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ sutaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca tāḍayet / na hīnānupaseveta na ca tīkṣṇamatīn kvacit
nātmānaṃ cāvamanyeta dainyaṃ yatnena varjayet / na viśiṣṭānasatkuryāt nātmānaṃ vā śaped budhaḥ
na nakhairvilikhed bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca saṃveśayenna hi / na nadīṣu nadīṃ brūyāt parvateṣu ca parvatān
āvāse bhojane vāpi na tyajet hasayāyinam / nāvagāhedapo nagno vahniṃ nātivrajet padā
śiro 'bhyaṅgāvaśiṣṭena tailenāṅgaṃ na lepayet / na sarpaśastraiḥ krīḍeta svāni khāni na saṃspṛśet / romāṇi ca rahasyāni nāśiṣṭena saha vrajet
na pāṇipādavāṅnetracāpalyaṃ samupāśrayet / na śiśnodaracāpalyaṃ na ca śravaṇayoḥ kvacit
na cāṅganakhavādaṃ vai kuryānnāñjalinā pibet / nābhihanyājjalaṃ padbhyāṃ pāṇinā vā kadācana
na śātayediṣṭakābhiḥ phalāni na phalena ca / na mlecchabhāṣāṃ śikṣeta nākarṣecca padāsanam
na bhedanamavasphoṭaṃ chedanaṃ vā vilekhanam / kuryād vimardanaṃ dhīmān nākasmādeva niṣphalam
notsaṅgebhakṣayed bhakṣyaṃ vṛthā ceṣṭāṃ ca nācaret / na nṛtyedathavā gāyenna vāditrāṇi vādayet
na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ / na laukikaiḥ stavairdevāṃstoṣayed bāhyajairapi
nākṣaiḥ krīḍenna dhāveta nāpsu viṇmūtramācaret / nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃviśennityaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret
na gacchenna paṭhed vāpi na caiva svaśiraḥ spṛśet / na dantairnakharomāṇi chindyāt suptaṃ na bodhayet
na bālātapamāsevet pretadhūmaṃ vivarjayet / naikaḥ supyācchūnyagṛhe svayaṃ nopānahau haret
nākāraṇād vā niṣṭhīvenna bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret / na pādakṣālanaṃ kuryāt pādenaiva kadācana
nāgnau pratāpayet pādau na kāṃsye dhāvayed budhaḥ / nābhiprāsarayed devaṃ brāhmaṇān gāmathāpi vā / vāyvagniguruviprān vā sūryaṃ vā śaśinaṃ prati
aśuddhaḥ śayanaṃ yānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ snānavāhanam / bahirniṣkramaṇaṃ caiva na kurvota kathañcana
svapnamadhyayanaṃ snānamudvartaṃ bhojanaṃ gatim / ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayornityaṃ madhyāhne caiva varjayet
na spṛśet pāṇinocchiṣṭo viprogobrāhmaṇānalān / na cāsanaṃ padā vāpi na devapratimāṃ spṛśet
nāśuddho 'gniṃ paricarenna devān kīrtayedṛṣīn / nāvagāhedagādhāmbu dhārayennānimittataḥ
na vāmahastenoddhatya pibed vaktreṇa vā jalam / nottaredanupaspṛśya nāpsu retaḥ samutsṛjet
amedhyaliptamanyad vā lohitaṃ vā viṣāṇi vā / vyatikramenna stravantīṃ nāpsu maithunamācaret / caityaṃ vṛkṣaṃ na vai chindyānnāpsu ṣṭhīvanamācaret
nāsthibhasmakapālāni na keśānna ca kaṇṭakān / tuṣāṅgārakarīṣaṃ vā nādhitiṣṭhet kadācana
na cāgniṃ laṅghayed dhīmān nopadadhyādadhaḥ kvacit / na cainaṃ pādataḥ kuryānmukhena na dhamed budhaḥ
na kūpamavaroheta nāvekṣetāśuciḥ kvacit / agnau na ca kṣipedagniṃ nādbhiḥ praśamayet tathā
suhṛnmaraṇamārtiṃ vā na svayaṃ śrāvayet parān / apaṇyaṃ kūṭapaṇyaṃ vā vikraye na prayojayet
na vahniṃ mukhaniśvāsair jvālayennāśucirbudhaḥ / puṇyasthānodakasthāne sīmāntaṃ vā kṛṣenna tu
na bhindyāt pūrvasamayamabhyupetaṃ kadācana / parasparaṃ paśūn vyālān pakṣiṇo nāvabodhayet
parabādhaṃ na kurvota jalavātātapādibhiḥ / kārayitvā svakarmāṇi kārūn paścānna vañcayet / sāyaṃprātar gṛhadvārān bhikṣārthaṃ nāvaghaṭṭayet
bahirmālyaṃ bahirgandhaṃ bhāryayā saha bhojanam / vigṛhya vādaṃ kudvārapraveśaṃ ca vivarjayet
na khādanbrāhmaṇastiṣṭhenna jalped vā hasan budhaḥ / svamagniṃ naiva hastena spṛśennāpsu ciraṃ vaset
na pakṣakeṇopadhamenna śūrpeṇa na pāṇinā / mukhe naiva dhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata
parastriyaṃ na bhāṣeta nāyājyaṃ yājayed dvijaḥ / naikaścaret sabhāṃ vipraḥ samavāyaṃ ca varjayet
na devāyatanaṃ gacchet kadācid vāpradakṣiṇam / na vījayed vā vastreṇa na devāyatane svapet
naiko 'dhvānaṃ prapadyeta nādhārmikajanaiḥ saha / na vyādhidūṣitairvāpi na śūdraiḥ patitena vā
nopānadvarjito vātha jalādirahitastathā / na rātrau nāriṇā sārdhaṃ na vinā ca kamaṇḍalum / nāgnigobrāhmaṇādīnāmantareṇa vrajet kvacit
na vatsatantrīṃ vitatāmatikrāmet kvacid dvijaḥ / na ninded yoginaḥ siddhān vratino vāyatīṃstathā
devatāyatanaṃ prājño devānāṃ caiva satriṇām / nākrāmet kāmataśchāyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gorapi
svāṃ tu nākramayecchāyāṃ patitādyairna rogibhiḥ / nāṅgārabhasmakeśādiṣvadhitiṣṭhet kadācana
varjayenmārjanīreṇuṃ snānavastraghacodakam / na bhakṣayedabhakṣyāṇi nāpeyaṃ ca pibed dvijaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca nādyācchūdrasya vipro 'nnaṃ mohād vā yadi vānyataḥ / sa śūdrayoniṃ vrajati yastu bhuṅkte hyanāpadi
ṣaṇmāsān yo dvijo bhuṅkte śūdrasyānnaṃ vigarhitam / jīvanneva bhavecchūdro mṛtaḥ śvā cābhijāyate
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrasya ca munīśvarāḥ / yasyānnenodarasthena mṛtastadyonimāpnuyāt
rājānnaṃ nartakānnaṃ ca takṣṇo 'nnaṃ carmakāriṇaḥ / gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca ṣaṇḍhānnaṃ caiva varjayet
cakropajīvirajakataskaradhvajināṃ tathā / gāndharvalohakārānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca varjayet
kulālacitrakarmānnaṃ vārdhuṣeḥ patitasya ca / paunarbhavacchatrikayorabhiśastasya caiva hi
suvarṇakāraśailūṣavyādhabaddhāturasya ca / cikitsakasya caivānnaṃ puṃścalyā daṇḍikasya ca
stenanāstikayorannaṃ devatānindakasya ca / somavikrayiṇaścānnaṃ śvapākasya viśeṣataḥ
bhāryājitasya caivānnaṃ yasya copapatirgṛhe / utsṛṣṭasya kadaryasya tathaivocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ
apāṅktyānnaṃ ca saṅghānnaṃ śastrājīvasya caiva hi / klībasaṃnyāsinoścānnaṃ mattonmattasya caiva hi / bhītasya ruditasyānnamavakruṣṭaṃ parikṣutam
brahmadviṣaḥ pāparuceḥ śrāddhānnaṃ sūtakasya ca / vṛthāpākasya caivānnaṃ śāvānnaṃ śvaśurasya ca
aprajānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ bhṛtakasya tathaiva ca / kārukānnaṃ viśeṣeṇa śastravikrayiṇastathā
śauṇḍānnaṃ ghāṭikānnaṃ ca bhiṣajāmannameva ca / viddhaprajananasyānnaṃ parivittyannameva ca
punarbhuvo viśeṣeṇa tathaiva didhiṣūpateḥ / avajñātaṃ cāvadhūtaṃ saroṣaṃ vismayānvitam / gurorapi na bhoktavyamannaṃ saṃskāravarjitam
duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyasya sarvamanne vyavasthitam / yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāni kilbiṣam
ārdhikaḥ kulamitraśca svagopālaśca nāpitaḥ / ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaścātmānaṃ nivedayet
kuśīlavaḥ kumbhakāraḥ kṣetrakarmaka eva ca / ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā dattvā svalpaṃ paṇaṃ budhaiḥ
pāyasaṃ snehapakvaṃ yad gorasaṃ caiva saktavaḥ / piṇyākaṃ caiva tailaṃ ca śūdrād grāhyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ
vṛntākaṃ nālikāśākaṃ kusumbhāśmantakaṃ tathā / palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ śuktaṃ niryāsaṃ caiva varjayet
chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca śelaṃ peyūṣameva ca / vilayaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva kavakāni ca varjayet
gṛñjanaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva kakubhāṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca / udumbaramalābuṃ ca jagdhvā patati vai dvijaḥ
vṛthā kṛśarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpameva ca / anupākṛtamāṃsaṃ ca devānnāni havīṃṣi ca
yavāgūṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca matsyānapyanupākṛtān / nīpaṃ kapitthaṃ plakṣaṃ ca prayatnena vivarjayet
piṇyākaṃ coddhṛtasnehaṃ devadhānya tathaiva ca / rātrau ca tilasaṃbaddhaṃ prayatnena dadhi tyajet
nāśnīyāt payasā takraṃ na bījānyupajīvayet / kriyāduṣṭaṃ bhāvaduṣṭamasatsaṃsargi varjayet
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ ca nityaśaḥ / śvāghrātaṃ ca punaḥ siddhaṃ caṇḍālāvekṣitaṃ tathā
udakyayā ca patitairgavā cāghrātameva ca / anarcitaṃ puryuṃ ṣitaṃ paryāyānnaṃ ca nityaśaḥ
kākakukkuṭasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ kṛmibhiścaiva saṃyutam / manuṣyairapyavaghrātaṃ kuṣṭhinā spṛṣṭameva ca
na rajasvalayā dattaṃ na puṃścālyā saroṣayā / malabadvāsasā vāpi paravāso 'tha varjayet
vivatsāyāśca goḥ kṣīramauṣṭraṃ vānirdaśaṃ tathā / āvikaṃ sandhinīkṣīramapeyaṃ manurabravīt
balākaṃ haṃsadātyūhaṃ kalaviṅkaṃ śukaṃ tathā / kuraraṃ ca cakoraṃ ca jālapādaṃ ca kokilam
vāyasaṃ khañjarīṭaṃ ca śyenaṃ gṛdhraṃ tathaiva ca / ulūkaṃ cakravākaṃ ca bhāsaṃ pārāvatānapi / kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva grāmakukkuṭameva ca
siṃhavyāghraṃ ca mārjāraṃ śvānaṃ śūkarameva ca / śṛgālaṃ markaṭaṃ caiva gardabhaṃ ca na bhakṣayet
na bhakṣayet sarvamṛgān pakṣiṇo 'nyān vanecarān / jalecarān sthalacarān prāṇinaśceti dhāraṇā
godhā kūrmaḥ śaśaḥ śvāvicchalyakaśceti sattamāḥ / bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhā nityaṃ manurāha prijāpatiḥ
matsyān saśalkān bhuñjīyān māṃsaṃ rauravamevaca / nivedya devatābhyastu brāhmaṇebhyastu nānyathā
mayūraṃ tittiraṃ caiva kapotaṃ ca kapiñjalam / vādhrīṇasaṃ bakaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mīnahaṃsaparājitāḥ
śapharaṃ siṃhatuṇḍaṃ ca tathā pāṭhīnarohitau / matsyāścaite samuddiṣṭā bhakṣaṇāya dvijottamāḥ
prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayedeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ ca dvijakāmyayā / yathāvidhi niyuktaṃ ca prāṇānāmapi cātyaye
bhakṣayennaiva māṃsāni śeṣabhojī na lipyate / auṣadhārthamaśaktau vā niyogād yajñakāraṇāt
āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe daive vā māṃsamutsṛjet / yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvato narakān vrajet
adeyaṃ cāpyapeyaṃ ca tathaivāspṛśyameva ca / dvijātīnāmanālokyaṃ nityaṃ madyamiti sthitiḥ
tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madyaṃ nityaṃ vivarjayet / pītvā patati karmabhyastvasaṃbhāṣyo bhaved dvijaḥ
bhakṣayitvā hyabhakṣyāṇi pītvāpeyānyapi dvijaḥ / nādhikārī bhavet tāvad yāvad tanna jahātyadhaḥ
tasmāt pariharennityamabhakṣyāṇi prayatnataḥ / apeyāni ca vipro vai tathā ced yāti rauravam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahāmune / tadācakṣvākhilaṃ karma yena mucyeta bandhanāt
vyāsa uvāca vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama / ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kramād vidhim
brāhme muhūrte tūtthāya dharmamarthaṃ ca cintayet / kāyakleśaṃ tadudbhūtaṃ dhyāyīta manaseśvaram
uṣaḥ kāle 'tha saṃprāpte kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ budhaḥ / snāyānnadīṣu suddhāsu śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
prātaḥ snānena pūyante ye 'pi pāpakṛto janāḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret
prātaḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ śubham / ṛṣīṇāmṛṣitā nityaṃ prātaḥ snānānna saṃśayaḥ
mukhe suptasya satataṃ lālā yāḥ saṃstravanti hi / tato naivācaret karma akṛtvā snānamāditaḥ
alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇo ca duḥ svapnaṃ durvicintitam / prātaḥ snānena pāpāni pūyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
na ca snānaṃ vinā puṃsāṃ pāvanaṃ karma susmṛtam / home japye viśeṣeṇa tasmāt snānaṃ samācaret
aśaktāvaśiraskaṃ vā snānamasya vidhīyate / ārdreṇa vāsasā vātha mārjanaṃ kāpilaṃ smṛtam
asāmarthye samutpanne snānamevaṃ samācaret / brāhmādīni yathāśaktau snānānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
brāhmamāgneyamuddiṣṭaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyameva ca / vāruṇaṃ yaugikaṃ tadvat ṣoḍhā snānaṃ prakīrtitam
brāhmaṃ tu mārjanaṃ mantraiḥ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ / āgneyaṃ bhasmanā pādamastakāddehadhūlanam
gavāṃ hi rajasā proktaṃ vāyavyaṃ snānamuttamam / yattu sātapavarṣeṇa snānaṃ tad divyamucyate
vāruṇaṃ cāvagāhastu mānasaṃ tvātmavedanam / yaugikaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ yogo viṣṇuvicintanam
ātmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / manaḥ śucikaraṃ puṃsāṃ nityaṃ tat snānamācaret
śaktaśced vāruṇaṃ vidvān prājāpatyaṃ tathaiva ca / prakṣālya dantakāṣṭhaṃ vai bhakṣayitvā vidhānataḥ
ācamya prayato nityaṃ snānaṃ prātaḥ samācaret / madhyāṅgulisamasthaulyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitam
satvacaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ syāt tadagreṇa tu dhāvayet / kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ mālatīsaṃbhavaṃ śubham / apāmārgaṃ ca bilvaṃ ca karavīraṃ viśeṣataḥ
varjayitvā ninditāni gṛhītvaikaṃ yathoditam / parihṛtya dinaṃ pāpaṃ bhakṣayed vai vidhānavit
notpāṭayeddantakāṣṭaṃnāṅgulyā dhāvayet kvacit / prakṣālya bhaṅktvā tajjahyācchucaudeśe samāhitaḥ
snātvā saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / ācamya mantravannityaṃ punarācamya vāgyataḥ
saṃmārjya mantrairātmānaṃ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ / āpo hiṣṭhā vyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryā vāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ
oṅkāravyāhṛtiyutāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / japtvā jalāñjaliṃ dadyād bhāskaraṃ prati tanmanāḥ
prākkūleṣu samāsīno darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ / prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet saṃdhyāmiti śrutiḥ
yā saṃdhyā sā jagatsūtirmāyātītā hi niṣkalā / aiśvarī tu parāśaktistattvatrayasamudbhavā
dhyātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ sāvitrīṃ vai japan budhaḥ / prāṅmukhaḥ satataṃ vipraḥ saṃdhyopāsanamācaret
saṃdhyāhīno 'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu / yadanyat kurute kiñcinna tasya phalamāpnuyāt
ananyacetasaḥ śāntā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / upāsya vidhivat saṃdhyāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvaṃ parāṃ gatim
yo 'nyatra kurute yatnaṃ dharmakārye dvijottamaḥ / vihāya saṃdhyāpraṇatiṃ sa yāti narakāyutam
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃdhyopāsanamācaret / upāsito bhavet tena devo yogatanuḥ paraḥ
sahasraparamāṃ nityaṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām / sāvitrariṃ vai japed vidvān prāṅmukhaḥ prayataḥ sthitaḥ
athopatiṣṭhedādityamudayantaṃ samāhitaḥ / mantraistu vividhaiḥ saurerṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ
upasthāya mahāyogaṃ devadevaṃ divākaram / kurvota praṇatiṃ bhūmau mūrdhnā tenaiva mantrataḥ
oṃ khakholkāya śāntāya kāraṇatrayahetave / nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ namaste jñānarūpiṇe / namaste ghṛṇine tubhyaṃ sūryāya brahmarūpiṇe
tvameva brahma paramamāpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam / bhūrbhuvaḥ svastvamoṅkāraḥ sarve rudrāḥ sanātanāḥ / puruṣaḥ sanmaho 'tastvāṃ praṇamāmi kapardinam
tvameva viśvaṃ bahudhā sadasat sūyate ca yat / namo rudrāya sūryāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
pracetase namastubhyaṃ namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya te / namo namaste rudrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
hiraṇyabāhave tubhyaṃ hiraṇyapataye namaḥ / ambikāpataye tubhyamumāyāḥ pataye namaḥ
namo 'stu nīlagrīvāya namastubhyaṃ pinākine / vilohitāya bhargāya sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ
namo haṃsāya te nityamādityāya namo 'stu te / namaste vajrahastāya tryambakāya namo 'stu te
prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ mahāntaṃ parameśvaram / hiraṇmayaṃ gṛhe guptamātmānaṃ sarvadehinām
namasyāmi paraṃ jyotirbrahmāṇaṃ tvāṃ parāṃ gatim / viśvaṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ naranārīśarīriṇam
namaḥ sūryāya rudrāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine / ugrāya sarvabhaktāya tvāṃ prapadye sadaiva hi
etad vai sūryahṛdayaṃ japtvā stavamanuttamam / prātaḥ kāle 'tha madhyāhne namaskuryād divākaram
idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dhārmikāya dvijātaye / pradeyaṃ sūryahṛdayaṃ brahmaṇā tu pradarśitam
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ vedasārasamudbhavam / brāhmaṇānāṃ hitaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam
athāgamya gṛhaṃ vipraḥ samācamya yathāvidhi / prajvālya vihniṃ vidhivajjuhuyājjātavedasam
ṛtvikputro 'tha patnī vā śiṣyo vāpi sahodaraḥ / prāpyānujñāṃ viśeṣeṇa juhuyurvā yatāvidhi
pavitrapāṇiḥ pūtātmā śuklāmbaradharottaraḥ / ananyamānaso vahniṃ juhuyāt saṃyatendriyaḥ
vinā darbheṇa yatkarma vinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ / rākṣasaṃ tadbhavet sarvaṃ nāmutreha phalapradam
daivatāni namaskuryād deyasārānnivedayet / dadyāt puṣpādikaṃ teṣāṃ vṛddhāṃścaivābhivādayet
guruṃ caivāpyupāsīta hitaṃ cāsya samācaret / vedābhyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prayatnācchaktito dvijaḥ
japedadhyāpayecchiṣyān dhārayecca vicārayet / avekṣeta ca śāstrāṇi dharmādīni dvijottamaḥ / vaidikāṃścaiva nigamān vedāṅgāni veśiṣataḥ
upeyādīśvaraṃ cātha yogakṣemaprasiddhaye / sādhayed vividhānarthān kuṭumbārthe tato dvijaḥ
tato madhyāhnasamaye snānārthaṃ mṛdamāharet / puṣpākṣatān kuśatilān gomayaṃ śuddhameva ca
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca / snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ gartaprastravaṇeṣu ca
parakīyanipāneṣu na snāyād vai kadācana / pañcapiṇḍān samuddhṛtya snāyād vāsaṃbhave punaḥ
mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ dvābhyāṃ nābhestathopari / adhaśca tisṛbhiḥ kāyaṃ pādau ṣaḍbhistathaiva ca
mṛttikā ca samuddiṣṭā tvārdrāmalakamātrikā / gomayasya pramāṇaṃ tat tenāṅgaṃ lepayet tataḥ
lepayitvā tu tīrasthastalliṅgaireva mantrataḥ / prakṣālyācamya vidhivat tataḥ snāyāt samāhitaḥ
abhimantrya jalaṃ mantraistalliṅgairvāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ / bhāvapūtastadavyaktaṃ dhyāyan vai viṣṇumavyayam
āpo nārāyaṇodbhūtāstā evāsyāyanaṃ punaḥ / tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ snānakāle smared budhaḥ
procya soṃkāramādityaṃ trirnimajjejjalāśaye / ācāntaḥ punarācāmenmantreṇānena mantravit
antaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvato mukhaḥ / tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam
drupadāṃ vā trirabhyasyed vyāhṛtipraṇavānvitām / sāvitrīṃ vā japed vidvān tathā caivāghamarṣaṇam
tataḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kuryādāpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ / idamāpaḥ pravahata vyāhṛtibhistathaiva ca
tato 'bhimantrya tat tīrthamāpo hiṣṭhādimantrakaiḥ / antarjalagato magno japet triraghamarṣaṇam
tripadāṃ vātha sāvitrīṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam / āvartayed vā praṇavaṃ devaṃ vā saṃsmareddharim
drupadādiva yo mantro yajurvede pratiṣṭhitaḥ / antarjale trirāvartya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
apaḥ pāṇau samādāya japtvā vai mārjane kṛte / vinyasya mūrdhni tat toyaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ / tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam
athopatiṣṭhedādityaṃ mūrdhni puṣpānvitāñjalim / prakṣipyālokayed devamudvayaṃ tamasaspari
udutyaṃ citramityete taccakṣuriti mantrataḥ / haṃsaḥ śuciṣadetena sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ
anyaiśca vaidikairmantraiḥ sauraiḥ pāpapraṇāśanaiḥ / sāvitrīṃ vai japet paścājjapayajñaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
vividhāni pavitrāṇi guhyavidyāstathaiva ca / śatarudrīyamatharvaśiraḥ saurāṃśca śaktitaḥ
prākkūleṣu samāsīnaḥ kuśeṣu prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ / tiṣṭhaṃścedīkṣamāṇor'kaṃ japyaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
sphāṭikendrākṣarudrākṣaiḥ putrajīvasamudbhavaḥ / kartavyā tvakṣamālā syāduttarāduttamā smṛtā
japakāle na bhāṣeta nānyāni prekṣayed budhaḥ / na kampayecchirogrīvāṃ dantānnaiva prakāśayet
guhyakā rākṣasā siddhā haranti prasabhaṃ yataḥ / ekānte suśubhe deśe tasmājjapyaṃ samācaret
caṇḍālāśaucapatitān dṛṣṭvācamya punarjapet / taireva bhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā caiva japet punaḥ
ācamya prayato nityaṃ japedaśucidarśane / saurān mantrān śaktito vai pāvamānīstu kāmataḥ
yadi syāt klinnavāsā vai vārimadhyagato japet / anyathā tu śucau bhūmyāṃ darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ
pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvṛtya namaskṛtvā tataḥ kṣitau / ācamya ca yathāśāstraṃ śaktyā svādhyāyamācaret
tataḥ saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / adāvoṅkāramuccārya namo 'nte tarpayāmi vaḥ
devān brahmaḥṛṣīṃścaiva tarpayedakṣatodakaiḥ / tilodakaiḥ pitṝn bhaktyā svasūtroktavidhānataḥ
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu / devarṣostarpayed dhīmānudakāñjalibhiḥ pitan
yajñopavītī devānāṃ nivītī ṛṣītarpaṇe / prācīnāvītī pitrye tu svena tīrthena bhāvataḥ
niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu samācamya ca vāgyataḥ / svairmantrairarcayed devān puṣpaiḥ patrairathāmbubhiḥ
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sūryaṃ tathaiva madhusūdanam / anyāṃścābhimatān devān bhaktyā cākrodhano 'tvaraḥ
pradadyād vātha puṣpāṇi sūktena pauruṣeṇa tu / āpo vā devatāḥ sarvāstena samyak samarcitāḥ
dhyātvā praṇavapūrvaṃ vai daivatāni samāhitaḥ / namaskāreṇa puṣpāṇi vinyased vai pṛthak pṛthak
na viṣṇvārādhanāt puṇyaṃ vidyate karma vaidikam / tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ nityamārādhayeddharim
tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa sūktena puruṣeṇa tu / naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro sūktena puruṣeṇa tu / naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro vedeṣūktaścaturṣvapi
nivedayeta svātmānaṃ viṣṇāvamalatejasi / tadātmā tanmanāḥ śāntastadviṣṇoriti mantrataḥ
athavā devamīśānaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam / ārādhayenmahādevaṃ bhāvapūto maheśvaram
mantreṇa rudrāgāyatryā praṇavenātha vā punaḥ / īśānenātha vā rudraistryambakena samāhitaḥ
puṣpaiḥ patrairathādbhirvā candanādyairmaheśvaram / uktvā namaḥ śivāyeti mantreṇānena yojayet
namaskuryānmahādevaṃ ṛtaṃ satyamitiśvaram / nivedayīta svātmānaṃ yo brahmāṇamitīśvaram
pradakṣiṇaṃ dvijaḥ kuryāt pañca brahmāṇi vai japan / dhyāyīta devamīśānaṃ vyomamadhyagataṃ śivam
athāvalokayedarkaṃ haṃsaḥ suciṣadityṛcā / kuryāt pañca mahāyajñān gṛhaṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ
devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathaiva ca / mānuṣyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca pañca yajñān pracakṣate
yadi syāt tarpaṇādarvāk brahmayajñaḥ kṛto na hi / kṛtvā manuṣyayajñaṃ vai tataḥ svādhyāyamācaret
agneḥ paścimato deśe bhūtayajñānta eva vā / kuśapuñje samāsīnaḥ kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ
śālāgnau laukike vāgnau jale bhūbhyāmathāpivā / vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryād devayajñaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
yadi syāllaukike pakvaṃ tato 'nnaṃ tatra hūyate / śālāgnau tatra devānnaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
devebhyastu hutādannāccheṣād bhūtabaliṃ haret / bhūtayajñaḥ sa vai jñeyo bhūtidaḥ sarvadehinām
śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca patitādibhya eva ca / dadyād bhūmau baliṃ tvannaṃ pakṣibhyo 'tha dvijottamaḥ
sāyaṃ cānnasya siddhasya patnyamantraṃ baliṃ haret / bhūtayajñastvayaṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātarvidhīyate
ekaṃ tu bhojayed vipraṃ pitṝnuddiśya sattamam / nityaśrāddhaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ pitṛyajño gatipradaḥ
uddhṛtya vā yathāśakti kiñcidannaṃ samāhitaḥ / vedatattvārthaviduṣe dvijāyaivopapādayet
pūjayedatithiṃ nityaṃ namasyedarcayed dvijam / manovākkarmabhiḥ śāntamāgataṃ svagṛha tataḥ
hantakāramathāgraṃ vā bhikṣāṃ vā śaktito dvijaḥ / dadyādatithaye nityaṃ budhyeta parameśvaram
bhikṣāmāhurgrāsamātramagraṃ tasyāścaturguṇam / puṣkalaṃ hantakāraṃ tu taccaturguṇamucyate
godohamātraṃ kālaṃ vai pratīkṣyo hyatithiḥ svayam / abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayedatithiṃ yathā
bhikṣāṃ vai bhikṣave dadyād vidhivad brahmacāriṇe / dadyādannaṃ yathāśakti tvarthibhyo lobhavarjitaḥ
sarveṣāmapyalābhe tu annaṃ gobhyo nivedayet / bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vāgyato 'nnamakutsayan
akṛtvā tu dvijaḥ pañca mahāyajñān dvijottamāḥ / bhṛñjīta cet sa mūḍhātmā tiryagyoniṃ sagacchati
vedābhyāso 'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyā kṣamā / nāśayatyāśu pāpāni devānāmarcanaṃ tathā
yo mohādathavālasyādakṛtvā devatārcanam / bhuṅkte sa yāti narakān śūkareṣvabhijāyate
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kṛtvā karmāṇi vai dvijāḥ / bhuñjīta svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ sayāti paramāṃ gatim
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta sūryābhimukha eva vā / āsīnastvāsane śuddhe bhūmyāṃ pādau nidhāya tu
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhāḥ
pañcārdre bhojanaṃ kuryād bhūmau pātraṃ nidhāya tu / upavāsena tattulyaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ
upalipte śucau deśe pādau prakṣālya vai karau / ācamyārdrānano 'krodhaḥ pañcārdre bhojanaṃ caret
mahāvyahṛtibhistvannaṃ paridhāyodakena tu / amṛtopastaraṇamasītyāpośānakriyāṃ caret
svāhāpraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ prāṇāyādyāhutiṃ tataḥ / apānāya tato hutvā vyānāya tadanantaram
udānāya tataḥ kuryāt samānāyeti pañcamīm / vijñāya tattvameteṣāṃ juhuyādātmani dvijaḥ
śeṣamannaṃ yathākāmaṃ bhuñjītavyaṃ janairyutam / dhyātvā tanmanasā devamātmānaṃ vai prajāpatim
amṛtāpidhānamasītyupariṣṭādapaḥ pibet / ācāntaḥ punarācāmedāyaṃ gauriti mantrataḥ
drupadāṃ vā trirāvartya sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm / prāṇānāṃ granthirasītyālabhed hṛdayaṃ tataḥ
ācamyāṅguṣṭhamātreti pādāṅguṣṭhe 'tha dakṣiṇe / niḥ stravayed hastajalamūrdhvahastaḥ samāhitaḥ
hutānumantraṇaṃ kuryāt śraddhāyāmiti mantrataḥ / athākṣareṇa svātmānaṃ yojayed brahmaṇeti hi
sarveṣāmeva yāgānāmātmayāgaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ / yo 'nena vidhinā kuryāt sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ kṣayam
yajñopavītī bhuñjīta straggandhālaṅkṛtaḥ śuciḥ / sāyaṃprāparnāntarā vai saṃdhyāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
nādyāt sūryagrahāt pūrvamahni sāyaṃ śaśigrahāt / grahakāle ca nāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt tu muktayoḥ
mukte śaśini bhuñjīta yadi na syānmahāniśā / amuktayorastaṅgatayoradyād dṛṣṭvā pare 'hani
nāśnīyāt prekṣamāṇānāmapradāyaiva durmatiḥ / na yajñaśiṣṭādand vā na kruddho nānyamānasaḥ
ātmārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yasya ratyarthaṃ yasya maithunam / vṛtyarthaṃ yasya cādhītaṃ niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvitam
yadbhuṅkte veṣṭitaśirā yacca bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ / sopānatkaśca yad bhuṅkte sarvaṃ vidyāt tadāsuram
nārdharātre na madhyāhne nājīrṇe nārdravastradhṛk / na ca bhinnāsanagato na śayānaḥ sthito 'pi vā
na bhinnabhājane caiva na bhūmyāṃ na ca pāṇiṣu / nocchiṣṭo ghṛtamādadyānna mūrdhānaṃ spṛśedapi
na brahma kīrtayan vāpi na niḥ śeṣaṃ na bhāryayā / nāndhakāre na cākāśe na ca devālayādiṣu
naikavastrastu bhuñjīta na yānaśayanasthitaḥ / na pādukānirgato 'tha na hasan vilapannapi
bhuktvaivaṃ sukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmayet / itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedārthānupabṛṃhayet
tataḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta pūrvoktavidhinā dvijaḥ / āsīnastu japed devīṃ gāyatrīṃ paścimāṃ prati
na tiṣṭhati tu yaḥ purvāṃ nāste saṃdhyāṃ tu paścimām / sa śūdreṇa samo loke sarvadharmavivarjitaḥ
hutvāgniṃ vidhivanmantrairbhuktvā yajñāvaśiṣṭakam / sabhṛtyabāndhavajanaḥ svapecchuṣkapado niśi
nottarābhimukhaḥ svapyāt paścimābhimukho na ca / na cākāśe na nagno vā nāśucirnāsane kvacit
na śīrṇāyāṃ tu khaṭvāyāṃ śūnyāgāre na caiva hi / nānuvaṃśaṃ na pālāśe śayane vā kadācana
ityetadakhilenoktamahanyahani vai mayā / brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛtyajātamapavargaphalapradam
nāstikyādathavālasyāt brāhmaṇo na karoti yaḥ / sa yāti narakān ghorān kākayonau ca jāyate
nānyo vimuktaye panthā muktvāśramavidhiṃ svakam / tasmāt karmāṇi kurvota tuṣṭaye parameṣṭhinaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca atha śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ prāpya kāryaṃ dvijottamaiḥ / piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ bhaktyā bhuktimuktiphalapradam
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṣīṇe rājani śasyate / aparāhne dvijātīnāṃ praśastenāmiṣeṇa ca
pratipatprabhṛti hyanyāstithayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣake / caturdaśīṃ varjayitvā praśastā hyuttarottarāḥ
amāvāsyāṣṭakāstistraḥ pauṣamāsādiṣu triṣu / tistraścānvaṣṭakāḥ puṇyā māghī pañcadaśī tathā
trayodaśī maghāyuktā varṣāsu tu viśeṣataḥ / śasyāpākaśrāddhakālā nityāḥ proktā dine dine
naimittikaṃ tu kartavyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / bāndhavānāṃ ca maraṇe nārakī syādato 'nyathā
kāmyāni caiva śrāddhāni śasyānte grahaṇādiṣu / ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte 'pyanantakam
saṃkrāntyamakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā janmadineṣvapi / nakṣatreṣu ca sarveṣu kāryaṃ kāmyaṃ viśeṣataḥ
svargaṃ ca labhate kṛtvā kṛttikāsu dvijottamaḥ / apatyamatha rohiṇyāṃ saumye tu brahmavarcasam
raudrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhimārdrāyāṃ śauryameva ca / punarvasau tathā bhūmiṃ śriyaṃ puṣye tathaiva ca
sarvān kāmāṃstathā sārpe pitrye saubhāgyameva ca / aryamṇe tu dhanaṃ vindyāt phālgunyāṃ pāpanāśanam
