jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ tathā haste citrāyāṃ ca bahūn sutān / vāṇijyasiddhiṃ svātau tu viśākhāsu suvarṇakam
maitre bahūni mitrāṇi rājyaṃ śākre tathaiva ca / mūle kṛṣiṃ labhed yānasiddhimāpye samudrataḥ
sarvān kāmān vaiśvadeve śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu śravaṇe punaḥ / śraviṣṭhāyāṃ tathā kāmān vāruṇe ca paraṃ balam
ajaikapāde kupyaṃ syādahirbudhne gṛhaṃ śubham / revatyāṃ bahavo gāvo hyaśvinyāṃ turagāṃstathā / yāmye 'tha jīvanaṃ tat syādyadi śrāddhaṃ prayacchati
ādityavāre tvārogyaṃ candre saubhāgyameva ca / kauje sarvatra vijayaṃ sarvān kāmān budhasya tu
vidyāmabhīṣṭā jīve tu dhanaṃ vai bhārgave punaḥ / śamaiśvare labhedāyuḥ pratipatsu sutān śubhān
kanyakāṃ vai dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu vandinaḥ / paśūnkṣudrāṃścaturthyāṃ tu pañcamyāṃśobhanān sutān
ṣaṣṭyāṃ dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ cāpi saptamyāṃ labhate naraḥ / aṣṭamyāmapi vāṇijyaṃ labhate śrāddhadaḥ sadā
syānnavamyāmekakhuraṃ daśamyāṃ dvikhuraṃ bahu / ekādaśyāṃ tathā rūpyaṃ brahmavarcasvinaḥ sutān
dvādaśyāṃ jātarūpaṃ ca rajataṃ kupyameva ca / jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu kruprajāḥ / pañcadaśyāṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā
tasmācchrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ dvijātibhiḥ / śastreṇa tu hatānāṃ vai tatra śrāddhaṃ prakalpayet
dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃpattau na kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ / tasmād bhogāpavargārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryurdvijātayaḥ
karmārambheṣu sarveṣu kuryādābhyudayaṃ punaḥ / putrajanmādiṣu śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇaṃ parvaṇi smṛtam
ahanyahani nityaṃ syāt kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ punaḥ / ekoddiṣṭādi vijñeyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam
etat pañcavidhaṃ śrāddhaṃ manunā parikīrtitam / yātrāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamākhyātaṃ tatprayatnena pālayet
śuddhaye saptamaṃ śrāddhaṃ brahmaṇā paribhāṣitam / daivikaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ śrāddhaṃ yatkṛtvā mucyate bhayāt
saṃdhyārātryorna kartavyaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt / deśānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa bhavet puṇyamanantakam
gaṅgāyāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayāge 'marakaṇṭake / gāyanti pitaro gāthāṃ kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ / teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gāyāṃ vrajet
gayāṃ prāpyānuṣaṅgeṇa yadi śrāddhaṃ samācaret / tāritāḥ pitarastena sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
varāhaparvate caiva gaṅgāyāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ / vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yatra devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ
gaṅgādvāre prabhāse ca bilvake nīlaparvate / kurukṣetre ca kubjāmre bhṛgutuṅge mahālaye
kedāre phalgutīrthe ca naimiṣāraṇya eva ca / sarasvatyāṃ viśeṣeṇa puṣkareṣu viśeṣataḥ
narmadāyāṃ kuśāvarte śrīśaile bhadrakarṇake / vetravatyāṃ vipāśāyāṃ godāvaryāṃ viśeṣataḥ
evamādiṣu cānyeṣu tīrtheṣu pulineṣu ca / nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu tuṣyanti pitaraḥ sadā
vrīhibhiśca yavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalena vā / śyāmākaiśca yavaiḥ śākairnovāraiśca priyaṅgubhiḥ / gaudhūmaiśca tilairmudgairmāsaṃ prīṇayate pitṝn
āmrān pāne ratānikṣūn mṛdvīkāṃśca sadāḍimān / vidāryāśca bharaṇḍāśca śrāddhakāle prādapayet
lājān madhuyutān dadyāt saktūn śarkarayā saha / dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena śṛṅgāṭakakaśerukān
dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīn māsān hāriṇenatu / aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākuneneha pañca tu
ṣaṇmāsāṃśchāgamāṃsena pārṣatenātha sapta vai / aṣṭāveṇasya māṃsena rauraveṇa navaiva tu
daśamāsāṃstu tṛpyanti varāhamahiṣāmiṣaiḥ / śaśakūrmaryormāṃsena māsānekādaśaiva tu
saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena tu / vārdhroṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī
kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkaṃ khaṅgalohāmiṣaṃ madhu / ānantyāyaiva kalpante munyannāni ca sarvaśaḥ
krītvā labdhvā svayaṃ vātha mṛtānāhṛtya vā dvijaḥ / dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena tadasyākṣayamucyate
pippalīṃ kramukaṃ caiva tathā caiva masūrakam / kūṣmāṇḍālābuvārtākān bhūstṛṇaṃ surasaṃ tathā
kusumbhapiṇḍamūlaṃ vai tandulīyakameva ca / rājamāṣāṃstathā kṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ ca vivarjayet
kodravān kovidārāṃścapālakyān maricāṃstathā / varjayet sarvayatnena śrāddhakāle dvijottamaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca snātvā yathoktaṃ saṃtarpya pitṝṃścandrakṣaye dvijaḥ / piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt saumyamanāḥ śuciḥ
pūrvameva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam / tīrthaṃ tad havyakavyānāṃ pradāne cātithiḥ smṛtaḥ
ye somapā virajaso dharmajñāḥ śāntacetasaḥ / vratino niyamasthāśca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ
pañcāgnirapyadhīyāno yajurvedavideva ca / bahvṛcaśca trisauparṇastrimadhurvātha yo bhavet
triṇāciketacchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmaga eva ca / atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā rudrādhyāyī viśeṣataḥ
agnihotraparo vidvān nyāyavicca ṣaḍaṅgavit / mantrabrāhmaṇaviccaiva yaśca syād dharmapāṭhakaḥ
ṛṣivratī ṛṣīkaśca tathā dvādaśavārṣikaḥ / brahmadeyānusaṃtāno garbhaśuddhaḥ sahasradaḥ
cāndrāyaṇavratacaraḥ satyavādī purāṇavit / gurudevāgnipūjāsu prasakto jñānatatparaḥ
vimuktaḥ sarvato dhīro brahmabhūto dvijottamaḥ / mahādevārcanarato vaiṣṇavaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
ahiṃsānirato nityamapratigrahaṇastathā / satriṇo dānaniratā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
yuvānaḥ śrotriyāḥ svasthā mahāyajñaparāyaṇāḥ / sāvitrījāpaniratā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
kulīnāḥ śrutavantaśca śīlavantastapasvinaḥ / agnicitsnātakā viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
mātāpitrorhite yuktaḥ prātaḥ snāyī tathā dvijaḥ / adhyātmavinmunirdānto vijñeyaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
jñānaniṣṭho mahāyogī vedāntārthavicintakaḥ / śraddhāluḥ śrāddhanirato brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
vedavidyārataḥ snāto brahmacaryaparaḥ sadā / atharvaṇo mumukṣuśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
asamānapravarako hyasagotrastathaiva ca / asaṃbandhī ca vijñeyo brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
bhojayed yoginaṃ pūrvaṃ tattvajñānarataṃ yatim / alābhe naiṣṭhikaṃ dāntamupakurvāṇakaṃ tathā
tadalābhe gṛhasthaṃ tu mumukṣuṃ saṅgavarjitam / sarvālābhe sādhakaṃ vā gṛhasthamapi bhojayet
prakṛterguṇatattvajño yasyāśnāti yatirhaviḥ / phalaṃ vedavidāṃ tasya sahasrādatiricyate
tasmād yatnena yogīndramīśvarajñānatatparam / bhojayed havyakavyeṣu alābhāditarān dvijān
eṣa vai prathamaḥ kalpaḥ pridāne havyakavyayoḥ / anukalpastvayaṃ jñeyaḥ sadā sadbhiranuṣṭhitaḥ
mātāmahaṃ mātulaṃ ca svastrīyaṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum / dauhitraṃ viṭpatiṃ bandhumṛtvigyājyau ca bhojayet
na śrāddhe bhojayenmitraṃ dhanaiḥ kāryo 'sya saṃgrahaḥ / paiśācī dakṣiṇā sā hi naivāmutra phalapradā
kāma śrāddhe 'rcayenmitraṃ nābhirūpamapi tvarim / dviṣatā hi havirbhuktaṃ bhavati pretya niṣphalam
brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati / tasmai havyaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate
yatheriṇe bījamuptvā na vaptā labhate phalam / tathānṛce havirdattvā na dātā labhate phalam
yāvato grasate piṇḍān havyakavyeṣvamantravit / tāvato grasate pretya dīptān sthūlāṃstvayoguḍān
api vidyākulairyuktā hīnavṛttā narādhamāḥ / yatraite bhuñjate havyaṃ tad bhavedāsura dvijāḥ
yasya vedaśca vedī ca vicchidyete tripūruṣam / sa vai durbrāhmaṇo nārhaḥ śrāddhādiṣu kadācana
śūdrapreṣyo bhṛto rājño vṛṣalo grāmayājakaḥ / badhabandhopajīvī ca ṣaḍete brahmabandhavaḥ
dattānuyogān vṛtyarthaṃ patitān manurabravīt / vedavikrāyiṇo hyete śrāddhādiṣu vigarhitāḥ
śrutivikrayiṇo ye tu parapūrvāsamudbhavāḥ / asamānān yājayanti patitāste prakīrtitāḥ
asaṃskṛtādhyāpakā ye bhṛtyā vādhyāpayanti ye / adhīyate tathā vedān patitāste prakīrtitāḥ
vṛddhaśrāvakanirgranthāḥ pañcarātravido janāḥ / kāpālikāḥ pāśupatāḥ pāṣaṇḍā ye ca tadvidhāḥ
yasyāśnanti havīṃṣyete durātmānastu tāmasāḥ / na tasya tad bhavecchrāddhaṃ pretya ceha phalapradam
anāśramo yo dvijaḥ syādāśramī vā nirarthakaḥ / mithyāśramī ca te viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktidūṣakāḥ
duścarmā kunakhī kuṣṭhī śvitrī ca śyāvadantakaḥ / viddhaprajananaścaiva stenaḥ klībo 'tha nāstikaḥ
madyapo vṛṣalīsakto vīrahā didhiṣūpatiḥ / āgāradāhī kuṇḍāśī somavikrayiṇo dvijāḥ
parivettā tathā hiṃstraḥ parivittirnirākṛtiḥ / paunarbhavaḥ kusīdī ca tathā nakṣatradarśakaḥ
gītavāditranirato vyādhitaḥ kāṇa eva ca / hīnāṅgaścātiriktāṅgo hyavakīrṇistathaiva ca
kanyādūṣī kuṇḍagolau abhiśasto 'tha devalaḥ / mitradhruk piśunaścaiva nityaṃ bhāryānuvartakaḥ
mātāpitrorgurostyāgī dāratyāgī tathaiva ca / gotrabhid bhraṣṭaśaucaśca kāṇḍaspṛṣṭastathaiva ca
anapatyaḥ kūṭasākṣī yācako raṅgajīvakaḥ / samudrayāyī kṛtahā tathā samayabhedakaḥ
devanindāparaścaiva vedanindāratastathā / dvijanindārataścaite varjyāḥ śrāddhādikarmasu
kṛtaghnaḥ piśunaḥ krūro nāstiko vedanindakaḥ / mitradhruk kuhakaścaiva viśeṣāt paṅktidūṣakāḥ
sarve punarabhojyānnāstvadānārhāśca karmasu / brahmabhāvanirastāśca varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
śūdrānnarasapuṣṭāṅgaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitaḥ / mahāyajñavihīnaśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ
adhītanāśanaścaiva snānahomavivarjitaḥ / tāmaso rājasaścaiva brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ
bahunātra kimuktena vihitān ye na kurvate / ninditānācarantyete varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāya in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca gomayenodakairbhūmiṃ śodhayitvā samāhitaḥ / saṃnipātya dvijān sarvān sādhubhiḥ saṃnimantrayet
śvo bhaviṣyati me śrāddhaṃ pūrvedyurabhipūjya ca / asaṃbhave paredyurvā yathoktairlakṣaṇairyutān
tasya te pitaraḥ śrutvā śrāddhakālamupasthitam / anyonyaṃ manasā dhyātvā saṃpatanti manojavāḥ
brāhmaṇaiste sahāśnanti pitaro hyantarikṣagāḥ / vāyubhūtāstu tiṣṭhanti bhuktvā yānti parāṃ gatim
āmantritāśca te viprāḥ śrāddhakāla upasthite / vaseyurniyatāḥ sarve brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ
akrodhano 'tvaro 'mattaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ / bhāraṃ maithunamadhvānaṃ śrāddhakṛd varjayejjapam
āmantrito brāhmaṇo vā yo 'nyasmai kurute kṣaṇam / sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sūkaratvāṃ prāyāti ca
āmantrayitvā yo mohādanyaṃ cāmantrayed dvijam / sa tasmādadhikaḥ pāpī viṣṭhākīṭo 'bhijāyate
śrāddhe nimantrito vipro maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati / brahmahatyāmavāpnoti tiryagyonau ca jāyate
nimantritastu yo vipro hyadhvānaṃ yāti durmatiḥ / bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ pāṃśubhojanāḥ
nimantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe prakuryāt kalahaṃ dvijaḥ / bhavanti tasya tanmāsaṃ pitaro malabhojanāḥ
tasmānnimantritaḥ śrāddhe niyatātmā bhaved dvijaḥ / akrodhanaḥ śaucaparaḥ kartā caiva jitendriyaḥ
śvobhūte dakṣiṇāṃ gatvā diśaṃ darbhān samāhitaḥ / samūlānāhared vāri dakṣiṇāgrān sunirmalān
dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ vibhaktaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam / śuciṃ deśaṃ viviktaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet
nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu svabhūmau caiva sānuṣu / vivikteṣu ca tuṣyanti dattena pitaraḥ sadā
pārakye bhūmibhāge tu pitṝṇāṃ naiva nirvapet / svāmibhistad vihanyeta mohād yat kriyate naraiḥ
aṭavyaḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca / sarvāṇyasvāmikānyāhurna hi teṣu parigrahaḥ
tilān pravikiret tatra sarvato bandhayedajān / asuropahataṃ sarvaṃ tilaiḥ śuddhyatyajena vā
tato 'nnaṃ bahusaṃskāraṃ naikavyañjanamacyutam / coṣyapeyasamṛddhaṃ ca yathāśaktyā prakalpayet
tato nivṛtte madhyāhne luptalomanakhān dvijān / abhigamya yathāmārgaṃ prayacched dantadhāvanam
tailamabhyañjanaṃ snānaṃ snānīyaṃ ca pṛthagvidham / pātrairaudumbarairdadyād vaiśvadaivatyapūrvakam
tataḥ snātvā nivṛttebhyaḥ pratyutthāyakṛtāñjaliḥ / pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca saṃprayacched yathākramam
ye cātra viśvedevānāṃ viprāḥ pūrvaṃ nimantritāḥ / prāṅmukhānyāsanānyeṣāṃ tridarbhopahitāni ca
dakṣiṇāmukhayuktāni pitṝṇāmāsanāni ca / dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi prokṣitāni tilodakaiḥ
teṣūpaveśayedetānāsanaṃ spṛśya sa dvijam / āsadhvamiti saṃjalpan āsanāste pṛthak pṛthak
dvau daive prāṅmukhau pitrye trayaścodaṅmukhāstathā / ekaikaṃ vā bhavet tatra devamātāmaheṣvapi
satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca śaucaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadam / pañcaitān vistaro hanti tasmānneheta vistaram
api vā bhojayedekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam / śrutaśīlādisaṃpannamalakṣaṇavivarjitam
uddhṛtya pātre cānnaṃ tat sarvasmāt prakṛtāt punaḥ / devatāyatane cāsmai nivedyānyatpravartayet
prāsyedagnau tadannaṃ tu dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe / tasmādekamapi śreṣṭhaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ bhojayed dvijam
bhikṣuko brahmacārī vā bhojanārthamupasthitaḥ / upaviṣṭeṣu yaḥ śrāddhe kāmaṃ tamapi bhojayet
atithiryasya nāśnāti na tacchrāddhaṃ praśasyate / tasmāt prayatnācchrāddheṣu pūjyā hyatithayo dvijaiḥ
ātithyarahite śrāddhe bhuñjate ye dvijātayaḥ / kākayoniṃ vrajantyete dātā caiva na saṃśayaḥ
hīnāṅgaḥ patitaḥ kuṣṭhī vraṇī pukkasanāstikau / kukkuṭāḥ śūkarāḥ śvāno varjyāḥ śrāddheṣu dūrataḥ
bībhatsumaśuciṃ nagnaṃ mattaṃ dhūrtaṃ rajasvalām / nīlakāṣāyavasanaṃ pāṣaṇḍāṃśca vivarjayet
yat tatra kriyate karma paitṛkaṃ brāhmaṇān prati / tatsarvameva kartavyaṃ vaiśvadaivatyapūrvakam
yathopaviṣṭān sarvāṃstānalaṅkuryād vibhūṣaṇaḥ / stragdāmabhiḥ śiroveṣṭairdhūpavāso 'nulepanaiḥ
tatastvāvāhayed devān brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā / udaṅmukho yathānyāyaṃ viśve devāsa ityṛcā
dve pavitre gṛhītvātha bhājane kṣālite punaḥ / śaṃ no devyā jalaṃ kṣiptvā yavo 'sīti yavāṃstathā
yā divyā iti mantraṇa haste tvarghaṃ vinikṣipet / pradadyād gandhamālyāni dhūpādīni ca śaktitaḥ
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryāduśantastvetyṛcā budhaḥ
āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyantu nastataḥ / śaṃ no devyodakaṃ pātre tilo 'sīti tilāṃstathā
kṣiptvā cārghaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ dattvā hasteṣu vai punaḥ / saṃstravāṃśca tataḥ sarvān pātre kuryāt samāhitaḥ / pitṛbhyaḥ sthānametena nyubjaṃ pātraṃ nidhāpayet
agnau kariṣyetyādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutam / kuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto juhuyādupavītavān
yajñopavītinā homaḥ kartavyaḥ kuśapāṇinā / prācīnāvītinā pitryaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ tu homavat
dakṣiṇaṃ pātayejjānuṃ devān paricaran pumān / pitṛṇāṃ paricaryāsu pātayeditaraṃ tathā
somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā nama iti bruvan / agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadheti juhuyāt tataḥ
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāvevopapādayet / mahādevāntike vātha goṣṭhe vā susamāhitaḥ
tatastairabhyanujñāto gatvā vai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / gomayenopatipyorvoṃ sthānaṃ kṛtvā tu saikatam
maṇḍalaṃ caturastraṃ vā dakṣiṇāvanataṃ śubham / trirullikhet tasya madhyaṃ darbheṇaikena caiva hi
tataḥ saṃstīrya tatsthāne darbhān vaidakṣiṇāgrakān / trīn piṇḍān nirvapet tatra haviḥ śeṣātsamāhitaḥ
nyupya piṇḍāṃstu taṃ hastaṃ nimṛjyāllepabhāginām / teṣu darbheṣvathācamya trirāyamya śanairasūn / tadannaṃ tu namaskuryāt pitṝneva ca mantravit
udakaṃ ninayeccheṣaṃ śanaiḥ piṇḍāntike punaḥ / avajighrecca tān piṇḍān yathānyuptān samāhitaḥ
atha piṇḍāvaśiṣṭānnaṃ vidhinā bhojayed dvijān / māṃsānyapūpān vividhān dadyāt kṛsarapāyasam
sūpaśākaphalānīkṣūn payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu / annaṃ caiva yathākāmaṃ vividhaṃ bhakṣyapeyakam
yad yadiṣṭaṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ tatsarvaṃ vinivedayet / dhānyāṃstilāṃśca vividhān śarkarā vividhāstathā
uṣṇamannaṃ dvijātibhyo dātavyaṃ śreya icchatā / anyatra phalamūlebhyaḥ pānakebhyastathaiva ca
nāśrūṇi pātayejjātu na kupyennānṛtaṃ vadet / na pādena spṛśedannaṃ na caitadavadhūnayet
krodhena caiva yat dattaṃ yad bhuktaṃ tvarayā punaḥ / yātudhānā vilumpanti jalpatā copapāditam
svinnagātro na tiṣṭheta sannidhau tu dvijanmanām / na cātra śyenakākādīn pakṣiṇaḥ pratiṣedhayet / tadrūpāḥ pitarastatra samāyānti bubhukṣavaḥ
na dadyāt tatra hastena pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ tathā / na cāyasena pātreṇa na caivāśraddhayā punaḥ
kāñcanena tu pātreṇa rājataudumbareṇa vā / dattamakṣayatāṃ yāti khaḍgena ca viśeṣataḥ
pātre tu mṛṇmaye yo vai śrāddhe bhojayate pitan / sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ bhoktā caiva purodhasaḥ
na paṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadyānna yācenna ca dāpayet / yācitā dāpitā dātā narakān yānti dāruṇān
bhuñjīran vāgyatāḥ śiṣṭā na brūyuḥ prākṛtān guṇān / tāvaddhi pitaro 'śnanti yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ
nāgrāsanopaviṣṭastu bhuñjota prathamaṃ dvijaḥ / bahūnāṃ paśyatāṃ so 'jñaḥ paṅktyā harati kilbiṣam
na kiñcid varjayecchrāddhe niyuktastu dvijottamaḥ / na māṃsaṃ pratiṣedheta na cānyasyānnamīkṣayet
yo nāśnāti dvijo māṃsaṃ niyuktaḥ pitṛkarmaṇi / sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavānekaviṃśatim
svādhyāyaṃ śrāvayedeṣāṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi / itihāsapurāṇāni śrāddhakalpāṃśca śobhanān
tato 'nnamutsṛjed bhukte agrato vikiran bhuvi / pṛṣṭvā tṛptāḥ stha ityevaṃ tṛptānācāmayet tataḥ
ācāntānanujānīyādabhito ramyatāmiti / svadhāstviti ca taṃ brūyurbrāhmaṇāstadanantaram
tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣāmannaśeṣaṃ nivedayet / yathā brūyustathā kuryādanujñātastu vai dvijaiḥ
pitrye svadita ityeva vākyaṃ goṣṭheṣu sūnṛtam / saṃpannamityabhyudaye daive rocata ityapi
visṛjya brāhmaṇāṃstān vai daivapūrvaṃ tu vāgyataḥ / dakṣiṇāṃ diśamākāṅ kṣanyācetemān varān pitṝn
dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatireva ca / śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca nosttviti
piṇḍāṃstu go 'javiprebhyo dadyādagnau jale 'pi vā / madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ piṇḍamadyāt patnī sutārthinī
prakṣālya hastāvācamya jñātīn śeṣeṇa toṣayet / jñātiṣvapi catuṣṭeṣu svān bhṛtyān bhojayot tataḥ / paścāt svayaṃ ca patnībhiḥ śeṣamannaṃ samācaret
nodvāsayet taducchiṣṭaṃ yāvannāstaṅgato raviḥ / brahmacārī bhavetāṃ tu dampatī rajanīṃ tu tām
dattvā śrāddhaṃ tathā bhuktvā sevate yastu maithunam / mahārauravamāsādya kīṭayoniṃ vrajet punaḥ
śucirakrodhanaḥ śāntaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ / svādhyāyaṃ ca tathādhvānaṃ kartā bhoktā ca varjayet
śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā paraśrāddhaṃ bhuñjate ye dvijātayaḥ / mahāpātikibhistulyā yānti te narakān bahūn
eṣa vo vihitaḥ samyak śrāddhakalpaḥ sanātanaḥ / āmena vartayennityamudāsīno 'tha tattvavit
anagniradhvago vāpi tathaiva vyasanānvitaḥ / āmaśrāddhaṃ dvijaḥ kuryād vidhijñaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ / tenāgnau karaṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍāṃstenaiva nirvapet
yo 'nena vidhinā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt saṃyatamānasaḥ / vyapetakalpaṣo nityaṃ yogināṃ vartate padam
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryād dvijottamaḥ / ārādhito bhavedīśastena samyak sanātanaḥ
api mūlairphalairvāpi prakuryānnirdhano dvijaḥ / tilodakaistarpayed vā pitṝn snātvā samāhitaḥ
na jīvatpitṛko dadyāddhomāntaṃ cābhidhīyate / yeṣāṃ vāpi pitā dadyāt teṣāṃ caike pracakṣate
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ / yo yasya mriyate tasmai deyaṃ nānyasya tena tu
bhojayed vāpi jīvantaṃ yathākāmaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ / na jīvantamatikramya dadāti śrūyate śrutiḥ
dvyāmuṣyāyaṇiko dadyād bījikṣetrikayoḥ samam / ṛkyādardhaṃ samādadyānniyogotpādito yadi
aniyuktaḥ suto yaśca śulkato jāyate tviha / pradadyād bījine piṇḍaṃ kṣetriṇe tu tato 'nyathā
dvau piṇḍau nirvapet tābhyāṃ kṣetriṇe bījine tathā / kīrtayedatha caikasmin bījinaṃ kṣetriṇaṃ tataḥ
mṛtāhani tu kartavyamekodiṣṭaṃ vidhānataḥ / aśauce sve parikṣīṇe kāmyaṃ vai kāmataḥ punaḥ
pūrvāhne caiva kartavyaṃ śrāddhamabhyudayārthinā / devavatsarvameva syād yavaiḥ kāryā tilakriyā
darbhāśca ṛjavaḥ kāryā yugmān vai bhojayed dvijān / nāndīmukhāstu pitaraḥ prīyantāmiti vācayet
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tu pūrvaṃ syāt pitṝṇāṃ syādanantaram / tato mātāmahānāṃ tu vṛddhau śrāddhatrayaṃ smṛtam
davapūrvaṃ pradadyād vai na kuryādapradakṣiṇam / prāṅmukho nirvapet piṇḍānupavītī samāhitaḥ
pūrvaṃ tu mātaraḥ pūjyā bhaktyā vai sagaṇeśvarāḥ / sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu pratimāsu dvijātiṣu
puṣperdhūpaiśca naivedyairgandhādyairbhūṣaṇairapi / pūjayitvā mātṛgaṇaṃ kūryācchrāddhatrayaṃ budhaḥ
akṛtvā mātṛyāgaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet / tasya krodhasamāviṣṭā hiṃsāmicchanti mātaraḥ

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca daśāhaṃ prāhurāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vipaścitaḥ / mṛteṣu vātha jāteṣu brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ
nityāni caiva karmāṇi kāmyāni ca viśeṣataḥ / nakuryād vihitaṃ kiñcit svādhyāyaṃ manasāpica
śucīnakrodhanān bhūmyān śālāgnau bhāvayed dvijān / śuṣkānnena phalairvāpi vaitānaṃ juhuyāt tathā
na spṛśeyurimānanye na ca tebhyaḥ samāharet / caturthe pañcame vāhni saṃsparśaḥ kathito budhaiḥ
sūtake tu sapiṇḍānāṃ saṃsparśo na praduṣyati / sūtakaṃ sūtikāṃ caiva varjayitvā nṛṇāṃ punaḥ
adhīyānastathā yajvā vedavicca pitā bhavet / saṃspṛśyāḥ sarva evaite snānānmātā daśāhataḥ
daśāhaṃ nirguṇe proktamaśaucaṃ cātinirguṇe / ekadvitriguṇairyuktaṃ catustryekadinaiḥ śuciḥ
daśāhāt tu paraṃ samyagadhīyīta juhoti ca / caturthe tasya saṃsparśaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ
kriyāhīnasya mūrkhasya mahārogiṇa eva ca / yatheṣṭācaraṇasyāhurmaraṇāntamaśauvakam
trirātraṃ daśarātraṃ vā brāhmaṇānāmaśaucakam / prāksaṃskārāt trirātraṃ syāt tasmādūrdhvaṃ daśāhakam
ūnadvivārṣike prete mātāpitrostadiṣyate / trirātreṇa śucistvanyo yadi hyatyantanirguṇaḥ
adantajātamaraṇe pitrorekāhamiṣyate / jātadante trirātraṃ syād yadi syātāṃ tu nirguṇau
ādantajananāt sadya ācaulādekarātrakam / trirātramaupanayanāt sapiṇḍānāmudāhṛtam
jātamātrasya bālasya yadi syānmaraṇaṃ pituḥ / mātuśca sūtakaṃ tat syāt pitā syāt spṛśya eva ca
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ kartavyaṃ sodarasya ca / ūrdhvaṃ daśāhādekāhaṃ sodaro yadi nirguṇaḥ
athordhvaṃ dantajananāt sapiṇḍānāmaśaucakam / ekarātraṃ nirguṇānāṃ cailādūrdhvaṃ trirātrakam
adantajātamaraṇaṃ saṃbhaved yadi sattamāḥ / ekarātraṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ yadi te 'tyantanirguṇāḥ
vratādeśāt sapiṇḍānāmarvāk snānaṃ vidhīyate / sarveṣāmeva guṇināmūrdhvaṃ tu viṣamaṃ punaḥ
arvāk ṣaṇmāsataḥ strīṇāṃ yadi syād garbhasaṃstravaḥ / tadā māsasamaistāsāmaśaucaṃ divasaiḥ smṛtam
tata ūrdhvaṃ tu patane strīṇāṃ dvādaśarātrikam / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ garbhastrāvācca vā tataḥ
garbhacyutāvahorātraṃ sapiṇḍe 'tyantanirguṇe / yatheṣṭācaraṇe jñātau trirātramiti niścayaḥ
yadi syāt sūtake sūtirmaraṇe vā mṛtirbhavet / śeṣeṇaiva bhavecchuddhirahaḥ śeṣe trirātrakam
maraṇotpattiyoge tu maraṇācchuddhiriṣyate / aghavṛddhimadāśaucamūrghvaṃ cet tena śudhyati
atha cet pañcamīrātrimatītya parato bhavet / aghavṛddhimadāśaucaṃ tadā pūrveṇa śudhyati
deśāntaragataṃ śrutvā sūtakaṃ śāvameva tu / tāvadaprayato martyo yāvaccheṣaḥ samāpyate
atīte sūtake proktaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātrakam / tathaiva maraṇe snānamūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarād yadi
vedāntaviccādhīyāno yo 'gnimān vṛttikarṣitaḥ / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ bhavet tasya sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā
strīṇāmasaṃskṛtānāṃ tu pradānāt pūrvataḥ sadā / sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātraṃ syāt saṃskāre bhartureva hi
ahastvadattakanyānāmaśaucaṃ maraṇe smṛtam / ūnadvivarṣānmaraṇe sadyaḥ śaucamudāhṛtam
ādantāt sodare sadya ācaulādekarātrakam / āpradānāt trirātraṃ syād daśarātramataḥ param
mātāmahānāṃ maraṇe trirātraṃ syādaśaucakam / ekodakānāṃ maraṇe sūtake caitadeva hi
pakṣiṇī yonisambandhe bāndhaveṣu tathaiva ca / ekarātraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ gurau sabrahmacāriṇi
prete rājani sajyotiryasya syād viṣaye sthitiḥ / gṛhe mṛtāsu dattāsu kanyakāsu tryahaṃ pituḥ
parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu putreṣu kṛtakeṣu ca / trirātraṃ syāt tathācārye svabhāryāsvanyagāsu ca
ācāryaputre patnyāṃ ca ahorātramudāhṛtam / ekāhaṃ syādupādhyāye svagrāme śrotriye 'pi ca
trirātramasapiṇḍeṣu svagṛhe saṃsthiteṣu ca / ekāhaṃ cāsvavarye syādekarātraṃ tadiṣyate
trirātraṃ śvaśrūmaraṇe śvaśure vai tadeva hi / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sagotre saṃsthite sati
śuddhyed vipro daśāhena dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ / vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudyati
kṣatraviṭśūdradāyādā ye syurviprasya bāndhavāḥ / teṣāmaśauce viprasya daśāhācchuddhiriṣyate
rājanyavaiśyāvapyevaṃ hīnavarṇāsu yoniṣu / svameva śaucaṃ kuryātāṃ viśuddhyarthamasaṃśayam
sarve tūttaravarṇānāmaśaucaṃ kuryurādṛtāḥ / tadvarṇavidhidṛṣṭena svaṃ tu śaucaṃ svayoniṣu
ṣaḍrātraṃ vā trirātraṃ syādekarātraṃ krameṇa hi / vaiśyakṣatriyaviprāṇāṃ śūdreṣvāśaucameva tu
ardhamāso 'tha ṣaḍrātraṃ trirātraṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ / śūdrakṣatriyaviprāṇāṃ vaiśyeṣvāśaucamiṣyate
ṣaḍrātraṃ vai daśāhaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ / aśaucaṃ kṣatriye proktaṃ krameṇa dvijapuṅgavāḥ
śūdraviṭkṣatriyāṇāṃ tu brāhmaṇe saṃsthite sati / daśarātreṇa śuddhiḥ syādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ
asapiṇḍaṃ dvijaṃ pretaṃ vipro nirhṛtya bandhuvat / aśitvā ca sahoṣitvā daśarātreṇa śudhyati
yadyannamatti teṣāṃ tu trirātreṇa tataḥ śuciḥ / anadannannamahnaiva na ca tasmin gṛhe vaset
sodakeṣvetadeva syānmāturāpteṣu bandhuṣu / daśāhena śavasparśe sapiṇḍaścaiva śudhyati
yadi nirharati pretaṃ prolabhākrāntamānasaḥ / daśāhena dvijaḥ śudhyed dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ
ardhamāsena vaiśyastu śūdro māsena śudhyati / ṣaḍrātreṇāthavā sarve trirātreṇāthavā punaḥ
anāthaṃ caiva nirhṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ dhanavarjitam / snātvā saṃprāśya tu ghṛtaṃ śudhyanti brāhmaṇādayaḥ
avaraśced varaṃ varṇamavaraṃ vā varo yadi / aśauce saṃspṛśet snehāt tadāśaucena śudhyati
pretībhūtaṃ dvijaṃ vipro yo 'nugacchata kāmataḥ / snātvā sacailaṃ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati
ekāhāt kṣatriye śuddhirvaiśye syācca dvyahena tu / śūdre dinatrayaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaśataṃ punaḥ
anasthisaṃcite śūdre rauti ced brāhmaṇaḥ svakaiḥ / trirātraṃ syāt tathāśaucamekāhaṃ tvanyathā smṛtam
asthisaṃcayanādarvāgekāhaṃ kṣatravaiśyayoḥ / anyathā caiva sajyotirbrāhmaṇe snānameva tu
anasthisaṃcit vipre brāhmaṇo rauti cet tadā / snānenaiva bhavecchuddhiḥ sacailena na saṃśayaḥ
yastaiḥ sahāśanaṃ kuryācchayanādīni caiva hi / bāndhavo vāparo vāpi sa daśāhena śudhyati
yasteṣāmannamaśnāti sakṛdevāpi kāmataḥ / tadāśauce nivṛtte 'sau snānaṃ kṛtvā viśudhyati
yāvattadannamaśnāti durbhikṣopahato naraḥ / tāvantyahānyaśaucaṃ syāt prāyaścittaṃ tataścaret
dāhādyaśaucaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijānāmagnihotriṇām / sapiṇḍānāṃ tu maraṇe maraṇāditareṣu ca
sapiṇḍatā ca puruṣe saptame vinivartate / samānodakabhāvastu janmanāmnoravedane
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ / lepabhājastrayaścātmā sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣaṇ
aprattānāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣam / ūḍhānāṃ bhartusāpiṇḍyaṃ prāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ
ye caikajātā bahavo bhinnayonaya eva ca / bhinnavarṇāstu sāpiṇḍyaṃ bhavet teṣāṃ tripūruṣam
kāravaḥ śilpino vaidyā dāsīdāsāstathaiva ca / dātāro niyamī caiva brahmavidbrahmacāriṇau
satriṇo vratinastāvat sadyaḥ śaucā udāhṛtāḥ / rājā caivābhiṣiktaśca prāṇasatriṇa eva ca
yajñe vivāhakāle ca devayāge tathaiva ca / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ durbhikṣe cāpyupadrave
ḍimbāhavahatānāṃ ca vidyutā pārthivairdvijaiḥ / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ sarpādimaraṇe tathā
agnau maruprapatane vīrādhvanyapyanāśake / brāhmaṇārthe ca saṃnyaste sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate
naiṣṭhikānāṃ vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām / nāśaucaṃ kīrtyate sadbhiḥ patite ca tathā mṛte
patitānāṃ na dāhaḥ syānnāntyeṣṭirnāsthisaṃcayaḥ / na cāśrupātapiṇḍau vā kāryaṃ śrāddhādi kaṅkvacit
vyāpādayet tathātmānaṃ svayaṃ yo 'gniviṣādibhiḥ / vihitaṃ tasya nāśaucaṃ nāgnirnāpyudakādikam
atha kaścit pramādena mriyate 'gniviṣādibhiḥ / tasyāśaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kāryaṃ caivodakādikam
jāte kumāre tadahaḥ kāmaṃ kuryāt pratigraham / hiraṇyadhānyagovāsastilānnaguḍasarpiṣām
phalāni puṣpaṃ śākaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ kāṣṭhameva ca / toyaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailamauṣadhaṃ kṣīrameva ca / āśaucināṃ gṛhād grāhyaṃ śuṣkānnaṃ caiva nityaśaḥ
āhitāgniryathānyāyaṃ dagdhavyastribhiragnibhiḥ / anāhitāgnirgṛhyeṇa laukikenetaro janaḥ
dehābhāvāt palāśaistu kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ punaḥ / dāhaḥ kāryo yathānyāyaṃ sapiṇḍaiḥ śraddhayānvitaiḥ
sakṛtprasiñcantyudakaṃ nāmagotreṇa vāgyatāḥ / daśāhaṃ bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarve caivārdravāsasaḥ
piṇḍaṃ pratidinaṃ dadyuḥ sāyaṃ prātaryathāvidhi / pretāya ca gṛhadvāri caturthe bhojayed dvijān
dvitīye 'hani kartavyaṃ kṣurakarma sabāndhavaiḥ / caturthe bāndhavaiḥ sarvairasthanāṃ saṃcayanaṃ bhavet / pūrvaṃ tu bhojayed viprānayugmān śraddhayā śucīn
pañcame navame caiva tathaivaikādaśe 'hani / ayugmān bhojayed viprān navaśrāddhaṃ tu tadviduḥ
ekādaśe 'hni kurvota pretamuddiśya bhāvataḥ / dvādaśe vātha kartavyamanindye tvathavāhani / ekaṃ pavitramekor'ghaḥ piṇḍapātraṃ tathaiva ca
evaṃ mṛtāhni kartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram / sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ pūrṇe saṃvatsare punaḥ
kuryāccatvāri pātrāṇi pretādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ / pretārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pātramāsecayet tataḥ
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ piṇḍānapyevameva hi / sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ devapūrvaṃ vidhīyate
pitṝnāvāhayet tatra punaḥ pretaṃ ca nirdiśet / ye sapiṇḍīkṛtāḥ pretāna teṣāṃ syāt pṛthakkriyāḥ / yastu kuryāt pṛthak piṇḍaṃ pitṛhā so 'bhijāyate
mṛte pitari vai putraḥ piṇḍamabdaṃ samācaret / dadyāccānnaṃ sodakumbhaṃ pratyahaṃ pretadharmataḥ
pārvaṇena vidhānena saṃvatsarikamiṣyate / pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
mātāpitroḥ sutaiḥ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānādikaṃ ca yat / patnī kuryāt sutābhāve patnya bhāve sahodahaḥ
anenaiva vidhāne jīvan vā śrāddhamācaret / kṛtvā dānādikaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ
eṣa vaḥ kathitaḥ samyag gṛhasthānāṃ kriyāvidhiḥ / strīṇāṃ tu bhartṛśuśrūṣā dharmo nānya iheṣyate
svadharmaparamo nityamīśvirārpitamānasaḥ / prāpnoti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ yaduktaṃ vedavādibhiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca agnihotraṃ tu juhuyādādyante 'harniśoḥ sadā / darśena caiva pakṣānte paurṇamāsena caiva hi
śasyānte navaśasyeṣṭyā tathartvante dvijo 'dhvaraiḥ / paśunā tvayanasyānte samānte saumikairmakhaiḥ
nāniṣṭvā navaśasyeṣṭyā paśunā vāgnimān dvijaḥ / navānnamadyānmāṃsaṃ vā dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ
navenānnena cāniṣṭvā paśuhavyena cāganyaḥ / prāṇānevāttumicchanti navānnāmiṣagṛddhinaḥ
sāvitrān śāntihomāṃśca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ / pitṝṃścaivāṣṭakāsvarcan nityamanvaṣṭakāsu ca
eṣa dharmaḥ paro nityamapadharmo 'nya ucyate / trayāṇāmiha varṇānāṃ gṛhasthāśramavāsinām
nāstikyādathavālasyād yo 'gnīn nādhātumicchati / yajeta vā na yajñena sa yāti narakān bahūn
tāmistramandhatāmistraṃ mahārauravarauravau / kumbhīpākaṃ vaitaraṇīmasipatravanaṃ tathā
anyāṃśca narakān ghorān saṃprāpyānte sudurmatiḥ / antyajānāṃ kule viprāḥ śūdrayonau ca jāyate
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇo hi viśeṣataḥ / ādhāyāgniṃ viśuddhātmā yajeta parameśvaram
agnihotrāt paro dharmo dvijānāṃ neha vidyate / tasmādārādhayennityamagnihotreṇa śāśvatam
yaścādhāyāgnimālasyānna yaṣṭuṃ devamicchati / so 'sau mūḍho na saṃbhāṣyaḥ kiṃ punarnāstiko janaḥ
yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati
eṣa vai sarvayajñānāṃ somaḥ prathama iṣyate / somenārādhayed devaṃ somalokamaheśvaram
na somayāgādadhiko maheśārādhane kratuḥ / samo vā vidyate tasmāt somenābhyarcayet param
pitāmahena viprāṇāmādāvabhihitaḥ śubhaḥ / dharmo vimuktaye sākṣācchrautaḥ smārto dvidhā punaḥ
śrautastretāgnisaṃbandhāt smārtaḥ pūrvaṃ mayoditaḥ / śreyaskaratamaḥ śrautastasmācchrautaṃ samācaret
ubhāvabhihitau dharmau vedādeva viniḥ sṛtau / śiṣṭācārastṛtīyaḥ syācchratismṛtyoralābhataḥ
dharmeṇābhigato yaistu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ / te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā nityamātmaguṇānvitāḥ
teṣāmabhimato yaḥ syāccetasā nityameva hi / sa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ sadbhirnānyeṣāmiti dhāraṇā
purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca vedānāmupabṛṃhaṇam / ekasmād brahmavijñānaṃ dharmajñānaṃ tathaikataḥ
dharmaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ tatpramāṇataraṃ smṛtam / dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ tad brahmajñāne parā pramā
nānyato jāyate dharmo brahmavidyā ca vaidikī / tasmād dharmaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śraddhātavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca eṣa vo 'bhihitaḥ kṛtsno gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ / dvijāteḥ paramo dharmo vartanāni nibodhata
dvividhastu gṛhī jñeyaḥ sādhakaścāpyasādhakaḥ / adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca pūrvasyāhuḥ pratigraham / kusīdakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ prakurvotāsvayaṅkṛtam
kṛṣerabhāvād vāṇijyaṃ tadabhāvāt kusīdakam / āpatkalpo hyaṃ jñeyaḥ pūrvokto mukhya iṣyate
svayaṃ vā karṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāṇijyaṃ vā kusīdakam / kaṣṭā pāpīyasī vṛttiḥ kusīdaṃ tad vivarjayet
kṣātravṛttiṃ parāṃ prahurna svayaṃ karṣaṇaṃ dvijaiḥ / tasmāt kṣātreṇa varteta vartanenāpadi dvijaḥ
tena cāvāpyajīvaṃstu vaiśyavṛttiṃ kṛṣiṃ vrajet / na kathañcana kurvota brāhmaṇaḥ karma karṣaṇam
labdhalābhaḥ pitṝn devān brāhmaṇāṃścāpi pūjayet / te tṛptāstasya taṃ doṣaṃ śamayanti na saṃśayaḥ
devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyād bhāgaṃ tu viṃśakam / triṃśadbhāgaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛṣiṃ kurvan na duṣyati
vaṇik pradadyād dviguṇaṃ kusīdī triguṇaṃ punaḥ / kṛṣīvalo na doṣeṇa yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
śiloñchaṃ vāpyādadīta gṛhasthaḥ sādhakaḥ punaḥ / vidyāśilpādayastvanye bahavo vṛttihetavaḥ
asādhakastu yaḥ prokto gṛhasthāśramasaṃsthitaḥ / śiloñche tasya kathite dve vṛttī paramarṣibhiḥ
amṛtenāthavā jīvenmṛtenāpyathavā yadi / ayācitaṃ syādamṛtaṃ mṛtaṃ bhekṣaṃ tu yācitam
kuśūladhānyako vā syāt kumbhīdhānyaka eva vā / tryahaihiko vāpi bhavedaśvastanika eva ca
caturṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ dvijānāṃ gṛhamedhinām / śreyān paraḥ paro jñeyo dharmato lokajittamaḥ
ṣaṭkarmaiko bhavatyeṣāṃ tribhiranyaḥ pravartate / dvābhyāmekaścaturthastu brahmasatreṇa jīvati
vartayaṃstu śiloñchābhyāmagnihotraparāyaṇaḥ / iṣṭīḥ pārvāyaṇāntīyāḥ kevalā nirvapet sadā
na lokavṛtiṃ varteta vṛttihetoḥ kathañcana / ajihmāmaśaṭhāṃ śuddhāṃ jīved brāhmaṇajīvikām
yācitvā vāpi sadbhyo 'nnaṃ pitṝndevāṃstu toṣayet / yācayed vā śuciṃ dāntaṃ na tṛpyeta svayaṃ tataḥ
yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhasthastoṣayenna tu / devān pitṛṃśca vidhinā śunāṃ yoniṃ vrajatyasau
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca śreyo mokṣaścatuṣṭayam / dharmāviruddhaḥ kāmaḥ syād brāhmaṇānāṃ tu netaraḥ
yor'tho dharmāya nātmārthaḥ sor'tho 'narthastathetaraḥ / tasmādarthaṃ samāsādya dadyād vai juhuyād yajet

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānadharmamanuttamam / brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavādinām
arthānāmudite pātre śraddhayā pratipādanam / dānamityabhinirdiṣṭaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam
yad dadāti viśiṣṭebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ / tad vai vittamahaṃ manye śeṣaṃ kasyāpi rakṣati
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ dānamucyate / caturthaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ sarvadānottamottamam
ahanyahani yat kiñcid dīyate 'nupakāriṇe / anuddiśya phalaṃ tasmād brāhmaṇāya tu nityakam
yat tu pāpopaśāntyarthaṃ dīyate viduṣāṃ kare / naimittikaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dānaṃ sadbhiranuṣṭhitam
apatyavijayaiśvaryasvargārthaṃ yat pradīyate / dānaṃ tat kāmyamākhyātamṛṣibhirdharmacintakaiḥ
yadīśvaraprīṇanārthaṃ brahmavitsu pradīyate / cetasā dharmayuktena dānaṃ tad vimalaṃ śivam
dānadharmaṃ niṣeveta pātramāsādya śaktitaḥ / utpatsyate hi tatpātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ
kuṭumbabhaktavasanād deyaṃ yadatiricyate / anyathā dīyate yaddhi na tad dānaṃ phalapradam
śrotriyāya kulīnāya vinītāya tapasvine / vṛttasthāya daridrāya pradeyaṃ bhaktipūrvakam
yastu dadyānmahīṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye / sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati
ikṣubhiḥ saṃtatāṃ bhumiṃ yavagodhūmaśalinīm / dadāti vedaviduṣe yaḥ sa bhūyo na jāyate
gocarmamātrāmapi vā yo bhūmiṃ saṃprayacchati / brāhmaṇāya daridrāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
bhūmidānāt paraṃ dānaṃ vidyate neha kiñcana / annadānaṃ tena tulyaṃ vidyādānaṃ tato 'dhikam
yo brāhmaṇāya śāntāya śucaye dharmaśāline / dadāti vidyāṃ vidhinā brahmaloke mahīyate
dadyādaharahastvannaṃ śraddhayā brahmacāriṇe / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaṇaḥ sthānamāpnuyāt
gṛhasthāyānnadānena phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / āmamevāsya dātavyaṃ dattvāpnoti parāṃ gatim
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā / upoṣya vidhinā śāntaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ
pūjayitvā tilaiḥ kṛṣṇairmadhunā na viśeṣataḥ / gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya vācayed vā svyaṃ vadet
prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti yad vā manasi vartate / yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati
kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛttvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī / dadāti yastu viprāya sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam
kṛtānnamudakumbhaṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / nirdiśya dharmarājāya viprebhyo mucyate bhayāt
suvarṇatilayuktaistu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā / tarpayedudapātraistu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
māghamāse tu viprastu dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ / śuklāmvaradharaḥ kṛṣṇaistilairhutvā hutāśanam
pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu tilāneva samāhitaḥ / janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ tarati vai dvijaḥ
amāvasyāmanuprāpya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine / yatkicid devadeveśaṃ dadyāccoddiśya śaṅkaram
prīyatāmīśvaraḥ somo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ / saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati
yastu kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam / ārādhayed dvijamukhe na tasyāsti punarbhavaḥ
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhārmikāya dvijātaye / snātvābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ
prīyatāṃ me mahādevo dadyād dravyaṃ svakīyakam / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
dvijaiḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / amāvāsyāyāṃ bhaktaistu pūjanīyastrilocanaḥ
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam / arcayed bāhmaṇamukhe sa gacchet paramaṃ padam
eṣā tithirvaiṣṇavīṃ syād dvādaśī śuklapakṣake / tasyāmārādhayed devaṃ prayatnena janārdanam
yatkiñcid devamīśānamuddiśya brāhmaṇe śucau / dīyate viṣṇave vāpi tadanantaphalapradam
yo hi yāṃ devatāmicchet samārādhayituṃ naraḥ / brāhmaṇān pūjayed yatnāt satasyāṃ toṣayet tataḥ
dvijānāṃ vapurāsthāya nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ / pūjyante brāhmaṇālābhe pratimādiṣvapi kvacit
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tat tat phalamabhīpsatā / dvijeṣu devatā nityaṃ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ
vibhūtikāmaḥ satataṃ pūjayed vai purandaram / brahmavarcasakāmastu brahmāṇaṃ brahmakāmukaḥ
ārogyakāmo 'tha raviṃ dhanakāmo hutāśanam / karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu pūjayed vai vināyakam
bhogakāmastu śaśinaṃ balakāmaḥ samīraṇam / mumukṣuḥ sarvasaṃsārāt prayatnenārcayeddharim
yastu yogaṃ tathā mokṣamanvicchejjñānamaiśvaram / sor'cayed vai virūpākṣaṃ prayatneneśvareśvaram
ye vāñchanti mahāyogān jñānāni ca maheśvaram / te pūjayanti bhūteśaṃ keśavaṃ cāpi bhoginaḥ
vāridastṛptimāpnoti sukhamakṣayyamannadaḥ / tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam
bhūmidaḥ sarvamāpnoti dīrghamāyurhiraṇyadaḥ / gṛhado 'gryāṇi veśmāni rūpyado rūpamuttamam
vāsodaścandrasālokyamaśvisālokyamaśvadaḥ / anaḍudaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo vradhnasya viṣṭapam
yānaśayyāprado bhāryāmaiśvaryamabhayapradaḥ / dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahmasātmyatām
dhānyānyapi yathāśakti vipreṣu pratipādayet / vedavitsu viśiṣṭeṣu pretya svargaṃ samaśnute
gavāṃ ghāsapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / indhanānāṃ pradānena dīptāgnirjāyate naraḥ
phalamūlāni śākāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca / pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu mudā yuktaḥ sadā bhavet
auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ rogiṇe rogaśāntaye / dadāno rogarahitaḥ sukhī dīrghāyureva ca
asipatravanaṃ mārgaṃ kṣuradhārāsamanvitam / tīvritāpaṃ ca tarati chatropānatprado naraḥ
yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi dayitaṃ gṛhe / tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣyamicchatā
apane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / saṃkrāntyādiṣu kāleṣu dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca / dattvā cākṣayamāpnoti nadīṣu ca vaneṣu ca
dānadharmāt paro dharmo bhūtānāṃ neha vidyate / tasmād viprāya dātavyaṃ śrotriyāya dvijātibhiḥ
svagāyurbhūtikāmena tathā pāpopaśāntaye / mumukṣuṇā ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathānvaham
dīyamānaṃ tu yo mohād goviprāgnisureṣu ca / nivārayati pāpātmā tiryagyoniṃ vrajet tu saḥ
yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā nārcayed brāhmaṇān surān / sarvasvamapahṛtyainaṃ rājā rāṣṭrāt pravāsayet
yastu durbhikṣavelāyāmannādyaṃ na prayacchati / mriyamāṇeṣu vipreṣu brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu garhitaḥ
na tasmāt pratigṛhṇīyurna viśeyuśca tena hi / aṅkayitvā svakād rāṣṭrāt taṃ rājā vipravāsayet
yastvasadbhyo dadātīha svadravyaṃ dharmasādhanam / sa pūrvābhyadhikaḥ pāpī narake pacyate naraḥ
svādhyāyavanto ye viprā vidyāvanto jitendriyāḥ / satyasaṃyamasaṃyuktāstebhyo dadyād dvijottamāḥ
subhuktamapi vidvāṃsaṃ dhārmikaṃ bhojayed dvijam / na tu mūrkhamavṛttasthaṃ daśarātramupoṣitam
sannikṛṣṭamatikramya śrotriyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati / sa tena karmaṇā pāpī dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam
yadisyādadhiko vipraḥ śīlavidyādibhiḥ svayam / tasmai yatnena dātavyaṃ atikramyāpi sannidhim
yo 'rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇīyād dadyādarcitameva ca / tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye
na vāryapi prayaccheta nāstike haituke 'pi ca / pāṣaṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu nāvedavidi dharmavit
apūpaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca gāmaśvaṃ pṛthivīṃ tilān / avidvān pratigṛhṇāno bhasmī bhavati kāṣṭhavat
dvijātibhyo dhanaṃ lipset praśastebhyo dvijottamaḥ / api vā jātimātrebhyo na tu śūdrāt kathañcana
vṛttisaṅkocamanvicchenneheta dhanavistaram / dhanalobhe prasaktastu brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate
vedānadhītya sakalān yajñāṃścāvāpya sarvaśaḥ / na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti saṅkocād yāmavāpnuyāt
pratigraharucirna syāt yātrārthaṃ tu samāharet / sthityarthādadhikaṃ gṛhṇan brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatim
yastu yācanako nityaṃ na sa svargasya bhājanam / udvejayati bhūtāni yathā caurastathaiva saḥ
gurūn bhṛtyāṃścojjihīrṣurarciṣyan devatātithīn / sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ
evaṃ gṛhastho yuktātmā devatātithipūjakaḥ / vartamānaḥ saṃyātātmā yāti tat paramaṃ padam
putre nidhāya vā sarvaṃ gatvāraṇyaṃ tu tattvavit / ekākī vicarennityamudāsīnaḥ samāhitaḥ
eṣa vaḥ kathito dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / jñātvānutiṣṭhenniyataṃ tathānuṣṭhāpayed dvijān
iti devamanādimekamīśaṃ gṛhadharmeṇa samarcayedajastram / samatītya sa sarvabhūtayoniṃ prakṛtiṃ yāti paraṃ na yāti janma

iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā dvitīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ / vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchet sadāraḥ sāgnireva ca nikṣipya bhāryāṃ putreṣu gacched vanamathāpi vā / dṛṣṭvāpatyasya cāpatyaṃ jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ
śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhne praśaste cottarāyaṇe / gatvāraṇyaṃ niyamavāṃstapaḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
phalamūlāni pūtāni nityamāhāramāharet / yatāhāro bhavet tena pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ
pūjayitvātithiṃ nityaṃ snātvā cābhyarcayet surān / gṛhādāhṛtya cāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān samāhitaḥ
jaṭāśca bibhṛyānnityaṃ nakharomāṇi notsṛjet / svādhyāyaṃ sarvadā kuryānniyacched vācamanyataḥ
agnihotraṃ ca juhuyāt pañcayajñān samācaret / munyannaiṃrvividhairmedhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā
cīravāsā bhavennityaṃ snāyāt triṣavaṇaṃ śuciḥ / sarvabhūtānukampī syāt pratigrahavivarjitaḥ
darśena paurṇamāsena yajet niyataṃ dvijaḥ / ṛkṣeṣvāgrayaṇe caiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet / uttarāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dakṣasyāyanameva ca
vāsantaiḥ śāradairmedhyairmunyannaiḥ svayamāhṛtaiḥ / puroḍāśāṃścarūṃścaiva vidhivannirvapet pṛthak
devatābhyaśca tad hutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ / śeṣaṃ samupabhuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam
varjayenmadhumāṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca / bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukaṃ caiva śleṣmātakaphalāni ca
na phālakṛṣṭamaśnīyādutsṛṣṭamapi kenacit / na grāmajātānyārto 'pi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
śrāvaṇenaiva vidhinā vahniṃ paricaret sadā / na druhyet sarvabhūtāni nirdvandvo nirbhayo bhavet
na naktaṃ kiñcidaśnīyād rātrau dhyānaparo bhavet / jitendriyo jitakrodhastattvajñānavicintakaḥ / brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ na patnīmapi saṃśrayet
yastu patnyā vanaṃ gatvā maithunaṃ kāmataścaret / tad vrataṃ tasya lupyeta prāyaścittīyate dvijaḥ
tatra yo jāyate garbho na saṃspṛśyo dvijātibhiḥ / na hi vede 'dhikāro 'sya tadvaṃśepyevameva hi
adhaḥ śayīta satataṃ sāvitrījāpyatatparaḥ / śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃvibhāgaparaḥ sadā
parivādaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ nidrālasyaṃ vivarjayet / ekāgniraniketaḥ syāt prokṣitāṃ bhūmimāśrayet
mṛgaiḥ saha cared vāsaṃ taiḥ sahaiva ca saṃvaset / śilāyāṃ śarkarāyāṃ vā śayīta susamāhitaḥ
sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syānmāsasaṃcayiko 'pi vā / ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syāt samānicaya eva vā
tyajedāśvayuje māsi saṃpannaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam / jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni ca
dantolūkhaliko vāsyāt kāpotīṃ vṛttimāśrayet / aśmakuṭṭo bhaved vāpi kālapakvabhugeva vā
naktaṃ cānna samaśnīyād divā cāhṛtya śaktitaḥ / caturthakāliko vā syāt syādvāpyaṣṭamakālikaḥ
cāndrāyaṇavidhānairvā śukle kṛṣṇe ca vartayet / pakṣe pakṣe samaśnīyād yavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt
puṣpamūlaphalairvāpi kevalairvartayet sadā / svābhāvikaiḥ svayaṃ śīrṇairvaikhānasamate sthitaḥ
bhūmau vā parivarteta tiṣṭhed vā prapadairdinam / sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharenna kvacid dhairyamutsṛjet
grīṣme pañcatapāśca syād varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ / ārdravāsāstu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃstapaḥ
upaspṛśya triṣavaṇaṃ pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet / ekapādena tiṣṭheta marīcīn vā pibet tadā
pañcāgnirdhūmapo vā syāduṣmapaḥ somapo 'pi vā / payaḥ pibecchuklapakṣe kṛṣṇāpakṣe tu gomayam / śīrṇaparṇāśano vā syāt kṛcchrair vā vartayet sadā
yogābhyāsarataśca syād rudrādhyāyī bhavet sadā / atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā vedāntābhyāsatatparaḥ
yamān seveta satataṃ niyamāṃścāpyatandritaḥ / kṛṣṇājinī sottarīyaḥ śuklayajñopavītavān
atha cāgnīn samāropya svātmani dhyānatatparaḥ / anagniraniketaḥ syānmunirmokṣaparo bhavet
tāpaseṣveva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣamāharet / gṛhamedhiṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu
grāmādāhṛtya vāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān vane vasan / pratigṛhya puṭenaiva pāṇinā śakalena vā
vividhāścopaniṣada ātmasaṃsiddhaye japet / vidyāviśeṣān sāvitrīṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ tathaiva ca
mahāprāsthānikaṃ cāsau kuryādanaśanaṃ tu vā / agnipraveśamanyad vā brarhmārpaṇavidhau sthitaḥ
yastu samyagimamāśramaṃ śivaṃ saṃśrayedaśivapuñjanāśanam / tāpasaḥ sa paramaiśvaraṃ padaṃ yāti yatra jagato 'sya saṃsthitiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptaviśo 'dhyāya vyāsa uvāca evaṃ vanāśrame sthitvā tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ / caturthamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ saṃnyāsena nayet kramāt
agnīnātmanī saṃsthāpya dvijaḥ pravrajito bhavet / yogābhyāsarataḥ śānto brahmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ
yadā manasi saṃjātaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ sarvavastuṣu / tadā saṃnyāsamicchecca patitaḥ syād viparyaye
prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭimāgneyīmathavā punaḥ / dāntaḥ pakvakaṣāyo 'sau brahmāśramamupāśrayet
jñānasaṃnyāsinaḥ kecid vedasaṃnyāsinaḥ pare / karmasaṃnyāsinastvanye trividhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
yaḥ sarvasaṅganirmukto nirdvandvaścaiva nirbhayaḥ / procyate jñānasaṃnyāsī svātmanyeva vyavasthitaḥ
vedamevābhyasennityaṃ nirāśī niṣparigrahaḥ / procyate vedasaṃnyāsī mumukṣurvijitendriyaḥ
yastvagnīnātmasātkṛtvā brahmārpaṇaparo dvijaḥ / jñeyaḥ sa karmasaṃnyāsī mahāyajñaparāyaṇaḥ
trayāṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ jñānī tvabhyadhiko mataḥ / na tasya vidyate kāryaṃ na liṅgaṃ vā vipaścitaḥ
nirmamo nirbhayaḥ śānto nirdvandvaḥ parṇabhojanaḥ / jīrṇakaupīnavāsāḥ syānnagno vā dhyānatatparaḥ
brahmacārī mitāhāro grāmādannaṃ samāharet / adhyātmamatirāsīta nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ
ātmanaiva sahāyena sukhārthaṃ vicarediha / nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā / nādhyetavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ na kadācana / evaṃ jñātvā paro yogī brahmabhūyāya kalpate
ekavāsāthavā vidvān kaupīnācchādanastathā / muṇḍī śikhī vātha bhavet tridaṇḍī niṣparigrahaḥ / kāṣāyavāsāḥ satataṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ
grāmānte vṛkṣamūle vā vased devālaye 'pi vā / samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ / bhaikṣyeṇa vartayennityaṃ naikānnādī bhavet kvacit
yastu mohena vālasyādekānnādī bhaved yatiḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ kācid dharmaśāstreṣu kathyate
rāgadveṣavimuktātmā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ / prāṇihaṃsānivṛttaśca maunī syāt sarvanispṛhaḥ
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet / satyapūtāṃ vaded vāṇīṃ manaḥ pūtaṃ samācaret
naikatra nivased deśe varṣābhyo 'nyatra bhikṣukaḥ / snānaśaucarato nityaṃ kamaṇḍalukaraḥ śuciḥ
brahmacaryarato nityaṃ vanavāsarato bhavet / mokṣaśāstreṣu nirato brahmasūtrī jitendriyaḥ
dambhāhaṅkāranirmukto nindāpaiśunyavarjitaḥ / ātmajñānaguṇopeto yatirmokṣamavāpnuyāt
abhyaset satataṃ vedaṃ praṇavākhyaṃ sanātanam / snātvācamya vidhānena śucirdevālayādiṣu
yajñopavītī śāntātmā kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ / dhautakāṣāyavasano bhasmacchannatanūrahaḥ
adhiyajñaṃ brahma japedādhidaivikameva ca / ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat
putreṣu vātha nivasan brahmacārī yatirmuniḥ / vedamevābhyasennityaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ param / kṣamā dayā ca satoṣo vratānyasya viśeṣataḥ
vedāntajñānaniṣṭho vā pañca yajñān samāhitaḥ / kuryādaharahaḥ snātvā bhikṣānnenaiva tena hi
homamantrāñjapennityaṃ kāle kāle samāhitaḥ / svādhyāyaṃ cānvahaṃ kuryāt sāvitrīṃ saṃdhyayorjapet
dhyāyīta satataṃ devamekānte parameśvaram / ekānnaṃ varjayennityaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
ekavāsā dvivāsā vā śikhī yajñopavītavān / kamaṇḍalukaro vidvān tridaṇḍī yāti tatparam
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge 'ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ svāśramaniṣṭhānāṃ yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām / bhaikṣeṇa vartanaṃ proktaṃ phalamūlairathāpi vā
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ na prasajyeta vistare / bhaikṣe prasakto hi yatirviṣayeṣvapi sajjati
saptāgāraṃ cared bhaikṣamalābhāt tu punaścaret / prakṣālya pātre bhuñjīyādadbhiḥ prakṣālayet tu tat
athavānyadupādāya pātre bhuñjīta nityaśaḥ / bhuktvā tat saṃtyajet pātraṃ yātrāmātramalolupaḥ
vidhūme sannamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane / vṛtte śarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret
godohamātraṃ tiṣṭheta kālaṃ bhikṣuradhomukhaḥ / bhikṣetyuktvā sakṛt tūṣṇīmaśnīyād vāgyataḥ śuciḥ
prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca samācamya yathāvidhi / āditye darśayitvānnaṃ bhuñjīta prāṅmukhottaraḥ
hutvā prāṇāhutīḥ pañca grāsānaṣṭau samāhitaḥ / ācamya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhyāyīta parameśvaram
alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tataḥ / catvāri yatipātrāṇi manurāha prajāpatiḥ
prāgrātre pararātre ca madhyarātre tathaiva ca / saṃdhyāsvahni viśeṣeṇa cintayennityamīśvaram
kṛtvā hṛtpadmanilaye viśvākhyaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam / ātmānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parastāt tamasaḥ sthitam
sarvasyādhārabhūtānāmānandaṃ jyotiravyayam / pradhānapuruṣātītamākāśaṃ dahanaṃ śivam
tadantaḥ sarvabhāvānāmīśvaraṃ brahmarūpiṇam / dhyāyedanādimadvaitamānandādiguṇālayam
mahāntaṃ paramaṃ brahma puruṣaṃ satyamavyayam / sitetarāruṇākāraṃ maheśaṃ viśvarūpiṇam
oṅkārānte 'tha cātmānaṃ saṃsthāpya paramātmani / ākāśe devamīśānaṃ dhyāyītākāśamadhyagam
kāraṇaṃ sarvabhāvānāmānandaikasamāśrayam / purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhyāyan mucyeta bandhanāt
yadvā guhāyāṃ prakṛtau jagatsaṃmohanālaye / vicintya paramaṃ vyoma sarvabhūtaikakāraṇam
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yatra lokaḥ pralīyate / ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūkṣmaṃ yat paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ
tanmadhye nihitaṃ brahma kevalaṃ jñānalakṣaṇam / anantaṃ satyamīśānaṃ vicintyāsīta saṃyataḥ
guhyād guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ yatīnāmetadīritam / yo 'nutiṣṭhenmaheśena so 'śnute yogamaiśvaram
tasmād dhyānarato nityamātmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ / jñānaṃ samabhyased brāhmaṃ yena mucyeta bandhanāt
matvā pṛthak svamātmānaṃ sarvasmādeva kevalam / ānandamajaraṃ jñānaṃ dhyāyīta ca punaḥ param
yasmāt bhavanti bhūtāni yad gatvā neha jāyate / sa tasmādīśvaro devaḥ parasmād yo 'dhitiṣṭhati
yadantare tad gaganaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamavyayam / yadaṃśastatparo yastu sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ
vratāni yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ tathaivopavratāni ca / ekaikātikrame teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate
upetya ca striyaṃ kāmāt prāyaścittaṃ samāhitaḥ / prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaṃ kuryāt sāṃtapanaṃ śuciḥ
tataścareta niyamāt kṛcchraṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ / punarāśramamāgamya cared bhiśruratandritaḥ
na dharmayuktamanṛtaṃ hinastīti manīṣiṇaḥ / tathāpi ca na kartavyaṃ prasaṅgo hyeṣa dāruṇaḥ
ekarātropavāsaśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā / uktvānṛtaṃ prakartavyaṃ yatinā dharmalipsunā
paramāpadgatenāpi na kāryaṃ steyamanyataḥ / steyādabhyadhikaḥ kaścinnāstyadharma iti smṛtiḥ / hiṃsā caiṣāparā diṣṭā yā cātmajñānanāśikā
yadetad draviṇaṃ nāma prāṇa hyete bahiśvarāḥ / sa tasya harati prāṇān yo yasya harate dhanam
evaṃ kṛtvā sa duṣṭātmā bhinnavṛtto vratāccyutaḥ / bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścareccāndrāyaṇavratam
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena saṃvatsaramiti śrutiḥ / bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścared bhikṣuratandritaḥ
akasmādeva hiṃsāṃ tu yadi bhikṣuḥ samācaret / kuryātkṛchrātikṛcchraṃ tu cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā
skandedindriyadaurbalyāt striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatiryadi / tena dhārayitavyā vai prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa / divāskande trirātraṃ syāt prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā
ekānne madhumāṃse ca navaśrāddhe tathaiva ca / pratyakṣalavaṇe coktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśodhanam
dhyānaniṣṭhasya satataṃ naśyate sarvapātakam / tasmānmaheśvaraṃ jñātvā tasya dhyānaparo bhavet
yad brahma paramaṃ jyotiḥ pratiṣṭhākṣaramadvayam / yo 'ntarātra paraṃ brahma sa vijñeyo maheśvaraḥ
eṣa devo mahādevaḥ kevalaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ / tadevākṣaramadvaitaṃ tadādityāntaraṃ param
yasmānmahīyate devaḥ svadhāmni jñānasaṃjñite / ātmayogāhvaye tattve mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ
nānyad devānmahādevād vyatiriktaṃ prapaśyati / tamevātmānamanveti yaḥ sa yāti paraṃ padam
manyate ye svamātmānaṃ vibhinnaṃ parameśvarāt / na te paśyanti taṃ devaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ pariśramaḥ
ekameva paraṃ brahma vijñeyaṃ tattvamavyayam / sa devastu mahādevo naitad vijñāya badhyate
tasmād yateta niyataṃ yatiḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ / jñānayogarataḥ śānto mahādevaparāyaṇaḥ
eṣa vaḥ kathito vipro yatīnāmāśramaḥ śubhaḥ / pitāmahena vibhunā munīnāṃ pūrvamīritam
nāputraśiṣyayogibhyo dadyādidamanuttamam / jñānaṃ svayaṃbhuvā proktaṃ yatidharmāśrayaṃ śivam
iti yatiniyamānāmetaduktaṃ vidhānaṃ paśupatiparitoṣe yad bhavedekahetuḥ / na bhavati punareṣāmudbhavo vā vināśaḥ praṇihitamanaso ye nityamevācaranti
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravalakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham / hitāya sarvaviprāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmapanuttaye
akṛtvā vihitaṃ karma kṛtvā ninditameva ca / doṣamāpnoti puruṣaḥ prāyaścittaṃ viśodhanam
prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu na tiṣṭhed brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit / yad brūyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntā vidvāṃsastatsamācaret
vedārthavittamaḥ śānto dharmakāmo 'gnimān dvijaḥ / sa eva syāt paro dharmo yameko 'pi vyavasyati
anāhitāgnayo viprāstrayo vedārthapāragāḥ / yad brūyurdharmakāmāste tajjñeyaṃ dharmasādhanam
anekadharmaśāstrajñā ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ / vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ saptaite parikīrtitāḥ
mīmāṃsājñānatattvajñā vedāntakuśalā dvijāḥ / ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyātāḥ prayāścittaṃ vadanti vai
brahmahā madyapaḥ steno gurutalpaga eva ca / mahāpātakinastvete yaścaitaiḥ saha saṃvaset
saṃvatsaraṃ tu patitaiḥ saṃsargaṃ kurute tu yaḥ / yānaśayyāsanairnityaṃ jānan vai patito bhavet
yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ tathaivādhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ / kṛtvā sadyaḥ patejjñānāt saha bhojanameva ca
avijñāyātha yo mohāt kuryādadhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ / saṃvatsareṇa patati sahādhyayanameva ca
brahmāhā dvādaśābdāni kuṭiṃ kṛtvā vane vaset / bhaikṣamātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtvā śavaśirodhvajam
brāhmaṇāvasathān sarvān devāgārāṇi varjayet / vinindan svayamātmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ ca saṃsmaran
asaṃkalpitayogyāni saptāgārāṇi saṃviśet / vidhūme śanakairnityaṃ vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ doṣaṃ vikhyāpayan nṛṇām / vanyamūlaphalairvāpi vartayed dhairyamākṣitaḥ
kapālapāṇiḥ khaṭvāṅgī brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ / pūrṇe tu dvādaśe varṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittamidaṃ śubham / kāmato maraṇācchuddhirjñeyā nānyena kenacit
kuryādanaśanaṃ vātha bhṛgoḥ patanameva vā / jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ jalaṃ vā praviśet svayam
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā samyak prāṇān parityajet / brahmahatyāpanodārthamantarā vā mṛtasya tu
dīrghāmayānvitaṃ vipraṃ kṛtvānāmayameva tu / dattvā cānnaṃ sa durbhikṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
aśvamedhāvabhṛthake snātvā vā śudhyate dvijaḥ / sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāya pradāya tu
sarasvatyāstvaruṇayā saṃgame lokaviśrute / śudhyet triṣavaṇasnānāt trirātropoṣito dvijaḥ
gatvā rāmeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ snātvā caiva mahodadhau / brahmacaryādibhiryukto dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ vimucyate
kapālamocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ / snātvābhyarcya pitṝn bhaktyā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
yatra devādidevena bharaveṇāmitaujasā / kapālaṃ sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
samabhyarcya mahādevaṃ tatra bhairavarūpiṇam / tarpapitvā pitṝn snātvā mucyate brahmahatyayā
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge triśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ devena rudreṇa śaṅkareṇāmitaujasā / kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpitaṃ dehajaṃ bhuvi
sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
purā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ meruśṛṅge maharṣayaḥ / procuḥ praṇamya lokādiṃ kimekaṃ tattvamavyayam
sa māyayā maheśasya mohito lokasaṃbhavaḥ / avijñāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ prāha dharṣiṇam
ahaṃ dhātā jagadyoniḥ svayaṃbhūreka īśvaraḥ / anādimatparaṃ brahma māmabhyarcya vimucyate
ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ / na vidyate cābhyadhiko matto lokeṣu kaścana
tasyaivaṃ manyamānasya jajñe nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ / provāca prahasan vākyaṃ roṣatāmravilocanaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇamidaṃ brahman vartate tava sāṃpratam / ajñānayogayuktasya na tvetaducitaṃ tava
ahaṃ dhātā hi lokānāṃ yajño nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / na māmṛte 'sya jagato jīvanaṃ sarvadā kvacit
ahameva paraṃ jyotirahameva parā gatiḥ / matpreritena bhavatā sṛṣṭaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalam
evaṃ vivadatormohāt parasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ / ājagmuryatra tau devau vedāścatvāra eva hi
anvīkṣya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ yajñātmānaṃ ca saṃsthitam / procuḥ saṃvignahṛdayā yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
ṛgveda uvāca yasyāntaḥ sthāni bhūtāni yasmātsarvaṃ pravartate / yadāhustatparaṃ tattvaṃ sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ
yajurveda uvāca yo yajñairakhilairīśo yogena ca samarcyate / yamāhurīśvaraṃ devaṃ sa devaḥ syāt pinākadhṛk
sāmaveda uvāca yenedaṃ bhrāmyate cakraṃ yadākāśāntaraṃ śivam / yogibhirvidyate tattvaṃ mahādevaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ
atharvaveda uvāca yaṃ prapaśyanti yogeśaṃ yatanto yatayaḥ param / maheśaṃ puruṣaṃ rudraṃ sa devo bhagavān bhavaḥ
evaṃ sa bhagavān brahmā vedānāmīritaṃ śubham / śrutvāha prahasan vākyaṃ viśvātmāpi vimohitaḥ
kathaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma sarvasaṅgavivarjitam / ramate bhāryayā sārdhaṃ pramathaiścātigarvitaiḥ
itirite 'tha bhagavān praṇavātmā sanātanaḥ / amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā vacaḥ prāha pitāmaham
praṇava uvāca na hyeṣa bhagavān patnyā svātmano vyatiriktayā / kadācid ramate rudrastādṛśo hi maheśvaraḥ
ayaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ / svānandabhūtā kathitā devī nāgantukā śivā
ityevamukte 'pi tadā yajñamūrterajasya ca / nājñānamagamannāśamīśvarasyaiva māyayā
tadantare mahājyotirviriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ / prāpaśyadadbhutaṃ divyaṃ pūrayan gaganāntaram
tanmadhyasaṃsthaṃ vimalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tejasojjvalam / vyomamadhyagataṃ divyaṃ prādurāsīd dvijottamāḥ
sa dṛṣṭvā vadanaṃ divyaṃ mūrdhni lokapitāmahaḥ / tena tanmaṇjalaṃ ghoramālokayadaninditam
prajajvālātikopena brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ / kṣaṇādadṛśyata mahān puruṣo nīlalohitaḥ
triśūlapiṅgalo devo nāgayajñopavītavān / taṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam
jānāmi bhavataḥ pūrvaṃ lalāṭādeva śaṅkara / prādurbhāvaṃ maheśān māmeva śaraṇaṃ vraja
śrutvā sagarvavacanaṃ padmayoneratheśvaraḥ / prāhiṇot puruṣaṃ kālaṃ bhairavaṃ lokadāhakam
sa kṛtvā sumahad yuddhaṃ brahmaṇā kālabhairavaḥ / cakarta tasya vadanaṃ viriñcasyātha pañcamam
nikṛttavadano devo brahmā devena śaṃbhunā / mamāra ceśayogena jīvitaṃ prāpa viśvasṛk
athānupaśyad giriśaṃ maṇḍalāntarasaṃsthitam / samāsīnaṃ mahādevyā mahādevaṃ sanātanam
bhujaṅgarājavalayaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam / koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ jaṭājūṭavirājitam
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ divyamālāsamanvitam / triśūlapāṇiṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ yoginaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
yamantarā yoganiṣṭhāḥ prapaśyanti hṛdīśvaram / tamādidevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ mahādevaṃ dadarśa ha
yasya sā paramā devī śaktirākāśasaṃsthitā / so 'nantaiśvaryayogātmā maheśo dṛśyate kila
yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam / sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate
yo 'tha nācāraniratān svabhaktāneva kevalam / vimocayati lokānāṃ nāyako dṛśyate kila
yasya vedavidaḥ śāntā nirdvandvā brahmacāriṇaḥ / vidanti vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sa śaṃbhurdṛśyate kila
yasya brahmādayo devā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ / arcayanti sadā liṅgaṃ viśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate
yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam / sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate
vidyāsahāyo bhagavān yasyāsau maṇḍalāntaram / hiraṇyagarbhaputro 'sāvīśvaro dṛśyate kila
yasyāśeṣajagatsūtirvijñānatanurīśvarī / na muñcati sadā pārśvaṃ śaṅkaro 'sāvadṛśyata
puṣpaṃ vā yadi vā patraṃ yatpādayugale jalam / dattvā tarati saṃsāraṃ rudro 'sau dṛśyate kila
tatsannidhāne sakalaṃ niyacchati sanātanaḥ / kālaḥ kila sa yogātmā kālakālo hi dṛśyate
jīvanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ trilokasyaiva bhūṣaṇam / somaḥ sa dṛśyate devaḥ somo yasya vibhūṣaṇam
devyā saha sadā sākṣād yasya yogaḥ svabhāvataḥ / gīyate paramā muktiḥ sa yogī dṛśyate kila
yogino yogatattvajñā viyogābhimukhāniśam / yogaṃ dhyāyanti devyāsau sa yogī dṛśyate kila
so 'nuvīkṣya mahādevaṃ mahādevyā sanātanam / varāsane samāsīnamavāpa paramāṃ smṛtim
labdhvā māheśvarīṃ divyāṃ saṃsmṛtiṃ bhagavānajaḥ / toṣayāmāsa varadaṃ somaṃ somavibhūṣaṇam
brahmovāca namo devāya mahate mahādevyai namo namaḥ / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya śivāyai śāntaye namaḥ
oṃ namo brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ vidyāyai te namo namaḥ / namo mūlaprakṛtaye maheśāya namo namaḥ
namo vijñānadehāya cintāyai te namo namaḥ / namaste kālakālāya īśvarāyai namo namaḥ
namo namo 'stu rudrāya rudrāṇyai te namo namaḥ / namo namaste kāmāya māyāyai ca namo namaḥ
niyantre sarvakāryāṇāṃ kṣobhikāyai namo namaḥ / namo 'stu te prakṛtaye namo nārāyaṇāya ca
yogādāyai namastubhyaṃ yogināṃ gurave namaḥ / namaḥ saṃsāranāśāya saṃsārotpattaye namaḥ
nityānandāya vibhave namo 'stvānandamūrtaye / namaḥ kāryavihīnāya viśvaprakṛtaye namaḥ
oṅkāramūrtaye tubhyaṃ tadantaḥ saṃsthitāya ca / namaste vyomasaṃsthāya vyomaśaktyai namo namaḥ
iti somāṣṭakeneśaṃ praṇanāma pitāmahaḥ / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau gṛṇan vai śatarudriyam
atha devo mahādevaḥ praṇatārtiharo haraḥ / provācotthāpya hastābhyāṃ prato 'smi tava sāṃpratam
dattvāsau paramaṃ yogamaiśvaryamatulaṃ mahat / provācāgre sthitaṃ devaṃ nīlalohitamīśvaram
eṣa brahmāsya jagataḥ saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ / ātmano rakṣaṇīyaste gururjyeṣṭhaḥ pitā tava
ayaṃ purāṇapuruṣo na hantavyastvayānagha / svayogaiśvaryamāhātmyānmāmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
ayaṃ ca yajño bhagavān sagarvo bhavatānagha / śāsitavyo viriñcasya dhāraṇīyaṃ śirastvayā
brahmahatyāpanodārthaṃ vrataṃ lokāya darśayan / carasva satataṃ bhikṣāṃ saṃsthāpaya suradvijān
ityetaduktvā vacanaṃ bhagavān parameśvaraḥ / sthānaṃ svābhāvikaṃ divyaṃ yayau tatparamaṃ padam
tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ kaparde nīlalohitaḥ / grāhayāmāsa vadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kālabhairavam
cara tvaṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ vrataṃ lokahitāvaham / kapālahasto bhagavān bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇātu sarvataḥ
uktvaivaṃ prāhiṇot kanyāṃ brahmahatyāmiti śrutām / daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ jvālāmālāvibhūṣaṇām
yāvad vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ purīmeṣa gamiṣyati / tāvat tvaṃ bhīṣaṇe kālamanugaccha trilocanam
evamābhāṣya kālāgniṃ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ / aṭasva nikhilaṃ lokaṃ bhikṣārtho manniyogataḥ
yadā drakṣyasi deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / tadāsau vakṣyati spaṣṭamupāyaṃ pāpaśodhanam
sa devadevatāvākyamākarṇya bhagavān haraḥ / kapālapāṇirviśvātmā cacāra bhuvanatrayam
āsthāya vikṛtaṃ veṣaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā / śrīmat pavitramatulaṃ jaṭājūṭavirājitam
koṭisūryapratīkāśaiḥ pramathaiścātigarvitaiḥ / bhāti kālāgninayano mahādevaḥ samāvṛtaḥ
pītvā kadamṛtaṃ divyamānandaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / līlāvilāsūbahulo lokānāgacchatīśvaraḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kālavadanaṃ śaṅkaraṃ kālabhairavam / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannaṃ nārīkulamagādanu
gāyanti vividhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyanti purataḥ prabhoḥ / sasmitaṃ prekṣya vadanaṃ cakrurbhrūbhaṅgameva ca
sa devadānavādīnāṃ deśānabhyetya śūladhṛk / jagāma viṣṇorbhavanaṃ yatrāste madhusūdanaḥ
nirīkṣya divyabhavanaṃ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ / sahaiva bhūtapravaraiḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame
avijñāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ divyaṃ tatpārameśvaram / nyavārayat triśūlāṅkaṃ dvārapālo mahābalaḥ
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā mahābhujaḥ / viṣvaksena iti khyāto viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavaḥ
athainaṃ śaṅkaragaṇo yuyudhe viṣṇusaṃbhavam / bhīṣaṇo bhairavādeśāt kālavega iti śrutaḥ
vijitya taṃ kālavegaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / rudrāyābhimukhaṃ raudraṃ cikṣepa ca sudarśanam
atha devo mahādevastripurāristriśūlabhṛt / tamāpatantaṃ sāvajñamālokayadamitrajit
tadantare mahadbhūtaṃ yugāntadahanopamam / śūlenorasi nirbhidya pātayāmāsa taṃ bhuvi
sa śūlābhihato 'tyarthaṃ tyaktvā svaṃ paramaṃ balam / tatyāja jīvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ vyādhihatā iva
nihatya viṣṇupuruṣaṃ sārdhaṃ pramathapuṅgavaiḥ / viveśa cāntaragṛhaṃ samādāya kalevaram
nirīkṣya jagato hetumīśvaraṃ bhagavān hariḥ / śiro lalāṭāt saṃbhidya raktadhārāmapātayat
gṛhāṇa bhagavan bhikṣāṃ madīyāmamitadyute / na vidyate 'nābhyuditā tava tripuramardana
na saṃpūrṇaṃ kapālaṃ tad brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu sā ca dhārā pravāhitā
athābravīt kālarudraṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / saṃstūya vaidikairmantrairbahumānapuraḥ saram
kimarthametad vadanaṃ brahmaṇo bhavatā dhṛtam / provāca vṛttamakhilaṃ bhagavān parameśvaraḥ
samāhūya hṛṣīkeśo brahmahatyāmathācyutaḥ / prārthayāmāsa deveśo vimuñceti triśūlinam
na tatyājātha sā pārśvaṃ vyāhṛtāpi murāriṇā / ciraṃ dhyātvā jagadyoniḥ śaṅkaraṃ prāha sarvavit
vrajasva bhagavan divyāṃ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām / yatrākhilajagaddoṣaṃ kṣipraṃ nāśayatāśvaraḥ
tataḥ śarvāṇi guhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / jagāma līlayā devo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
saṃstūyamānaḥ pramathairmahāyogairitastataḥ / nṛtyamāno mahāyogī hastanyastakalevaraḥ
tamabhyadhāvad bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam / athāsthāyāparaṃ rūpaṃ nṛtyadarśanalālasaḥ
nirīkṣamāṇo novindaṃ vṛṣendrāṅkitaśāsanaḥ / sasmito 'nantayogātmā nṛtyati sma punaḥ punaḥ
atha sānucaro rudraḥ saharirdharmavāhanaḥ / bheje mahādevapurīṃ vārāṇasīmiti śrutām
praviṣṭamātre deveśe brahmahatyā kapardini / hā hetyuktvā sanādaṃ sā pātālaṃ prāpa duḥ khitā
praviśya paramaṃ sthānaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇo haraḥ / gaṇānāmagrato devaḥ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
sthāpayitvā mahādevo dadau tacca kalevaram / uktvā sajīvamastvīśo viṣṇave sa ghṛṇānidhiḥ
ye smaranti mamājastraṃ kāpālaṃ veṣamuttamam / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipramihāmutra ca pātakam
āgamya tīrthapravare snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ / tarpayitvā pitṝn devān mucyate brahmahatyayā
aśāśvataṃ jagajjñātvā ye 'smin sthāne vasanti vai / dehānte tat paraṃ jñānaṃ dadāmi paramaṃ padam
itīdamuktvā bhagavān samāliṅgya janārdanam / sahaiva pramatheśānaiḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
sa labdhvā bhagavān kṛṣṇo viṣvaksenaṃ triśūlinaḥ / svaṃ deśamagat tūrṇaṃ gṛhītvāṃ paramaṃ vapuḥ
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ sthāṇoḥ priyakaraṃ śubham
ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ / vācikairmānasaiḥ pāpaiḥ kāyikaiśca vimucyate
iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekatriśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca surāpastu surāṃ taptāmagnivarṇāṃ svayaṃ pibet / tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mucyate tu dvijottamaḥ
gomūtramagnivarṇaṃ vā gośakṛdrasameva vā / payo ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vātha mucyate pātakāt tataḥ
jalārdravāsāḥ prayato dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim / brahmahatyāvrataṃ cātha caret tatpāpaśāntaye
suvarṇasteyakṛd vipro rājānamabhigamya tu / svakarma khyāpayan brūyānmāṃ bhavānanuśāstviti
gṛhītvā musalaṃ rājā sakṛd hanyāt tataḥ svayam / vadhe tu śuddhyate steno brāhmaṇastapasaiva vā
skandhenādāya musalaṃ lakuṭaṃ vāpi khādiram / śaktiṃ cobhayatastīkṣṇāmāyasaṃ daṇḍameva vā
rājā tena ca gantavyo muktakeśena dhāvatā / ācakṣāṇena tatpāpamevaṅkarmāsmi śādhi mām
śāsanād vā vimokṣād vā stenaḥ steyād vimucyate / aśāsitvā tu taṃ rājāstenasyāpnoti kilbiṣam
tapasāpanunutsustu suvarṇasteyajaṃ malam / cīravāsā dvijo 'raṇye cared brahmahaṇo vratam
snātvāśvamedhāvabhṛthe pūtaḥ syādathavā dvijaḥ / pradadyād vātha viprebhyaḥ svātmatulyaṃ hiraṇyakam
cared vā vatsaraṃ kṛcchraṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ / brāhmaṇaḥ svarṇahārī tu tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
gurorbhāryāṃ samāruhya brāhmaṇaḥ kāmamohitaḥ / avagūhet striyaṃ taptāṃ dīptāṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ kṛtām
svayaṃ vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāvutkṛtyādhāya cāñcalau / ātiṣṭhed dakṣiṇāmāśāmānipātādajihmagaḥ
gurvarthaṃ vā hataḥ śuddhyeccared vā brahmahā vratam / śākhāṃ vā kaṇṭakopetāṃ pariṣvajyātha vatsaram / adhaḥ śayīta niyato mucyate gurutalpagaḥ
kṛcchraṃ vābdaṃ cared vipraścīravāsāḥ samāhitaḥ / aśvamedhāvabhṛthake snātvā vā śuddhyate naraḥ
kāle 'ṣṭame vā bhuñjāno brahmacārī sadāvratī / sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharaṃstrirahno 'bhyupayannapaḥ
adhaḥ śāyī tribhirvarṣaistad vyapohati pātakam / cāndrāyaṇāni vā kuryāt pañca catvāri vā punaḥ
patitaiḥ saṃprayuktānāmatha vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim / patitena tu saṃsargaṃ yo yena kurute dvijaḥ / sa tatpāpāpanodārthaṃ tasyaiva vratamācaret
taptakṛcchraṃ cared vātha saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ / ṣāṇmāsike tu saṃsarge prāyaścittārdhamarhati
ebhirvratairapohanti mahāpātakino malam / puṇyatīrthābhigamanāt pṛthivyāṃ vātha niṣkṛtiḥ
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ / kṛtvā taiścāpi saṃsargaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kāmakārataḥ
kuryādanaśanaṃ vipraḥ puṇyatīrthe samāhitaḥ / jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ dhyātvā devaṃ kapardinam
na hyanyā niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā munibhirdharmavādibhiḥ / tasmāt puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu dahed vāpi svadehakam
gatvā duhitaraṃ vipraḥ svasāraṃ vā snuṣāmapi / praviśejjvalanaṃ dīptaṃ matipūrvamiti sthitiḥ
mātṛṣvasāṃ mātulānīṃ tathaiva ca pitṛṣvasām / bhāgineyīṃ samāruhya kuryāt kṛcchrātikṛcchrakau
cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca kurvota tasya pāpasya śāntaye / dhyāyan devaṃ jagadyonimanādinidhanaṃ param
bhrātṛbhāryāṃ samāruhya kuryāt tatpāpaśāntaye / cāndrāyaṇāni catvāri pañca vā susamāhitaḥ
paitṛṣvastreyīṃ gatvā tu svastreyāṃ mātureva ca / mātulasya sutāṃ vāpi gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
sakhibhāryāṃ samāruhya gatvā śyālīṃ tathaiva ca / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret
udakyāgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśudhyati / cāṇḍālīgamane caiva taptakṛcchratrayaṃ viduḥ / saha sāṃtapanenāsya nānyathā niṣkṛtiḥ smṛtā
mātṛgotrāṃ samāsādya samānapravarāṃ tathā / cādrāyaṇena śudhyeta prayatātmā samāhitaḥ
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā gṛcchramekaṃ samācaret / kanyakāṃ dūṣayitvā tu careccāndrāyaṇavratam
amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāyāmayoniṣu / retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret
bandhakīgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśuddhyati / gavi bhathunamāsevya careccāndrāyaṇavratam
ajāvī maithunaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ / patitāṃ ca striyaṃ gatvā tribhiḥ kṛcchrai rviśuddhyati
pulkasīgamane caiva kracchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / naṭīṃ śailūṣakīṃ caiva rajakīṃ veṇujīvinīm / gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tathā carmopajīvinīm
brahāmacārī striyaṃ gacchet kathañcitkāmamohitaḥ / saptagāraṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ vasitvā gardabhājinam
upaspṛśet triṣavaṇaṃ svapāpaṃ parikīrtayan / saṃvatsareṇa caikena tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate
brahmahatyāvrataṃ vāpi ṣaṇmāsānācared yamī / mucyate hyavakīrṇo tu brāhmaṇānumate sthitaḥ
saptarātramakṛtvā tu bhaikṣacaryāgnipūjanam / retasaśca samutsarge prāyaścittaṃ samācaret
oṅkārapūrvikābhistu mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sadā / saṃvatsaraṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ bhikṣāśanaḥ śuciḥ
sāvitrīṃ ca japeccaiva nityaṃ krodhavivarjitaḥ / nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu tasmāt pāpād vimucyate
hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vipraḥ kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam / akāmato vai ṣaṇmāsān dadyān pañcaśataṃ gavām
abdaṃ careta niyato vanavāsī samāhitaḥ / prājāpatyaṃ sāntapanaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ tu vā svayam
pramāpyākāmato vaiśyaṃ kuryāt saṃvatsaradvayam / gosahasraṃ sapādaṃ ca dadyād brahmahaṇo vratam / kṛcchrātikṛcchrau vā kuryāccāndrāyaṇamathāvi vā
saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kuryācchūdraṃ hatvā pramādataḥ / gosahasrārdhapādaṃ ca dadyāt tatpāpaśāntaye
aṣṭau varṣāṇi ṣaṭ trīṇi kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam / hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva yathākramam
nihatya brāhmaṇīṃ viprastvaṣṭavarṣaṃ vrataṃ caret / rājanyāṃ varṣaṣaṭkaṃ tu vaiśyāṃ saṃvatsaratrayam / vatsareṇa viśuddhyeta śūdrāṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ
vaiśyāṃ hatvā pramādena kiñcid dadyād dvijātaye / antyajānāṃ vadhe caiva kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam / parākeṇāthavā śuddhirityāha bhagavānajaḥ
maṇḍūkaṃ nakulaṃ kākaṃ dandaśūkaṃ ca mūṣikam / śvānaṃ hatvā dvijaḥ kuryāt ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ vrataṃ tataḥ
payaḥ pibet trirātraṃ tu śvānaṃ hatvā suyantritaḥ / mārjāraṃ vātha nakulaṃ yojanaṃ vādhvano vrajet / kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ tu kuryādaśvavadhe dvijaḥ
abhrīṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt sarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ / palālabhāraṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ ca saisakaṃ caikamāṣakam
dhṛtakumbhaṃ varāhaṃ ca tiladroṇaṃ ca tittirim / śukaṃ dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam
hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇameva ca / vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau ca sparśayed brāhmaṇāya gām
kravyādāṃstu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm / akravyādān vatsatarīmuṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam
kiñcideva tu viprāya dadyādasthimatāṃ vadhe / anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati
phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyamṛkśatam / gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām
anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ sarasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam
hastināṃ ca vadhe dṛṣṭaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ viśodhanam / cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā gāṃ hatvā tu pramādataḥ / matipūrvaṃ vadhe cāsyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvātriśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇaṃ kṛtvā strīṇāṃ gṛhasya ca / vāpīkūpajalānāṃ ca śudhyeccāndrāyaṇena tu
dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tanniryātyātmaśuddhaye
dhānyānnadhanacauryaṃ tu kṛtvā kāmād dvijottamaḥ / svajātīyagṛhādeva kṛcchrārdhena viśuddhyati
bhakṣabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca / puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ ca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca / cailacarmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca / ayaḥ kāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇāśanam
kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca / pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajvāścaiva tryahaṃ payaḥ
naramāṃsāśanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret / kākaṃ caiva tathā śvānaṃ jagdhvā hastinameva ca / varāhaṃ kukkuṭaṃ cātha taptakṛcchreṇa śudhyati
kravyādānāṃ ca māṃsāni purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca / gogomāyukapīnāṃ ca tadeva vratamācaret / upoṣya dvādaśāhaṃ tu kūṣmāṇḍairjuhuyād ghṛtam
nakulolūkamārjāraṃ jagdhvā sāṃtapanaṃ caret / śvāpadoṣṭrakharāñjagdhvā taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / vratavaccaiva saṃskāraṃ pūrveṇa vidhinaiva tu
bakaṃ caiva balākaṃ ca haṃsaṃ kāraṇḍavaṃ tathā / cakravākaṃ plavaṃ jagghvā dvādaśāhamabhojanam
kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva śukaṃ sārasameva ca / ulūkaṃ jālapādaṃ ca jagdhvāpyetad vrataṃ caret
śiśumāraṃ tathā cāṣaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca / jagdhvā caiva kaṭāhārametadeva cared vratam
kokilaṃ caiva matsyāṃśca maṇḍukaṃ bhujagaṃ tathā / gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati
jalecarāṃśca jalajān prattudānnakhaviṣkirān / raktapādāṃstathā jagdhvā saptāhaṃ caitadācaret
śuno māṃsaṃ śuṣkamāṃsamātmārthaṃ ca tathā kṛtam / bhuktvā māsaṃ caredetat tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
vārtākaṃ bhustṛṇaṃ śigruṃ khukhuṇḍaṃ karakaṃ tathā / prājāpatyaṃ carejjagdhvā śaṅkhaṃ kumbhīkameva ca
palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / nālikāṃ taṇḍulīyaṃ ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati
aśmāntakaṃ tathā potaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / prājāpatyena śuddhiḥ syāt kakkubhāṇḍasya bhakṣaṇe
alābuṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva bhuktvā caitad vrataṃ caret / udumbaraṃ ca kāmena taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
vṛthā kṛsarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpasaṃkulam / bhuktvā caivaṃ vidhaṃ tvannaṃ trirātreṇa viśuddhyati
pītvā kṣīrāṇyapeyāni brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati
anirdaśāhaṃ gokṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ cājameva ca / saṃdhinyāśca vivatsāyāḥ piban kṣīramidaṃ caret
eteṣāṃ ca vikārāṇi pītvā mohena mānavaḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ saptarātreṇa śuddhyati
bhuktvā caiva navaśrāddhe mṛtake sūtake tathā / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhyeta brāhmaṇastu samāhitaḥ
yasyāgnau hūyate nityaṃ na yasyāgraṃ na dīyate / cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret samyak tasyānnaprāśane dvijaḥ
abhojyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bhuktvā cānnamupaskṛtam / antāvasāyināṃ caiva taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
cāṇḍālānnaṃ dvijo bhuktvā samyak cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchrābdaṃ punaḥ saṃskārameva ca
asurāmadyapānena kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam / abhojyānnaṃ tu bhuktvā ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati
viṇmūtrapāśanaṃ kṛtvā retasaścaitadācaret / anādiṣṭeṣu caikāhaṃ sarvatra tu yathārthataḥ
viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ / prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca / punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ
kravyādāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva prāśya mūtrapurīṣakam / mahāsāṃtapanaṃ mohāt tathā kuryād dvijottamaḥ / bhāsamaṇḍūkakurare viṣkire kṛcchramācaret
prājāpatyena śuddhyeta brāhāmaṇocchiṣṭabhojane / kṣatriye taptakṛcchraṃ syād vaiśye caivātikṛcchrakam / śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam
surābhāṇḍodare vāri pītvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / śunocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ pītaśeṣaṃ ca rāgavān
apo mūtrapurīṣādyairdūṣitāḥ prāśayed yadā / tadā sāṃtapanaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ pāpaviśodhanam
cāṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu yadi jñānāt pibejjalam / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pāpaśodhanam
cāṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭaṃ pītvā vāri dvijottamaḥ / trirātreṇa viśuddhyeta pañcagavyena caiva hi
mahāpātakisaṃsparśe bhuṅkte 'snātvā dvijo yadi / buddhipūrvaṃ tu mūḍhātmā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret
spṛṣṭvā mahāpātakinaṃ cāṇḍālaṃ vā rajasvalām / pramādād bhojanaṃ kṛtvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati
snānārhe yadi bhuñjīta ahorātreṇa śuddhyati / buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchreṇa bhagavānāha padmajaḥ
śuṣkaparyuṣitādīni gavādipratidūṣitam / bhuktvopavāsaṃ kurvota kṛcchrapādamathāpi vā
saṃvatsarānte kṛcchraṃ tu cared vipraḥ punaḥ punaḥ / ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ
vrātyānāṃ yajanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmantyakarma ca / abhicāramahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrairviśuddhyati
brāhmaṇādihatānāṃ tu kṛtvā dāhādikāḥ kriyāḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ prājāpatyena śuddhyati
tailābhyakto 'thavā kuryād yadi mūtrapurīṣake / ahorātreṇa śuddhyeta śmaśrukarma ca maithunam
ekāhena vivāhāgniṃ parihārya dvijottamaḥ / trirātreṇa viśaddhyeta trirātrāt ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ
daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā parihārya pramādataḥ / kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
patitād dravyamādāya tadutsargeṇa śuddhyati / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchramityāha bhagavān prabhuḥ
anāśakanivṛttāstu pravrajyāvasitāstathā / careyustrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi trīṇi cāndrāyaṇāni ca
punaśca jātakarmādisaṃkāraiḥ saṃskṛtā dvijāḥ / śuddhyeyustad vrataṃ samyak careyurdharmavardhanāḥ
anupāsitasaṃdhyastu tadaharyāpako vaset / anaśnan saṃyatamanā rātrau ced rātrimeva hi
akṛtvā samidādhānaṃ śuciḥ snātvā samāhitaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasrasya japyaṃ kuryād viśuddhaye
upāsīta na cet saṃdhyāṃ gṛhastho 'pi pramādataḥ / snātvā viśuddhyate sadyaḥ pariśrāntastu saṃyamāt
vedoditāni nityāni karmāṇi ca vilopya tu / snātakavratalopaṃ tu kṛtvā copavased dinam
saṃvatsaraṃ caret kṛcchramagnyutsādī dvijottamaḥ / cāndrāyaṇaṃ cared vrātyo gopradānena śuddhyati
nāstikyaṃ yadi kurvota prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ / devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ ca kāmataḥ / trirātreṇa viśuddhyet tu nagno vā praviśejjalam
ṣaṣṭhānnakālatāmāsaṃ saṃhitājapa eva ca / homāśca śākalā nityamapāṅktānāṃ viśodhanam
nīlaṃ raktaṃ vasitvā ca brāhmaṇo vastrameva hi / ahorātroṣitaḥ snātaḥ pañcagavyena śuddhyati
vedadharmapurāṇānāṃ caṇḍālasya tu bhāṣaṇe / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syānna hyanyā tasya niṣkṛtiḥ
udbandhanādinihataṃ saṃspṛśya brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syāt prājāpatyena vā punaḥ
ucchiṣṭo yadyanācāntaścāṇḍālādīn spṛśed dvijaḥ / pramādād vai japet snātvā gāyatryaṣṭasahasrakam
drupadānāṃ śataṃ vāpi brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak pañcagavyena śuddhyati
caṇḍālapatitādīṃstu kāmād yaḥ saṃspṛśed dvijaḥ / ucchiṣṭastatra kurvota prājāpatyaṃ viśuddhaye
cāṇḍālasūtakaśavāṃstathā nārīṃ rajasvalām / spṛṣṭvā snāyād viśuddhyarthaṃ tatspṛṣṭaṃ patitiṃ tathā
cāṇḍālasūtakaśavaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saṃspṛśed yadi / pramādāt tata ācamya japaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
tat spṛṣṭasparśinaṃ spṛṣṭvā buddhipūrvaṃ dvijottamaḥ / ācamet tad viśuddhyarthaṃ prāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ
bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācit saṃstraved gudam / kṛtvā śaucaṃ tataḥ snāyādupoṣya juhuyād ghṛtam
cāṇḍālāntyaśavaṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛcchraṃ kuryād viśuddhaye / spṛṣṭvābhyaktastvasaṃspṛśyamahorātreṇa śuddhyati
surāṃ spṛṣṭvā dvijaḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ śuciḥ / palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva ghṛtaṃ prāśya tataḥ śuciḥ
brāhmaṇastu śunā daṣṭastryahaṃ sāyaṃ payaḥ pibet / nābherūrdhvaṃ tu daṣṭasya tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet
syādetat triguṇaṃ bāhvormūrdhni ca syāccaturguṇam / snātvā japed vā sāvitrīṃ śvabhirdaṣṭo dvijottamaḥ
anirvartya mahāyajñān yo bhuṅkte tu dvijottamaḥ / anāturaḥ sati dhane kṛcchrārdhena sa śuddhyati
āhitāgnirupasthānaṃ na kuryād yastu parvaṇi / ṛtau na gacched bhāryāṃ vā so 'pi kṛcchrārdhamācaret
vinādbhirapsu nāpyārtaḥ śarīraṃ sanniveśya ca / sacailo jalamāplutya gāmālabhya viśuddhyati
buddhipūrvaṃ tvabhyudito japedantarjale dvijaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu tryahaṃ copavased vratī
anugamyecchayā śūdraṃ pretībhūtaṃ dvijottamaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ ca japyaṃ kuryānnadīṣu ca
kṛtvā tu śapathaṃ vipro viprasya vadhasaṃyutam / mṛṣaiva yāvakānnena kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam
paṅktyāṃ viṣamadānaṃ tu kṛtvā kṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / chāyāṃ śvapākasyāruhya snātvā saṃprāśayed ghṛtam
īkṣedādityamaśucirdṛṣṭvāgniṃ candrameva vā / mānuṣaṃ cāsthi saṃspṛśya snānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhyati
kṛtvā tu mithyādhyayanaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ tu vatsaram / kṛtaghno brāhmaṇagṛhe pañca saṃvatsaraṃ vratī
huṅkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṅkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ / snātvānaśnannahaḥ śeṣaṃ praṇipatya prasādayet
tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhaṃ baddhvāpi vāsasā / vivāde vāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet
avagūrya caret kṛcchramatikṛcchraṃ nipātane / kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvota viprasyotpādya śoṇitam
gurorākrośamanṛtaṃ kṛtvā kuryād viśodhanam / ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
devarṣoṇāmabhimukhaṃ ṣṭhīvanākrośane kṛte / ulmukena dahejjihvāṃ dātavyaṃ ca hiraṇyakam
devodyāne tu yaḥ kuryānmūtroccāraṃ sakṛd dvijaḥ / chindyācchiśnaṃ tu śuddhyarthaṃ careccāndrāyaṇaṃ tu vā
devatāyatane mūtraṃ kṛtvā mohād dvijottamaḥ / śiśnasyotkartanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ caiva kutsanam / kṛtvā samyak prakurvota prājāpatyaṃ dvijottamaḥ
taistu saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā devān samarcayet / dṛṣṭvā vīkṣeta bhāsvantaṃ smvatvā viśeśvaraṃ smaret
yaḥ sarvabhūtādhipatiṃ viśveśānaṃ vinindati / na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi
cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret pūrvaṃ kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam / prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tasmāt pāpād vimucyate
sarvasvadānaṃ vidhivat sarvapāpaviśodhanam / cāndrāyaṇaṃ cavidhinā kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam
puṇyakṣetrābhigamanaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / devatābhyarcanaṃ nṝṇāmaśeṣāghavināśanam
amāvasyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya yaḥ samārādhayecchivam / brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahādevaṃ tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm / saṃpūjya brāhmaṇamukhe sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanam / dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ / yamāca dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca / pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyāt saptodakāñjalīn / snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāmupavāsaṃ dvijārcanam / vrateṣveteṣu kurvota śāntaḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ
amāvasyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ samuddiśya pitāmaham / brāhmaṇāṃstrīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito devaṃ śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ / saptamyāmarcayed bhānuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
bharaṇyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca śanaiścaradine yamam / pūjayet saptajanmotthairmucyate pātakairnaraḥ
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam / dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate
tapo japastīrthasevā devabrāhmaṇapūjanam / grahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu mahāpātakaśodhanam
yaḥ sarvapāpayukto 'pi puṇyatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ / niyamena tyajet prāṇān sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ
brahmaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ vā mahāpātakadūṣitam / bhartāramuddharennārī praviṣṭā saha pāvakam
etadeva paraṃ strīṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ / sarvapāpasamudbhūtau nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
pativratā tu yā nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇotsukā / na tasyā vidyate pāpamiha loke paratra ca
pativratā dharmaratā rudrāṇyeva na saṃśayaḥ / nāsyāḥ parābhavaṃ kartuṃ śaknotīha janaḥ kvacit
yathā rāmasya subhagā sītā trailokyaviśrutā / patnī dāśaratherdevī vijigye rākṣaseśvaram
rāmasya bhāryāṃ vimalāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / sītāṃ viśālanayanāṃ cakame kālacoditaḥ
gṛhītvā māyayā veṣaṃ carantīṃ vijane vane / samāhartuṃ matiṃ cakre tāpasaḥ kila kāminīm
vijñāya sā ca tadbhāvaṃ smṛtvā dāśarathiṃ patim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ vahnimāvasathyaṃ śucismitā
upatasthe mahāyogaṃ sarvadoṣavināśanam / kṛtāñjalī rāmapatnī śākṣāt patimivācyutam
namasyāmi mahāyogaṃ kṛtāntaṃ gahanaṃ param / dāhakaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśānaṃ kālarūpiṇam
namasye pāvakaṃ devaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ viśvatomukham / ātmānaṃ dīptavapuṣaṃ sarvabhūtahṛdī sthitam
