prapadye śaraṇaṃ vahniṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brahmarūpiṇam / bhūteśaṃ kṛttivasanaṃ śaraṇyaṃ paramaṃ padam
oṃ prapadye jaganmūrtiṃ prabhavaṃ sarvatejasām / mahāyogeśvaraṃ vahnimādityaṃ parameṣṭhinam
prapadye śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ mahāgrāsaṃ triśūlinam / kālāgniṃ yogināmīśaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam
prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ svarūpiṇam / hiraṇyamaye gṛhe guptaṃ mahāntamamitaujasam
vaiśvānaraṃ prapadye 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam / havyakavyavahaṃ devaṃ prapadye vahnimīśvaram
prapadye tatparaṃ tattvaṃ vareṇyaṃ savituḥ svayam / bhargamagniparaṃ jyotī rakṣa māṃ havyavāhana
iti vahnyaṣṭakaṃ japtvā rāmapatnī yaśasvinī / dhyāyantī manasā tasthau rāmamunmīlitekṣaṇā
athāvasathyād bhagavān havyavāho maheśvaraḥ / āvirāsīt sudīptātmā tejasā pradahanniva
svaṣṭvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ sa rāvaṇavadhepsayā / sītāmādāya dharmiṣṭhāṃ pāvako 'ntaradhīyata
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / samādāya yayau laṅkāṃ sāgarāntarasaṃsthitām
kṛtvātha rāvaṇavadhaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ / masādāyābhavat sītāṃ śaṅkākulitamānasaḥ
sā pratyayāya bhūtānāṃ sītā māyāmīya punaḥ / viveśa pāvakaṃ dīptaṃ dadāha jvalano 'pi tām
dagdhvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ / rāmāyādarśayat sītāṃ pāvako 'bhūt surapriyaḥ
pragṛhya bhartuścaraṇau karābhyāṃ sā sumadhyamā / cakāra praṇatiṃ bhūmau rāmāya janakātmajā
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā rāmo vismayākulalocanaḥ / nanāma vahniṃ sirasā toṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
uvāca vahnerbhagavān kimeṣā varavarṇinī / dagdhā bhagavatā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā matpārśvamāgatā
tamāha devo lokānāṃ dāhako havyavāhanaḥ / yathāvṛttaṃ dāśarathiṃ bhūtānāmeva sannidhau
iyaṃ sā mithileśena pārvatīṃ rudravallabhām / ārādhya labdhā tapasā devyāścātyantavallabhā
bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇopetā suśīleyaṃ pativratā / bhavānīpārśvamānītā mayā rāvaṇakāmitā
yā nītā rākṣaseśena sītā bhagavatāhṛtā / mayā māyāmayī sṛṣṭā rāvaṇasya vadhāya sā
tadarthaṃ bhavatā duṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / mayopasaṃhṛtā caiva hato lokavināśanaḥ
gṛhāṇa vimalāmenāṃ jānakīṃ vacanānmama / paśya nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svātmānaṃ prabhavāvyayam
ityuktvā bhagavāṃścaṇḍo viścārcirviśvatomukhaḥ / mānito rāghaveṇāgnirbhūtaiścāntaradhīyata
etate pativratānāṃ vaiṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā / strīṇāṃ sarvāghaśamanaṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam
aśeṣapāpayuktastu puruṣo 'pi susaṃyataḥ / svadehaṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu tyaktvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā puṇyeṣu vā dvijaḥ / mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ samastairapi pūruṣaḥ
vyāsa uvāca ityeṣa mānavo dharmo yuṣmākaṃ kathito mayā / maheśārādhanārthāya jñānayogaṃ ca śāśvatam
yo 'nena vidhinā yuktaṃ jñānayogaṃ samācaret / sa paśyati mahādevaṃ nānyaḥ kalpaśatairapi
sthāpayed yaḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tatpārameśvaram / na tasmādadhiko loke sa yogī paramo mataḥ
ya saṃsthāpayituṃ śakto na kuryānmohito janaḥ / sa yogayukto 'pi munirnātyarthaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ
tasmāt sadaiva dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ / dharmayukteṣu śānteṣu śraddhayā cānviteṣu vai
yaḥ paṭhed bhavatāṃ nityaṃ saṃvādaṃ mama caiva hi / sarvapāpavinirmukto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau / paṭheta nityaṃ sumanāḥ śrotavyaṃ ca dvijātibhiḥ
yor'thaṃ vicārya yuktātmā śrāvayed brāhmaṇān śucīn / sa doṣakañcukaṃ tyaktvā yāti devaṃ maheśvaram
etāvaduktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / samāśvāsya munīn sūtaṃ jagāma ca yathāgatam
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayastriśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ tīrthāni yāni loke 'smin viśrutāni māhanti ca / tāni tvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa sāṃpratam
romaharṣaṇa uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ kathayiṣye 'haṃ tīrthāni vividhāni ca / kathitāni purāṇeṣu munibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ
yatra snānaṃ japo homaḥ śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtam / ekaikaśo muniśreṣṭhāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam
pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / prayāgaṃ prathitaṃ tīrthaṃ tasya māhātmyamīritam
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kurūṇāṃ devavanditam / ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam
tatra snātvā viśuddhātmā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ / dadāti yatkiñcidapi punātyubhayataḥ kulam
gayātīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāti vallabham / kṛtvā piṇḍapradānaṃ tu na bhūyo jāyate naraḥ
sakṛd gayābhigamanaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ dadāti yaḥ / tāritāḥ pitarastena yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim
tatra lokahitārthāya rudreṇa paramātmanā / śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ tatra pitṝn prasādayet
gayābhigamanaṃ kartuṃ yaḥ śakto nābhigacchati / śocanti pitarastaṃ vai vṛthā tasya pariśramaḥ
gāyanti pitaro gāthāḥ kīrtayanti maharṣayaḥ / gayāṃyāsyatiyaḥ kaścit so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati
yadi syāt pātakopetaḥ svadharmarativarjitaḥ / gayāṃ yāsyati vaṃśyo yaḥ so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ / teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ / pradadyād vidhivat piṇḍān gayāṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ
dhanyāstu khalu te martyā gayāyāṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ / kulānyubhayataḥ sapta samuddhṛtyāpnuyāt param
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ siddhāvāsamudāhṛtam / prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ yatrāste bhagavān bhavaḥ
tatra snānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam / kṛtvā lokamavāpnoti brahmaṇo 'kṣayyamuttamam
tīrthaṃ traiyambakaṃ nāma sarvadevanamaskṛtam / pūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ jyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
suvarṇākṣaṃ mahādevaṃ samabhyarcya kapardinam / brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu gāṇapatyaṃ labhed dhruvam
someśvaraṃ tīrthavaraṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ / sarvavyādhiharaṃ puṇyaṃ rudrasālokyakāraṇam
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vijayaṃ nāma śobhanam / tatra liṅgaṃ maheśasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutam
ṣaṇmāsān niyatāhāro brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / uṣitvā tatra viprendrā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ pūrvadeśe suśobhanam / ekāmraṃ devadevasya gāṇapatyaphalapradam
dattvātra śivabhaktānāṃ kiñcicchaśvanmahīṃ śubhām / sārvabhaumo bhaved rājā mumukṣurmokṣamāpnuyāt
mahānadījalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / grahaṇe samupaspṛśya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
anyā ca virajā nāma nadī trailokyaviśrutā / tasyāṃ snātvā naro viprā brahmaloke mahīyate
tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇasyānyannāmnā tu puruṣottamam / tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānāste paramapūruṣaḥ
pūjayitvā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ snātvā tatra dvijottamaḥ / brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ gokarṇaṃ nāma viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ śaṃbhornivāsaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
dṛṣṭvā liṃṅgaṃ tu devasya gokarṇeśvaramuttamam / īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān rudrasya dayito bhavet
uttaraṃ cāpi gokarṇaṃ liṅgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ / mahādevasyārcayitvā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
tatra devo mahādevaḥ sthāṇurityabhiviśrutaḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate tatkṣaṇānnaraḥ
anyat kubjāmramatulaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ / saṃpūjya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śvetadvīpe mahīyate
yatra nārāyaṇo devo rudreṇa tripurāriṇā / kṛtvā yajñasya mathanaṃ dakṣasya tu visarjitaḥ
samantād yojanaṃ kṣetraṃ siddharṣigaṇavanditam / puṇyamāyatanaṃ viṣṇostatrāste puruṣottamaḥ
anyat kokāmukhaṃ viṣṇostīrthamadbhutakarmaṇaḥ / mṛto 'tra pātakairmukto viṣṇusārūpyamāpnuyāt
śālagrāmaṃ mahātīrthaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītivivardhanam / prāṇāṃstatra narastyaktvā hṛṣīkeṣaṃ prapaśyati
aśvatīrthamiti khyātaṃ siddhāvāsaṃ supāvanam / āste hayaśirā nityaṃ tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / puṣkaraṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ mṛtānāṃ brahmalokadam
manasā saṃsmared yastu puṣkaraṃ vai dvijottamaḥ / pūyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakreṇa saha modate
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / upāsate siddhasaṅghā brahmaṇaṃ padmasaṃbhavam
tatra strātvā bhavecchuddho brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / pūjayitvā dvijavarān brahmāṇaṃ saṃprapaṣyati
tatrābhigamya deveśaṃ puruhūtamaninditam / surūpo jāyate martyaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt
saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ param / pūjayitvā tatra rudramaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
yatra maṅkaṇako rudraṃ prapannaḥ parameśvaram / ārādhayāmāsa haraṃ pañcakṣaraparāyaṇaḥ
namaḥ śivāyeti muniḥ japan pañcākṣaraṃ param / ārādhayāmāsa śivaṃ tapasā govṛṣadhvajam
prajajvālātha tapasā munirmaṅkaṇakastadā / nanarta harṣavegena jñātvā rudraṃ samāgatam
taṃ prāha bhagavān rudraḥ kimarthaṃ nartitaṃ tvayā / dṛṣṭvāpi devamīśānaṃ nṛtyati sma punaḥ punaḥ
so 'nvīkṣya bhagavānīśaḥ sagarvaṃ garvaśāntaye / svakaṃ dehaṃ vidāryāsmai bhasmarāśimadarśayat
paśyemaṃ maccharīrotthaṃ bhasmarāśiṃ dvijottama / māhātmyametat tapasastvādṛśo 'nyo 'pi vidyate
yat sagarvaṃ hi bhavatā nartitaṃ munipuṅgava / na yuktaṃ tāpasasyaitat tvattopyatrādhiko hyaham
ityābhāṣya muniśreṣṭhaṃ sa rudraḥ kila viśvadṛk / āsthāya paramaṃ bhāvaṃ nanarta jagato haraḥ
sahasraśīrṣā bhūtvā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt / daṃṣṭrākarālavadano jvālāmālī bhayaṅkaraḥ
so 'nvapaśyadaśeṣasya pārśve tasya triśūlinaḥ / viśālalocanamekāṃ devīṃ cāruvilāsinīm / sūryāyutasamaprakhyāṃ prasannavadanāṃ śivām
sasmitaṃ prekṣya viśveśaṃ tiṣṭhantīmamitadyutim / dṛṣṭvā saṃtrastahṛdayo vepamāno munīśvaraḥ / nanāma śirasā rudraṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ japan vaśī
prasanno bhagavānīśastryambako bhaktavatsalaḥ / pūrvaveṣaṃ sa jagrāha devī cāntarhitābhavat
āliṅgya bhaktaṃ praṇataṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃśivaḥ / na bhetavyaṃ tvayā vatsa prāha kiṃ te dadāmyaham
praṇamya mūrdhnā giriśaṃ haraṃ tripurasūdanam / vijñāpayāmāsa tadā hṛṣṭaḥ praṣṭumanā muniḥ
namo 'stu te mahādeva maheśvara namo 'stu te / kimetad bhagavadrūpaṃ sughoraṃ viśvatomukham
kā ca sā bhagavatpārśve rājamānā vyavasthitā / antarhiteva sahasā sarvamicchāmi veditum
ityukte vyājahāramaṃ tathā maṅkaṇakaṃ haraḥ / maheśaḥ svātmano yogaṃ devīṃ ca tripurānalaḥ
ahaṃ sahasranayanaḥ sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ / dāhakaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ kālaḥ kālakaro haraḥ
mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ cetanācetanātmakam / so 'ntaryāmī sa puruṣo hyahaṃ vai puruṣottamaḥ
tasya sā paramā māyā prakṛtistriguṇātmikā / procyate munirbhiśaktirjagadyoniḥ sanātanī
sa eṣa māyayā viśvaṃ vyāmohayati viśvavit / nārāyaṇaḥ paro 'vyakto māyārūpa iti śrutiḥ
evametajjagat sarvaṃ sarvadā sthāpayāmyaham / yojayāmi prakṛtyāhaṃ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
tathā vai saṃgato devaḥ kūṭasthaḥ sarvago 'malaḥ / sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ svamūrteḥ prakṛterajaḥ
sa devo bhagavān brahmā viśvarūpaḥ pitāmahaḥ / tavaitat kathitaṃ samyak straṣṭvatvaṃ paramātmanaḥ
eko 'haṃ bhagavān kalo hyanādiścāntakṛd vibhuḥ / samāsthāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ prokto rudro manīṣibhiḥ
mama vai sāparā śaktirdevī vidyeti viśrutā / dṛṣṭā hi bhavatā nūnaṃ vidyādehastvahaṃ tataḥ
evametāni tattvāni pradhānapuruṣeśvarāḥ / viṣṇurbrahmā ca bhagavān rudraḥ kāla iti śrutiḥ
trayametadanādyantaṃ brahmaṇyeva vyavasthitam / tadātmakaṃ tadavyaktaṃ tadakṣaramiti śrutiḥ
ātmānandaparaṃ tattvaṃ cinmātraṃ paramaṃ padam / ākāśaṃ niṣkalaṃ brahma tasmādanyanna vidyate
evaṃ vijñāya bhavatā bhaktiyogāśrayeṇa tu / saṃpūjyo vandanīyo 'haṃ tatastaṃ paśya śāśvatam
etāvaduktvā bhagavāñjagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ / tatraiva bhaktiyogena rudrāmārādhayanmuniḥ
etat pavitramatulaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmarṣisevitam / saṃsevya brāhmaṇo vidvān mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca anyat pavitraṃ vipulaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / rudrakoṭiriti khyātaṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
purā puṇyatame kāle devadarśanatatparāḥ / koṭibrahmarṣayo dāntāstaṃ deśamagaman param
ahaṃ drakṣyāmi giriśaṃ pūrvameva pinākinam / anyo 'nyaṃ bhaktiyuktānāṃ vyāghāto jāyate kila
teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā giriśo yogināṃ guruḥ / koṭirūpo 'bhavad rudro rudrakoṭistataḥ smṛtaḥ
te sma sarve mahādevaṃ haraṃ giriguhāśayam / paśyantaḥ pārvatīnāthaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭadhiyo 'bhavan
anādyantaṃ mahādevaṃ pūrvamevāhamīśvaram / dṛṣṭavāniti bhaktyā te rudranyastadhiyo 'bhavan
athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ paśyanti sma mahattaram / jyotistatraiva te sarve 'bhilaṣantaḥ paraṃ padam
etat sadeśādhyuṣitaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham / dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ samabhyarcya rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā madhuvanaṃ smṛtam / tatra gatvā niyamavānindrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet
athānyatpuṣpanagarī deśaḥ puṇyatamaḥ śubhaḥ / tatra gatvā pitṝn pūjya kulānāṃ tārayecchatam
kālañjaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ loke rudro maheśvaraḥ / kālaṃ jaritavān devo yatra bhaktipriyo haraḥ
śveto nāma śive bhakto rājarṣipravaraḥ purā / tadāśīstannamaskāraḥ pūjayāmāsa śūlinam
saṃsthāpya vidhinā liṅgaṃ bhaktiyogapuraḥ saraḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ
sa taṃ kālo 'tha dīptātmā śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam / netumabhyāgato deśaṃ sa rājā yatra tiṣṭhati
vīkṣya rājā bhayāviṣṭaḥ śūlahastaṃ samāgatam / kālaṃ kālakaraṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ caṇḍadīdhitim
ubābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ spṛṭvāsau liṅgamaiśvaram / nanāma śirasā rudraṃ jajāpa śatarudriyam
japantamāha rājānaṃ namantamasakṛd bhavam / ehyehīti puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāntaḥ prahasanniva
tamuvāca bhayāviṣṭo rājā rudraparāyaṇaḥ / ekamīśārcanarataṃ vihāyānyaṃ niṣūdaya
ityuktavantaṃ bhagavānabravīd bhītamānasam / rudrārcanarato vānyo madvaśe ko na tiṣṭhati
evamuktvā sa rājānaṃ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / babandha pāśai rājāpi jajāpa śatarudriyam
athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ dīpyamānaṃ tejorāśiṃ bhūtabhartuḥ purāṇam / jvālāmālāsaṃvṛtaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ saṃsthitaṃ saṃdadarśa
tanmadhye 'sau puruṣaṃ rukmavarṇaṃ devyā devaṃ candralekhojjvalāṅgam / tejorūpaṃ paśyati smātihṛṣṭo mene cāsmannātha āgacchatīti
āgacchantaṃ nātidūre 'tha dṛṣṭvā kālo rudraṃ devadevyā maheśam / vyapetabhīrakhileśaikanāthaṃ rājarṣistaṃ netumabhyājagāma
ālokyāsau bhagavānugrakarmā devo rudro bhūtabhartā purāṇaḥ / ekaṃ bhaktaṃ matparaṃ māṃ smarantaṃ dehītīmaṃ kālamūce mameti
śrutvā vākhyaṃ gopaterugrabhāvaḥ kālātmāsau manyamānaḥ svabhāvam / baddhvā bhaktaṃ punarevātha pāśaiḥ kruddho rudramabhidudrāva vegāt
prekṣyāyāntaṃ śailaputrīmatheśaḥ so 'nvīkṣyānte viśvamāyāvidhijñaḥ / sāvajñaṃ vai vāmapādena mṛtyuṃ śvetasyainaṃ paśyato vyājaghāna
mamāra so 'tibhīṣaṇo maheśapādaghātitaḥ / rarāja devatāpatiḥ sahomayā pinākadhṛk
nirīkṣya devamīśvaraṃ prahṛṣṭamānaso haram / nanāma sāmbamavyayaṃ sa rājapuṅgavastadā
namo bhavāya hetave harāya viśvasaṃbhave / namaḥ śivāya dhīmate namo 'pavargadāyine
namo namo namo 'stu te mahāvibhūtaye namaḥ / vibhāgahīnarūpiṇe namo narādhipāya te
namo 'stu te gaṇeśvara prapannaduḥ khanāśana / anādinityabhūtaye varāhaśṛṅgadhāriṇe
namo vṛṣadhvajāya te kapālamāline namaḥ / namo mahānaṭāya te namo vṛṣadhvajāya te
athānugṛhya śaṅkaraḥ praṇāmatatparaṃ nṛpam / svagāṇapatyamavyayaṃ sarūpatāmatho dadau
sahomayā sapārṣadaḥ sarājapuṅgavo haraḥ / munīśasiddhavanditaḥ kṣaṇādadṛśyatāmagāt
kāle maheśābhihate lokanāthaḥ pitāmahaḥ / ayācata varaṃ rudraṃ sajīvo 'yaṃ bhavatviti
nāsti kaścidapīśāna doṣaleśo vṛṣadhvaja / kṛtāntasyaiva bhavatā tatkārye viniyojitaḥ
sa devadevavacanād devadeveśvaro haraḥ / tathāstvityāha viśvātmā so 'pi tādṛgvidho 'bhavat
ityetat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ kālañjaramiti śrutam / gatvābhyarcya mahādevaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ sa vindati
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca idanamanyate paraṃ sthānaṃ guhyād guhyatamaṃ mahat / mahādevasya devasya mahālayamiti śrutam
tatra devādidevena rudreṇa tripurāriṇā / śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam
tatra puśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / upāsate mahādevaṃ vedādhyayanatatparāḥ
snātvā tatra padaṃ śārvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktipuraḥ saram / namaskṛtvātha śirasā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ śaṃbhormahātmanaḥ / kedāramiti vikhyātaṃ siddhānāmālayaṃ śubham
tatra snātvā mahādevamabhyarcya vṛṣaketanam / pītvā caivodakaṃ śuddhaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtvā hyakṣyaṃ labhate phalam / dvijātipravarairjuṣṭaṃ yogibhiryatamānasaiḥ
tīrthaṃ plakṣāvataraṇaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / tatrābhyarcya śrīnivāsaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate
anyaṃ magadharājasya tīrthaṃ svargagatipradam / akṣayaṃ vindati svargaṃ tatra gatvā dvijottamaḥ
tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / yatra devena rudreṇa yajño dakṣasya nāśitaḥ
tatra gaṅgāmupaspṛśya śucirbhāvasamanvitaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpaistu brahmalokaṃ labhenmṛtaḥ
mahātīrthamiti khyātaṃ puṇyaṃ nārāyaṇapriyam / tatrābhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ nigacchati
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā śrīparvataṃ śubham / tatra prāṇān parityajya rudrasya dayito bhavet
tatra sannihito rudro devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / snānapiṇḍādikaṃ tatra kṛtamakṣayyamuttamam
godāvarī nadī puṇyā sarvapāpavināśanī / tatra snātvā pitṝn devāṃstarpayitvā yathāvidhi / sarvapāpavisuddhātmā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
pavitrasalilā puṇyā kāverī vipulā nadī / tasyāṃ snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ / trirātropoṣitenātha ekarātroṣitena vā
dvijātīnāṃ tu kathitaṃ tīrthānāmiha sevanam / yasya vāṅmanaso śuddhe hastapādau ca saṃsthitau / alolupo brahmacāro tīrthānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt
svāmitīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / tatra sannihito nityaṃ skando 'maranamaskṛtaḥ
snātvā kumāradhārāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam / ārādhya ṣaṇmukhaṃ devaṃ skandena saha modate
nadī trailokyavikhyātā tāmraparṇoti nāmataḥ / tatra snātvā pitṝn bhaktyā tarpayitvā yathāvidhi / pāpakartṝnapi pitṝstārayennātra saṃśayaḥ
candratīrthamiti khyātaṃ kāveryāḥ prabhave 'kṣayam / tīrthaṃ tatra bhaved vastuṃ mṛtānāṃ svargatirdhruvā
vindhyapāde prapaśyanti devadevaṃ sadāśivam / bhaktyā ye te na paśyanti yamasya sadanaṃ dvijāḥ
devikāyāṃ vṛṣo nāma tīrthaṃ siddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvodakaṃ datvā yogasiddhiṃ ca vindati
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ tatrāpnoti phalaṃ naraḥ
puṇḍarīkaṃ mahātīrthaṃ brāhmaṇairupasevitam / tatrābhigamya yuktātmā pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet
tīrthebhyaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmatīrthamiti śrutam / brahmāṇamarcayitvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate
sarasvatyā vinaśanaṃ plakṣaprastravaṇaṃ śubham / vyāsatīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mainākaṃ ca nagottamam / yamunāprabhavaṃ caiva sarvapāpaviśodhanam
pitṝṇāṃ duhitā devī gandhakālīti viśrutā / tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ yāti mṛto jātismaro bhavet
kuberatuṅgaṃ pāpaghnaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam / prāṇāṃstatra parityajya kuberānucaro bhavet
umātuṅgamiti khyātaṃ yatra sā rudravallabhā / tatrābhyarcya mahādevīṃ kosahasraphalaṃ labhet
bhṛgutuṅge tapastaptaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā kṛtam / kulānyubhayataḥ sapta punātīti śrutirmama
kāśyapasya mahātīrthaṃ kālasarpiriti śrutam / tatra śrāddhāni deyāni nityaṃ pāpakṣayecchayā
daśārṇāyāṃ tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ homastathā japaḥ / akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvadā
tīrthaṃ dvijātibhirjuṣṭaṃ nāmnā vai kurujāṅgalam / dattvā tu dānaṃ vidhivad brahmaloke mahīyate
vaitaraṇyāṃ mahātīrthe svarṇavedyāṃ tathaiva ca / dharmapṛṣṭhe ca sarasi brahmaṇaḥ parame śubhe
bharatasyāśrame puṇye puṇye śrāddhavaṭe śubhe / mahāhrade ca kauśikyāṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
muñjapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyastaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā / hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam
alpenāpi tu kālena naro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / pāpmānamutsṛjatyāśu jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ
nāmnā kanakanandeti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / udīcyāṃ muñjapṛṣṭhasya brahmarṣigaṇasevitam
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti saśarīrā dvijātayaḥ / dattaṃ cāpi sadā śrāddhamakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam / ṛṇaistribhirnaraḥ snātvā mucyate kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ
mānase sarasi snātvā śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet / uttaraṃ mānasaṃ gatvā siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām
tasmānnirvartayecchrāddhaṃ yathāśakti yathābalam / kāmān salabhate divyān mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati
parvato himavānnāma nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi so 'śītistvāyato giriḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇo devarṣigaṇasevitaḥ
tatra puṣkariṇī ramyā suṣumnā nāma nāmataḥ / tatra gatvā dvijo vidvān brahmahatyāṃ vimuñcati
śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayyaṃ tatra dattaṃ mahodayam / tārayecca pitṝn samyag daśa pūrvān daśāparān
sarvatra himavān puṇyo gaṅgā puṇyā samantataḥ / nadyaḥ samudragāḥ puṇyāḥ samudraśca viśeṣataḥ
badaryāśramamāsādya mucyate kalikalmaṣāt / tatra nārāyaṇo devo nareṇāste sanātanaḥ
akṣayaṃ tatra dānaṃ syāt japyaṃ vāpi tathāvidham / mahādevapriyaṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tad viśeṣataḥ / tārayecca pitṝn sarvān dattvā śrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ
devadāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam / mahādevena devena tatra dattaṃ mahad varaṃ
mohayitvā munīn sarvān punastaiḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ / prasanno bhagavānīśo munīndrān prāha bhāvitān
ihāśramavare ramye nivasiṣyatha sarvadā / madbhāvanāsamāyuktāstataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha
ye 'tra māmarcayantīha loke dharmaparā janāḥ / teṣāṃ dadāmi paramaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ hi śāśvatam
atra nityaṃ vasiṣyāmi saha nārāyaṇena ca / prāṇāniha narastyaktvā na bhūyo janma vindati
saṃsmaranti ca ye tīrthaṃ deśāntaragatā janāḥ / teṣāṃ ca sarvapāpāni nāśayāmi dvijottamāḥ
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā / dhyānaṃ japaśca niyamaḥ sarvamatrākṣayaṃ kṛtam
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena draṣṭavyaṃ hi dvijātibhiḥ / devadāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahādevaniṣevitam
yatresvaro mahādevo viṣṇurvā puruṣottamaḥ / tatra sannihitā gaṅgātīrthānyāyatanāni ca
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣaṭtriśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ dāruvanaṃ prāpto bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ / mohayāmāsa viprendrān sūta vaktumihārhasi
sūta uvāca purā dāruvan ramye devasiddhaniṣevite / saputradārā munayastapaśceruḥ sahasraśaḥ
pravṛttaṃ vividhaṃ karma prakurvāṇā yathāvidhi / yajanti vividhairyajñaistapanti ca maharṣayaḥ
teṣāṃ pravṛttivinyastacetasāmatha śūladhṛk / khyāpayan sa mahādoṣaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ haraḥ
kṛtvā viśvaguruṃ viṣṇuṃ pārśve devo maheśvaraḥ / yayau nivṛttavijñānasthāpanārthaṃ ca śaṅkaraḥ
āsthāya vipulaṃ veśamūnaviṃśativatsaraḥ / līlālaso mahābāhuḥ pīnāṅgaścārulocanaḥ
cāmīkaravapuḥ śrīmān pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ / mattamātaṅgagāmano digvāsā jagadīśvaraḥ
kuśeśayamayīṃ mālaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtām / dadhāno bhagavānīśaḥ samāgacchati sasmitaḥ
yo 'nantaḥ puruṣo yonirlokānāmavyayo hariḥ / strīveṣaṃ viṣṇurāsthāya so 'nugacchati śūlinam
sampūrṇacandravadanaṃ pīnonnatapayodharam / śucismitaṃ suprasannaṃ raṇannupurakadvayam
supītavasanaṃ divyaṃ śyāmalaṃ cārulocanam / udārahaṃsacalanaṃ vilāsi sumanoharam
evaṃ sa bhagavānīśo devadāruvane haraḥ / cacāra hariṇā bhikṣāṃ māyayā mohayan jagat
dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ viśveśaṃ tatra tatra pinākinam / māyayā mohitā nāryo devadevaṃ samanvayuḥ
vistrastavastrābharaṇāstyaktvā lajjāṃ pativratāḥ / sahaiva tena kāmārtā vilāsinyaścarantihi
ṛṣīṇāṃ putrakā ye syuryuvāno jitamānasāḥ / anvagacchan hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarve kāmaprapīḍitāḥ
gāyanti nṛtyanti vilāsabāhyā nārīgaṇā māyinamekamīśam / dṛṣṭvā sapatnīkamatīvakānta- micchantyathāliṅganamācaranti
pade nipetuḥ smitamācaranti gāyanti gītāni munīśaputrāḥ / ālokya padmāpatimādidevaṃ bhrūbhaṅgamanye vicaranti tena
āsāmathaiṣāmapi vāsudevo māyī murārirmanasi praviṣṭaḥ / karoti bhogān manasi pravṛttiṃ māyānubhūyanta itiva samyak
vibhāti viśvāmarabhūtabhartā sa mādhavaḥ strīgaṇamadhyaviṣṭaḥ / aśeṣaśaktyāsanasaṃniviṣṭo yathaikaśaktyā saha devadevaḥ
karoti nṛtyaṃ paramaprabhāvaṃ tadā virūḍhaḥ punareva bhūyaḥ / yayau samāruhya hariḥ svabhāvaṃ tadīśavṛttāmṛtamādidevaḥ
dṛṣṭvā nārīkulaṃ rudraṃ putrāṇāmapi keśavam / mohayantaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ kopaṃ saṃdadhire bhṛśam
atīva paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ procurdevaṃ kapardinam / śeṣuśca śāpairvividhairmāyayā tasya mohitāḥ
tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare / yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ
te bhagnatapaso viprāḥ sametya vṛṣabhadhvajam / ko bhavāniti deveśaṃ pṛcchanti sma vimohitāḥ
so 'bravīd bhagavānīśastapaścartumihāgataḥ / idānīṃ bhāryayā deśe bhavadbhiriha suvratāḥ
tasya te vākyamākarṇya bhṛgvādyā munipuṅgavāḥ / ūcurgṛhītvā vasanaṃ tyaktvā bhāryāṃ tapaścara
athovāca vihasyeśaḥ pinākī nīlalohitaḥ / saṃprekṣya jagato yoniṃ pārśvasthaṃ ca janārdanam
kathaṃ bhavadbhiruditaṃ svabhāryāpoṣaṇotsukaiḥ / tyaktavyā mama bhāryeti dharmajñaiḥ śāntamānasaiḥ
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vyabhicāraratā nāryaḥ saṃtyājyāḥ patineritāḥ / asmābhireṣā subhagā tādṛśī tyāgamarhati
mahādeva uvāca na kadācidiyaṃ viprā manasāpyanyamicchati / nāhamenāmapi tathā vimuñcāmi kadācana
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ dṛṣṭvā vyabhicarantīha hyasmābhiḥ puruṣādhama / uktaṃ hyasatyaṃ bhavatā gamyatāṃ kṣiprameva hi
evamukte mahādevaḥ satyameva mayeritam / bhavatāṃ pratibhātyeṣetyuktvāsau vicacāra ha
so 'gacchaddhariṇā sārdhaṃ munindrasya mahātmanaḥ / vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ bhikṣārtho parameśvaraḥ
dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ devaṃ bhikṣamāṇamarundhatī / vasiṣṭhasya priyā bhāryā pratyudgamya nanāma nam
prakṣālya pādau vimalaṃ dattvā cāsanamuttamam / saṃprekṣya śithilaṃ gātramabhighātahataṃ dvijaiḥ / saṃdhayāmāsa bhaiṣajyairviṣṇā vadanā satī
cakāra mahatīṃ pūjāṃ prārthayāmāsa bhāryayā / ko bhavān kuta āyātaḥ kimācāro bhavāniti / uvāca tāṃ mahādevaḥ siddhānāṃ pravaro 'smyaham
yadetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuddhaṃ bhāti brahmamayaṃ sadā / eṣaiva devatā mahyaṃ dhārayāmi sadaiva tat
hatyuktvā prayayau śrīmānanugṛhya pativratām / tāḍayāñcakrire daṇḍairloṣṭibhirmuṣṭibhidvijāḥ
dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ giriśaṃ nagnaṃ vikṛtalakṣaṇam / procuretad bhavāṃlliṅgamutpāṭayatu durmate
tānabravīnmahāyogī kariṣyāmīti śaṅkaraḥ / yuṣmākaṃ māmake liṅge yadi dveṣo 'bhijāyate
ityuktvotpāṭayāmāsa bhagavān bhaganetrahā / nāpaśyaṃstatkṣaṇeneśaṃ keśavaṃ liṅgameva ca
tadotpātā babhūvurhi lokānāṃ bhayaśaṃsinaḥ / na rājate sahasrāṃśuścacāla pṛthivī punaḥ / niṣprabhāśca grahāḥ sarve cukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ
apaśyaccānusūyātreḥ svapnaṃ bhāryā pativratā / kathayāmāsa viprāṇāṃ bhayādākulitekṣaṇā
tejasā bhāsayan kṛtsnaṃ nārāyaṇasahāyavān / bhikṣamāṇaḥ śivo nūnaṃ dṛṣṭo 'smākaṃ gṛheṣviti
tasyā vacanamākarṇya śaṅkamānā maharṣayaḥ / sarve jagmurmahāyogaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam
upāsyamānamamalairyogibhirbrahmavittamaiḥ / caturvedairmūrtimadbhiḥ sāvitryā sahitaṃ prabhum
āsīnamāsane ramye nānāścaryasamanvite / prabhāsahasrakalile jñānaiśvaryādisaṃyute
vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā sastitaṃ śubhralocanam / caturmukhaṃ mahābāhuṃ chandomayamajaṃ param
vilokya vedapuruṣaṃ prasannavadanaṃ śubham / śirobhirdharaṇīṃ gatvā toṣayāmāsurīśvaram
tān prasannamanā devaścaturmūrtiścaturmukhaḥ / vyājahāra muniśreṣṭhāḥ kimāgamanakāraṇam
tasya te vṛttamakhilaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ / jñāpayāñcakrire sarve kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kaścid dāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣo 'tīvaśobhanaḥ / bhāryayā cārusarvāṅgyā praviṣṭo nagna eva hi
mohayāmāsa vapuṣā nārīṇāṃ kulamīśvaraḥ / kanyakānāṃ priyā cāsya dūṣayāmāsa putrakān
asmābhirvividhāḥ śāpāḥ pradattāśca parāhatāḥ / tāḍito 'smābhiratyarthaṃ liṅgantu vinipātitam
antarhitaśca bhagavān sabhāryo liṅgameva ca / utpātāścābhavan ghorāḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkarāḥ
ka eṣa puruṣo deva bhītāḥ sma puruṣottama / bhavantameva śaraṇaṃ prapannā vayamacyuta
tvaṃ hi vetsi jagatyasmin yatkiñcidapi ceṣṭitam / anugraheṇa viśveśa tadasmānanupālaya
vijñāpito munigaṇairviśvātmā kamalodbhavaḥ / dhyātvā devaṃ triśūlāṅkaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
brahmovāca hā kaṣṭaṃ bhavatāmadya jātaṃ sarvārthanāśanam / dhigbalaṃ dhik tapaścaryā mithyaiva bhavatāmiha
saṃprāpya puṇyasaṃskārānnidhīnāṃ paramaṃ nidhim / upekṣitaṃ vṛthācārairbhavadbhiriha mohitaiḥ
kāṅkṣante yogino nityaṃ yatanto yatayo nidhim / yameva taṃ samāsādya hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
yajanti yajñairvividhairyatprāptyairvedavādinaḥ / mahānidhiṃ samāsādya hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
yaṃ samāsādya devānaimaiśvaryamakhilaṃ jagat / tamāsādyākṣayanidhiṃ hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
yatsamāpattijanitaṃ viśveśatvamidaṃ mama / tadevopekṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nidhānaṃ bhāgyavarjitaiḥ
yasmin samāhitaṃ divyamaiśvaryaṃ yat tadavyayam / tamāsādya nidhiṃ brāhma hā bhavadbhirvṛthākṛtam
eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ / na tasya paramaṃ kiñcit padaṃ samadhigamyate
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ cāpi śāśvataḥ / sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinām / saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ
eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā / eṣa cakrī ca vajrī ca śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
yogī kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ yajña ucyate / dvāpare bhagavān kālo dharmaketuḥ kalau yuge
rudrasya mūrtayastistro yābhirviśvamidaṃ tatam / tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuriti prabhuḥ
mūrtiranyā smṛtā cāsya digvāsā vai śivā dhruvā / yatra tiṣṭhati tad brahma yogena tu samanvitam
yā cāsya pārśvagā bhāryā bhavadbhirabhivīkṣitā / sā hi nārāyaṇo devaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ
tasmāt sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tatraiva ca layaṃ vrajet / sa eva mohayet kṛtsnaṃ sa eva paramā gatiḥ
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt / ekaśṛṅgo mahānātmā purāṇo 'ṣṭākṣaro hariḥ
caturvedaścaturmūrtistrimūrtistriguṇaḥ paraḥ / ekamūrtirameyātmā nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
ṛtasya garbho bhagavānāpo māyātanuḥ prabhuḥ / stūyate vividhairmantrairbrāhmaṇairdharmamokṣibhiḥ
saṃhṛtya sakalaṃ viśvaṃ kalpānte puruṣottamaḥ / śete yogāmṛtaṃ pītvā yat tad viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam
na jāyate na mriyate vardhate na ca viśvasṛk / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā gīyate vaidikairajaḥ
tato niśāyāṃ vṛttāyāṃ sisṛkṣurakhilañjagat / ajasya nābhau tad bījaṃ kṣipatyeṣa maheśvaraḥ
taṃ māṃ vitta mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvato mukham / mahāntaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvamapāṃ garbhamanuttamam
na taṃ vidātha janakaṃ mohitāstasya māyayā / devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ bhūtānāmīśvaraṃ haram
eṣa devo mahādevo hyanādirbhagavān haraḥ / viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vikaroti ca
na tasya vidyate kāryaṃ na tasmād vidyate param / sa vedān pradadau pūrvaṃ yogamāyātanurmama
sa māyī māyayā sarvaṃ karoti vikaroti ca / tameva muktaye jñātvā vrajeta śaraṇaṃ bhavam
itīritā bhagavatā marīcipramukhā vibhum / praṇamya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pṛcchanti sma suduḥ khitāḥ
munaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ paśyema taṃ devaṃ punareva pinākinam / brūhi viśvāmareśāna trātā tvaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇām
pitāmaha uvāca yad dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā tasya liṅgaṃ bhuvi nipātitam / talliṅgānukṛtīśasya kṛtvā liṅgamanuttamam
pūjayadhvaṃ sapatnīkāḥ sādaraṃ putrasaṃyutāḥ / vaidikaireva niyamairvividhairbrahmacāriṇaḥ
saṃsthāpya śāṅkarairmantrairṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ / tapaḥ paraṃ samāsthāya gṛṇantaḥ śatarudriyam
samāhitāḥ pūjayadhvaṃ saputrāḥ saha bandhubhiḥ / sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā śūlapāṇiṃ prapadyatha
tato drakṣyatha deveśaṃ durdarśamakṛtātmabhiḥ / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvamajñānamadharmaśca praṇaśyati
tataḥ praṇamya varadaṃ brahmāṇamamitaujasam / jagmuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamanaso devadāruvanaṃ punaḥ
ārādhayitumārabdhā brahmaṇā kathitaṃ yathā / ajānantaḥ paraṃ devaṃ vītarāgā vimatsarāḥ
sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca / nadīnāṃ ca vivikteṣu pulineṣu śubheṣu ca
śaivālabhojanāḥ kecit kecidantarjaleśayāḥ / kecidabhrāvakāśāstu pādāṅguṣṭhāgraviṣṭhitāḥ
danto 'lūkhalinastvanye hyaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare / śākaparṇāśinaḥ kecit saṃprakṣālā marīcipāḥ
vṛkṣamūlaniketāśca śilāśayyāstathā pare / kālaṃ nayanti tapasā pūjayanto maheśvaram
tatasteṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ prapannārtiharo haraḥ / cakā bhagavān buddhiṃ prabodhāya vṛṣadhvajaḥ
devaḥ kṛtayuge hyasmin śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe / devadāruvanaṃ prāptaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
bhasmapāṇḍuradigdhāṅgo nagno vikṛtalakṣaṇaḥ / ulmukavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ
kvacicca hasate raudraṃ kvacid gāyati vismitaḥ / kvacinnṛtyati śṛṅgārī kvacidrauti muhurmuhuḥ
āśrame 'bhyāgato bhikṣāṃ yācate ca punaḥ punaḥ / māyāṃ kṛtvātmano rūpaṃ devastad vanamāgataḥ
kṛtvā girisutāṃ gaurīṃ pārśvedevaḥ pinākadhṛk / sā ca pūrvavad deveśī devadāruvanaṃ gatā
dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ devaṃ devyā saha kapardinam / praṇemuḥ śirasā bhūmau toṣayāmāsurīśvaram
vaidikairvividhairmantraiḥ sūktairmāheśvaraiḥ śubhaiḥ / atharvaśirasā cānye rudrādyairbrahmabhirbhavam
namo devādidevāya mahādevāya te namaḥ / tryambakāya namastubhyaṃ triśūlavaradhāriṇe
namo digvāsase tubhyaṃ vikṛtāya pinākine / sarvapraṇatadehāya svayamapraṇatātmane
antakāntakṛte tubhyaṃ sarvasaṃharaṇāya ca / namo 'stu nṛtyaśīlāya namo bhairavarūpiṇe
naranārīśarīrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ / namo dāntāya śāntāya tāpasāya harāya ca
vibhīṣaṇāya rudrāya namaste kṛttivāsase / namaste lelihānāya śitikaṇṭhāya te namaḥ
aghoraghorarūpāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ / namaḥ kanakamālāya devyāḥ priyakarāya ca
gaṅgāsaliladhārāya śambhave parameṣṭhine / namo yogādhipataye brahmādhipataye namaḥ
prāṇāya ca namastubhyaṃ namo bhasmāṅgarāgine / namaste ghanavāhāya daṃṣṭriṇe vahniretase
brahmaṇaśca śiro hartre namaste kālarūpiṇe / āgatiṃ te na janīmo gatiṃ naiva ca naiva ca / viśveśvara mahādeva yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te
namaḥ pramathanāthāya dātre ca śubhasaṃpadām / kapālapāṇaye tubhyaṃ namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya te / namaḥ kanakaliṅgāya vāriliṅgāya te namaḥ
namo vahnyarkaliṅgāya jñānaliṅgāya te namaḥ / namo bhujaṅgahārāya karṇikārapriyāya ca / kirīṭine kuṇḍaline kālakālāya te namaḥ
vāmadeva maheśāna devadeva trilocana / kṣamyatāṃ yatkṛtaṃ mohāt tvameva śaraṇaṃ hi naḥ
caritāni vicitrāṇi guhyāni gahanāni ca / brahmādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ durvijñeyo 'si śaṅkara
ajñānād yadi vā jñānād yatkiñcitkurute naraḥ / tatsarvaṃ bhagavānena kurute yogamāyayā
evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā / ūcuḥ praṇamya giriśaṃ paśyāmastvāṃ yathā purā
teṣāṃ saṃstavamākarṇya somaḥ momavibhūṣaṇaḥ / svameva paramaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
taṃ te dṛṣṭvātha giriśaṃ devyā saha pinākinam / yathā pūrvaṃ sthitā viprāḥ praṇemurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ
tataste munayaḥ sarve saṃstūya ca maheśvaram / bhṛgvaṅgirovasiṣṭhāstu viśvāmitrastathaiva ca
gautamo 'triḥ sukeśaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / marīciḥ kaśyapaścāpi saṃvartaśca mahātapāḥ / praṇamya devadeveśamidaṃ vacanamabruvan
kathaṃ tvāṃ devadeveśa karmayogena vā prabho / jñānena vātha yogena pūjayāmaḥ sadaiva hi
kena vā devamārgeṇa saṃpūjyo bhagavāniha / kiṃ tat sevyamasevyaṃ vā sarvametad bravīhi naḥ
devadeva uvāca etad vaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi gūḍhaṃ gahanamuttamam / brahmaṇe kathitaṃ pūrvamādāveva maharṣayaḥ
sāṃkhyayogo dvidhā jñeyaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ hi sādhanam / yogena sahitaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vimuktidam
na kevalena yogena dṛśyate puruṣaḥ paraḥ / jñānaṃ tu kevalaṃ samyagapavargaphalapradam
bhavantaḥ kevalaṃ yogaṃ samāśritya vimuktaye / vihāya sāṃkhyaṃ vimalamakurvanta pariśramam
etasmāt kāraṇād viprānṛṇāṃ kevaladharmiṇām / āgato 'hamimaṃ deśaṃ jñāpayan mohasaṃbhavam
tasmād bhavadbhirvimalaṃ jñānaṃ kaivalyasādhanam / jñātavyaṃ hi prayatnena śrotavyaṃ dṛśyameva ca
ekaḥ sarvatrago hyātmā kevalaścitimātrakaḥ / ānando nirmalo nityaṃ syādetat sāṃkhyadarśanam
etadeva paraṃ jñānameṣa mokṣo 'tra gīyate / etat kaivalyamamalaṃ brahmabhāvaśca varṇitaḥ
āśritya caitat paramaṃ tanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ / paśyanti māṃ mahātmāno yatayo viśvamīśvaram
etat tat paramaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ sannirañjanam / ahaṃ hi vedyo bhagavān mama mūrtiriyaṃ śivā
bahūni sādhanānīha siddhaye kathitāni tu / teṣāmabhyadhikaṃ jñānaṃ māmakaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ
jñānayogaratāḥ śāntā māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / ye hi māṃ bhasmaniratā dhyāyanti satataṃ hṛdi
madbhaktiparamā nityaṃ yatayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ / nāśayāmyacirāt teṣāṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram
praśāntaḥ saṃyatamanā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ / brahmacaryarato nagno vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caret
nirmitaṃ hi mayā pūrvaṃ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ param / guhyād guhyatamaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vedasāraṃ vimuktaye
yad vā kaupīnavasanaḥ syād vaikavasano muniḥ / vedābhyāsarato vidvān dhyāyet paśupatiṃ śivam
eṣa pāśupato yogaḥ sevanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ / bhasmacchannairhi satataṃ niṣkāmairiti viśrutiḥ
vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ / bahavo 'nena yogena pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
anyāni caiva śāstrāṇi loke 'smin mohanānitu / vedavādaviruddhāni mayaiva kathitāni tu
vāmaṃ pāśupataṃ somaṃ lākulaṃ caiva bhairavam / asevyametat kathitaṃ vedavāhyaṃ tathetaram
vedamurtirahaṃ viprā nānyaśāstrārthavedibhiḥ / jñāyate matsvarūpaṃ tu muktvā vedaṃ sanātanam
sthāpayadhvamidaṃ mārgaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ maheśvaram / acirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ
mayi bhaktiśca vipulā bhavatāmastu sattamāḥ / dhyātamātro hi sānnidhyaṃ dāsyāmi munisattamāḥ
ityuktvā bhagavān somastatraivāntaradhīyata / to 'pi dāruvane tasmin pūjayanti sma śaṅkaram / brahmacaryaratāḥ śāntā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
sametya te mahātmāno munayo brahmavādinaḥ / vitenire bahūn vādānnadhyātmajñānasaṃśrayān
kimasya jagato mūlamātmā cāsmākameva hi / ko 'pi syāt sarvabhāvānāṃ heturīśvara eva ca
ityevaṃ manyamānānāṃ dhyānamārgāvalambinām / āvirāsīnmahādevī devī girivarātmajā
koṭisūryapratīkāśā jvālāmālāsamāvṛtā / svabhābhirvimalābhistu pūrayantī nabhastalam
tāmanvapaśyan girijāmameyāṃ jvālāsahasrāntarasanniviṣṭām / praṇemurekāmakhileśapatnīṃ jānanti te tat paramasya bījam
asamākameṣā parameśapatnī gatistathātmā gaganābhidhānā / paśyantyathātmānamidaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ tasyāmathaite munayaśca viprāḥ
nirīkṣitāste parameśapatnyā tadantare devamaśeṣahetum / paśyanti śaṃbhuṃ kavimīśitāraṃ rudraṃ bṛhantaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam
ālokya devīmatha devamīśaṃ praṇemurānandamavāpuragryam / jñānaṃ tadaiśaṃ bhagavatprasādā- dāvirbabhau janmavināśahetu
iyaṃ hi sā jagato yonirekā sarvātmikā sarvaniyāmikā ca / māheśvarīśaktiranādisiddhā vyomābhidhānā divi rājatīva
asyā mahatparameṣṭhī parastā- nmaheśvaraḥ śiva eko 'tha rudraḥ / cakāra viśvaṃ paraśaktiniṣṭhāṃ māyāmathāruhya sa devadevaḥ
eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍho māyī rudraḥ sakalo niṣkalaśca / sa eva devī na ca tadvibhinna- metajjñātvā hyamṛtatvaṃ vrajanti
antarhito 'bhūd bhagavānatheśo devyā bhargaḥ saha devādidevaḥ / ārādhayanti sma tameva devaṃ vanaukasaste punareva rudram
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ devadevaviceṣṭitam / devadāruvane pūrvaṃ purāṇe yanmayā śrutam
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ / śrāvayed vā dvijān śāntān sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca eṣā puṇyatamā devī devagandharvasevitā / narmadā lokavikhyātā tīrthānāmuttamā nadī
tasyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ māhātmyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena bhāṣitam / yudhiṣṭhirāya tu śubhaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutāstu vividhā dharmāstvatprasādānmahāmune / māhātmyaṃ ca prayāgasya tīrthāni vividhāni ca
narmadā sarvatīrthānāṃ mukhyā hi bhavateritā / tasyāstvidānīṃ māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasi sattama
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehād viniḥ sṛtā / tārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
narmadāyāstu māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yanmayā śrutam / idānīṃ tatpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śubham
puṇyā kanakhale gaṅgā kurukṣetre sarasvatī / grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā
tribhiḥ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ saptāhena tu yāmunam / sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādeva nārmadam
kaliṅgadeśapaścārdhe parvate 'marakaṇṭake / puṇyā ca triṣu lokeṣu ramaṇīyā manoramā
sadevāsuragandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / tapastaptvā tu rājendra siddhiṃ tu paramāṃ gatāḥ
tatra snātvā naro rājan niyamastho jitendriyaḥ / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam
yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ śrūyate sariduttamā / vistāreṇa tu rājendra yojanadvayamāyatā
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca / parvatasya samantāt tu tiṣṭhantyamarakaṇṭake
brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ / sarvahiṃsānivṛttastu sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
evaṃ sarvasamācāro yastu prāṇān samutsṛjet / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājan śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa
śatavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge modati pāṇḍava / sapsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇo divyastrīparivāritaḥ
divyagandhānuliptaśca divyapuṣpopaśobhitaḥ / krīḍate devaloke tu daivataiḥ saha modate
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ / gṛhaṃ tu labhate 'sau vai nānāratnasamanvitam
stambhairmaṇimayairdivyairvajravaidūryabhūṣitam / ālekhyavāhanaiḥ śubhrairdāsīdāsasamanvitam
rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvastrījanavallabhaḥ / jīved varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tatra bhogasamanvitaḥ
agnipraveśe 'tha jale athavānaśane kṛte / anivartikā gatistasya pavanasyāmbare yathā
paścime parvatataṭe sarvapāpavināśanaḥ / hrado jaleśvaro nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
tatra piṇḍapradānena saṃdhyopāsanakarmaṇā / daśavarṣāṇi pitarastarpitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ
dakṣiṇe narmadākūle kapilākhyā mahānadī / saralārjunasaṃcchannā nātidūre vyavasthitā
sā tu puṇyā mahābhāgā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / tatra koṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tīrthānāṃ tu yudhiṣṭhira
tasmiṃstīrthe tu ye vṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyayāt / narmadātoyasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim
dvitīyā tu mahābhāgā viśalyakaraṇī śubhā / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā viśalyo bhavati kṣaṇāt
kapilā ca viśalyā ca śrūyate rājasattama / īśvareṇa purā proktā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
tatra snātvā naro rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / ye vasantyuttare kūle rudraloke vasanti te
sarasvatyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / samaṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt
parityajati yaḥ praṇān parvate 'marakaṇṭake / varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate
narmadāyāṃ jalaṃ puṇyaṃ phenormisamalaṅkṛtam / pavitraṃ śirasā vandya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
narmadā sarvataḥ puṇyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī / ahorātropavāsena mucyate brahmahatyayā
jāleśvaraṃ tīrthavaraṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / tatra gatvā niyamavān sarvakāmāṃllabhennaraḥ
candrasūryoparāge tu gatvā hyamarakaṇṭakam / aśvamedhād daśaguṇaṃ puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ
eṣa puṇyo girivaro devagandharvasevitaḥ / nānādrumalatākīrṇo nānāpuṣpopaśobhitaḥ
tatra saṃnihito rājan devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / brahmā viṣṇustathā cendro vidyādharagaṇaiḥ saha
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt parvataṃ hyamarakaṇṭakam / pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānaḥ
kāverī nāma vipulā nadī kalpaṣanāśinī / tatra snātvā mahādevamarcayed vṛṣabhadhvajam / saṃgame narmadāyāstu rudraloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge aṣṭātriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpavināśinī / munibhiḥ kathitā pūrvamīśvareṇa svayaṃbhuvā
munibhiḥ saṃstutā hyeṣā narmadā pravarā nadī / rudragātrād viniṣkrāntā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
sarvapāpaharā nityaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtā / saṃstutā devagandharvairapyarobhistathaiva ca
uttare caiva tatkūle tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / nāmnā bhadreśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham / tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha mohate
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthamāmrātakeśvaram / tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
tato 'ṅgāreśvaraṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra kedāraṃ nāma puṇyadam / tatra snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt
pippaleśaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / tatra snātvā mahārāja rudraloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra vimaleśvaramuttamam / tatra prāṇān parityajya rudralokamavāpnuyāt
tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra indrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet
tato gaccheta rājendra śūlabhedamiti śrutam / tatra snātvārcayed devaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
tato gaccheta rājendra balitīrthamanuttam / tatra snātvā naro rājan sihāsanapatirbhavet
śakratīrthaṃ tato gacchet kūle caiva tu dakṣiṇe / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
ārādhayenmahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim / gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
ṛṣitīrthaṃ tato gatvā sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām / snātamātro narastatra śivaloke mahīyate
nāradasya tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
yatra taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ nāradena surarṣiṇā / pratīstasya dadau yogaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeśvaramiti śrutam / yatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate
ṛṇatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sa ṛṇānmucyate dhruvam / maheśvaraṃ tato gacchet paryāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchet sarvavyādhivināśanam / snātamātro narastatra sarvaduḥkhaiḥ pramucyate
tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam / ahorātropavāsena trirātraphalamāpnuyāt
tasmiṃmastīrthe tu rājendra kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
yastu prāṇaparityāgaṃ kuryāt tatra narādhipa / akṣayaṃ modate kālaṃ yāvaccandradivākarau
narmadātaṭamāśritya tiṣṭhante ye tu mānavāḥ / te mṛtāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā
tato dīpteśvaraṃ gacched vyāsatīrthaṃ tapovanam / nivartitā purā tatra vyāsabhītā mahānadī / huṅkāritā tu vyāsena dakṣiṇena tato gatā
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / prītastasya bhaved vyāso vāñchitaṃ labhate phalam
tato gaccheta rājendra ikṣunadyāstu saṃgamam / trailokyaviśrutaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra sannihitaḥ śivaḥ / tatra stanātvā naro rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
skandatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / ājanmanaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snātastīvraṃ vyapohati
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā bhavātmajamanuttamam / upāsate mahātmānaṃ skandaṃ śaktidhiraṃ prabhum
tato gacchedāṅgirasaṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret / gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
aṅgirā yatra deveśaṃ brahmaputro vṛṣadhvajam / tapasārādhya viśveśaṃ labdhavān yogamuttamam
kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / snānaṃ tatra prakurvota aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / tatra strātvā naro rājyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
candrabhāgāṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle saṃgameśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
narmadāyottare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / ādityāyatanaṃ ramyamīśvareṇa tu bhāṣitam
tatra snātvā tu rājendra dattvā dānaṃ tu śaktitaḥ / tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa labhate cākṣayaṃ phalam
daridrā vyādhitā ye tu ye ca duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ / mucyante sarvapāpebhyaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayānti ca
mārgeśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra svargalokamavāpnuyāt
tataḥ paścimato gacchenmarudālayamuttamam / tatra snātvā tu rājendra śucirbhūtvā prayatnataḥ
kāñcanaṃ tu dvijo dadyād yathāvibhavavistaram / puṣpakeṇa vimānena vāyulokaṃ sa gacchati
tato gaccheta rājendra ahalyātīrthamuttamam / snānamātrādapsarobhirmodate kālamakṣayam
caitramāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe trayodaśī / kāmadevadine tasminnahalyāṃ yastu pūjayet
yatra tatra narotpanno varastatra priyo bhavet / strīvallabho bhavecchrīmān kāmadeva ivāparaḥ
ayodhyāṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ śakrasya viśrutam / snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
somatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
somagrahe tu rājendra pāpakṣayakaraṃ bhavet / trailokyaviśrutaṃ rājan somatīrthaṃ mahāphalam
yastu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatra tīrthe samāhitaḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ sa gacchati
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt somatīrthe narādhipa / jale cānaśanaṃ vāpi nāsau martyo 'bhijāyate
stambhatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra viṣṇutīrthamanuttamam / yodhanīpuramākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam
asurā yodhitāstatra vāsudevena koṭiśaḥ / tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ viṣṇuśrīko bhavediha / ahorātropavāsena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / kāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ yatra kāmor'cayad bhavam
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kusumāyudharūpeṇa rudroloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra brahmatīrthamanuttamam / umāhakamiti khyātaṃ tatra saṃtarpayet pitṝn
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ śrdhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi / gajarūpā śilā tatra toyamadhye vyavasthitā
tasmiṃstu dāpayet piṇḍān vaiśākhyāntu viśeṣataḥ / snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ / tṛpyanti pitarastasya yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī
siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra gāṇapatyapadaṃ labhet
tato gaccheta rājendra liṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra viṣṇuloke mahīyate
yatra nārāyaṇo devo munonāṃ bhāvitātmanām / svātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tat paramaṃ padam
aṅkolaṃ tu tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / snānaṃ dānaṃ ca tatraiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam / piṇḍapridānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ pretyānantaphalapradam
traiyambakena toyena yaścaruṃ śrapayet tataḥ / aṅkolamūle dadyācca piṇḍāṃścaiva yathāvidhi / tāritāḥ pitarastena tṛpyantyācandratārakam
tato gaccheta rājendra tāpaseśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā tu rājendra prāpnuyāt tapasaḥ phalam
śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / nāsti tena sama tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
darśanāt sparśanāt tasya snānadānatapojapāt / homāccaivopavāsācca śuklatīrthe mahat phalam
yojanaṃ tat smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ devagandharvasevitam / śuklatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam
pādapāgreṇa dṛṣṭena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati / devyā saha sadā bhargastatra tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe māsi suvrata / kailāsāccābhiniṣkramya tatra sannihito haraḥ
devadānavagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā / gaṇāścāpsarasāṃ nāgāstatra tiṣṭhanti puṅgava
rajakena yathā vastraṃ śuklaṃ bhavati vāriṇā / ājanmani kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuklatīrthe vyapohati / snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhamanantaṃ tatra dṛśyate
śuklatīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni mānavaḥ / ahorātropavāsena śuklatīrthe vyapohati
kārtikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī / ghṛtena snāpayed devamupoṣya parameśvaram / ekaviṃśatkulopeto na cyavedaiśvarāt padāt
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñadānena vā punaḥ / na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti śuklatīrthe tu yāṃ labhet
śuklatīrthaṃ mahātīrthamṛṣisiddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvā naro rājan punarjanma na vindati
ayane vā caturdaśyāṃ saṃkrāntau viṣuve tathā / snātvā tu sopavāsaḥ san vijitātmā samāhitaḥ
dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti prīyetāṃ hariśaṅkarau / etat tīrthaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
anāthaṃ durgataṃ vipraṃ nāthavantamathāpi vā / udvādayati yastīrthe tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
yāvat tadromasaṃkhyā tu tatprasūtikuleṣu ca / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra yamatīrtha manuttamam / kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māghamāse yudhiṣṭhira / snānaṃ kṛtvā naktabhījī na paśyed yonisaṅkaṭam
tato gaccheta rājendra eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam / saṃgame tu naraḥ snāyādupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitāḥ
eraṇḍīsaṃgame snātvā bhaktibhāvāt turañjitaḥ / mṛttikāṃ śirasi sthāpya avagāhya ca tajjalam / narmadodakasaṃmiśraṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ kārṇāṭikeśvaram / gaṅgāvatarate tatra dine puṇye na saṃśayaḥ
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca dattvā caiva yathāvidhi / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
nanditīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / prīyate tasya nandīśaḥ somaloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ śubham / tatra snātvā naro rājan narakaṃ naiva paśyati
tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra svānyasthīni vinikṣipet / rūpavān jāyate loke dhanabhogasamanvitaḥ
tato gaccheta rājendra kapilātīrtha muttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
jyeṣṭhamāse tu saṃprāpte caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / tatropoṣya naro bhaktyā dadyād dīpaṃ ghṛtena tu
ghṛtena snāpayed rudraṃ saghṛtaṃ śrīphalaṃ dahet / ghaṇṭābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kapilāṃ vai pradāpayet
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / śivatulyabalo bhūtvā śivavat krīḍate ciram
aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ / snāpayitvā śivaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu bhojanam
sarvabhogasamāyukto vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ / gatvā śakrasya bhavanaṃ śakreṇa saha modate
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo dhanavān bhogavān bhavet / aṅgārakanavamyāṃ tu amāvāsyāṃ tathaiva ca / snāpayet tatra yatnena rūpavān subhago bhavet
tato gaccheta rājendra gaṇeśvaramanuttamam / śrāvaṇe māsī saṃprāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī
snātamātro narastatra rudraloke mahīyate / pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate 'sāvṝṇatrayāt
gaṅgeśvarasamīpe tu gaṅgāvadanamuttamam / akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra snātvā tu mānavaḥ / ājanmajanitaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
tasya vai paścime deśe samīpe nātidūrataḥ / daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ māsi bhādrapade śubhe / amāvasyāṃ naraḥ snātvā pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam
kāñcanena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā / gatvā rudrapuraṃ ramyaṃ rudreṇa saha modate
sarvatra sarvadivase snānaṃ tatra samācaret / pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonacatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheta rājendra bhṛgutīrtha manuttamam / tatra devo bhṛguḥ purvaṃ rudramārādhayat purā
darśanāt tasya devasya sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate / etat kṣetraṃ suvipulaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ / upānahostathā yugmaṃ deyamannaṃ sakāñcanam / bhojanaṃ ca yathāśakti tadasyākṣayamucyate
kṣaranti sarvadānāni yajñadānaṃ tapaḥ kriyā / akṣayaṃ tat tapastaptaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
tasyaiva tapasogreṇa tuṣṭena tripurāriṇā / sānnidhyaṃ tatra kathitaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
tato gaccheta rājendra gautameśvaramuttamam / yatrārādhya triśūlāṅkaṃ gautamaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt
tatra snātvā naro rājan upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kāñcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate
vṛṣotsargaṃ tato gacchecchāśvataṃ padamāpnuyāt / na jānanti narā mūḍhā viṣṇormāyāvimohitāḥ
dhautapāpaṃ tato gacched dhautaṃ yatra vṛṣeṇa tu / narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ rājan sarvapātakanāśanam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / caturbhujastrinetraśca haratulyabalo bhavet
vaset kalpāyutaṃ sāgraṃ śivatulyaparākramaḥ / kālena mahatā jātaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet
tato gaccheta rājendra haṃsatīrtha manuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra siddho yatra janārdanaḥ / varāhatīrtha mākhyātaṃ viṣṇulokagatipradam
tato gaccheta rājendra candratīrthamanuttamam / paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra candraloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta rājendra kanyātīrthamanuttamam / śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet
devatīrtha tato gacchet sarvadevanamakṛtam / tatra snātvā ca rājendra daivataiḥ saha modate
tato gaccheta rājendra śikhitīrthamanuttamam / yat tatra dīyate dānaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ śubham / yattatra kriyate śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ bhavet
sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet / vidhūya sarvapāpāni brahmaloke mahīyate
manoharaṃ tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha modate
tato gaccheta rājendra mānasaṃ tīrthamuttamam / snātvā tatra naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate
svargabinduṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ devanamaskṛtam / tatra snātvā naro rājan durgatiṃ naiva gacchati
apsareśaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / krīḍate nākalokastho hyapsarobhiḥ sa modate
tato gaccheta rājendra bhārabhūtimanuttamam / upoṣitor'cayedīśaṃ rudraloke mahīyate / asmiṃstīrthe mṛto rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
kārtike māsi deveśamarcayet pārvatīpatim / aśvamedhād daśaguṇaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tatra kundendusaprabham / vṛṣayuktena yānena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
etat tīrthaṃ samāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / haṃsayuktena yānena svargalokaṃ sa gacchati
eraṇḍyā narmadāyāstu saṃgamaṃ lokaviśrutam / tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
upavāsaparo bhūtvā nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra mucyate brahmahatyayā
tato gaccheta rājendra narmadodadhisaṃgamam / jamadagniriti khyātaḥ siddho yatra janārdanaḥ
tatra snātvā naro rājan narmadodadhisaṃgame / triguṇaṃ cāśvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate
tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram / saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam
tato gaccheta rājendra ālikātīrthamuttamam / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ niyato niyatāśanaḥ / asya tīrthasya māhātmyānmucyate brahmahatyayā
etāni tava saṃkṣepāt prādhānyāt kathitāni tu / na śakyā vistarād vaktuṃ saṃkhyā tīrtheṣupāṇḍava
eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā / narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā
manasā saṃsmaredyastu narmadāṃ vai yudhiṣṭhira / cāndrāyaṇaśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ / patanti narake ghore ityāha parameśvaraḥ
narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca idaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ naimiśamuttamam / mahādevapriyakaraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
mahādevaṃ didṛkṣūṇāmṛṣīṇaṇāṃ parameṣṭhinām / brahāmaṇā nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ tapastaptuṃ dvijottamāḥ
marīcayo 'trayo viprā vasiṣṭhāḥ kratavastathā / bhṛgavo 'ṅgirasaḥ pūrvā brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam
sametya sarvavaradaṃ caturmūrti caturmukham / pṛcchanti praṇipatyainaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam
ṣaṭkulīyā ūcuḥ bhagavan devamīśānaṃ bhargamekaṃ kapardinam / kenopāyena paśyāmo brūhi devanamaskṛtam
brahmovāca satraṃ sahasramāsadhvaṃ vāṅmanodoṣavarjitāḥ / deśaṃ ca vaḥ pravakṣyāmi yasmin deśe cariṣyatha
uktvā manomayaṃ cakraṃ sa sṛṣṭvā tānuvāca ha / kṣiptametanmayā cakramanuvrajata mā ciram / yatrāsya nemiḥ śīryeta sa deśaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ
tato mumoca taccakraṃ te ca tatsamanuvrajan / tasya vai vrajataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra nemiraśīryata / naimisaṃ tatsmṛtaṃ nāmnā puṇyaṃ sarvatra pūjitam
siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ yakṣagandharvasevitam / sthānaṃ bhagavataḥ śaṃbhoretannaimiśamuttamam
atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / tapastaptvā purā devā lebhire pravarān varān
imaṃ deśaṃ samāśritya ṣaṭkulīyāḥ samāhitāḥ / satreṇārādhya deveśaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram
atra dānaṃ tapastaptaṃ snānaṃ japyādikaṃ ca yat / ekaikaṃ pāvayet pāpaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
atra pūrvaṃ sa bhagavānṛṣīṇāṃ satramāsatām / provāca vāyurbrahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmabhāṣitam
atra devo mahādevo rudrāṇyā kila viśvakṛt / ramate 'dhyāpi bhagavān pramathaiḥ parivāritaḥ
atra prāṇān parityajya niyamena dvijātayaḥ / brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyanti yatra gatvā na jāyate
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ jāpyeśvaramitiśrutam / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ yatra nandī mahāgaṇaḥ
prītastasya mahādevo devyā saha pinākadhṛk / dadāvātmasamānatvaṃ mṛtyuvañcanameva ca
abhūdṛṣiḥ sa dharmātmā śilādo nāma dharmavit / ārādhayanmahādevaṃ putrārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
tasya varṣasahasrānte tapyamānasya viśvakṛt / śarvaḥ somo gaṇavṛto varado 'smītyabhāṣata
sa vavre varamīśānaṃ vareṇyaṃ girijāpatim / ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnaṃ dehi putraṃ tvayā samam
tathāstvityāha bhagavān devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / paśyatastasya viprarṣerantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ
tato yiyakṣuḥ svāṃ bhūmiṃ śilādo dharmavittamaḥ / cakarṣa lāṅgalenorvoṃ bhittvādṛśyata śobhanaḥ
saṃvartakānalaprakhyaḥ kumāraḥ prahasanniva / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannastejasā bhāsayan diśaḥ
kumāratulyo 'pratimo meghagambhīrayā girā / śilādaṃ tāta tāteti prāha nandī punaḥ punaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandanaṃ jātaṃ śilādaḥ pariṣasvaje / munibhyo darśayāmāsa ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ
jātakarmādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāstasya cakāra ha / upanīya yathāśāstraṃ vedamadhyāpayat sutam
adhītavedo bhagavān nandī matimanuttamām / cakre maheśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ jeṣye mṛtyumiti prabhum
sa gatvā saritaṃ puṇyāmekāgraśraddhayānvitaḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ maheśāsaktamānasaḥ
tasya koṭyāṃ tu pūrṇāyāṃ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ / āgatya sāmbaḥ sagaṇo varado 'smītyuvāca ha
sa vavre punarevāhaṃ japeyaṃ koṭimīśvaram / tāvadāyurmahādeva dehīti varamīśvara
evamastviti saṃprocya devo 'pyantaradhīyata / jajāpa koṭiṃ bhagavān bhūyastadgatamānasaḥ
dvitīyāyāṃ ca koṭyāṃ vai saṃpūrṇāyāṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ / āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ
tṛtīyāṃ japtumicchāmi koṭiṃ bhūyo 'pi śaṅkara / tathāstvityāha viśvātmā devo 'pyantaradhīyata
koṭitraye 'tha saṃpūrṇe devaḥ prītamanā bhṛśam / āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ
japeyaṃ koṭimanyāṃ vai bhūyo 'pi tava tejasā / ityukte bhagavānāha na japtavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ
amaro jarayā tyakto mama pārśvagataḥ sadā / mahāgaṇapatirdevyāḥ putro bhava maheśvaraḥ
yogīśvaro yoganetā gaṇānāmīśvareśvaraḥ / sarvalokādhipaḥ śrīmān sarvajño madbalānvitaḥ
jñānaṃ tanmāmakaṃ divyaṃ hastāmalakavat tava / ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī tato yāsyasi matpadam
etaduktvā mahādevo gaṇānāhūya śaṅkaraḥ / abhiṣekeṇa yuktena nandīśvaramayojayat
udvāhayāmāsa ca taṃ svayameva pinākadhṛk / marutāṃ ca śubhāṃ kanyāṃ suyaśeti ca viśrutām
etajjapyeśvaraṃ sthānaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ / yatra tatra mṛto martyo rudraloke mahīyate
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ japyeśvarasamīpataḥ / nāmnā pañcanadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
trirātropoṣitastatra pūjayitvā maheśvaram / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ / mahābhairavamityuktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
tīrthānāṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ vitastā paramā nadī / sarvapāpaharā puṇyā svayameva girīndrajā
tīrthaṃ pañcatapaṃ nāma śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ / yatra devādidevena cakrārthaṃ pūjito bhavaḥ
piṇḍadānādikaṃ tatra pretyānantaphalapradam / mṛtastatrāpi niyamād brahmaloke mahīyate
kāyāvarohaṇaṃ nāma mahādevālayaṃ śubham / yatra māheśvarā dharmā munibhiḥ saṃpravartitāḥ
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo homa upavāsastathākṣayaḥ / parityajati yaḥ prāṇān rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kanyātīrthamiti śrutam / tatra gatvā tyajet prāṇāṃllokān prāpnoti śāśvatān
jāmadagnyasya tu śubhaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ / tatra snātvā tīrtha vare gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
mahākālamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / gatvā prāṇān parityajya gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
guhyād guhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ nakulīśvaramuttamam / tatra sannihitaḥ śrīmān bhagavān nakulīśvaraḥ
himavacchikhare ramye gaṅgādvāre suśobhane / devyā saha mahādevo nityaṃ śiṣyaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
tatra snātvā mahādevaṃ pūjayitvā vṛṣadhvajam / sarvapāpairvimucyeta mṛtastajjñānamāpnuyāt
anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham / bhīmeśvaramiti khyātaṃ gatvā muñcati pātakam
tathānyaccaṇḍavegāyāḥ saṃbhedaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ / tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate brahmahatyayā
sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ paramā purī / nāmnāvārāṇasī divyā koṭikoṭyayutādhikā
tasyāḥ purastānmāhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ vo mayā tviha / nānyatra labhyate muktiryogināpyekajanmanā
ete prādhānyataḥ proktā deśāḥ pāpaharā nṛṇām / gatvā saṃkṣālayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam
yaḥ svadharmān parityajya tīrthasevāṃ karoti hi / na tasya phalate tīrthamahi loke paratra ca
prāyaścittī ca vidhurastathā pāpacaro gṛhī / prakuryāt tīrthasaṃsevāṃ ye cānye tādṛśā janāḥ
sahāgnirvā sapatnīko gacchet tīrthāni yatnataḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto yathoktāṃ gatimāpnuyāt
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya kuryād vā tīrthasevanam / vidhāya vṛttiṃ putrāṇāṃ bhāryāṃ teṣu nidhāya ca
prāyaścittaprasaṅgena tīrthamāhātmyamīritam / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etadākarṇya vijñānaṃ nārāyaṇamukheritam / kūrmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ papracchurmunayaḥ prabhum
munaya ūcuḥ kathitā bhavatā dharmā mokṣajñānaṃ savistaram / lokānāṃ sargavistāraṃ vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca
pratisargamidānīṃ no vaktumarhasī mādhava / bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhavyeśa yathā pūrvaṃ tvayoditam
sūta uvāca śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavān kūrmarūpadhṛk / vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtānāṃ pratisaṃcaram
kūrma uvāca nityo naimittikaścaiva prākṛtātyantikau tathā / caturdhāyaṃ purāṇe 'smin procyate pratisaṃcaraḥ
yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate nityaṃ loke bhūtakṣayastviha / nityaḥ saṃkīrtyate nāmnā munibhiḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ
brāhmo naimittiko nāma kalpānte yo bhaviṣyati / trailokyasyāsya kathitaḥ pratisargo manīṣibhiḥ
mahādādyāṃ viśeṣāntaṃ yadā saṃyāti saṃkṣayam / prākṛtaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ procyate kālacintakaiḥ
jñānādātyantikaḥ prokto yoginaḥ paramātmani / pralayaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ kālacintāparairdvijaiḥ
ātyantikaśca kathitaḥ pralayo 'tra sasādhanaḥ / naimittikamidānīṃ vaḥ kathayiṣye samāsataḥ
caturyugasahasrānte saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare / svātmasaṃsthāḥ prajāḥ kartuṃ pratipede prajāpatiḥ
tato bhavatyanāvṛṣṭistīvrā sā śatavārṣikī / bhūtakṣayakarī ghorā sarvabhūtakṣayaṅkarī
tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale / tāni cāgre pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca
saptaraśmiratho bhūtvā samuttiṣṭhan divākaraḥ / asahyaraśmirbhavati pibannambho gabhastibhiḥ
tasya te raśmayaḥ sapta pibantyambu mahārṇave / tenāhāreṇa tā dīptāḥ sūryāḥ sapta bhavantyuta
tataste raśmayaḥ sapta sūryā bhūtvā caturdiśam / caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ dahanti śikhinastathā
vyāpnuvantaśca te viprāstūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca raśmibhiḥ / dīpyante bhāskarāḥ sapta yugāntāgnipratāpinaḥ
te sūryā vāriṇā dīptā bahusāhastraraśmayaḥ / khaṃ samāvṛtya tiṣṭhanti nirdahanto vasuṃdharām
tatasteṣāṃ pratāpena dahyamānā vasuṃdharā / sādrinadyarṇavadvīpā nisnehā samapadyata
dīptābhiḥ saṃtatābhiśca raśmibhirvai samantataḥ / adhaścordhvaṃ ca lagnābhistiryak caiva samāvṛtam
sūryāgninā pramṛṣṭānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ parasparam / ekatvamupayātānāmekajvālaṃ bhavatyuta
sarvalokapraṇāśaśca so 'gnirbhūtvā sukuṇḍalī / caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ nirdahatyātmatejasā
tataḥ pralīne sarvasmiñ jaṅgame sthāvare tathā / nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmiḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhā prakāśate
ambarīṣamivābhāti sarvamāpūritaṃ jagat / sarvameva tadarcirbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ jājvalyate punaḥ
pātāle yāni sattvāni mahodadhigatāni ca / tatastāni pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca
dvīpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva varṣāṇyatha mahodadhīn / tān sarvān bhasmasāt kṛtvā saptātmā pāvakaḥ prabhuḥ
samudrebhyo nadībhyaśca pātālebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ / pibannapaḥ samiddho 'gniḥ pṛthivīmāśrito jvalan
tataḥ saṃvartakaḥ śailānatikramya mahāṃstathā / lokān dahati dīptātmā rudratejovijṝmbhitaḥ
sa dagdhvā pṛthivīṃ devo rasātalamaśoṣayat / adhastāt pṛthivīṃ dagdhvā divamūrdhvaṃ dahiṣyati
yojanānāṃ śatānīha sahasrāṇyayutāni ca / uttiṣṭhanti śikhāstasya vahneḥ saṃvartakasya tu
gandharvāṃśca piśācāṃśca sayakṣoragarākṣasān / tadā dahatyasau dīptaḥ kālarudrapracoditaḥ
bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca tathā mahaḥ / dahedaśeṣaṃ kālāgniḥ kālo viśvatanuḥ svayam
vyāpteṣveteṣu lokeṣu tiryagūrdhvamathāgninā / tat tejaḥ samanuprāpya kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ / ayoguḍanibhaṃ sarvaṃ tadā caikaṃ prakāśate
tato gajakulonnādāstaḍidbhiḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ / uttiṣṭhanti tadā vyomni ghorāḥ saṃvartakā ghanāḥ
kecinnīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecit kumudasannibhāḥ / dhūmravarṇāstathā kecit kecit pītāḥ payodharāḥ
kecid rāsabhavarṇāstu lākṣārasanibhāstathā / śaṅkhakundanibhāścānye jātyañjananibhāḥ pare
manaḥ śilābhāstvanye ca kapotasadṛśāḥ pare / indragopanibhāḥ keciddharitālanibhāstathā / indracāpanibhāḥ keciduttiṣṭhanti ghanā divi
kecit parvatasaṃkāśāḥ kecid gajakulopamāḥ / kūṭāṅgāranibhāścānye kecinmīnakulodvahāḥ / bahūrūpā ghorūpā ghorasvaraninādinaḥ
tadā jaladharāḥ sarve pūrayanti nabhaḥ sthalam / tataste jaladā ghorā rāviṇo bhāskarātmajāḥ / saptadhā saṃvṛtātmānastamagniṃ śamayantyuta
tataste jaladā varṣaṃ muñcantīha mahaughavat / sughoramaśivaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayanti ca pāvakam
pravṛṣṭe ca tadātyarthamambhasā pūryate jagat / adbhistejobhibhūtatvāt tadāgniḥ praviśatyapaḥ
naṣṭe cāgnau varṣaśataiḥ payodāḥ kṣayasaṃbhavāḥ / plāvayanto 'tha bhuvanaṃ mahājalaparistravaiḥ
dhārābhiḥ pūrayantīdaṃ codyamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā / atyantasalilaughaiśca velā iva mahodadhiḥ
sādridvīpā tathā pṛthvī jalaiḥ saṃcchādyate śanaiḥ / ādityaraśmibhiḥ pītaṃ jalamabhreṣu tiṣṭhati / punaḥ patati tad bhūmau pūryante tena cārṇavāḥ
tataḥ samudrāḥ svāṃ velāmatikrāntāstu kṛtsnaśaḥ / parvatāśca vilīyante mahī cāpsu nimajjati
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / yoganindrāṃ samāsthāya śete devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
caturyugasahasrāntaṃ kalpamāhurmaharṣayaḥ / vārāho vartate kalpo yasya vistāra īritaḥ
asaṃkhyātāstathā kalpā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ / kathitā hi purāṇeṣu munibhiḥ kālacintakaiḥ
sāttvikeṣvatha kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ / tāmaseṣu harasyoktaṃ rājaseṣu prajāpateḥ
yo 'yaṃ pravartate kalpo vārāhaḥ sāttviko mataḥ / anye ca sāttvikāḥ kalpā mama teṣu parigrahaḥ
dhyānaṃ tapastathā jñānaṃ labdhvā teṣveva yoginaḥ / ārādhya giriśaṃ māṃ ca yānti tat paramaṃ padam
so 'haṃ sattvaṃ samāsthāya māyī māyāmayīṃ svayam / ekārṇave jagatyasmin yoganidrāṃ vrajāmi tu
māṃ paśyanti mahātmānaḥ suptaṃ kālaṃ maharṣayaḥ / janaloke vartamānāstapasā yogacakṣuṣā
ahaṃ purāṇapuruṣo bhūrbhuvaḥ prabhavo vibhuḥ / sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān sahasrāṃśuḥ sahasradṛk
mantro 'gnirbrāhmiṇā gāvaḥ kuśāśca samidho hyaham / prokṣaṇī ca śruvaścaiva somo ghṛtamathāsmyaham
saṃvartako mahānātmā pavitraṃ paramaṃ yaśaḥ / vedo vedyaṃ prabhurgoptā gopatirbrahmaṇo mukham
anantastārako yogī gatirgatimatāṃ varaḥ / haṃsaḥ prāṇo 'tha kapilo viśvamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ
kṣetrajñaḥ prakṛtiḥ kālo jagadbījamathāmṛtam / mātā pitā mahādevo matto hyanyanna vidyate
ādityavarṇo bhuvanasya goptā nārāyaṇaḥ puruṣo yogamūrtiḥ / māṃ paśyanti yatayo yoganiṣṭhā jñātvātmānamamṛtatvaṃ vrajanti
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ kūrma uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratisargamanuttamam / prākṛtaṃ hi samāsena śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama
gate parārdhadvitaye kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / kālāgnirbhasmasāt kartuṃ karoti nikilaṃ matim
svātmanyātmānamāveśya bhūtvā devo maheśvaraḥ / dahedaśeṣaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
tamāviśya mahādevo bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ / karoti lokasaṃhāraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ
praviśya maṇḍalaṃ sauraṃ kṛtvāsau bahudhā punaḥ / nirdahatyakhilaṃ lokaṃ saptasaptisvarūpadhṛk
sa dagdhvā sakalaṃ sattvamastraṃ brahmaśiro mahat / devatānāṃ śarīreṣu kṣipatyakhiladāhakam
dagdheṣvaśeṣadeveṣu devī girivarātmajā / ekāsā sākṣiṇī śaṃbhostiṣṭhate vaidikī śrutiḥ
śiraḥ kapālairdevānāṃ kṛtastragvarabhūṣaṇaḥ / ādityacandrādigaṇaiḥ pūrayan vyomamaṇḍalam
sahasranayano devaḥ sahasrākṛtiriśvaraḥ / sahasrahastacaraṇaḥ sahasrārcirmahābhujaḥ
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ pradīptānalalocanaḥ / triśūlī kṛttivasano yogamaiśvaramāsthitaḥ
pītvā tatparamānandaṃ prabhūtamamṛtaṃ svayam / karoti tāṇḍavaṃ devīmālokya parameśvaraḥ
pītvā nṛttāmṛtaṃ devī bhartuḥ paramamaṅgalā / yogamāsthāya devasya dehamāyāti śūlinaḥ
saṃtyaktvā tāṇḍavarasaṃ svecchayaiva pinākadhṛk / jyotiḥ svabhāvaṃ bhagavān dagdhvā brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam
saṃsthiteṣvatha deveṣu brahmaviṣṇupinākiṣu / guṇairaśeṣaiḥ pṛthivīvilayaṃ yāti vāriṣu
sa vāritattvaṃ saguṇaṃ grasate havyavāhanaḥ / tejastu guṇasaṃyuktaṃ vāyau saṃyāti saṃkṣayam
ākāśe saguṇo vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti viśvabhṛt / bhūtādau ca tathākāśaṃ līyate guṇasaṃyutam
indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi taijase yānti saṃkṣayam / vaikārike devagaṇāḥ pralaṃya yānti sattamāḥ
vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiśceti sattamāḥ / trividho 'yamahaṅkāro mahati pralaṃya vrajet
mahāntamebhiḥ sahitaṃ brahmāṇamatitejasam / avyaktaṃ jagato yoniḥ saṃharedekamavyayam
evaṃ saṃhṛtya bhūtāni tattvāni ca maheśvaraḥ / viyojayati cānyonyaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ param
pradhānapuṃsorajayoreṣa saṃhāra īritaḥ / maheśvarecchājanito na svayaṃ vidyate layaḥ
guṇasāmyaṃ tadavyaktaṃ prakṛtiḥ parigīyate / pradhānaṃ jagato yonirmāyātattvamacetanam
kūṭasthaścinmayo hyātmā kevalaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ / gīyate munibhiḥ sākṣī mahānekaḥ pitāmahaḥ
evaṃ saṃhārakaraṇī śaktirmāheśvarī dhruvā / pradhānādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ dahed rudra iti śrutiḥ
yogināmatha sarveṣāṃ jñānavinyastacetasām / ātyantikaṃ caiva layaṃ vidadhātīha śaṅkaraḥ
ityeṣa bhagavān rudraḥ saṃhāraṃ kurute vaśī / sthāpikā mohanī śaktirnārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
hiraṇyagarbhā bhagavān jagat sadasadātmakam / sṛjedaśeṣaṃ prakṛtestanmayaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
sarvajñāḥ sarvagāḥ śāntāḥ svātmanyevavyavasthitāḥ / śaktayo brahmaviṇvīśā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ
sarveśvarāḥ sarvavandyāḥ śāśvatānantabhoginaḥ / ekamevākṣaraṃ tattvaṃ puṃpradhāneśvarātmakam
anyāśca śaktayo divyāḥ santi tatra sahasraśaḥ / ijyante vividhairyajñaiḥ śakrādityādayo 'marāḥ
ekaikasya sahasrāṇi dehānāṃ vai śatāni ca / kathyante caiva māhātmyācchaktirekaiva nirguṇāḥ
tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samādhāya svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / karoti dehān vividhān grasate caiva līlayā
ijyate sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇairvedavādibhiḥ / sarvakāmaprado rudra ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ
sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / prādhānyena smṛtā devāḥ śaktayaḥ paramātmanaḥ
ādyaḥ parastād bhagavān paramātmā sanātanaḥ / gīyate sarvaśaktyātmā śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ
enameke vadantyagniṃ nārāyaṇamathāpare / indrameke pare viśvān brahmāṇamapare jaguḥ
brahmaviṣṇavagnivaruṇāḥ sarve devāstatharṣayaḥ / ekasyaivātha rudrasya bhedāste parikīrtitāḥ
yaṃ yaṃ bhedaṃ samāśritya yajanti parameśvaram / tat tad rūpaṃ samāsthāya pradadāti phalaṃ śivaḥ
tasmādekataraṃ bhedaṃ samāśrityāpi śāśvatam / ārādhayanmahādevaṃ yāti tatparamaṃ padam
kintu devaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvaśaktiṃ sanātanam / ārādhayed vai giriśaṃ saguṇaṃ vātha nirguṇam
mayā prokto hi bhavatāṃ yogaḥ prāgeva nirguṇaḥ / ārurukṣustu saguṇaṃ pūjayet parameśvaram
pinākinaṃ trinayanaṃ jaṭilaṃ kṛttivāsasam / padmāsanasthaṃ rukmābhaṃ cintayed vaidikī śrutiḥ
eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo munisattamāḥ / tasmāt sarvān parityajya devān brahmapurogamān / ārādhayed virūpākṣamādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam
bhaktiyogasamāyuktaḥ svadharmanirataḥ śuciḥ / tādṛśaṃ rūpamāsthāya samāyātyantikaṃ śivam
eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo 'tyantabhāvane / yathāvidhi prakurvāṇaḥ prāpnuyādaiśvaraṃ padam
atrāpyaśakto 'tha haraṃ viṣṇuṃ bahmāṇamarcayet / atha cedasamarthaḥ syāt tatrāpi munipuṅgavāḥ / tato vāyvagniśakrādīn pūjayed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ
ye cānye bhāvane śuddhe prāgukte bhavatāmiha / athāpi kathito yogo nirbojaśca sabījakaḥ
jñānaṃ taduktaṃ nirbojaṃ pūrvaṃ hi bhavatāṃ mayā / viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ virañciṃ ca sabījaṃ bhāvayed budhaḥ / sathavāgnyādikān devāṃstatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
pūjayet puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ caturmūrtidharaṃ harim / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyonimākāśaṃ paramaṃ padam / talliṅgadhārī niyataṃ tadbhaktastadapāśrayaḥ / eṣa eva vidhirbrāhme bhāvane cāntike mataḥ
ityetat kathitaṃ jñānaṃ bhāvanāsaṃśrayaṃ param / indradyumnāya munaye kathitaṃ yanmayā purā
avyaktātmakamevedaṃ cetanācetanaṃ jagat / tadīśvaraḥ paraṃ brahma tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat
sūta uvāca etāvaduktvā bhagavān virarāma janārdanaḥ / tuṣṭuvurmunayo viṣṇuṃ śakreṇa saha mādhavam
munaya ūcuḥ namaste kūrmarūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane / nārāyaṇāya viśvāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ
namo namaste kṛṣṇāya govindāya namo namaḥ / mādhavāya namastubhyaṃ namo yajñeśvarāya ca
sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ / namaḥ sahasrahastāya sahasracaraṇāya ca
oṃ namo jñānarūpāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe / ānandāya namastubhyaṃ māyātītāya te namaḥ
namo gūḍhaśarīrāya nirguṇāya namo 'stu te / puruṣāya purāṇāya sattāmātrasvarūpiṇe
namaḥ sāṃkhyāya yogāya kevalāya namo 'stu te / dharmajñānādhigamyāya niṣkalāya namo namaḥ
namostu vyomatattvāya mahāyogeśvarāya ca / parāvarāṇāṃ prabhave vedavedyāya te namaḥ
namo buddhāya śuddhāya namo yuktāya hetave / namo namo namastubhyaṃ māyine vedhase namaḥ
namo 'stu te varāhāya nārasiṃhāya te namaḥ / vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ hṛṣīkeśāya te namaḥ
namo 'stu kālarudrāya kālarūpāya te namaḥ / svargāpavargadātre ca namo 'pratihatātmane
namo yogādhigamyāya yogine yogadāyine / devānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ devārtiśamanāya te
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena sarvasaṃsāranāśanam / asmābhirviditaṃ jñānaṃ yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute
śrutāstu vividhā dharmā vaṃśā manvantarāṇi ca / sargaśca pratisargaśca brahmāṇyasyāsya vistaraḥ
tvaṃ hi sarvajagatsākṣī viśvo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ / trātumarhasyanantātmaṃstvameva śaraṇaṃ gatiḥ
sūta uvāca etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yogamokṣapradāyakam / kaurmaṃ purāṇamakhilaṃ yajjagāda gadādharaḥ
asmin purāṇe lakṣmyāstu saṃbhavaḥ kathitaḥ purā / mohāyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ vāsudevena yojanam
prajāpatīnāṃ sargastu varṇadharmāśca vṛttayaḥ / dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yathāvallakṣaṇaṃ śubham
pitāmahasya viṣṇośca maheśasya ca dhīmataḥ / ekatvaṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ ca viśeṣaścopavarṇitaḥ
bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ samācāraśca śobhanaḥ / varṇāśramāṇāṃ kathitaṃ yathāvadiha lakṣaṇam
ādisargastataḥ paścādaṇḍāvaraṇasaptakam / hiraṇyagarbhasargaśca kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ
kālasaṃkhyāprakathanaṃ māhātmyaṃ ceśvarasya ca / brahmaṇaḥ śayanaṃ cāpsu nāmanirvacanaṃ tathā
varāhavapuṣā bhūyo bhūmeruddharaṇaṃ punaḥ / mukhyādisargakathanaṃ munisargastathāparaḥ
vyākhyato rudrasargaśca ṛṣisargaśca tāpasaḥ / dharmasya ca prajāsargastāmasāt pūrvameva tu
brahmaviṣṇuvivādaḥ syādantardehapraveśanam / padmodbhavatvaṃ devasya mohastasya ca dhīmataḥ
darśanaṃ ca maheśasya māhātmyaṃ viṣṇuneritam / divyadṛṣṭipradānaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
saṃstavo devadevasya brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / prasādo giriśasyātha varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
saṃvādo viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ / varadānaṃ tathāpūrvamantardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ
vadhaśca kathito viprā madhukaiṭabhayoḥ purā / avatāro 'tha devasya brahmaṇo nābhipaṅkajāt
ekībhāvaśca devasya viṣṇunā kathitastataḥ / vimoho brahmaṇaścātha saṃjñālābho harestataḥ
tapaścaraṇamākhyātaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / prādurbhāvo maheśasya lalāṭāt kathitastataḥ
rudrāṇāṃ kathitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇaḥ pratiṣedhanam / bhūtiśca devadevasya varadānopadeśakau
antardhānaṃ ca rudrasya tapaścaryāṇḍajasya ca / darśanaṃ devadevasya naranārīśarīratā
devyā vibhāgakathanaṃ devadevāt pinākinaḥ / devyāstu paścāt kathitaṃ dakṣaputrītvameva ca
himavadduhitṛtvaṃ ca devyā māhātmyameva ca / darśanaṃ divyarūpasya vaiśvarūpasya darśanam
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kathitaṃ pitrā himavatā svayam / upadeśo mahādevyā varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
bhṛgvādīnāṃ prajāsargo rājñāṃ vaṃśasya vistaraḥ / prācetasatvaṃ dakṣasya dakṣayajñavimardanam
dadhīcasya ca dakṣasya vivādaḥ kathitastadā / tataśca śāpaḥ kathito munīnāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
rudrāgatiḥ prasādaśca antardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ / pitāmahasyopadeśaḥ kīrtyate rakṣaṇāya tu
dakṣasya ca prajāsargaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ / hiraṇyakaśipornāśo hiraṇyākṣavadhastathā
tataśca śāpaḥ kathito devadāruvanaukasām / nigrahaścāndhakasyātha gāṇapatyamanuttamam
prahrādanigrahaścātha baleḥ saṃyamanaṃ tataḥ / bāṇasya nigrahaścātha prasādastasya śūlinaḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ vaṃśavistāro rājñāṃ vaṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / vasudevāt tato viṣṇorutpattiḥ svecchayā hareḥ
darśanaṃ copamanyorvai tapaścaraṇameva ca / varalābho mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmbaṃ trilocanam
kailāsagamanaṃ cātha nivāsastatra śārṅgiṇaḥ / tataśca kathyate bhītirdvārivatyā nivāsinām
rakṣaṇaṃ garuḍenātha jitvā śatrūn mahābalān / nārādāgamanaṃ caiva yātrā caiva garutmataḥ
tataśca kṛṣṇāgamanaṃ munīnāmāgatistataḥ / naityakaṃ vāsudevasya śivaliṅgārcanaṃ tathā
mārkaṇḍeyasya ca muneḥ praśnaḥ proktastataḥ param / liṅgārcananimittaṃ ca liṅgasyāpi saliṅginaḥ
yathātmyakathanaṃ cātha liṅgāvirbhāva eva ca / brahmaviṣṇostathā madhye kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ
mohastayostu kathito gamanaṃ cordhvato 'pyadhaḥ / saṃstavo devadevasya prasādaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
antardhānaṃ ca liṅgasya sāmbotpattistataḥ param / kīrtitā cāniruddhasya samutpattirdvijottamāḥ
kṛṣṇasya gamane buddhirṛṣīṇāmāgatistathā / anuvaśāsitaṃ ca kṛṣṇena varadānaṃ mahātmanaḥ
gamanaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya pārthasyāpi ca darśanam / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasyoktā yugadharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
anugraho 'tha pārthasya vārāṇasīgatistataḥ / pārāśaryasya ca munervyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ
vāraṇasyāśca māhātmyaṃ tīrthānāṃ caiva varṇanam / tīrthayātrā ca vyāsasya devyāścaivātha darśanam / udvāsanaṃ ca kathitaṃ varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ kṣetrāṇāmatha kīrtinam / phalaṃ ca vipulaṃ viprā mārkaṇḍeyasya nirgamaḥ
bhuvanānāṃ svarūpaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ ca niveśanam / kīrtyante caiva varṣāṇi nadīnāṃ caiva nirṇayaḥ
parvatānāṃ ca kathanaṃ sthānāni ca divaukasām / dvīpānāṃ pravibhāgaśca śvetadvīpopavarṇanam
śayanaṃ keśavasyātha māhātmyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ / manvantarāṇāṃ kathanaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca
vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ vyāsānāṃ kathanaṃ tataḥ / avedasya ca vedānāṃ kathanaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
yogeśvarāṇāṃ ca kathā śiṣyāṇāṃ cātha kīrtanam / gītāśca vividhāguhyā īśvarasyātha kīrtitāḥ
varṇāśramāṇāmācārāḥ prāyaścittavidhistataḥ / kapālitvaṃ ca rudrasya bhikṣācaraṇameva ca
pativratāyāścākhyānaṃ tīrthānāṃ ca vinirṇayaḥ / tathā maṅkaṇakasyātha nigrahaḥ kīrtyate dvijāḥ
vadhaśca kathito viprāḥ kālasya ca samāsataḥ / devadāruvane śaṃbhoḥ praveśo mādhavasya ca
darśanaṃ ṣaṭkulīyānāṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / varadānaṃ ca devasya nandine tu prakīrtitam
naimittikastu kathitaḥ pratisargastataḥ param / prākṛtaḥ pralayaścordhvaṃ sabījo yoga eva ca
evaṃ jñātvā purāṇasya saṃkṣepaṃ kīrtayet tu yaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
evamuktvā śriyaṃ devīmādāya puruṣottamaḥ / saṃtyajya kūrmasaṃsthānaṃ svasthānaṃ ca jagāma ha
devāśca sarve munayaḥ svāni sthānāni bhejire / praṇamya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ gṛhītvā hyamṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
etat purāṇaṃ paramaṃ bhāṣitaṃ kūrmarūpiṇā / sākṣād devādidenena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā
yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ martyo niyamena samāhitaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
likhitvā caiva yo dadyād vaiśākhe māsi suvrataḥ / viprāya vedaviduṣe tasya puṇyaṃ nibodhata
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ / bhuktvā ca vipulānsvarge bhogāndivyānsuśobhanān
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo viprāṇāṃ jāyate kule / pūrvasaṃskāramāhātmyād brahmavidyāmavāpnuyāt
paṭhitvādhyāyamevaikaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / yor'thaṃ vicārayet samyak sa prāpnoti paraṃ padam
adhyetavyamidaṃ nityaṃ vipraiḥ parvaṇi parvaṇi / śrotavyaṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhā mahāpātakanāśanam
ekatastu purāṇāni setihāsāni kṛtsnaśaḥ / ekatra cedaṃ paramametadevātiricyate
dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ jñānanaipuṇyakāminām / idaṃ purāṇaṃ muktvaikaṃ nāstyanyat sādhanaṃ param
yathāvadatra bhagavān devo nārāyaṇo hariḥ / kathyate hi yathā viṣṇurna tathānyeṣu suvratāḥ
brāhmī paurāṇikī ceyaṃ saṃhitā pāpanāśanī / atra tat paramaṃ brahma kīrtyate hi yathārthataḥ
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ tapaḥ / jñānānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ vratam
nādhyetavyamidaṃ śāstraṃ vṛṣalasya ca sannidhau / yo 'dhīte sa tu mohātmā sa yāti narakān bahūn
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye śrāvaṇīyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ / yajñānte tu viśeṣeṇa sarvadoṣaviśodhanam
mumukṣūṇāmidaṃ śāstramadhyetavyaṃ viśeṣataḥ / śrotavyaṃ cātha mantavyaṃ vedārthaparibṛṃhaṇam
jñātvā yathāvad viprendrān śrāvayed bhaktisaṃyutān / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt
yo 'śraddadhāne puruṣe dadyāccādhārmike tathā / sa pretya gatvā nirayān śunāṃ yoniṃ vrajatyadhaḥ
namaskṛtvā hariṃ viṣṇuṃ jagadyoniṃ sanātanam / adhyetavyamidaṃ śāstraṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ tathā
ityājñā devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / pārāśaryasya viprarṣervyāsasya ca mahātmanaḥ
śrutvā nārāyaṇād divyāṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ / gautamāya dadau pūrvaṃ tasmāccaiva parāśaraḥ
parāśaro 'pi bhagavāna gaṅgādvāre munīśvarāḥ / munibhyaḥ kathayāmāsa dharmakāmārthamokṣadam
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sanakāya ca dhīmate / sanatkumārāya tathā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
sanakād bhagavān sākṣād devalo yogavittamaḥ / avāptavān pañcaśikho devalādidamuttamam
sanatkumārād bhagavān muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / lebhe purāṇaṃ paramaṃ vyāsaḥ sarvārthasaṃcayam
tasmād vyāsādahaṃ śrutvā bhavatāṃ pāpanāśanam / ūcivān vai bhavadbhiśca dātavyaṃ dhārmike jane
tasmai vyāsāya gurave sarvajñāya maharṣaye / pārāśaryāya śāntāya namo nārāyaṇātmane
yasmāt saṃjāyate kṛtsanaṃ yatra caiva pralīyate / namastasmai sureśāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe
